name: Salary arrival and financial planning
description: On January 15, payday, Feng Haoran received his January basic salary and performance bonus from Huatai Securities totaling about 21,000 yuan. At his desk at home, he opened mobile banking and allocated the funds to three accounts: 10,000 yuan to a savings account as emergency reserve, 8,000 yuan to an investment account for future wealth management, and the remaining 3,000 yuan as this month's living and consumption budget. He also reviewed last month's expenses, found that dining and transportation costs were relatively high, and decided to control them appropriately this month.

subevent.name: Received salary and performance notification.
subevent.description: On the morning of January 15, 2025, Feng Haoran received his January basic salary and performance bonus totaling about 21,000 yuan from Huatai Securities via mobile banking in his home study. He checked the pay details and confirmed the amount was correct.

subevent.name: Allocate salary to three accounts
subevent.description: Feng Haoran sat at his desk at home, opened the mobile banking app, and allocated the 21,000 yuan he had just received: 10,000 yuan was transferred to a savings account as an emergency reserve, 8,000 yuan was transferred to an investment account for subsequent wealth management, and the remaining 3,000 yuan was kept in the current account as the living and consumption budget for this month.

subevent.name: Review last month's spending details
subevent.description: Feng Haoran checked his December spending records in mobile banking. After analyzing item by item, he found that his expenses on dining and transportation last month were higher than budgeted, exceeding the budget by about 500 yuan and 300 yuan, respectively.

subevent.name: Make a spending control plan for this month
subevent.description: Based on last month's spending analysis, Feng Haoran decided to strictly control dining and transportation this month: the dining budget was reduced from 1,500 yuan to 1,200 yuan, and transportation costs from 800 yuan to 600 yuan. He plans to achieve this by bringing lunch from home and walking more.

name: Video-called younger sister to discuss Spring Festival arrangements.
description: On the evening of January 12, Feng Haoran had a nearly one-hour video call with his younger sister Feng Xinran, who is in Shanghai, via WeChat. They discussed the specific date and train tickets for returning home during the Spring Festival, and especially mentioned their mother’s recent weight loss, agreeing to take her for a medical checkup together after returning home. His sister also shared stories about her new job and life in Shanghai, and the sibling bond grew stronger through the conversation.

subevent.name: Initiated a video call
subevent.description: At 7 p.m., Feng Haoran contacted his sister Feng Xinran, who was in Shanghai, via WeChat video from his home in Changsha. They asked about each other's recent situation, chatted about daily life and weather changes, and created a relaxed atmosphere for the in-depth discussion that followed.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Discussing plans to go home for Spring Festival
subevent.description: Feng Haoran and his sister discussed over video the specific dates for returning to their hometown in Wuhan for the 2025 Spring Festival, preliminarily set the departure times from their respective cities (Changsha and Shanghai), and discussed channels and backup plans for buying train tickets to ensure they could both arrive in Wuhan on the same day.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Discuss mother's physical examination matters
subevent.description: Feng Haoran mentioned that his mother Li Xiuying has looked thinner in recent video calls. He and his younger sister Feng Xinran are both worried about their mother's health. They agreed that after returning to Wuhan for the Spring Festival, they will take their mother to a tertiary hospital in Jiangan District, Wuhan for a comprehensive check-up, and the sister will be responsible for registering the appointment in advance.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: My younger sister shared updates on her work and life.
subevent.description: Feng Xinran shared with her brother via video call the fun aspects of her work as a marketing specialist at a new internet company in Shanghai, including team atmosphere, project challenges, and the cafes and exhibitions she had recently explored in Shanghai. Feng Haoran also shared his daily life in Changsha and his photography works. The siblings encouraged each other and agreed to meet during the Spring Festival and take more photos. The call lasted about an hour with a pleasant atmosphere.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Watch a science fiction movie
description: On the evening of February 23, Feng Haoran and his close friend Peng Yuqing watched the re-release of the sci-fi film 'Interstellar' at Changsha Wanda Cinema. The two first had dinner at a Hunan restaurant near the cinema, then watched the movie, and afterwards discussed black hole theory and investment risk control. This outing relaxed his mind and deepened his connection with his friend.

subevent.name: Buy movie tickets and arrange to meet.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran bought two tickets online through a mobile app for that night's re-release of Interstellar, and via WeChat agreed with his friend Peng Yuqing to have dinner first at a Hunan restaurant near Changsha Wanda Cinema at 6:30 p.m., then watch the movie together.

subevent.name: Have dinner together
subevent.description: Feng Haoran and Peng Yuqing had dinner at a Hunan restaurant near Changsha Wanda Cinema. They ordered Hunan dishes such as chopped pepper fish head and stir-fried pork with green peppers, chatting about recent work and life while eating, in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
subevent.location: Hunan restaurant near Wanda Cinema, Changsha

subevent.name: Watch a science fiction movie
subevent.description: After dinner, Feng Haoran and Peng Yuqing entered the IMAX hall at Wanda Cinema together and watched the newly released re-release of 'Interstellar'. The two were captivated by the film's stunning visual effects and profound scientific themes.

subevent.name: Movie discussion and exchange
subevent.description: After the movie, Feng Haoran and Peng Yuqing discussed scientific concepts such as black hole theory and time dilation in the cinema lounge, and related them to investment risk control. Feng Haoran shared how he uses probabilistic thinking to avoid risks in financial investment, while Peng Yuqing shared new media strategies for disseminating technology content. The two had an in-depth exchange of insights from their respective fields.

name: Signed the coffee shop branch investment contract with Shen Xinyi and resolved the decoration disagreement.
description: From July 8 to 12, Feng Haoran and Shen Xinyi conducted final negotiations on the coffee branch investment and signed an investment agreement: investing 150,000 yuan for a 15% stake. During the process, the two still had disagreements over decoration style, material procurement, and opening pace. Feng Haoran advocated a quick launch, while Shen Xinyi insisted on cost control. After repeated adjustment, they reached a compromise, the contract details were finalized, and the branch entered the renovation stage.

subevent.name: Preliminary negotiation for a coffee branch investment
subevent.description: Feng Haoran had his first face-to-face negotiation with Shen Xinyi at Xinyi Hand-Drip Coffee Shop in Changsha regarding the investment in a coffee branch. The two discussed the investment amount, shareholding ratio, and cooperation model. Feng Haoran proposed an initial plan of investing 150,000 yuan for a 15% stake, and Shen Xinyi said she needed to further consider the issue of cost control.

subevent.name: Discussion on Decoration Style and Purchasing Differences
subevent.description: Feng Haoran and Shen Xinyi had an in-depth discussion at a café about the branch's renovation style, material procurement, and opening pace. Feng Haoran advocated for a quick launch with a modern minimalist style, while Shen Xinyi insisted on cost control and preferred a warm retro style. The two did not reach an agreement and decided to discuss it again the next day.

subevent.name: Reached a compromise renovation plan
subevent.description: After communications over the previous two days, Feng Haoran and Shen Xinyi negotiated again and finally reached a compromise: the overall design would adopt a modern minimalist style, but with retro elements incorporated into some details; for materials procurement, Shen Xinyi would provide a list of suppliers, and Feng Haoran would help optimize costs; the opening would be rolled out in phases.

subevent.name: Sign the investment agreement.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran and Shen Xinyi formally signed the coffee branch investment agreement under the witness of the law firm. Feng Haoran invested 150,000 yuan in one lump sum and obtained 15% of the shares. The contract clarified the rights and obligations of both parties, profit distribution, and exit mechanism, with all details finalized.

subevent.name: Coffee branch renovation starts.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran and Shen Xinyi went together to the branch store site, confirmed that the decoration construction team entered the site and started the renovation project. The two communicated on the decoration schedule and acceptance standards, and Feng Haoran said he would continue to keep an eye on the progress.

name: April financial review and credit card repayment plan optimization
description: From April 28 to 30, Feng Haoran conducted a comprehensive review of April income and expenses: total income from salary and rent was 22,200 yuan, while total expenditure including medical expenses, loans, and daily consumption was about 35,000 yuan, resulting in a deficit for the month. To bridge the liquidity gap, he adjusted his credit card bill into installments, paying off this month's 18,000 yuan credit card debt in three installments, and decided to reduce non-essential spending starting in May.

subevent.name: Compile April income data
subevent.description: Feng Haoran, in his study at home in Changsha, logged into the banking app and payroll system, aggregated April salary income of 18,000 yuan and rental income of 4,200 yuan, confirmed total income of 22,200 yuan, and recorded it in his personal financial ledger.

subevent.name: Compile April expenditure data
subevent.description: In his study at home in Changsha, Feng Haoran checked credit card statements, WeChat Pay and Alipay records line by line, sorting out April medical expenses of 8,000 yuan, a loan to a friend of 5,000 yuan, daily consumption of 22,000 yuan, etc. He confirmed total spending of about 35,000 yuan and found a deficit for the month.

subevent.name: Analyze Financial Deficit and Repayment Plan
subevent.description: In his study at home in Changsha, Feng Haoran compared the income and expenditure data for April and confirmed a deficit of about 12,800 yuan for the month, assessing the liquidity gap. He decided to apply to repay this month’s 18,000 yuan credit card debt in three installments to ease short-term cash pressure, and recorded the key points of the plan.

subevent.name: Apply for credit card bill installment
subevent.description: Feng Haoran, in his study at home in Changsha, submitted a credit card bill installment application of 18,000 yuan through the bank's mobile app, chose to repay in 3 installments, confirmed the installment fee and submitted, waiting for bank review.

subevent.name: Formulate a May budget and spending reduction plan
subevent.description: In his home study in Changsha, Feng Haoran, based on the lesson of April's deficit, formulated a May budget: reduce non-essential spending (such as eating out, coffee, entertainment), set a monthly routine expense cap of 15,000 yuan, and list priority projects to protect (rent, transportation, basic food).

name: Attended advanced latte art class, learned leaf pattern
description: On the morning of July 26, Feng Haoran confirmed the time for the afternoon advanced latte art class with Shen Xinyi via WeChat and organized the equipment to bring. From 2 p.m. to 4 p.m., he learned leaf pattern latte art at Xinyi Hand-Drip Coffee. He produced stable results after the second attempt; although not perfect, the improvement was obvious.

subevent.name: Course reservation and travel preparation
subevent.description: On the morning of July 26, Feng Haoran confirmed via WeChat with Shen Xinyi the time of that afternoon's advanced latte art class at 'Xinyi Pour-over Coffee Shop', and prepared his personal latte art equipment and camera.

subevent.name: Advanced latte art course
subevent.description: From 2 pm to 4 pm, Feng Haoran attended an advanced latte art class at ‘Xinyi Hand-Drip Coffee’ on Jiefang West Road, Furong District, Changsha. Under the guidance of Shen Xinyi, he learned the leaf pattern latte art technique. After the second attempt, he could produce the pattern steadily. Although not perfect, the progress was obvious. During the session, they exchanged ideas on coffee culture and hand-drip brewing.
subevent.location: Changsha - Furong District - Xinyi Pour-Over Coffee Shop

name: Learned pour-over coffee with Shen Xinyi, and their friendship grew warmer
description: On the afternoon of June 13, Feng Haoran arrived at Xinyi Café as promised to attend a pour-over and latte art experience class personally instructed by Shen Xinyi. This was his first time trying latte art. Although he was flustered and only managed to make a lopsided heart-shaped latte, Shen Xinyi patiently corrected his technique and shared the story of Yunnan coffee beans. After class, the two talked about the equity participation plan, and Shen Xinyi expressed confidence in the cooperation. Feng Haoran took a photo of his work and posted it on Moments, jokingly calling it the "third career path." This interaction deepened their mutual trust and understanding.

subevent.name: Go to Xinyi Cafe
subevent.description: On the afternoon of June 13, Feng Haoran set out from home and walked to Xinyi Café on Jiefang West Road, Furong District, Changsha, to attend a hand-drip coffee and latte art experience class personally guided by Shen Xinyi.
subevent.location: On the way from home in Yuelu District, Changsha to Furong District.

subevent.name: Attend a pour-over coffee and latte art experience class
subevent.description: Feng Haoran was at Xinyi Café, learning pour-over coffee and latte art techniques under the guidance of the owner Shen Xinyi. It was Feng Haoran's first attempt at latte art; although he only produced a crooked heart shape, Shen Xinyi patiently corrected his hand movements and shared the story of Yunnan coffee beans. The lesson was relaxed and enjoyable.

subevent.name: After-class discussion of the shareholding plan
subevent.description: After the trial class ended, Feng Haoran and Shen Xinyi continued their conversation at a corner seat in the café. Shen Xinyi voluntarily brought up the matter of equity cooperation and expressed confidence in the partnership. The two discussed preliminary intentions such as investment amount and equity ratio in a harmonious atmosphere.

subevent.name: Post on WeChat Moments to share the experience
subevent.description: Feng Haoran took a photo of the lopsided heart-shaped latte he made, captioned it "The Third Career Path," and posted it to his WeChat Moments. It received likes and comments from friends. This further strengthened his friendship with Shen Xinyi and showed his interest in coffee culture.

name: Street photography on Yuelu Mountain and community sharing after weekend morning run
description: On the morning of July 20, after finishing his morning run, Feng Haoran took his camera to the foot of Yuelu Mountain for street photography, capturing early-morning vendors, elderly people exercising, and the gradually waking city. He combined his hobbies of running and photography, selected three photos, and uploaded them to a photography community, where they received positive feedback.

subevent.name: Early morning run on Yuelu Mountain.
subevent.description: On the morning of July 20, Feng Haoran set off from home and went for his daily morning run along Lushan South Road and the Yuelu Mountain trail, completing about 8 kilometers of jogging from approximately 6:00 to 7:00, fully warming up and enjoying the fresh morning air, storing up energy for the upcoming street photography activity.

subevent.name: Street photography at the foot of Yuelu Mountain
subevent.description: After the morning run, from about 7:00 to 8:00, Feng Haoran carried his DSLR camera for street photography on the streets at the foot of Yuelu Mountain, capturing vivid scenes of vendors setting up stalls, elderly people doing morning exercises, and the city gradually waking up. He used telephoto and wide-angle lenses to take multiple sets of photos.
subevent.location: Changsha - street at the foot of Yuelu Mountain.

subevent.name: Select works and upload to the photography community.
subevent.description: At around 8:00-9:00, Feng Haoran returned to his home study, carefully selected three of the most representative photos from the ones he took (including a close-up of a street vendor, the back view of an elderly person exercising in the morning, and a panoramic view of the city waking up), edited them with post-processing color grading, and uploaded them to the photography community, receiving likes and praise from group members.

name: Completed quarterly investment review and follow-up for client Huang Siqi
description: On July 15, Feng Haoran reported the second-quarter portfolio performance to Shenzhen client Huang Siqi via Tencent Meeting, analyzed the sources of excess returns, communicated the asset allocation adjustment plan for the second half of the year and received approval; after the meeting, organized the meeting minutes, created a formal document including adjustment plan and execution timeline, and sent it to the client for confirmation via encrypted email.

subevent.name: Held a quarterly investment review video conference
subevent.description: Feng Haoran connected with Shenzhen client Huang Siqi via Tencent video conferencing system, reported in detail on the second-quarter portfolio performance, analyzed the sources of excess returns (such as technology stock allocation and bond duration management), and discussed the asset allocation adjustment plan for the second half of the year (increasing the new energy sector and reducing real estate bonds), answered the client's questions, and gained the client's approval.

subevent.name: Organized meeting minutes and follow-up actions.
subevent.description: After the meeting, Feng Haoran organized the video meeting recording and notes, produced formal meeting minutes including the portfolio adjustment plan and implementation timeline, and sent them to Huang Siqi via encrypted email for confirmation.

name: Took a walk with parents on the riverside beach and had a family lunch, then returned to Changsha.
description: On the morning of April 20, Feng Haoran accompanied his parents for a walk along the Wuhan Riverside. He asked in detail about his mother's post-discharge dietary recovery, and discussed the family health management plan with his father. At noon, the family of three had lunch at a restaurant near the riverbank, enjoying his mother's favorite steamed sea bass and pork rib lotus root soup, with a warm atmosphere. After lunch, Feng Haoran took a high-speed rail back to Changsha. On the train, he used his phone notes to record the internet product thinking he had gained at the wedding, and highlighted the key words of the [Intelligent Investment Advisory Report Template]. This short visit comforted his concern for family in the midst of a busy schedule, and strengthened his belief in prioritizing family health.

subevent.name: Accompanying parents for a walk on the river beach
subevent.description: On the morning of April 20, 2025, Feng Haoran set out from his parents' home in Jiangan District, Wuhan, and accompanied them for a walk along the Wuhan Riverside. During the walk, he asked in detail about his mother Li Xiuying's post-discharge dietary recovery, and discussed the family health management plan with his father Feng Jianguo, including how to maintain the whole family's health through balanced meals and regular check-ups. The three walked along the riverside for about an hour, enjoying the river view in a warm atmosphere.

subevent.name: Family lunch with parents.
subevent.description: At noon on April 20, 2025, Feng Haoran accompanied his parents to lunch at a Hunan restaurant near the Wuhan riverbank. The family of three tasted the steamed sea bass and pork rib and lotus root soup that his mother liked, and Feng Haoran also ordered a few dishes his father loved. During the meal, the three chatted about family matters in a warm atmosphere. Feng Haoran once again reminded his parents to take care of their health and said he would return to Wuhan regularly to visit them. The lunch lasted about 1.5 hours.
subevent.location: Wuhan - a restaurant near the river beach

subevent.name: Taking the high-speed rail back to Changsha and taking notes
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 20, 2025, Feng Haoran said goodbye to his parents after lunch and took a high-speed train from Wuhan Station back to Changsha. During the approximately 1.5-hour ride, he used a mobile note-taking app to record the internet product thinking he had gained at the wedding earlier and highlighted the keywords of [Smart Investment Advisory Report Template], accumulating inspiration for his career development. Upon arriving in Changsha, he returned directly to his home in Yuelu District, ending the day's trip.
subevent.location: Wuhan City - Wuhan Station to Changsha City - home

name: Video call with my sister
description: On the evening of February 11, Feng Haoran had a video call with his sister Feng Xinran, who works in Shanghai. His sister shared interesting stories about her new job and bits of life in Shanghai, while Feng Haoran talked about his recent work stress and reminded his sister to pay attention to financial planning. The two agreed to go back to Wuhan together after the Spring Festival to visit their parents. The call lasted nearly an hour.

subevent.name: Confirm call time with younger sister
subevent.description: On the morning of February 11, Feng Haoran, at his home in Changsha, contacted his sister Feng Xinran, who works in Shanghai, via WeChat to confirm the schedule for a video call at 8 p.m. that evening. Both parties agreed on the time and adjusted their network devices in advance.
subevent.location: Home in Changsha, Hunan Province; home in Shanghai

subevent.name: Video call with my sister
subevent.description: On February 11 from 8 to 9 pm, Feng Haoran, at his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, had a video call with his younger sister Feng Xinran, who was far away in Pudong New Area, Shanghai. During the call, his sister shared funny stories about her new job and snippets of life in Shanghai. Feng Haoran confided about recent work pressure and reminded his sister to pay attention to financial planning. The two agreed to return to Wuhan together after the Spring Festival to visit their parents. The call lasted nearly an hour.
subevent.location: Home in Changsha, Hunan Province; home in Shanghai

name: Had a scheduled talk and candidly shared the dual pressures; after gaining understanding, worked out an efficiency improvement plan.
description: On July 13, Feng Haoran scheduled a meeting with his mentor Qian Yongqiang for the next day via WeChat Work. On the morning of the 14th, he organized case studies on distraction and talking points at his desk; in the afternoon, he frankly confided in Qian Yongqiang's office that the dual pressure of academics and work was causing a decline in efficiency. Qian expressed understanding but reminded him to optimize his time management. That evening, he returned home and, based on the feedback, formulated a time management plan for the next two weeks and decided to report progress regularly.

subevent.name: Schedule a communication time
subevent.description: Feng Haoran sent a message via WeChat Work to his direct supervisor Qian Yongqiang, requesting a face-to-face meeting on the afternoon of July 14 to discuss work and academic pressure. Qian Yongqiang confirmed the schedule.
subevent.location: Changsha City, Hunan Province - Huatai Securities Co., Ltd. Office

subevent.name: Prepared talking points.
subevent.description: On the morning of July 14, at his office workstation, Feng Haoran sorted out recent cases of distraction and data lag caused by the overlap of part-time graduate studies and work, listed the key points on which he wanted his advisor's advice, and formed a brief talking outline.
subevent.location: Changsha City, Hunan Province - Huatai Securities Co., Ltd. Office

subevent.name: Meeting with mentor Qian Yongqiang
subevent.description: On the afternoon of July 14, Feng Haoran had a face-to-face meeting of about 30 minutes with Qian Yongqiang in his private office. Feng Haoran frankly talked about his distraction and declining efficiency caused by the dual pressure of academic thesis and full-time work, and showed his recent work progress. Qian Yongqiang first expressed understanding of his situation, but also tactfully pointed out that Feng Haoran's work output in the past two weeks had lagged behind previous performance, reminding him to optimize time management and improve efficiency, and suggested breaking down academic tasks into fixed daily time slots.
subevent.location: Qian Yongqiang's office, Huatai Securities Co., Ltd., Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Post-interview review and planning
subevent.description: Back home that evening, Feng Haoran, incorporating Qian Yongqiang's feedback, reorganized his daily schedule in his notebook, reallocating time for morning runs, work, study, and rest, formulated a time management optimization plan for the next two weeks, and decided to report progress to his mentor regularly.
subevent.location: Home study, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Took night-scene photos at Houhu Lake with Xu Jianing and shared family reflections; afterwards, took the initiative to contact his sister and apologize.
description: On the evening of Saturday, June 28, 2025, Feng Haoran went to the Houhu International Art District in Changsha to do night scene photography with Xu Jianing. During a break in shooting, the two talked about family relationships by the lake. Feng Haoran admitted for the first time his regret over his harsh attitude toward his younger sister. After the gathering, he went home, reflected, and proactively sent a message to apologize to his sister, easing the relationship between the siblings.

subevent.name: Set out for Houhu Art District
subevent.description: After preparing his camera equipment at home, Feng Haoran drove off from his home on Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha at 6:30 p.m. to go to the appointment at Changsha Houhu International Art District. Before leaving, he confirmed the meeting time and place with Xu Jianing via WeChat, agreeing to meet at the east entrance of the art district.

subevent.name: Meet up with Xu Jianing and start night photography.
subevent.description: At 7 pm, Feng Haoran arrived at the east entrance of Houhu International Art District and met up with Xu Jianing, who had already been waiting there. After exchanging pleasantries, the two began nighttime street photography along the lakeside path. Xu Jianing used her camera to capture the city's light and shadows, while Feng Haoran used his DSLR to shoot the lake reflections and the art district's architecture. During the session, they frequently exchanged shooting techniques and composition insights.
subevent.location: Changsha - Lakeside walkway at Houhu International Art District

subevent.name: Resting on a lakeside bench and sharing reflections on family relationships
subevent.description: About an hour into the filming, the two sat down to rest on a bench by the lake. Xu Jianing first talked about the rift with her parents caused by her career choices. Feng Haoran was deeply moved and, for the first time, confessed to an outsider his regret over his cold attitude toward his younger sister Feng Xinran earlier this month, reflecting that as an older brother he often guided her with reason but ignored her feelings. Xu Jianing listened patiently and offered comfort, and the two shared their experiences of communicating with family.
subevent.location: Changsha - Lakeside rest area, Houhu International Art District

subevent.name: Continue shooting and end the gathering.
subevent.description: After resting for about half an hour, the two relaxed and continued taking night photos along the lake. On Xu Jianing's suggestion, Feng Haoran tried slow shutter shooting of the lake surface and got satisfactory shots. Around 10 p.m., they packed up their equipment, walked back to the east entrance, and said goodbye to each other. Feng Haoran promised to take Xu Jianing to his usual Hunan restaurant next time, and then they drove home separately.

subevent.name: After returning home, reflected and contacted younger sister
subevent.description: Feng Haoran returned home at 10:30 pm, washed up, and lay in bed reflecting on his conversation with Xu Jianing that evening. He took the initiative to send a WeChat message to his younger sister Feng Xinran, apologizing for his impatience at the beginning of the month and asking how she was doing. Feng Xinran quickly replied with understanding, and the siblings chatted for half an hour about work and life matters. Feng Haoran felt that the relationship had eased.

name: Quarterly review and adjustment of client investment portfolios
description: From May 6 to 8, Feng Haoran held video conferences with clients Huang Siqi and Lin Zhihao, reviewing Q2 investment portfolios, analyzing the impact of market volatility, and adjusting asset allocation ratios based on the latest macroeconomic data, optimizing the structure of equity and fixed-income holdings. After the meetings, he sent detailed asset allocation proposals separately and received positive feedback from clients.

subevent.name: Prepare quarterly review materials
subevent.description: In his company office in Changsha, Feng Haoran retrieved and analyzed the investment portfolio data of two clients, Huang Siqi and Lin Zhihao, as of the second quarter; combining recent market volatility and macroeconomic indicators, he compiled review points and preliminary adjustment ideas to prepare for the subsequent video conference.

subevent.name: Video meeting with Huang Siqi
subevent.description: Feng Haoran held a video call with client Huang Siqi via Tencent Meeting. They reviewed in detail the client's second-quarter investment portfolio, analyzed the impact of the market decline on equity assets, and reached a consensus on adjusting fixed-income positions. The meeting lasted about 40 minutes, and both sides confirmed the direction of asset allocation optimization.

subevent.name: Video conference with Lin Zhihao.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran held a video call with client Lin Zhihao via Tencent Meeting to assess the risks of the real-estate-related bonds he was heavily positioned in, and suggested reducing some highly volatile products and increasing cash management products. Lin Zhihao approved the plan, and both agreed to keep an eye on market changes.

subevent.name: Draft and send an asset allocation proposal.
subevent.description: Based on the discussion results of two video conferences, Feng Haoran wrote detailed asset allocation recommendations for Huang Siqi and Lin Zhihao respectively, including the adjusted equity/fixed income ratio, specific holdings changes, and risk warnings. He sent them via encrypted email to Huang Siqi before the end of work on May 7, and to Lin Zhihao on the morning of May 8.

subevent.name: Follow up on client feedback and archive it
subevent.description: After Feng Haoran sent the proposal, he successively received positive feedback emails from Huang Siqi and Lin Zhihao. Huang Siqi said the adjustment plan was professional and reasonable, and Lin Zhihao confirmed that he would execute the rebalancing as recommended. Feng Haoran organized and archived the meeting minutes, the proposal, and the client confirmation emails into the company's customer relationship management system.

name: Visit the Meixi Lake Contemporary Photography Exhibition and share insights
description: Feng Haoran, in order to visit the 'Urban Imprint · Contemporary Photography Exhibition' at the Meixi Lake International Culture and Arts Center, went online on January 16, 2025 to check exhibition information and purchase a ticket. On the evening of January 17, he took the subway from his home in Yuelu District to the venue. From 19:00 to 21:00, he carefully viewed and photographed the series of works on changes in old streets of Changsha. On the morning of January 18, he organized his notes at home and shared insights on composition and light/shadow techniques with his photography partner Xu Jiaming via WeChat.

subevent.name: Checked exhibition information and purchased tickets
subevent.description: Feng Haoran used the official WeChat public account of the Meixi Lake International Culture and Arts Center to look up information about the 'City Imprint · Contemporary Photography Exhibition', including exhibition time, participating photographers, and work introductions, and purchased an e-ticket for the evening session on January 17 online.

subevent.name: Set off for Meixi Lake International Culture and Art Center
subevent.description: On the evening of January 17, Feng Haoran departed from his home in Yuelu District, took Metro Line 2 to Meixi Lake International Culture and Arts Center, and arrived at the exhibition venue entrance around 18:30.

subevent.name: Visited the City Imprints · Contemporary Photography Exhibition and took photos to record it.
subevent.description: On January 17, from 19:00 to 21:00, Feng Haoran carefully viewed the City Imprints · Contemporary Photography Exhibition in the exhibition hall of Meixi Lake International Culture and Arts Center. He appreciated the works of several renowned photographers, especially a series of photos showing the changes in old Changsha streets, deeply analyzing the composition and lighting techniques, and used his portable camera to take multiple photos as learning references.
subevent.location: Changsha - Meixi Lake International Culture and Art Center

subevent.name: Organize exhibition notes and share insights with Xu Jianing
subevent.description: On the morning of January 18, Feng Haoran sorted through the photos and notes he had taken during the photography exhibition at home, selected the most inspiring works, and communicated online with his photography partner Xu Jianing in Shenzhen via WeChat, sharing insights on the composition and lighting techniques of his series of photos on the transformation of Changsha's old streets.

name: Valentine's Day date
description: On the evening of February 14, Valentine's Day, Feng Haoran met a woman working in culture and media in Changsha on a dating app recommended by a friend. They met in a private room at Xinyi Hand-Drip Coffee, had dinner together, and shared their work and hobbies. name: Cervical spine problems and health neglect caused by long-term overtime
description: Due to the high-intensity work that had continued since February, Feng Haoran began to feel persistent soreness and pain in his cervical spine in early March. He searched for rehabilitation training videos and office stretching methods on his own, but did not go to the hospital for an examination or systematically adjust his routine. He continued to maintain long periods of desk work, and his health risks gradually deepened. During this period, he tried yoga stretching, with limited results.

subevent.name: Search for rehabilitation exercises on your own.
subevent.description: After consecutive overtime work, Feng Haoran felt persistent soreness and pain in his cervical spine. He then searched the internet for cervical spine rehabilitation exercise videos and office stretching methods, recorded the key points of the exercises, but did not plan to go to the hospital for a check-up.

subevent.name: Office stretching attempt
subevent.description: During breaks at work, Feng Haoran did simple neck and shoulder stretches based on methods he found online, trying to relieve soreness, but the effect was limited because his movements were not professional and he kept working at his desk.

subevent.name: High-intensity desk work
subevent.description: Feng Haoran did not adjust his work pace due to cervical spine discomfort. He still maintained long periods of desk work, conducting investment analysis and writing client proposals, and his cervical symptoms did not ease.

subevent.name: Tried a yoga stretching class.
subevent.description: After work, Feng Haoran went to a yoga studio near his company to attend a shoulder-and-neck-relief yoga class, trying to ease his cervical spine issues through professional stretching. However, due to a lack of targeted guidance, the effect was limited.

subevent.name: Continued self-stretching and worsening of symptoms.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran continued to do simple stretching in the office, but the soreness in his neck gradually worsened and he developed a slight headache. Still, he did not seek medical attention or rest, choosing to endure it.

subevent.name: Weekend overtime and neglect of health
subevent.description: On Saturday, Feng Haoran continued to go to the office to work overtime on urgent tasks. During this time, his cervical spine discomfort worsened, and he only relieved it with brief periods of standing up and moving around, without taking any systematic treatment.

name: Calculation error when configuring a portfolio for a client triggered a trust crisis.
description: On March 7, while configuring an investment portfolio for colleague Huang Siqi's client, Feng Haoran made a serious error in the return rate calculation due to negligence in the data formula. The client noticed the discrepancy and raised questions. Feng Haoran urgently corrected it and apologized. His supervisor Qian Yongqiang asked him on March 10 to submit a detailed written reflection report within three days, analyzing the root cause of the error and preventive measures. During the reflection, Feng Haoran realized that neck discomfort may have affected his concentration.

subevent.name: Portfolio return calculation error
subevent.description: On the morning of March 7, 2025, while allocating an investment portfolio for high-net-worth client Huang Siqi at the Changsha branch office of Huatai Securities, Feng Haoran made a serious error in calculating the rate of return due to negligence with an Excel data formula. The erroneous figure was used in the client's investment proposal. After completing the allocation, Feng Haoran did not double-check and sent it directly to the client by email.

subevent.name: Urgently correct the mistake and apologize to the client
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 7, 2025, client Huang Siqi questioned Feng Haoran by phone after discovering a deviation in the yield calculation. Feng Haoran immediately checked the data, confirmed the formula error, and then recalculated correctly within 2 hours, updated the investment proposal, and sincerely apologized to Huang Siqi by phone and email, explaining the cause of the error and the corrective measures. The client expressed understanding but requested stronger quality control.

subevent.name: Supervisor required submitting a written reflection report
subevent.description: On the morning of March 10, 2025, direct supervisor Qian Yongqiang called Feng Haoran into the office for a serious conversation about the calculation error that occurred on March 7. He pointed out that the mistake could affect client trust and team reputation, and required Feng Haoran to submit a detailed written reflection report within three days (i.e., before March 13), with content including root cause analysis, improvement measures, and preventive solutions.

subevent.name: Write and submit reflection report
subevent.description: From the afternoon of March 10 to March 12, 2025, Feng Haoran used work breaks and after-work time to write a written reflection report. He reviewed in detail the process of the error: because of the cervical spine discomfort that day leading to lack of concentration, he omitted a key parameter when entering the yield calculation formula; he also formulated four preventive measures, including a step-by-step review system and the use of automated verification templates. On the afternoon of March 12, he submitted the report to Qian Yongqiang for review.

subevent.name: Review the process of how the error occurred and write a first draft.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 10, 2025, during work breaks and after work, Feng Haoran recalled and recorded in detail the error occurrence process in his study at home: because of cervical spine discomfort that day, he was inattentive and omitted a key parameter when entering the rate-of-return calculation formula, ultimately causing deviation in the report data. He wrote down the timeline, symptoms, and operational details one by one, forming the first draft of the first part of the reflection report.

subevent.name: Formulated four preventive measures and refined the report
subevent.description: In the evening after work, Feng Haoran thought in his study based on the first draft and formulated four preventive measures: establish a step-by-step review system (each time after entering formulas, colleagues cross-check), use an automated validation template (embed a parameter-checking macro in Excel), set a cervical spine health reminder (stand up and stretch every 45 minutes), and apply for a short lunch break to recover. He wrote these measures into the second part of the reflection report, and polished and adjusted the formatting of the full text.

subevent.name: Submit reflection report to supervisor for review
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 12, during work, Feng Haoran sent the final revised written reflection report to his direct supervisor Qian Yongqiang (Investment Director) via the company's internal email system, with a brief note requesting feedback. After sending, he confirmed receipt of the email with Qian Yongqiang through WeChat Work, and they agreed to have a face-to-face discussion the next morning.

On May 15, he called the office again and formally replied in writing, promising full attendance. The office recorded it and warned that any further absence would trigger an academic alert. On May 16, Feng Haoran made a detailed plan to guarantee full attendance, including course reminder settings, a work handover plan, and backup transportation arrangements, to ensure he would not miss any class in June.

subevent.description: On May 13, 2025, Feng Haoran checked the formal warning email from the MBA program office on his phone at his home in Changsha. He read the email in detail and confirmed that one absence in April due to his mother's hospitalization and one absence on May 8 due to a work conflict brought the total absences to two, reaching the stated limit. The email required full attendance in June, otherwise credits would be affected. Feng Haoran realized the seriousness of the situation.

During the day, he sent a birthday red packet and blessing in advance and arranged a video call in the evening. In the evening video call, he watched his sister's editing work, gave professional advice from the perspective of a financial investment advisor, and encouraged her to turn her new media interest into a career. The sister was deeply moved and became determined to explore the new media field, which brought them closer.

subevent.name: Prepare birthday wishes for younger sister
subevent.description: During the day on May 18, Feng Haoran, at home in Changsha, sent his sister Feng Xinran a birthday red envelope and blessings in advance via WeChat, and agreed to have a video call in the evening.

subevent.name: Video call birthday celebration and career encouragement
subevent.description: On the evening of May 18, Feng Haoran, at his home in Changsha, video-called his younger sister Feng Xinran, who was at home in Shanghai, via WeChat. In the video, he first wished his sister a happy 24th birthday, then watched her recent editing work, gave professional layout and rhythm advice from the perspective of a financial investment advisor, and encouraged her to develop her interest in new media editing into a career. His sister was deeply moved and became determined to explore the new media field.

name: Salary crediting, fund regular investment, and investment research
description: On March 31, after receiving his salary, Feng Haoran completed a monthly automatic investment of 2,000 yuan in the CSI 300 index fund through the Huatai Securities trading app. He then checked his portfolio and was satisfied to find the REITs portion had a quarterly return of 4.2%. Subsequently, he searched for QDII funds and overseas REITs products and began considering increasing automatic investments in overseas assets.

subevent.name: Check salary arrival
subevent.description: On March 31, Feng Haoran received his March salary from Huatai Securities. He logged into his savings account via mobile banking, confirmed that the salary had arrived, and checked the account balance.

subevent.name: Execute regular index fund investing.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran, through the Huatai Securities trading app, according to the monthly regular investment plan, transferred 2000 yuan from his salary account to the designated CSI 300 Index Fund, completing the March regular investment operation.

subevent.name: Review investment portfolio performance.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran logged into his securities account to check the returns of his existing investment portfolio, focusing on the performance of REITs assets. He found that the quarterly return for this part was 4.2%, which met expectations, and he felt satisfied.

subevent.name: Research dollar-cost averaging plans for overseas assets.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran searched QDII funds and overseas REITs products on a financial news website, compared fees, historical returns, and volatility, noted several candidate funds, and planned to further evaluate them next month before starting a regular investment plan.

name: Yuelu Mountain 15 km long-distance run training
description: On the morning of January 4, after completing his pre-run preparations at home in Changsha, Feng Haoran met his running partner Gao Yunfei at the East Gate of Yuelu Mountain. The two then ran a 15-kilometer long slow run along the planned route at a pace of about 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer, passing attractions such as Aiwan Pavilion and Yuelu Academy, and rehydrating at the 8-kilometer mark. After the workout, they did static stretching in the East Gate plaza and exchanged training insights. Feng Haoran's body felt good.

subevent.name: Preparation before morning run
subevent.description: At 5:30 a.m., Feng Haoran got up at his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, put on his running gear (quick-dry shirt, running shoes, sports watch), hydrated and did a brief warm-up, checked his energy gels and phone, confirmed the meeting point with Gao Yunfei, then left and walked to the East Gate of Yuelu Mountain.

subevent.name: Meet up with running buddy
subevent.description: At 6:15 a.m., Feng Haoran arrived at the East Gate of Yuelu Mountain and met up with Gao Yunfei, who had arrived early. The two greeted each other, checked their water and supplies, and Gao Yunfei started a running tracking app on his phone. They briefly discussed today's training route (the loop along Lushan South Road - Aiwan Pavilion - Yuelu Mountain trail).

subevent.name: 15-kilometer long-distance run training
subevent.description: From 6:30 to 8:00 a.m., Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei did a 15-kilometer long slow run along the planned route on Yuelu Mountain. They maintained a pace of about 5:30 per kilometer, passing scenic spots such as Aiwan Pavilion, Yuelu Academy, and the sightseeing cable car station. At the 8-kilometer mark, they briefly stopped at a supply point for water, and finally returned to the east gate of Yuelu Mountain to finish the training. Feng Haoran kept his heart rate at 140-155 beats per minute and felt good physically.

subevent.name: Post-workout stretching and review
subevent.description: At 8:15 a.m., Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei did 15 minutes of static stretching at the East Gate Square of Yuelu Mountain to relax their leg muscles. While stretching, the two exchanged their feelings about this training session. Feng Haoran reported no pressure on his knees and a steady breathing rhythm, while Gao Yunfei said the pace control was good and suitable as basic training for a half marathon.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu Mountain East Gate Square

name: First try at rock climbing for stress relief
description: On Sunday, February 9, Feng Haoran, due to high work pressure, decided on a whim to try rock climbing to relieve stress. He searched on his phone and chose the 'Yantu' Climbing Gym in Yuelu District, then drove there. After arriving, he paid the experience fee, collected equipment, and under the coach's guidance tried the beginner route, successfully reaching the top after three attempts. During a break in the rest area, he met an experienced climber, Lao Zhou, who enthusiastically taught him techniques and they exchanged WeChat contacts. After about two hours of climbing, he felt physically and mentally relaxed, his stress relieved, and he drove home.

subevent.name: Search for rock climbing gym information and decide to try it.
subevent.description: After waking up on Saturday morning, Feng Haoran, feeling the pressure of recent work, made a spontaneous decision to try rock climbing to relieve stress. He searched newly opened climbing gyms in Changsha on his phone, checked the ratings and route introductions, and finally chose a climbing gym named 'Yantu' in Yuelu District, deciding to set off right away.

subevent.name: Go to the climbing gym
subevent.description: Feng Haoran changed into sportswear, took his water bottle and towel, and drove the family car from his home on Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, to the Yantu Climbing Gym about 6 kilometers away. Along the way, he passed Lushan South Road and Xiaoxiang Avenue, taking about 20 minutes.
subevent.location: Yuelu District, Changsha - on the way to the climbing gym

subevent.name: Try a beginner basic climbing route
subevent.description: After arriving at the climbing gym, Feng Haoran registered at the front desk and paid the single-visit fee (about 120 yuan), then received climbing shoes and a chalk bag. After the coach briefly explained the safety rules, he chose a 5.8-difficulty route labeled 'Beginner' to try. His movements were unfamiliar on the first attempt, but he successfully reached the top after three tries, experiencing a sense of accomplishment from overcoming fear.
subevent.location: Yuelu District, Changsha - Yantu Rock Climbing Gym

subevent.name: Met experienced climbing buddies and exchanged skills
subevent.description: In the rest area of the climbing gym, Feng Haoran proactively struck up a conversation with 'Lao Zhou', a middle-aged climbing partner who looked experienced. Lao Zhou enthusiastically shared his climbing experience and coached Feng Haoran on basic techniques such as using leg power and adjusting the center of gravity. The two added each other on WeChat and agreed to climb together when they had the chance.
subevent.location: Rest area, Yantu Climbing Gym, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: End the experience and return home
subevent.description: After about two hours of rock climbing, Feng Haoran felt physically tired but emotionally uplifted, and his work stress was significantly relieved. He packed his belongings, said goodbye to Lao Zhou, and drove home. On the way, he bought a bottle of sports drink at a convenience store to replenish his energy. After getting home, he took a quick shower and recorded this pleasant experience.

name: Urgently canceled the three-day camping trip to western Hunan with Xie Yutong due to mother's hospitalization
description: On April 1, after learning that his mother needed hospitalization, Feng Haoran immediately called Xie Yutong to explain the family emergency and cancel the three-day camping trip in western Hunan originally planned for the Qingming holiday (April 4 to 6). Xie Yutong expressed understanding, but the outdoor shooting and relaxation itinerary the two had planned had to be shelved.

subevent.name: Received a call from his father and learned that his mother had been hospitalized.
subevent.description: On the morning of April 1, Feng Haoran received a call from his father Feng Jianguo at home in Yuelu District, Changsha, and learned that his mother Li Xiuying needed hospitalization due to health issues. Specifically, routine examination found abnormal indicators, requiring admission for further examination and short-term treatment. Feng Haoran was very worried after hearing this and immediately said he would arrange time to go back to Wuhan to visit as soon as possible.

subevent.name: Call Xie Yutong to cancel the three-day camping trip in western Hunan
subevent.description: At noon on April 1, Feng Haoran called Xie Yutong from his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, to inform her of the emergency that his mother had been suddenly hospitalized. He sincerely explained that family reasons made it impossible to go to Xiangxi for the three-day camping trip as originally planned from April 4 to 6. Xie Yutong said she fully understood, comforted Feng Haoran, confirmed the cancellation of the camping reservation, and the two agreed to reschedule once Feng Haoran's family situation stabilized.

subevent.name: Cancel camping-related reservations and equipment rentals
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 1, at home, Feng Haoran used his mobile phone to contact JD.com customer service for camping equipment rental, canceling the order for tents, sleeping bags, and other camping gear originally scheduled from April 4 to 6. At the same time, he logged into 12306 to refund the high-speed rail ticket from Changsha to Xiangxi on April 4. He also contacted the person in charge of the Xiangxi campsite he had previously intended to book via WeChat to inform them of the cancellation of the campsite reservation. All cancellation operations were completed, and some deposits were returned to the original account after handling fees were deducted.

name: Attend Huatai Securities' semi-annual investment strategy meeting and subsequent work.
description: On July 9, Feng Haoran prepared the strategy meeting materials in advance. On the morning of July 10, he attended Huatai Securities' semi-annual investment strategy meeting, listened to the chief economist's outlook on the second half of the year and the A-share market. At noon, he discussed key strategy points with colleague Zheng Wenbo. In the afternoon, he organized meeting notes and reviewed/shared them.

subevent.name: Pre-meeting preparation and document organization
subevent.description: On July 9, 2025, at his workstation at the Changsha branch of Huatai Securities, Feng Haoran reviewed the agenda of the semi-annual strategy meeting in advance, organized research reports and data on the macroeconomic outlook and the A-share market for the second half of the year, and made full preparations for attending the meeting the next day. He used the company's internal system to download recent analysis articles by the chief economist and noted key questions in his notebook so as to ask and exchange ideas during the meeting.

subevent.name: Attend the semi-annual investment strategy meeting
subevent.description: On the morning of July 10, 2025, Feng Haoran arrived on time at the large meeting room of Huatai Securities Changsha Branch to attend the company's semi-annual investment strategy meeting. During the meeting, he listened attentively to the chief economist's detailed analysis of the macroeconomic situation for the second half of the year, A-share market trends, and industry allocation recommendations, and took notes on key data and investment logic. He actively participated in the interactive session, asking experts about the technology sector and consumer recovery.
subevent.location: Changsha - Huatai Securities Main Conference Room

subevent.name: Discussed key strategy points with colleagues after the meeting.
subevent.description: At noon on July 10, 2025, after the strategy meeting, Feng Haoran and his colleague Zheng Wenbo had lunch in the company pantry while discussing the meeting content. The two exchanged views on the second-half investment themes proposed by the chief economist—new energy, artificial intelligence, and consumption recovery—and analyzed their clients' risk preferences, initially planning subsequent asset allocation adjustments. Feng Haoran also discussed specific market timing strategies with Zheng Wenbo based on his own understanding of technical analysis.

subevent.name: Organize meeting notes and review
subevent.description: On the afternoon of July 10, 2025, Feng Haoran returned to his desk, organized the recordings and notes from the strategy meeting into electronic documents, and extracted core viewpoints and actionable strategy suggestions. He marked the data metrics that needed further research and planned to use this information in upcoming client communications. After finishing, he shared the review notes with the team's internal group for other colleagues' reference.

name: Colleague changing jobs and heavier workload
description: In mid-January, colleague Zheng Wenbo privately told Feng Haoran that he had received an offer from a Shenzhen private equity fund and was planning to resign. Feng Haoran felt that competition within the department would become more delicate. Subsequently, his client Lin Zhihao's annual asset allocation plan was highly praised. His direct supervisor, Qian Yongqiang, transferred part of Zheng Wenbo's work to him because of Zheng Wenbo's resignation and Feng Haoran's outstanding performance. From January 19 to 22, Feng Haoran adjusted his work plan, handed over client information with Zheng Wenbo, and worked overtime to cope with the increased workload.

subevent.name: Zheng Wenbo revealed his intention to switch jobs
subevent.description: On January 16, 2025, during lunch break at the Huatai Securities office in Changsha, colleague Zheng Wenbo privately told Feng Haoran that he had received an offer from a private equity fund in Shenzhen and planned to submit his resignation soon. The two chatted quietly in the break room for about 20 minutes. Zheng Wenbo showed anticipation for the new opportunity but also reluctance to leave the current team. Feng Haoran expressed understanding and wished him well. This news made Feng Haoran realize that internal competition within the department would become more subtle.

subevent.name: Lin Zhihao's annual asset allocation plan received high recognition
subevent.description: On the morning of January 17, 2025, Feng Haoran received a WeChat message from client Lin Zhihao in his office. Lin Zhihao highly praised the annual asset allocation plan Feng Haoran had previously submitted, saying the plan was very professional and matched his risk preference, and expressed a desire to continue deepening the cooperation. Feng Haoran immediately reported the client feedback to his superior Qian Yongqiang, who praised Feng Haoran's work on the spot.
subevent.location: Workstation at Huatai Securities Investment Advisory Department, Changsha

subevent.name: The leader assigned extra work tasks.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 18, 2025, Feng Haoran was called into the office by his direct superior, Qian Yongqiang, for a face-to-face meeting. Qian Yongqiang said that because Zheng Wenbo was about to leave and Feng Haoran had performed outstandingly recently, he decided to transfer part of Zheng Wenbo's client maintenance work and the task of writing a quarterly report for a high-net-worth client to Feng Haoran, hoping he could take on greater responsibility. Feng Haoran accepted the arrangement and asked about the handover timeline.

subevent.name: Feng Haoran adjusted his work plan and started task handover
subevent.description: From January 19 to 22, 2025, Feng Haoran reorganized his work list and scheduled the new client maintenance tasks and quarterly report writing. During this period, he proactively contacted Zheng Wenbo to learn key information about the clients he handled and began browsing relevant materials. At the same time, he took time to study the dynamics of Shenzhen's private equity fund industry, in preparation for possible departmental staffing adjustments after Zheng Wenbo's departure. He worked about one hour of overtime each day to cope with the increased workload.
subevent.location: Changsha - Huatai Securities office and home study

name: Index fund regular investment purchase
description: On the evening of January 20, Feng Haoran logged into his account via the Huatai Securities app in his study at home in Changsha. After checking the balance and confirming the automatic investment plan settings were normal, he purchased 5000 yuan of the CSI 300 Index Fund through the plan. This fund was chosen as a long-term target due to its low fee rate and small tracking error. After the operation, he checked his holdings returns, with cumulative profit of about 2.3%, and thought the current valuation was suitable for continuing the plan, so he decided to keep the plan unchanged.

subevent.name: Check account balance and recurring investment settings
subevent.description: On the evening of January 20, Feng Haoran logged into his account through the Huatai Securities app in his home study, checked whether the account balance was sufficient, and confirmed that the monthly auto-investment plan for the CSI 300 Index Fund on the 20th was set up correctly, ensuring 5,000 yuan was available for this month's investment purchase.

subevent.name: Execute regular investment purchase of the CSI 300 index fund.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran performed a scheduled investment on the Huatai Securities app, selected the CSI 300 index fund, entered the scheduled investment amount of 5000 yuan, and confirmed the purchase. This fund is his long-term scheduled investment target due to its low expense ratio and small tracking error. The order was submitted successfully after the operation.

subevent.name: View holdings returns and valuation analysis.
subevent.description: After completing the regular investment purchase operation, Feng Haoran checked the holding returns of the CSI 300 Index Fund, with cumulative profit of about 2.3%. Based on the current market valuation level, he believed that valuations were in a range suitable for continuing regular investments, and decided to keep the monthly investment plan unchanged.

name: Healthy diet attempt and abandonment
description: On February 10, Feng Haoran enrolled in an online nutrition course and decided to adjust his diet and start making healthy lunches himself. He persisted in bringing lunch to work for five days (until February 14), but due to a sudden increase in overtime at work, he had no time to prepare from February 17 onward, gave up this plan, and his health management was shelved once again.

subevent.name: Enroll in an online nutrition course
subevent.description: On the morning of February 10, Feng Haoran signed up for an online nutrition course via a mobile app at his home in Yuelu District, Changsha. The course content includes balanced meal pairing and healthy recipes. He decided to adjust his diet starting that day and make healthy lunches to bring to the office.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Purchase healthy ingredients
subevent.description: After work on February 10, Feng Haoran went to a Kaifu District supermarket near the company, and following the recipes recommended in the course, he purchased healthy ingredients such as chicken breast, broccoli, quinoa, eggs, tomatoes, lettuce, as well as bento boxes and an insulated bag, to prepare for the next week of homemade lunches.
subevent.location: Hunan Province, Changsha City - Kaifu District supermarket.

subevent.name: Brought lunch to work for five consecutive days
subevent.description: From February 10 (Monday) to February 14 (Friday), Feng Haoran strictly followed his homemade lunch plan for five consecutive workdays: every morning he got up at 6:30, cooked a lunchbox meal according to the course recipe, packed it into a lunchbox and carried it to the Huatai Securities office building in Kaifu District; during lunch break, he heated it in the company microwave and ate, taking photos to record his eating progress. During this period, he declined colleagues' takeout invitations and insisted on bringing his own meals.
subevent.location: Home kitchen in Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, and Huatai Securities office building in Kaifu District

subevent.name: Gave up the healthy meal plan.
subevent.description: On Monday, February 17, because of urgent projects in the investment department recently, overtime suddenly increased, and Feng Haoran had no time to prepare a lunch box in the morning. He decided to suspend the homemade lunch plan and instead had a simple meal at the company cafeteria that day. In the following days, he was too busy with work to resume bringing lunch, and the health management attempt thus stalled.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities office building, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Organize stamp collection.
description: From February 1 to 2, during the last two days of the Spring Festival holiday, Feng Haoran conducted a thorough reorganization of his stamp collection at home in Changsha. He counted them one by one, took high-definition photos, built an electronic catalog using collecting software, and carefully noted the condition and market valuation of each item. He found that a set of Republic of China commemorative stamps had slightly yellowed due to improper storage, so their condition had declined a bit, and he decided to learn professional preservation techniques. At the same time, he reassessed the value of treasures such as the 'Large Dragon Stamps' and became interested in participating in a professional stamp exhibition.

subevent.name: Count and classify stamp collection
subevent.description: In the study of his home in Changsha, Feng Haoran took out all stamp albums from the collection cabinet, sorted and inventoried them by era and theme (such as Qing Dynasty stamps, Republic of China stamps, New China stamps, foreign stamps, etc.), checked the number of stamps in each set and their current preservation status one by one, and compiled a complete collection inventory.

subevent.name: Took high-definition photos of stamps and created an electronic catalog.
subevent.description: Using a digital camera and macro lens, he took high-definition photos of each stamp set in the study, ensuring that the details on both front and back were clearly visible. He then imported the photos into dedicated stamp collection management software, created electronic files for each stamp, and annotated in detail the issue year, edition, condition grade (e.g., mint, fine, average, etc.), and preliminary market valuation based on recent auction prices.

subevent.name: Discovered condition issues with Republic of China stamps and learned professional preservation knowledge
subevent.description: While sorting through items, Feng Haoran discovered that a set of Republic of China commemorative stamps had become slightly yellowed due to improper storage in the past, with their condition downgraded from mint to fine. He immediately searched the Internet for professional stamp preservation methods, including constant temperature and humidity storage, the use of acid-free stamp sleeves, and avoiding direct sunlight. He also recorded key points in a notebook and planned to purchase professional preservation tools.

name: Attend the company's internal investment strategy seminar
description: On June 23, the Changsha branch of Huatai Securities held an internal investment strategy seminar, where the chief analyst of the research department delivered a talk on the macroeconomic outlook and asset allocation ideas for the second half of the year. Feng Haoran participated throughout and asked questions about valuation methods for the technology sector. After the meeting, he organized the minutes into notes, shared them with colleagues in his department, and updated some clients' allocation plans based on his own clients' situations.

subevent.name: Went to the Changsha branch of Huatai Securities to participate in the seminar
subevent.description: On the morning of June 23, 2025, Feng Haoran left home and took the subway to Huatai Securities Changsha Branch (located at No. 88, Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha), arriving on time at the company conference room to attend the internal investment strategy seminar.

subevent.name: Attend internal investment strategy seminar
subevent.description: Feng Haoran participated in the full internal investment strategy seminar led by the chief analyst of the research department. The meeting covered the macroeconomic outlook for the second half of the year and asset allocation ideas. He listened carefully to the analysis and recorded key data and strategy points in detail in his notebook.
subevent.location: Changsha - Huatai Securities Changsha Branch Meeting Room

subevent.name: Discussion on tech sector valuation methods
subevent.description: During the interactive session of the seminar, Feng Haoran proactively asked questions to the chief analyst, delving into valuation methods for the technology sector, inquiring about the applicability of PE and PEG indicators in the current market environment, and exchanged views with colleagues Zheng Wenbo and Sun Xiaoya.
subevent.location: Changsha - Huatai Securities Changsha Branch Meeting Room

subevent.name: Organize the seminar minutes.
subevent.description: After the seminar, Feng Haoran returned to his workstation and digitized his meeting notes into structured meeting minutes, including content on macroeconomic data, asset allocation recommendations, and technology sector analysis.
subevent.location: Changsha - Huatai Securities Changsha Branch Office

subevent.name: Shared meeting minutes with department colleagues.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran sent the compiled electronic meeting minutes to the department work group, and briefly shared the key content in person with colleagues such as Zheng Wenbo and Sun Xiaoya, ensuring that everyone could access the latest investment strategy information.
subevent.location: Changsha - Huatai Securities Changsha Branch Office

subevent.name: Update client asset allocation plan
subevent.description: Drawing on the macroeconomic outlook and asset allocation insights from the seminar, Feng Haoran adjusted the allocation strategies for the existing portfolios of several high-net-worth clients under his management (such as Huang Siqi and Lin Zhihao) one by one, including increasing the technology sector weighting and optimizing the bond ratio, and documented the reasons for each adjustment for future communication.
subevent.location: Changsha - Huatai Securities Changsha Branch Office

name: Write and publish the monthly market analysis report
description: From August 6 to 7, Feng Haoran spent two days at the company's Changsha office writing a monthly investment strategy report for core clients, incorporating recent macroeconomic data and industry trends. The report covered outlooks on A-shares, bonds, and commodity markets, and was sent by email to more than 20 high-net-worth clients on the afternoon of August 7, receiving positive feedback from several clients.

subevent.name: Collected and organized market data
subevent.description: On the morning of August 6, 2025, in his office at Huatai Securities, No. 88 Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Feng Haoran systematically collected macro data from early August (such as PMI, CPI), trends in various A-share sectors, changes in bond yields, and commodity price fluctuations through financial data terminals and financial news websites, and organized key data into tables and charts in preparation for writing the monthly investment strategy report.

subevent.name: Write the initial draft of the report (A-shares and bond sections)
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 6, 2025, Feng Haoran began writing the monthly investment strategy report in his office based on the data compiled in the morning. He first wrote the A-share market outlook section, analyzing broad market index trends and sector rotation opportunities; then he wrote the bond market section, discussing interest rate trends and credit bond allocation recommendations. During the writing process, he referred to the company's internal research reports and used Excel to create relevant charts for illustration.

subevent.name: Complete the report (commodities section) and do the final proofread
subevent.description: On the morning of August 7, 2025, Feng Haoran continued writing the commodities market outlook section of the report in his office, analyzing the price drivers and investment recommendations for major commodities such as crude oil and gold. After finishing, he read through the entire report for review, checking data accuracy, chart labels, and layout formatting to ensure it was professional and error-free.

subevent.name: Send the report and collect client feedback.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 7, 2025, Feng Haoran sent the final monthly investment strategy report as a PDF attachment to 28 high-net-worth clients on the list (including Huang Siqi, Lin Zhihao, etc.) through the company's email system, and briefly summarized the core points in the body of the email. About an hour after sending, he received replies from 6 clients, who expressed approval of the report and raised further consultation needs. Feng Haoran replied to each with thanks and arranged follow-up phone calls.

name: Agreed with running buddy Gao Yunfei to participate in the 2026 Changsha Half Marathon and looked up event information.
description: On the morning of July 15, 2025, during a morning run on Yuelu Mountain, Feng Haoran and his running buddy Gao Yunfei agreed to sign up together for the 2026 Changsha Half Marathon, with a target finish time of 1 hour 45 minutes. The next evening (July 16), Feng Haoran checked the Changsha Marathon official website and shared the information with Gao Yunfei via WeChat, further confirming the preparation schedule.

subevent.name: Morning run with Gao Yunfei and discuss half-marathon goals.
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on July 15, 2025, Feng Haoran met his running partner Gao Yunfei on Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha. The two jogged about 5 kilometers along the foot of Yuelu Mountain. During the run, Feng Haoran brought up the idea of signing up for the 2026 Changsha Half Marathon, and Gao Yunfei responded enthusiastically. They discussed the race goal (finish time 1 hour 45 minutes) and made a formal agreement to prepare together.
subevent.location: Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Search for 2026 Changsha Half Marathon information
subevent.description: On the evening of July 16, Feng Haoran accessed the official website of the Changsha Marathon from his home study via computer to look up detailed information about the 2026 Changsha Half Marathon, including race date, registration time, race route, and registration fee. He took screenshots of the key information and shared them with Gao Yunfei via WeChat, and the two further confirmed the timeline for preparation.

name: Adjusted asset allocation plan for client Lin Zhihao
description: From February 11 to 17, Feng Haoran adjusted the asset allocation plan for Shanghai client Lin Zhihao. He first prepared materials for market analysis and adjustment suggestions at the office, then explained the plan via video conference on February 12. The client recognized the framework but requested adding overseas asset allocation. Feng Haoran researched overseas investment targets at home that same day, and finally integrated and completed a supplementary plan including overseas assets on February 17 and submitted it to the client.

subevent.name: Preparing asset allocation plan materials.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran, at the Huatai Securities office in Changsha, updates client portfolio analysis based on market volatility data, prepares the latest asset allocation proposal presentation document, including adjustment suggestions for the proportions of stocks, bonds, and funds, to prepare for the video conference with Lin Zhihao the next day.

subevent.name: Video conference communication with Lin Zhihao
subevent.description: Feng Haoran connected with Shanghai client Lin Zhihao via video conference at his Changsha Huatai Securities office, explaining the latest asset allocation plan in detail. Based on recent market volatility, he recommended adjusting some stock holdings to bond-type assets. Lin Zhihao approved the framework of the plan, but proposed to increase overseas asset allocation. Feng Haoran promised to provide a new plan within two weeks.

subevent.name: Research overseas asset allocation markets.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran, in his home study in Changsha, researched investment targets in US stocks, Hong Kong stocks, and emerging markets for Lin Zhihao's overseas asset allocation needs. He analyzed the risk-return characteristics of instruments such as QDII funds and cross-border ETFs, and recorded preliminary alternatives.

subevent.name: Develop and submit a new overseas asset allocation plan
subevent.description: Feng Haoran integrated the research results at the Huatai Securities office in Changsha, completed a supplementary asset allocation plan covering overseas stocks, cross-border bonds, and alternative investments, sent it to Lin Zhihao by email, and confirmed receipt on WeChat, later scheduling a further discussion time.

name: First community outdoor climbing event hit a setback; two people dropped out because of the demanding itinerary, and he was advised to listen to more opinions.
description: On July 19, Feng Haoran for the first time tried to organize a rock climbing community to go outdoor climbing at Heimifeng. He made a tight schedule and strictly followed it, causing two members to quit midway due to dissatisfaction with the pace.
