After the activity, Coach Lao Zhou privately suggested "listen to everyone's opinions more". Feng Haoran deeply reflected on his controlling tendencies.

subevent.name: Pre-event organization and notification
subevent.description: Feng Haoran posted a notice for the outdoor climbing event at Heimifeng in the climbing community, made a detailed itinerary (including meeting time, route, rest stops, etc.), and confirmed the participant list one by one. He communicated with members via the WeChat group, emphasized punctuality and discipline, and did not adopt some members' suggestions about itinerary flexibility. The entire preliminary organization was completed on the evening of July 17.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, and online

subevent.name: Publish the event notice and preliminary itinerary.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran posted a notice in the rock climbing community WeChat group about the Heimifeng outdoor climbing event, including the event date, meeting point, basic route, and preliminary description of required equipment, along with a preliminary itinerary framework. He @mentioned all members in the group, asking everyone to read carefully and reply promptly whether they would attend. At the same time, he privately messaged Coach Lao Zhou to confirm Coach Zhou's intention to participate and the guidance arrangements.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Refine the itinerary and route planning.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran carefully worked out a detailed itinerary for the outdoor climb at Heimifeng at home using maps and outdoor apps, including the exact meet-up time (7:00 AM), driving route (via Yuelu Avenue turning toward Heimifeng), mid-way rest stop (halfway parking lot), rock climbing route selection (three routes on the eastern cliff), and return time. He organized the refined itinerary into a document, posted it in the WeChat group, and explained the time requirements for each node.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Confirm participant list one by one and collect feedback
subevent.description: Feng Haoran used the private chat function in the WeChat group to contact the registered community members one by one (12 in total) to confirm whether each could attend on time and ask if there were special needs or suggestions. He also collected members' feedback on itinerary flexibility (such as hoping to allow more time for photos, adjusting the lunch location, etc.) and recorded it in his notebook. Coach Lao Zhou also replied via WeChat to confirm that he would provide technical guidance at that time.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Emphasize discipline and finalizing the itinerary.
subevent.description: After organizing the feedback, Feng Haoran posted the final itinerary in the WeChat group, along with important notes. He particularly emphasized the importance of punctuality, safety discipline, and teamwork, and clearly stated that he would not adopt some members' suggestions to postpone departure or extend rest time, in order to maintain the overall pace of the activity. He asked all members to reply to confirm final participation by 18:00 that day, and the final list was set at 11 people (1 person withdrew due to other reasons).
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, and online

subevent.name: Final confirmation and reminders before departure
subevent.description: The night before the event, Feng Haoran reminded all participants again in the WeChat group about the next day's meeting time (7:00 AM), meeting place (the entrance of the community at 156 Lushan South Road, Yuelu District), required equipment (climbing shoes, harness, helmet, lunch, water, etc.), and the weather conditions. He privately messaged in turn those members who had not replied in the group, making sure everyone had received the information. At the same time, he notified Coach Lao Zhou to confirm vehicle arrangements and checked his own gear bag.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province, and online

subevent.name: Gather and depart on the day of the event
subevent.description: On the morning of July 19, Feng Haoran counted the number of people at the designated assembly point in Changsha, confirmed the equipment (climbing ropes, helmets, harnesses, etc.), and departed on time at 7:30 for Heimifeng. He strictly enforced the departure time, urging late members, which made some of them feel pressured.
subevent.location: Changsha City, Hunan Province - meeting point and en route to Heimifeng

subevent.name: Executing the Heimifeng outdoor climbing activity
subevent.description: After arriving at Heimifeng, Feng Haoran organized the members to start climbing as planned. He strictly controlled the time and rest periods for each climbing route and frequently urged the members to speed up. Two members felt tired and displeased due to the fast pace and insufficient rest, and repeatedly asked to slow down but were not accommodated.
subevent.location: Heimifeng Outdoor Climbing Area, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Two members dropped out midway
subevent.description: About halfway through the afternoon climbing session, two members who were dissatisfied with the strict pace asked Feng Haoran to leave the activity early. Feng Haoran tried to persuade them to stay but failed, and finally allowed them to go down the mountain and return on their own. The remaining members continued the activity, but the atmosphere was affected.
subevent.location: Heimifeng Outdoor Climbing Area, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: End of activity and coach's advice.
subevent.description: After the rock climbing activity ended, Feng Haoran and the remaining members packed the gear together and prepared to head back. Coach Lao Zhou privately talked to him, tactfully suggesting that he should listen more to members' opinions and adjust the pace appropriately when organizing activities to enhance team cohesion. Feng Haoran fell into deep thought upon hearing this.
subevent.location: Heimifeng Scenic Area parking lot, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Return trip and self-reflection.
subevent.description: On the way back and that evening, Feng Haoran reviewed the entire event by himself, deeply reflecting on the controlling and stubborn behavior he had shown during organizing, and realized he should pay more attention to member experience and communication. He decided to improve his management style in future activities and planned to apologize to the members who had dropped out.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Open-air jazz concert
description: On June 6, Feng Haoran was invited by Peng Yuqing to attend an open-air jazz concert at the 'Mountain Concert Hall' at the foot of Yuelu Mountain. He received the invitation in the morning and got ready, then set off in the evening to meet Peng Yuqing. The concert started at 19:30, and they sat on the lawn listening to an impromptu duet of saxophone and piano. During the intermission, they ran into Shen Xinyi, and the three shared plum wine. In the second half, Feng Haoran used his phone to capture silhouettes of the musicians. The concert ended at 21:30.

subevent.name: Confirm concert invitation and preparation
subevent.description: On the morning of June 6, Feng Haoran received a WeChat invitation from Peng Yuqing to attend an outdoor jazz concert at the 'Mountain Music Hall' at the foot of Yuelu Mountain in the evening. He finished his work early, changed into casual clothes, took his camera, checked his cervical spine mobility, and prepared for the evening activity.

subevent.name: Departed for the concert hall on the mountain
subevent.description: At 18:30 in the evening, Feng Haoran left home and took the subway to Yuelu Mountain East Gate Station, then walked about 15 minutes up the mountain, arriving at the open-air venue of the 'Mountain Concert Hall' at 19:00. On the way, he confirmed the meeting point with Peng Yuqing by phone.

subevent.name: Attended the first half of the concert and the intermission
subevent.description: At 19:30 the concert officially began. Feng Haoran and Peng Yuqing sat on the grass listening to the improvised duet of saxophone and piano, enjoying the breeze and the evening light. During the intermission, they ran into Shen Xinyi. Feng Haoran introduced Peng Yuqing to Shen Xinyi, and the three sat on the lawn sharing the plum wine Shen Xinyi had brought, chatting freely about music and coffee.
subevent.location: Lawn area of the concert hall on Yuelu Mountain, Changsha

subevent.name: Second half of the concert and photography creation
subevent.description: After the intermission, the concert entered the second half. Feng Haoran used his phone to snap several silhouette photos of the musicians under the stage lights. He tried different angles to capture the saxophonist's expression while playing. The concert ended at 21:30, and the three of them applauded together in thanks.

name: MBA Spring Semester Launch and ESG Research Topic Collaboration
description: In mid-January, the MBA spring semester officially began. Feng Haoran took two courses, Strategic Management and Portfolio Theory, and made a dual-track plan of certifications and coursework. A week after the semester started, his college classmate Zhou Yuwei initiated a practical research project on ESG investment in the Chinese market. Feng Haoran joined out of strong interest, and the two agreed to co-author an academic paper, which added a new direction to his academic path.

subevent.name: MBA spring semester registration and course selection confirmation
subevent.description: On the morning of January 13, 2025, Feng Haoran went to the MBA Education Center of a university in Changsha to complete the enrollment procedures for the spring semester. He confirmed two elective courses, Strategic Management and Portfolio Theory, on-site, and received the course syllabi and teaching schedule.
subevent.location: Changsha - MBA Education Center of a Certain University

subevent.name: Formulated a dual-track study plan for certification exams and coursework.
subevent.description: The day after the semester began, Feng Haoran used his laptop at home, combining the course syllabus and the CFA exam schedule, to develop a detailed dual-track study plan of 'certification + coursework', dividing weekly study time into three modules: course preview, after-class review, and certification review, and set stage goals.

subevent.name: Purchase course textbooks and materials
subevent.description: According to the course syllabus requirements, Feng Haoran went to Dingwangtai Book City in Changsha and purchased the designated textbooks for "Strategic Management" and "Portfolio Theory," and also ordered related auxiliary reference books and CFA exam preparation materials online, getting ready for dual-track study.

subevent.name: Zhou Yuwei initiated an ESG investment research project.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 20, one week after the semester started, Zhou Yuwei, a college classmate far away in Shanghai, contacted Feng Haoran via WeChat to initiate a practical research project on ESG investing in the Chinese market. She hoped to invite Feng Haoran to jointly participate and co-author an academic paper, and attached a preliminary research framework and literature review.

name: Preparing to participate in the National Stamp Exhibition
description: On the afternoon of February 3, Feng Haoran sorted stamps in his home study and took high-definition photos. That evening, he had a video call with fellow collector Luo Zhenyu, showed the results, discussed preservation methods, and decided to sign up for the September National Stamp Exhibition together, choosing the Large Dragon stamp as the main exhibit. On February 4, Feng Haoran used his lunch break to look up preservation methods and the exhibition registration guide, took notes on key information, and officially began preparations.

subevent.name: Organize stamps and take photos
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 3, 2025, Feng Haoran, in his study at his home in Changsha, took out the yellowed stamps and large dragon stamps from his stamp collection album, carefully organized them, and took high-definition photos with a DSLR camera, preparing to show them during a video call with Luo Zhenyu in the evening.

subevent.name: Had a video call with Luo Zhenyu to discuss the stamp exhibition.
subevent.description: On the evening of February 3, 2025, Feng Haoran had a video call in his home study in Changsha with stamp collector friend Luo Zhenyu, who was far away in Shenzhen, showing the photos of stamps he had organized during the day and the details of the yellowed stamps. Luo Zhenyu shared professional preservation methods and suggested they both register for the National Stamp Exhibition in September. The two preliminarily agreed to bring their respective treasures to the exhibition, and Feng Haoran decided to use the Large Dragon stamp as his main exhibit, and they agreed to start preparing exhibition materials later.

subevent.name: Look up stamp maintenance and exhibition information
subevent.description: On February 4, 2025, Feng Haoran used his lunch break at the company (Huatai Securities, Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha) to log on to the philately forum and the Cultural Heritage Administration website, look up the preservation methods mentioned by Luo Zhenyu, and download the registration guide and participation requirements for the National Stamp Exhibition, recording key information in his notebook.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities office, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Urgent business trip to Shanghai to handle a commercial real estate dispute and issue a risk assessment memorandum
description: On August 26, Feng Haoran received an urgent notice and prepared business trip materials with legal colleagues; on August 27, he took the high-speed rail to Shanghai and started the first day of investigation at the Lujiazui office; on the 28th, he conducted in-depth interviews and contract analysis; on the morning of the 29th, he completed the risk assessment memo, and in the afternoon, the video report was adopted by client Lin Zhihao; he took the high-speed rail back in the evening, fell asleep tired on the way, and recorded his thoughts; on the 30th, after returning to Changsha, he organized and archived the documents and reported to his immediate superior.

subevent.name: Preparation before a business trip.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran received an urgent notice, confirmed the business trip arrangement with a legal colleague, booked a high-speed rail ticket from Changsha to Shanghai on August 27, organized materials and contract documents related to Lin Zhihao's commercial real estate project, and prepared a checklist of tools for background investigation.

subevent.name: Flew to Shanghai and began the first day of the investigation.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran and a legal colleague took the high-speed rail from Changsha to Shanghai. Upon arrival, they went directly to the Lujiazui office, began reviewing the partner's contracts and project documents, had the first phone communication with Lin Zhihao, and clarified the direction and focus of the investigation, working late into the night.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Lujiazui Grade A office building

subevent.name: Day Two In-depth Investigation and Interview
subevent.description: Feng Haoran and a legal colleague continued working in the Lujiazui office. In the morning, they interviewed representatives of the partner; in the afternoon, they organized interview notes, compared contract clauses, analyzed the focus of the dispute, and initially outlined the risk assessment framework. They worked for over 14 hours straight.

participant.name: Partner representative
participant.relation: Relevant personnel from the other party

subevent.location: Shanghai - Lujiazui Grade A office building

subevent.name: Third day: issued risk assessment memo and it was adopted
subevent.description: Feng Haoran continued to be stationed at the Lujiazui office. In the morning, he finished writing the risk assessment memo. In the afternoon, he had a video conference with Lin Zhihao to report the investigation conclusions. The memo was adopted by Lin Zhihao, successfully defusing part of the crisis. In the evening, he took the high-speed rail back to Changsha with his colleague from the legal department.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Lujiazui Grade A office building

subevent.name: Reflections recorded on the return high-speed train.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran and a legal colleague took the high-speed rail back from Shanghai to Changsha. He fell asleep on the train due to extreme exhaustion. After waking up, he noted the insight that "direct trench experience beats ten case books" and organized a post-trip work checklist.
subevent.location: In the Shanghai-Changsha high-speed rail carriage

subevent.name: Follow-up archiving after business trip.
subevent.description: After returning to Changsha, Feng Haoran organized the work documents, interview records, and risk assessment memos from the business trip at the company, archived them in the project database, and briefly reported the results of the trip to his immediate superior Qian Yongqiang, preparing for follow-up.

name: Completed the refinement of the cross-border REITs distribution plan and reported to the department.
description: On May 22, Feng Haoran further refined the cross-border REITs distribution plan based on the first draft from early April, adding risk hedging strategies and a client suitability model, and presented it to Qian Yongqiang and the team at a department meeting. The plan received preliminary approval; his supervisor suggested that the pilot could be launched after supplementing more overseas market data. This marked his formal establishment in the cross-border business field.

subevent.name: Refine details of the cross-border REITs distribution plan
subevent.description: In his office, Feng Haoran deeply refined the cross-border REITs agency sales plan based on the early April draft, focusing on adding risk hedging strategies and a client suitability model, while adjusting the product fee structure and fund custody process to ensure the plan better fits the needs of high-net-worth clients. He used a laptop to edit the document and referred to recent overseas market research reports to verify the feasibility of the strategy.
subevent.location: Office of the Investment Advisory Department, Huatai Securities, Changsha

subevent.name: Prepared presentation materials for department meeting
subevent.description: After refining the plan, Feng Haoran immediately used PPT to create a detailed presentation, highlighting the core points of the plan, risk hedging strategy model, client suitability assessment system, and expected return analysis, while printing 5 paper copies of the plan summary for attendees to review.
subevent.location: Office of the Investment Advisory Department, Huatai Securities, Changsha

subevent.name: Attend department meeting to present the proposal
subevent.description: In the department meeting room, Feng Haoran gave a presentation on the cross-border REITs distribution plan to Chief Investment Officer Qian Yongqiang and all team colleagues, explaining in detail the plan design logic, risk hedging strategy, and client suitability model, and answered questions from the attendees. After the meeting, the plan received preliminary approval from Qian Yongqiang, who also suggested supplementing more overseas market data to optimize portfolio allocation, and a pilot could be launched later.
subevent.location: Changsha - Huatai Securities conference room (No. 88 Furong Middle Road)

name: Weekend pour-over coffee time
description: On the afternoon of March 8, Feng Haoran set off from his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, to Xinyi Hand-Drip Coffee Shop on Jiefang West Road, Furong District. In the shop, he chatted with the owner Shen Xinyi about recent new products, tasted a hand-drip coffee from the Pu'er region of Yunnan, and bought a bag of the same coffee beans. Afterwards, he sat in a corner by the window reading Photography World magazine, enjoying some leisure time to relieve the fatigue of continuous overtime work.

subevent.name: Go to Xinyi Pour-Over Coffee Shop
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 8, Feng Haoran set out from his home on Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, and walked or drove to the Xinyi Pour-Over Coffee Shop on Jiefang West Road, Furong District, a trip of about 30 minutes.
subevent.location: Hunan Province, Changsha City - Yuelu District to Furong District - along the way.

subevent.name: Communicated with the boss and sampled the new coffee.
subevent.description: After arriving at Xinyi Pour-Over Coffee Shop, Feng Haoran exchanged information with the owner Shen Xinyi (coffee shop owner, regular-customer relationship) about newly launched coffee beans, then ordered a seasonal pour-over coffee from the Pu'er production area in Yunnan, tasted it at the counter, and discussed brewing techniques and flavor characteristics.
subevent.location: Xinyi Hand-Brewed Coffee Shop, Furong District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Select pour-over coffee beans.
subevent.description: After tasting, Feng Haoran decided to buy a bag of the same hand-drip coffee beans from the Yunnan Pu'er region. Shen Xinyi weighed them on the spot, sealed the package, and collected payment, and the two agreed on the next time to visit the shop.
subevent.location: Xinyi Hand-Brewed Coffee Shop, Furong District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Relaxing by flipping through photography magazines
subevent.description: Feng Haoran walked to a quiet corner by the window with his coffee, browsed the "Photography World" magazine provided by the cafe, enjoyed the street photography feature works, relieved the fatigue of consecutive overtime, and enjoyed a leisurely afternoon. He finished reading after about 1 hour.
subevent.location: Xinyi Hand-Brewed Coffee Shop, Furong District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Adjust the fund investment plan and increase index fund allocation.
description: On the evening of July 19, Feng Haoran analyzed the market in his home study and decided to adjust his systematic investment plan. During his lunch break on July 20, he logged into the Huatai Securities app at the office, reduced the original mixed fund's monthly investment amount by 20%, and added a new CSI 300 index fund plan with a fixed monthly investment of 2,000 yuan.

subevent.name: Market Analysis and Dollar-Cost Averaging Strategy Evaluation
subevent.description: On the evening of July 19, Feng Haoran conducted a systematic analysis of recent A-share market fluctuations in his home study using a financial data terminal and financial information platforms, focusing on the valuation level and trend changes of the CSI 300 Index. Based on his current holdings, he evaluated the cost-effectiveness of his existing monthly balanced fund investment strategy and initially decided to reduce the monthly investment amount in that fund and add an index fund to diversify risk and lower the average cost.

subevent.name: Log into the Huatai Securities APP to execute automatic investment plan adjustment
subevent.description: During the lunch break on July 20, Feng Haoran logged into the Huatai Securities app on his phone in the office, entered the fund auto-investment management interface, reduced the monthly auto-investment amount of the original mixed fund by 20%, and added a new CSI 300 index fund auto-investment plan with a fixed monthly investment of 2,000 yuan. After completing the operation, the system prompted that the adjustment was successful.

name: CFA Level I mock exam and pre-exam sprint preparation
description: From the evening of July 26 to all day on July 27, Feng Haoran systematically prepared for the exam at home. On the evening of the 26th, he prepared the mock exam materials in advance. On the morning of the 27th, he completed a full CFA Level I mock exam (240 questions) strictly according to the exam schedule. After a lunch break, he graded the test and did intensive review on his weak subject, financial statement analysis. In the evening, he formulated a final sprint plan to fully prepare for the official exam in August.

subevent.name: Prepare CFA mock exam materials
subevent.description: On the evening of July 26, Feng Haoran prepared the CFA Level I mock exam papers, answer sheets, and calculator in advance in his home study, and set up the exam environment to ensure the mock exam the next day went smoothly.

subevent.name: Completed the CFA Level I mock exam
subevent.description: From 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. on July 27, Feng Haoran strictly followed the CFA Level I exam time requirements and took a full mock exam in his study, completing all 240 questions covering Ethics and Professional Standards, Quantitative Methods, Financial Statement Analysis, and other topics.

subevent.name: Midday rest and lunch
subevent.description: After the mock exam, Feng Haoran had lunch and took a short break between 12:00 and 13:00 to relax his mind in preparation for the afternoon review and analysis.
subevent.location: Home dining room, Yuelu District, Changsha City

subevent.name: Grading mock exam papers and analyzing weak points.
subevent.description: From 13:00 to 15:00 on the afternoon of July 27, Feng Haoran graded the mock exam papers completed in the morning, calculated the accuracy rate for each subject, and highlighted the incorrect questions and difficult knowledge points in the financial statement analysis section.

subevent.name: Review and fill gaps in financial statement analysis
subevent.description: From 15:00 to 17:00 on July 27, Feng Haoran focused on reviewing weak areas in financial statement analysis, redoing incorrect problems, consulting textbooks and notes, and deepening his understanding of core knowledge points such as financial statement ratio analysis and accounting standards.

subevent.name: Create a final sprint plan for the exam
subevent.description: From 19:00 to 21:00 on the evening of July 27, based on the problems revealed by this mock exam, Feng Haoran formulated a final sprint plan before the August official exam, including the review order of subjects for the remaining time, daily study hours, and key breakthrough directions.

name: Remote client anxiety support and team health discussion.
description: In mid-February, client Huang Siqi experienced mild insomnia and difficulty concentrating due to continuous overtime on a key project, and expressed anxiety through a WeChat work group. After witnessing this, Feng Haoran not only offered simple comfort, but also used his lunch break to send her a list of stress-relief suggestions, and proactively organized a 15-minute online sharing session within the team to discuss self-regulation methods under high-pressure work patterns. Although he was also deeply buried in accumulated work, he realized the importance of mental health and decided to regularly carry out similar activities in the future.

subevent.name: Send a list of stress-relief suggestions
subevent.description: During the lunch break on February 10, 2025 (approximately 12:00-13:00), Feng Haoran, at his desk at Huatai Securities in Changsha, used the break to organize and write a stress-relief suggestion list containing meditation, breathing exercises, short walks, priority lists, etc., and sent it to client Huang Siqi via WeChat private chat, along with encouraging words to help her cope with current work pressure.

subevent.name: Host an online stress-relief sharing session
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 12, 2025, from 15:00 to 15:15, Feng Haoran hosted a 15-minute online sharing session via Tencent Meeting in his office at Huatai Securities in Changsha. Participants included colleagues from the Investment Advisory Department: Zheng Wenbo, Sun Xiaoya, Qian Yongqiang, and others. Feng Haoran shared methods for managing high-pressure work summarized from his own experience and client cases (such as the Pomodoro Technique, mindful breathing, and setting boundaries), and encouraged everyone to support one another. Colleagues actively discussed during the meeting, and the atmosphere was good.

subevent.name: Summarize the sharing session and plan follow-up activities.
subevent.description: On February 13, 2025, Feng Haoran summarized yesterday's online sharing session at the Huatai Securities office in Changsha, organized the meeting minutes, and sent them to team members. Meanwhile, he wrote a plan in his personal work notes: organize a similar online sharing session on stress-relief topics every two weeks, and regularly pay attention to clients' psychological states. Although his own work was piling up, he decided to prioritize the continuous advancement of mental health related activities.

name: Community tree-planting activity.
description: On the evening of March 8, Feng Haoran prepared tree-planting tools at home and confirmed the event notice. On the morning of March 9, responding to the call of Chunhua Community in Yuelu District, he took tools to the community park and planted five osmanthus trees with 15 volunteers, recording the work with his phone throughout. After the event, he shared photos and reflections in his Moments, and that evening wrote a summary of his reflections on the connection between finance professionals and the natural environment.

subevent.name: Prepare tree planting tools
subevent.description: On the evening of March 8, Feng Haoran sorted out tree-planting tools such as a shovel, bucket, and gloves on his home balcony, and checked the notification in the Chunhua Community activity group to confirm the gathering time and place for the community park tree-planting activity on the morning of March 9.
subevent.location: Balcony at home, Yuelu District, Changsha City

subevent.name: Go to the community park
subevent.description: At 7:30 a.m. on March 9, Feng Haoran carried tree-planting tools and walked from home to Chunhua Community Park in Yuelu District. On the way, he met his neighbor, volunteer Aunt Liu, and they walked together and exchanged tree-planting experience.
subevent.location: Chunhua Community Park, Yuelu District, Changsha City

subevent.name: Participated in a tree-planting activity
subevent.description: From 8 to 10 a.m. on March 9, Feng Haoran joined 15 volunteers from Chunhua Community to plant five osmanthus trees in a designated area of the community park. He was responsible for digging the holes, holding the trees upright, and mounding the soil, and he cooperated with community staff member Zhang Wei to complete the watering process.
subevent.location: Chunhua Community Park, Yuelu District, Changsha City

subevent.name: Filming the tree-planting process.
subevent.description: During the tree planting, Feng Haoran used his phone to take photos and short videos of digging holes, planting trees, and watering, with a focus on the before-and-after comparison of five osmanthus trees and the scenes of volunteers working.
subevent.location: Chunhua Community Park, Yuelu District, Changsha City

subevent.name: Share a post on Moments
subevent.description: At 11 a.m. on March 9, after returning home, Feng Haoran sorted through the footage he had taken, selected three photos and a 15-second video, and posted them on WeChat Moments with the caption: 'I planted five osmanthus trees with my own hands, looking forward to the garden being filled with fragrance in autumn. As finance professionals, we must not only manage capital but also protect nature.' He received likes and comments from colleagues and friends.

subevent.name: Write activity reflections
subevent.description: That evening, Feng Haoran recorded in his diary his reflections on participating in the community tree-planting activity, reflecting on the connection between fast-paced financial work and natural environmental protection. He planned to participate in more similar public welfare activities in the future and intended to regularly photograph the growth of the osmanthus tree.

name: Visit potential high-net-worth clients with colleague Zheng Wenbo
description: On the afternoon of August 22, Feng Haoran and his colleague Zheng Wenbo went to Yuhua District, Changsha, to visit a potential high-net-worth entrepreneur introduced by an existing client. The two sides talked for two hours in the other party's company meeting room. Feng Haoran introduced Huatai Securities' family trust and asset allocation services, while Zheng Wenbo added market views from a technical analysis perspective. Although no contract was signed on the spot, the other party expressed a willingness to communicate further and agreed to meet again next month.

subevent.name: Preparation for the visit
subevent.description: At the company office, Feng Haoran organized client background information, prepared the presentation documents for Huatai Securities' family trust and asset allocation plan, and confirmed the afternoon visit route and schedule with his colleague Zheng Wenbo.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities Office, Kaifu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Heading to the client's company
subevent.description: Feng Haoran and Zheng Wenbo took a company vehicle from the Huatai Securities office in Kaifu District to the potential client company in Yuhua District, reviewing the client's background again and discussing interview strategies on the way.
subevent.location: Changsha - Furong Middle Road to Yuhua District

subevent.name: In-person meeting with a client
subevent.description: Feng Haoran and Zheng Wenbo had a roughly two-hour meeting with a potential high-net-worth entrepreneur in the client company's conference room. Feng Haoran focused on introducing Huatai Securities' family trust and asset allocation services, while Zheng Wenbo supplemented the market outlook from a technical analysis perspective. The client expressed interest in further communication, and they agreed to meet again next month.
subevent.location: A corporate meeting room in Yuhua District, Changsha

subevent.name: Return to the company
subevent.description: After the meeting, Feng Haoran and Zheng Wenbo took a car back to the company, briefly summarizing the meeting key points and follow-up plan on the way.
subevent.location: Changsha City – Yuhua District to Kaifu District

name: Visit the "Century of Light and Shadow" photography exhibition at Hunan Museum
description: On the afternoon of May 9, Feng Haoran went alone to the Hunan Museum to visit the newly opened 'A Century of Light and Shadow' photography exhibition, which brought together works by multiple documentary photographers from home and abroad. He carefully studied each work, especially lingering over the black-and-white street photography section, and used his phone to record inspiration and composition techniques. After the exhibition, he shared his thoughts on WeChat Moments. Xu Jianing left a comment praising his improved aesthetic.

subevent.name: Preparation before departure and going to the museum
subevent.description: Feng Haoran checked his phone battery at home (No. 156 Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha), brought his portable camera and notebook, confirmed the Hunan Museum's opening hours and exhibition information, then set off at 1 p.m., took Metro Line 2 to Hunan Museum, and recorded key points for the exhibition in his phone memo on the way.

subevent.name: Visited the Century of Light and Shadow photography exhibition
subevent.description: Feng Haoran arrived at Hunan Museum at 2 p.m., bought a ticket, and entered the exhibition hall of the "A Century of Light and Shadow" photography exhibition. He carefully appreciated more than a hundred works by multiple documentary photographers from home and abroad, especially lingering in the black-and-white street photography area. He took photos of 3 composition examples with his phone and handwrote notes on the use of light and shadow and snapshot techniques. The visit lasted about 2.5 hours, ending at 4:30 p.m.
subevent.location: Changsha, Hunan Province - Hunan Museum - Special Exhibition Hall

subevent.name: Sharing exhibition impressions on Moments
subevent.description: After the visit, Feng Haoran sorted through the exhibition photos he had taken on his phone in the rest area of the Hunan Museum. He selected the 9 most representative works, added his own reflections on the exhibition (about 200 characters), and posted them on WeChat Moments at 5 p.m. The post emphasized the humanistic care and visual aesthetics of light and shadow in the photographs.
subevent.location: Hunan Museum, Changsha, Hunan Province - rest area

subevent.name: Online interaction with photography partner Xu Jianing
subevent.description: After Feng Haoran posted his thoughts on visiting the exhibition on Moments, his photography partner Xu Jianing, based in Shenzhen, commented in the comment section at 7 p.m. that evening, praising Feng Haoran's improved aesthetic and asking about details of the exhibition. Feng Haoran immediately replied with thanks and proactively shared photos he had taken of the exhibition and his composition notes. The two further exchanged insights on street photography in a private WeChat chat for about 40 minutes.

name: Spring road trip route refinement and preparation
description: From March 28 to 30, Feng Haoran prepared for a self-driving trip to western Hunan in early April: on the 28th, during his lunch break, he had the car thoroughly checked at an auto service shop; on the 29th, he had a video conference with friends Peng Yuqing and Dong Haoran to finalize the route (Changsha → Zhangjiajie → Fenghuang Ancient Town → Taohuayuan, 5 days and 4 nights); on the 30th, he booked accommodations along the way online (a guesthouse in Zhangjiajie, a riverside inn in Fenghuang, and a hotel in Taohuayuan), and sent the confirmation screenshots to the friends' group.

subevent.name: Check the vehicle condition for the self-driving tour.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran used his lunch break to drive to a chain auto care shop near Lushan South Road in Yuelu District, Changsha, for a comprehensive check of tires, brakes, oil, coolant, lights, etc., and topped up windshield washer fluid and antifreeze to ensure the vehicle was in good condition, making safety preparations for the upcoming road trip to western Hunan.
subevent.location: Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province - Auto Care Shop

subevent.name: Video conference with friends to finalize the self-driving tour route
subevent.description: Feng Haoran connected with friends Peng Yuqing and Dong Haoran via WeChat video call from his home study. The three discussed in detail and finally finalized the route for the early April road trip to western Hunan: starting from Changsha, visiting in order Zhangjiajie (stay two nights), Fenghuang Ancient City (stay one night), and Taohuayuan (stay one night), for a total of 5 days and 4 nights. During the meeting, details such as daily driving mileage, attraction arrangements, accommodation levels, and budget sharing were confirmed.
subevent.location: Home study, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Booked accommodation along the self-driving trip to Western Hunan
subevent.description: Based on the finalized route, Feng Haoran completed all accommodation bookings on Meituan and Ctrip: a homestay near Zhangjiajie Forest Park (check-in on March 30 for two nights), a riverside inn in Fenghuang Ancient Town (check-in on April 1 for one night), and a hotel in the Taohuayuan Scenic Area (check-in on April 2 for one night). During booking, he paid attention to free cancellation policies and parking conditions, and sent screenshots of the accommodation confirmations to the group of close friends.
subevent.location: Home study, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Handling backlogged client consultations and market analysis after resuming work
description: After returning to work on April 8, Feng Haoran first sorted through the backlog of client inquiry emails and phone calls accumulated during his leave, replying to each and arranging appointments. Meanwhile, he used the three working days from April 8 to 10 to reanalyze recent trends in the A-share and REITs markets, wrote a brief weekly market insight report, and pushed it to key clients via WeChat to restore client trust and communication frequency.

subevent.name: Handle backlogged client inquiries
subevent.description: Feng Haoran returned to the Huatai Securities Changsha office on the morning of April 8, 2025. He first checked the backlog of client inquiry emails and phone messages accumulated during his leave. He replied to emails one by one, made phone call-backs for urgent matters, and scheduled appointments for the coming days based on client needs. The entire process took about 3 hours, ensuring the timely resumption of client communication.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities office, No. 88 Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha City

subevent.name: Collect A-share and REITs market data
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 8, 2025, Feng Haoran used the financial terminal in his office to collect key information on recent A-share major index trends, sector rotation data, and REITs market trading volume and price volatility, and organized it into a spreadsheet as raw data for subsequent analysis.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities office, No. 88 Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha City

subevent.name: In-depth analysis of market trends
subevent.description: On April 9, 2025, Feng Haoran spent the whole day in his office conducting an in-depth analysis of the data collected the previous day. Using technical indicators and fundamental analysis tools, he assessed short-term trends in the A-share market and the risk-return characteristics of REITs products, and recorded key conclusions for report writing.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities office, No. 88 Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha City

subevent.name: Write and publish the weekly market insights report.
subevent.description: On April 10, 2025, Feng Haoran wrote a brief weekly market insight report in his office based on the previous two days' analysis results, covering the latest developments and investment recommendations in the A-share and REITs markets. After completing the report, he sent it to key clients one by one via WeChat, accompanied by personalized interpretations, to restore client trust and communication frequency.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities office, No. 88 Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha City

name: Sign up for the fluorescent night run
description: On July 10, Feng Haoran filled out the registration information for the Neon Night Run online and paid the fee. After successful registration, he took a screenshot of the QR code voucher and joined the official event WeChat group to check announcements.

subevent.name: Fill in registration information online and submit
subevent.description: Feng Haoran filled in basic personal information (name, mobile number, emergency contact, etc.) on the registration page, chose a T-shirt size, paid the registration fee, and successfully submitted the application for the Neon Night Run.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District - home study (online)

subevent.name: Confirm successful registration and join the activity group.
subevent.description: The registration system showed successful registration and generated a QR code voucher. Feng Haoran took a screenshot and saved it, then scanned the QR code on the page to join the official WeChat group of the Fluorescent Night Run, and checked the group announcement to understand the event precautions.

name: MBA group final defense scored poorly due to earlier conflicts
description: On March 15, team leader Feng Haoran took the initiative to communicate with team members to repair the rift caused by the February dispute over data standards; on the 18th, he reorganized the defense PPT; on the 20th, during a mock rehearsal, he found that collaboration was still stiff; on the 22nd, the defense day, he made final preparations in the morning and gave the official defense in the afternoon. Because the earlier estrangement had not been fully resolved, the division of labor and cooperation felt rigid, and the judges pointed out that the logic was not coherent, resulting in an average score. That evening, he had dinner with his team members to review the experience and admitted to insufficient communication; on the 23rd, he wrote a reflection diary and planned to strengthen his leadership learning. The whole process made Feng Haoran deeply realize the importance of leadership communication.

subevent.name: Communicating with team members to repair the relationship
subevent.description: Feng Haoran, as the MBA group leader, proactively contacted the three team members (Li Ming, Zhang Ya, Wang Hao) for a face-to-face meeting at a café in Yuelu District, Changsha, to address the team rift caused by the dispute over the February data scope. He sincerely apologized and re-clarified the data scope standards, striving to repair the cooperative relationship before the defense.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District Coffee Shop

subevent.name: Reorganized the final defense PPT
subevent.description: Based on the agreement reached on March 15, Feng Haoran and his team members divided the work, reorganized the logical framework of the case analysis, integrated data definitions, and spent 3 hours at his home study in Changsha to update the defense PPT version, then sent it to team members for review.

subevent.name: Conduct mock defense rehearsal.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran organized three team members in a seminar room at Hunan University Library to rehearse the mock defense. They pre-rehearsed segments such as case logic coherence and data consistency that judges might question. They found that team collaboration was still a bit stiff, but the process was basically streamlined.

subevent.name: Final preparations before the defense
subevent.description: At 8 a.m. on the day of the defense, Feng Haoran arrived early at the MBA case classroom, met up with his group members, checked the PPT presentation equipment again, assigned roles for the defense, and encouraged the team to stay calm.
subevent.location: Changsha – MBA teaching site near Huatai Securities

subevent.name: Group final defense process
subevent.description: At 3 p.m., the MBA group's final defense officially began. Feng Haoran, as the group leader, first gave a case overview, followed by the other members adding their parts in turn. Because the earlier team rift had not fully healed, the division of labor and coordination during the defense was stiff. The judges pointed out that the logical transitions were not coherent, and there were still subtle contradictions in the data metrics. The final score was average, falling short of expectations.
subevent.location: Changsha – MBA teaching site near Huatai Securities

subevent.name: Post-defense review with team members
subevent.description: After the defense ended at 7 p.m., Feng Haoran invited his team members to dinner at a restaurant by the Xiangjiang River in Changsha. He frankly analyzed the reasons for the failure, admitted as the team leader that he had not communicated well during the February conflict, and discussed directions for improving future teamwork.
subevent.location: Changsha - Restaurant by the Xiangjiang River

subevent.name: Personal reflection and leadership learning plan
subevent.description: Feng Haoran wrote a diary summarizing the defense in his home study, deeply reflecting on the importance of communicating with leaders, and planned to sign up for a leadership training course. He also decided to actively adjust the team atmosphere in future MBA courses to avoid similar conflicts.

name: Dragon Boat Festival video reunion, caring about father's blood pressure and mother's diet.
description: During the 2025 Dragon Boat Festival, Feng Haoran was unable to return to Wuhan for a family reunion due to work. On the evening of June 1, he went to the supermarket to buy fresh pork zongzi, candied jujube zongzi and fruit, and took photos to send to his parents to report on the festival preparations. On June 2, the Dragon Boat Festival, he cooked zongzi and had them with coffee for dinner, and sent another photo to reassure them. At 8 pm that evening, he had a nearly one-hour video call with his parents, showing the zongzi, asking about his father's blood pressure after switching antihypertensive medication, and reminding his mother to eat light in summer. His parents were concerned about his cervical spine, but he only shared good news. After the call, he felt homesick but relieved about his parents' health, browsed the photos, wrote in his diary about his feelings, and planned to go home next time.

subevent.name: Purchased ingredients for zongzi on the eve of the Dragon Boat Festival.
subevent.description: On the evening of June 1, 2025, after work, Feng Haoran went to a supermarket near his home and bought two bags of fresh pork zongzi, a pack of honey-date zongzi, and some summer fruits, preparing for the Dragon Boat Festival the next day, which he would spend alone at home. He deliberately took a photo and sent it to his parents, saying that although he couldn't go home, he would celebrate the festival properly on his own.
subevent.location: Supermarket near Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha City

subevent.name: Boiled zongzi and enjoyed dinner for the Dragon Boat Festival.
subevent.description: On the evening of June 2, 2025 (Dragon Boat Festival), Feng Haoran cooked fresh pork zongzi and honey-date zongzi in a pot in his kitchen according to the package instructions. After they were done, he took photos of the zongzi, paired them with his own hand-brewed coffee, enjoyed a Dragon Boat Festival dinner at the dining table, and sent the photos to his parents to let them know he was safe.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District - Home kitchen and dining room

subevent.name: Video call with parents to check on their health
subevent.description: On the evening of June 2, 2025, Dragon Boat Festival, around 8 pm, Feng Haoran had a nearly one-hour video call with his parents at their home in Wuhan via WeChat. He asked in detail about his father Feng Jianguo's blood pressure control after switching antihypertensive medication, and urged his mother Li Xiuying to keep a light diet and eat less greasy food in summer. At the same time, he showed the freshly cooked zongzi and the Dragon Boat Festival dinner to reassure his parents. His mother, in turn, asked about his neck condition. Feng Haoran replied that everything was fine, only reporting good news and not the bad.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yuelu District - home living room (video call to Wuhan - Jiangan District - parents' home)

subevent.name: Feeling homesick after the call and sorting out emotions
subevent.description: After the video call ended, Feng Haoran sat quietly at his desk for a few minutes, feeling a touch of homesickness, but more relief that his parents were in good health. He opened his phone's photo album, browsed through family photos from his previous trip to Wuhan, then briefly recorded his feelings about this Dragon Boat Festival in his diary, and planned to visit his parents in Wuhan during the next long holiday.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District - Home study

name: Spring road trip planning and initial preparation
description: On February 23, Feng Haoran discussed the spring self-driving tour route with Peng Yuqing and Dong Haoran (via video), chose the route from Western Hunan to Zhangjiajie, tentatively set for early April, and divided tasks: Feng Haoran responsible for route planning, Dong Haoran responsible for vehicle inspection, Peng Yuqing responsible for supplies procurement. That day, Dong Haoran started vehicle inspection in Shenzhen. On February 24, Peng Yuqing made a supplies list and confirmed it with the two.

subevent.name: Discussed the road trip with Peng Yuqing in person.
subevent.description: On the morning of February 23, Feng Haoran met his friend Peng Yuqing at a cafe in downtown Changsha. They had an in-depth discussion about preliminary ideas for a spring road trip, including destination preferences and travel time. Peng Yuqing proposed a route from western Hunan to Zhangjiajie; Feng Haoran agreed and planned to invite Dong Haoran to discuss it together later.
subevent.location: Changsha - Furong District - Xinyi Pour-Over Coffee Shop

subevent.name: Had a video conference with Dong Haoran to confirm the route.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 23, Feng Haoran connected via WeChat video with his friend Dong Haoran, who was far away in Shenzhen, to share the self-driving tour plan from western Hunan to Zhangjiajie that he had discussed with Peng Yuqing in the morning. Dong Haoran agreed with the route, and the three finally decided to set off in early April, and discussed the specific division of labor for vehicles, supplies, and route planning: Feng Haoran is responsible for route planning, Dong Haoran for vehicle inspection, and Peng Yuqing for supply procurement.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District - Home study

subevent.name: Vehicle inspection preparation
subevent.description: According to the division of labor, Dong Haoran began a comprehensive inspection in Shenzhen of the vehicle to be used for the self-driving trip, including tires, brakes, engine oil, coolant, etc., to ensure the vehicle is in good condition. At the same time, he communicated with Feng Haoran about the vehicle usage arrangement and confirmed that maintenance needs to be completed before departure.
subevent.location: Guangdong Province - Shenzhen - an auto repair shop

subevent.name: Making the supplies procurement list
subevent.description: Based on the road trip needs, Peng Yuqing made a list of required supplies at home, including outdoor gear, food and drinks, a first-aid kit, photography equipment, etc., and confirmed the list with Feng Haoran and Dong Haoran via WeChat. The three of them supplemented and adjusted it together.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuhua District - Peng Yuqing's home

name: Visit the Meixi Lake Impressionist Art Exhibition
description: On the evening of April 23, Feng Haoran used his after-work time to go to the Meixi Lake International Culture and Arts Center in Changsha and visited the newly opened 'Impressionist Masters Exhibition.' He carefully appreciated the original works of Monet and Renoir, took photos of details of several paintings with his phone as references for photographic composition, and finally bought an art book at the art shop as a collection.

subevent.name: Heading to Meixi Lake International Culture and Arts Center
subevent.description: Around 18:10, Feng Haoran left his company on Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, took Metro Line 2 toward Meixi Lake, arrived at the Meixi Lake International Culture and Arts Center around 19:00, and entered after verifying his ticket via QR code scan on his phone at the entrance.
subevent.location: Changsha - Meixi Lake International Culture and Art Center

subevent.name: Visit the Impressionist Masters Exhibition
subevent.description: From 19:10 to 20:30, Feng Haoran viewed original works one by one in the art center exhibition hall, including Monet's Water Lilies series and Renoir's Dance at Le Moulin de la Galette. He took out his phone and photographed the composition, light-and-shadow details, and brushstroke close-ups of several paintings as reference material for his own street photography composition.
subevent.location: Changsha - Meixi Lake International Culture and Arts Center Exhibition Hall

subevent.name: Purchased an art book at the art store
subevent.description: After the tour, at 20:35 Feng Haoran went to the souvenir shop on the first floor of the art center, browsed through several Impressionist art books, and finally selected a hardcover edition of 'The Complete Masterpieces of Impressionist Masters', paid 298 yuan by credit card, and then put the book into his backpack.
subevent.location: Changsha - Meixihu International Culture and Art Center Art Shop

name: Weekend urban street photography and exhibition planning
description: On Sunday, February 16, 2025, after preparing his photography equipment at home, Feng Haoran went to Taiping Street Historic District in Changsha in the morning and took about 100 photos. In the afternoon, he moved to Chaozong Street Historic District and continued shooting about 70 photos, capturing humanity and light and shadow. In the evening, he returned home, imported about 200 original photos into his computer, and made an initial selection of about 120. The next day, he further shortlisted 15 works (including a set of street performer portraits), looked up online photography exhibition information, and planned to submit after post-processing color grading.

subevent.name: Prepare street photography gear
subevent.description: At his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Feng Haoran organized his camera bag, checking the Sony A7M3 camera, 24-70mm and 85mm lenses, spare batteries, and memory cards to make sure everything was complete, and changed into casual clothes suitable for street photography.

subevent.name: Going to Taiping Street for photography
subevent.description: Feng Haoran set off from home with his camera, took Metro Line 2 to Xiangjiang Middle Road Station, and walked to Taiping Street. He wandered through the main alleys and side alleys of Taiping Street, photographing old street buildings, pedestrians, light and shadow, and shop signs, focusing on capturing the atmosphere of daily life under the soft morning light. He shot continuously for about 1.5 hours, completing about 100 photos.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Taiping Street Historic District

subevent.name: Move to the historic district and continue filming
subevent.description: Feng Haoran walked to the Chaozong Street historic district, which connects to Taiping Street, and photographed the old residential buildings, stone-paved roads, and scenes of residents' daily life in the area during the afternoon. Using the oblique light from 3 to 4 p.m., he focused on light–shadow contrast and texture, completing about 70 more photos. He took a short break during this time and had a cup of pour-over coffee at a street café.

subevent.name: Returned home to organize photos.
subevent.description: Around 5 p.m., Feng Haoran finished shooting and returned home. He imported the photos from the memory card into his computer and used Lightroom to initially screen and classify about 200 raw photos, deleting those that were clearly blurry or poorly composed and keeping about 120 as candidates.

subevent.name: Selecting photos and planning submissions for an online photography exhibition
subevent.description: The next day, Feng Haoran selected 15 of his most satisfying street photography works from the 120 photos he had sorted out, including a set of portraits of street performers and several street scenes with excellent light and shadow. He checked the submission deadline and requirements of an online photography exhibition, and decided to do post-processing color grading on the selected works in the near future and submit them for the exhibition.

name: Peng Yuqing's self-media account started taking ads, with a monthly income of 3,000 yuan
description: Throughout September, merchants gradually began contacting Peng Yuqing about placing ads on her self-media account, and the content-driven traffic began to show initial results. By the end of the month, her account's monthly income reached 3,000 yuan. Feng Haoran promptly encouraged her on WeChat, but deliberately avoided excessive interference, respecting her independent business pace.

subevent.name: Peng Yuqing received her first advertising collaboration invitation.
subevent.description: On September 3, while running her self-media account at home in Changsha, Peng Yuqing received a private message from a skincare brand expressing interest in placing an advertisement. After initially confirming the other party's needs, Peng Yuqing agreed on details for follow-up communication. Feng Haoran saw the post shared by Peng Yuqing on WeChat Moments that day, but did not proactively ask, respecting her independent pace of operation.

subevent.name: Peng Yuqing received multiple advertising cooperation offers in succession
subevent.description: On September 20, as the effect of content-driven traffic began to show, Peng Yuqing received advertising cooperation requests from two other businesses: a local restaurant brand and a travel app. She replied to these messages in a batch on the same day and screened out suitable cooperation for further negotiation. On the same day, Feng Haoran briefly asked how she was doing on WeChat. Peng Yuqing shared the progress of the contacts, and Feng Haoran expressed approval but did not give in-depth suggestions.

subevent.name: Peng Yuqing's monthly income reached 3000 yuan, and she was encouraged by Feng Haoran.
subevent.description: On the evening of September 30, Peng Yuqing, at her home in Changsha, tallied all advertising collaboration income for the month and confirmed the total reached 3,000 yuan. She shared the good news with Feng Haoran via WeChat and attached a screenshot of the income. Feng Haoran replied promptly on WeChat, praising her effort and content quality, encouraging her to keep up the pace while also balancing life and creation, avoiding over-commercialization that could affect the tone of her account. The whole exchange was natural, supportive, and not overly intrusive.

name: Communicated with parents about the retirement community inspection and subsequent arrangements.
description: From July 6 to 16, Feng Haoran made a series of preparations and communications to discuss retirement community inspections with his parents: On July 6, he first organized inspection materials for three retirement communities in Yuelu District; on the evening of July 15, he had a nearly 40-minute video call with his parents via WeChat, reporting the inspection results in detail and asking about their willingness to move. His parents showed interest in one of the communities and agreed to visit in person next month. After the call, Feng Haoran immediately recorded key points and planned follow-up actions. The next day (July 16), he further discussed with his parents and confirmed a weekend in early August for the site visit, and began checking high-speed rail and hotel information. The whole process strengthened Feng Haoran's sense of family responsibility and parent-child trust.

subevent.name: Organize the retirement community site-visit materials
subevent.description: At his home study, Feng Haoran systematically organized the notes, photos, and comparison tables from his July 5-6 inspection of three elderly care communities in Yuelu District, highlighting key indicators such as medical facilities, green space area, and transportation convenience, fully preparing for the evening video call with his parents.

subevent.name: Video call with parents to discuss the retirement community site visit
subevent.description: At 20:00 on the evening of July 15, 2025, Feng Haoran had a roughly 40-minute video call with his parents Feng Jianguo and Li Xiuying, who were far away in Wuhan, via WeChat. He reported in detail on the comparison of three retirement communities in Yuelu District, including the medical facilities, green space area, transportation convenience, and surrounding living amenities of each community, and asked about his parents' willingness to move and their specific living needs. His parents showed strong interest in one of the communities, and both sides agreed that next month Feng Haoran would arrange for his parents to come to Changsha for an on-site visit and experience.

subevent.name: Record the key points of the call and plan follow-up arrangements.
subevent.description: After the video call ended, Feng Haoran wrote down in his notebook the specific needs his parents had for a retirement community, their interest in a retirement community in Yuelu District, and the preliminary agreement to visit in person next month. Based on the call, he also made a next-step action list, including checking high-speed rail schedules for his parents to come to Changsha, finding nearby hotels, and contacting the retirement community to book a tour time.

subevent.name: Discussing specific dates for next month's field trip with parents
subevent.description: On the morning of July 16, 2025, Feng Haoran communicated with his parents via WeChat to confirm the specific date for their trip to Changsha next month to inspect retirement communities. Taking into account his parents' free time and his own work schedule, he initially settled on a weekend in early August as the inspection time, and began checking high-speed train schedules between Changsha and Wuhan as well as hotel information near retirement communities.

name: His mother had stomach discomfort, so Feng Haoran arranged an examination remotely and followed up on the results.
description: On March 12, 2025, his mother Li Xiuying called Feng Haoran to complain of stomach discomfort. After asking in detail, Feng Haoran used his phone to book a gastroscopy with the Gastroenterology Department of Wuhan Union Hospital for the next day. On March 13, his parents went to the hospital for the examination, and Feng Haoran followed up by phone. On March 20, after receiving the biopsy report, his mother told him the diagnosis was mild gastritis, and Feng Haoran reminded her of precautions to take.

subevent.name: Mother called to report stomach discomfort, and I made a remote appointment for her
subevent.description: On March 12, 2025, mother Li Xiuying called Feng Haoran from home in Wuhan, complaining of persistent stomach discomfort. Feng Haoran asked in detail about the pain location, frequency, and diet, then judged that a professional examination was needed. He immediately booked a gastroscopy appointment with the gastroenterology department for his mother the next morning through the Wuhan Union Hospital official account on his phone, reminded her of the fasting requirements, and also called his father Feng Jianguo to inform him to accompany her the next day.
subevent.location: Changsha - home / Wuhan - home (both ends of the phone call)

subevent.name: Mother went to Wuhan Union Hospital for a gastroscopy.
subevent.description: On the morning of March 13, 2025, the father Feng Jianguo accompanied the mother Li Xiuying to the Gastroenterology Department of Wuhan Union Hospital for a gastroscopy. Before the examination, Feng Haoran confirmed via WeChat voice message that his mother had fasted and informed her of the specific department location. During the examination, Feng Haoran took time from his office in Changsha to call and check progress. After the examination, his mother called to say the doctor had prescribed regulating medication and recommended dietary adjustments, but the biopsy report was not yet available.

subevent.name: Mother informed of the examination results; Feng Haoran reminded her of precautions
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 20, 2025, his mother Li Xiuying called Feng Haoran after receiving the biopsy report from Wuhan Union Hospital, and the diagnosis was mild chronic superficial gastritis without Helicobacter pylori infection. Feng Haoran breathed a sigh of relief, gave detailed instructions for his mother to continue taking medication as prescribed for two weeks, maintain a light diet in the long term, avoid raw, cold, and greasy food, suggested his father reduce the amount of oil in cooking, and agreed to keep a weekly phone call to monitor recovery. Family relationships improved due to positive communication.
subevent.location: Changsha - home / Wuhan - home (both ends of the phone call)

name: Blind date experience and reflection
description: On the afternoon of September 9, 2025, Feng Haoran went to a café in Yuhua District to meet his blind date, Liu Jia, after careful preparation. The two talked for about two hours. Feng Haoran found that Liu Jia paid more attention to material conditions and lacked spiritual resonance, which left him with a sense of unmet expectations. After returning home that evening, he recorded his reflections in his diary, clearly stating that 'spiritual resonance and mutual growth are what truly matter,' and refocused his energy on his personal goals.

subevent.name: Preparations for the blind date and heading to the dating venue.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of the blind date, Feng Haoran carefully dressed, chose a casual business style, and brought his camera bag as an icebreaker topic. He set out from his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, took the subway to the café in Yuhua District agreed upon with his date, and on the way checked the other person's photo and basic information again on his phone.
subevent.location: From home in Yuelu District, Changsha City to the metro line in Yuhua District

subevent.name: First meeting and conversation with the blind date
subevent.description: Feng Haoran had a first meeting with his blind date Liu Jia (28, a teacher at an educational institution in Changsha) at a boutique café in Yuhua District. The two started with work topics and gradually delved into hobbies and values. Feng Haoran shared his photography work and camping experiences, while Liu Jia talked about her passion for education. The conversation lasted about two hours. Feng Haoran found that the other party cared more about material conditions and lacked spiritual resonance, and he felt a gap between expectation and reality.
subevent.location: Boutique coffee shop in Yuhua District, Changsha.

subevent.name: Recording reflections in the diary after returning home.
subevent.description: After the blind date, Feng Haoran returned home in Yuelu District, opened the diary in the study, and seriously recorded the experience. He wrote down the other person's basic information, his own feelings and thoughts, and especially reflected on his expectations for a partner: 'Perhaps spiritual resonance and mutual growth are what truly matter; no need to rush.' Through this writing, he became clearer about his standards for choosing a partner and decided to temporarily refocus his energy on work promotion and personal investment goals.

name: The paper was published in 'Hunan Finance' and I was invited to attend a local financial forum.
description: On September 5, 2025, Feng Haoran's paper on fintech regulation was officially published in the journal "Hunan Finance". The article combined knowledge from his MBA studies with front-line practical experience. On September 10, he received an invitation from the organizing committee of the local financial forum to participate as a guest in the year-end event, achieving initial synergy between academic achievements and career development.

subevent.name: Paper officially published
subevent.description: On the morning of September 5, 2025, at his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Feng Haoran used his laptop to log into the official website of the journal *Hunan Finance*, confirmed that his paper 'Practice and Reflections on Fintech Regulation' had been officially published, downloaded and saved the full PDF to a local folder, and also took a screenshot of the publication page for the record.

subevent.name: Sharing the good news of the paper being published
subevent.description: After the paper was published, Feng Haoran informed his parents Feng Jianguo and Li Xiuying, childhood friend Zhang Mingxuan, college friends Zhao Tianyu and Wu Junjie, and colleague Zheng Wenbo one by one via WeChat, and received congratulations and discussion replies about the paper's content from everyone. During this period, he also had a video call with his mother to share the joy.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yuelu District, home living room

subevent.name: Received forum invitation email
subevent.description: On the morning of September 10, 2025, while checking emails via his company mailbox at the Huatai Securities office in Kaifu District, Changsha, Feng Haoran found a formal invitation from the organizing committee of the Local Financial Forum, inviting him to attend the forum to be held in mid-December 2025 as a guest and give a special presentation on the theme of fintech regulation.

subevent.name: Reply to confirm attendance at invitation
subevent.description: After carefully reading the invitation, Feng Haoran replied to the organizing committee via his company email that afternoon, confirming his acceptance of the invitation to be a forum guest, and politely asked about the forum's specific agenda, the arrangement of guests, and the presentation materials that needed to be prepared in advance. He also CC'd his direct supervisor, Qian Yongqiang, for the record.

name: Studied alternative investment strategies late at night; the REITs portfolio restored its credibility
description: After submitting the reflection report, Feng Haoran studied REITs and other alternative investments late into the night for several consecutive days from March 14 to 28, designing a comprehensive solution incorporating REITs for his important client Lin Zhihao. On March 28, amid market volatility, the portfolio performed steadily. Lin Zhihao made a special trip to thank him, partially restoring his damaged professional image. However, prolonged high-intensity eye use worsened his cervical spine discomfort.

subevent.name: Researching REITs-related materials late at night
subevent.description: To restore his professional credibility, Feng Haoran, starting from March 14, 2025, spent several consecutive late nights in his study at his home in Changsha researching alternative investment strategies such as REITs, reviewing domestic and international REITs market data and case analyses online, and recording key investment points. The intense eye strain caused mild discomfort in his cervical spine.
subevent.location: Home study, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Late-night research on REITs materials (Day 1)
subevent.description: Late on the night of March 14, 2025, Feng Haoran opened his laptop in the study of his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, and began researching alternative investment strategies such as REITs. He looked up the latest data on REITs markets at home and abroad (such as the United States, Singapore, China, etc.) online, analyzed typical investment cases, and recorded key investment points. After intensive eye use until around 1 a.m., he began to feel slight discomfort in his neck.
subevent.location: Home study, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Late-night research on REITs materials (Day 2)
subevent.description: Late at night on March 15, 2025, Feng Haoran continued researching REITs materials in the study, focusing on the performance and dividend distributions of Chinese public REITs products, and comparing yields of different asset types (industrial parks, highways, etc.). Due to continuous eye use, the neck discomfort persisted.
subevent.location: Home study, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Late-night research on REITs materials (Day 3)
subevent.description: Late night on March 16, 2025, Feng Haoran conducted in-depth research on the legal and regulatory frameworks of the global REITs market in his study, paying special attention to the impact of different countries' tax policies on REITs investment returns. He created a comparison table and began compiling a personal investment memorandum. The discomfort in his cervical spine had slightly worsened.
subevent.location: Home study, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Late-night research on REITs materials (Day 5)
subevent.description: Late at night on March 18, 2025, Feng Haoran reviewed previously recorded investment points in his study and simulated building a REITs investment portfolio based on recent market conditions. He used Excel to calculate expected returns and volatility, and optimized allocation weights. Because of prolonged sitting, neck discomfort affected his concentration, so he got up and moved around midway.
subevent.location: Home study, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Late-night research on REITs materials (Day 6).
subevent.description: Late at night on March 19, 2025, Feng Haoran was in the study reviewing the latest industry research reports, comparing his own investment strategy with institutional views for similarities and differences. He focused on analyzing the long-term performance differences between infrastructure REITs and commercial real estate REITs, and annotated key data sources in the report. Discomfort in his cervical spine required him to periodically massage his neck.
subevent.location: Home study, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Late-night research on REITs materials (Day 7)
subevent.description: Late at night on March 20, 2025, Feng Haoran was doing the final wrap-up work of REITs research in his study, organizing all analysis notes and writing a brief investment recommendation framework. He reviewed the research results of the past week and summarized the valid viewpoints. At the end, he felt obvious soreness and swelling in his neck and decided to rest moderately afterwards.
subevent.location: Home study, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Design a comprehensive REITs plan for client Lin Zhihao
subevent.description: Based on prior research, Feng Haoran designed a comprehensive investment plan incorporating REITs for important client Lin Zhihao in his home study in Changsha and at the Huatai Securities office, including asset allocation ratios, risk assessment, and return expectations. He also had a preliminary phone discussion with Lin Zhihao about the plan framework. Continued overtime work worsened his neck discomfort.
subevent.location: Changsha, Hunan Province - home study and Huatai Securities office

subevent.name: Organize financial reports and goals
subevent.description: In his study at home in Changsha, Feng Haoran reviewed client Lin Zhihao's existing asset allocation, investment preferences, and risk tolerance, and clarified the return target and risk boundaries of the comprehensive REITs plan, laying the foundation for subsequent design.

subevent.name: Modeling and risk assessment
subevent.description: Feng Haoran, at the Huatai Securities office, used financial modeling software to run simulations according to the asset allocation ratios, analyzing the portfolio risk metrics and expected returns after embedding REITs, and recorded the preliminary results.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities office, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Drafting a proposal document
