subevent.description: At the company office, Feng Haoran organized modeling data and wrote a comprehensive REITs investment plan document, including asset allocation ratios, risk assessment reports, and expected return tables, and self-checked the data accuracy.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities office, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Phone discussion on the plan framework.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran explained the core framework, allocation logic, and expected returns of the comprehensive REITs plan to client Lin Zhihao over the phone in his office, listened to Lin Zhihao's suggestions on liquidity needs and investment horizon, and recorded key feedback points.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities office, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Fine-tune the plan and address physical discomfort.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran, based on Lin Zhihao's feedback, fine-tuned the asset allocation and risk control clauses in the plan at the office and completed the final version. As neck discomfort worsened due to continuous overtime, he applied a hot towel to his neck to relieve it after returning home.
subevent.location: Changsha City, Hunan Province - Huatai Securities office and home

subevent.name: Submit the comprehensive REITs proposal and communicate on details.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran sent the finalized comprehensive REITs investment plan to Lin Zhihao by email, then explained in detail the logic, expected returns, and risk control measures of the plan via WeChat voice call, ensuring Lin Zhihao understood and adopted the plan, with plans to conduct market verification the next day.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities office in Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Market validation plan was effective and received a thank-you from the client.
subevent.description: On March 28, the market fluctuated. The REITs portfolio Feng Haoran designed for Lin Zhihao performed steadily and successfully withstood the market downturn. Lin Zhihao specifically called Feng Haoran to express gratitude and recognized his professional competence, partially repairing Feng Haoran's previously damaged professional image. Due to several days of intense eye use, Feng Haoran's cervical discomfort intensified.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities office in Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Went to the hospital to check cervical spine discomfort.
subevent.description: Due to worsening neck discomfort from continuous late-night research, Feng Haoran went to the outpatient clinic of Xiangya Third Hospital in Yuelu District, Changsha on March 29 for a cervical spine examination and received physical therapy recommendations. The doctor advised reducing continuous screen time and doing regular neck relaxation exercises.
subevent.location: Xiangya Third Hospital, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Pre-Festival New Year Shopping
description: On Saturday evening, January 25, Feng Haoran made a shopping list for Chinese New Year goods at home. On Sunday, January 26, he went to Walmart Supercenter and Jiuruzhai Specialties Store, buying traditional New Year goods such as lotus root powder, sesame candy, and sauce-braised duck, and picked an electronic blood pressure monitor as a health gift. At checkout, he remembered his mother's thin appearance and decided to urge his parents to have a medical examination after the New Year.

subevent.name: Make a New Year shopping list in advance
subevent.description: On the evening of Saturday, January 25, Feng Haoran used the memo app on his phone at home to make a shopping list for the next day's New Year goods, listing the traditional Hubei New Year items to buy (lotus root powder, sesame candy, etc.) as well as the electronic blood pressure monitor prepared for his parents, and planned the route to the supermarket and specialty stores.

subevent.name: Go to a large supermarket to purchase traditional New Year goods.
subevent.description: On the morning of Sunday, January 26, Feng Haoran drove alone to the Walmart supermarket near his home. In the snack area, he carefully selected a variety of traditional Hubei New Year goods, such as lotus root powder, sesame candy, Xiaogan sesame candy, and sesame baked cake, and carefully checked the production dates and packaging to ensure quality.

subevent.name: Go to a specialty store to buy local specialty products
subevent.description: On the morning of Sunday, January 26, after leaving the supermarket, Feng Haoran drove to the century-old specialty store "Jiuruzhai" on Huangxing Road Pedestrian Street and bought extra Changsha specialties, such as sauced dried duck and jarred pork, as a supplement to his parents' Spring Festival gifts.
subevent.location: Jiuruzhai Specialty Store, Huangxing Road Pedestrian Street, Furong District, Changsha City

subevent.name: Selecting an electronic blood pressure monitor as a health gift
subevent.description: On Sunday morning, January 26, at a medical device store near the specialty shop, Feng Haoran carefully compared the functions and value of several electronic blood pressure monitors, finally choosing a well-known brand upper-arm electronic blood pressure monitor, and asked the clerk to wrap it as a Spring Festival gift for his parents.
subevent.location: Medical Device Specialty Store, Furong District, Changsha

subevent.name: While paying the bill, he thought about urging his parents to get a physical examination after the New Year.
subevent.description: On Sunday morning, January 26, while checking out at the supermarket cashier, Feng Haoran looked at the New Year goods and blood pressure monitor he had bought, recalled his mother's increasingly thin appearance, resolved to set aside time after the New Year to take his parents to Wuhan Union Hospital for a comprehensive physical examination, and recorded this plan in his phone's memo.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yuelu District Walmart supermarket checkout counter

name: Acute cervical flare-up due to staying up late; sought emergency medical treatment and formulated a rehabilitation plan
description: After staying up late for a week to supplement thesis data, Feng Haoran developed severe neck pain and numbness in his right arm on June 18, and went to the emergency department of the Rehabilitation Department at the Fourth Hospital of Changsha. The doctor diagnosed an acute episode of cervical disc herniation, prescribed anti-inflammatory painkillers, and arranged physical therapy three times a week (traction and medium-frequency electrotherapy). He was advised to strictly limit desk time and get up and move every 45 minutes. Feng Haoran immediately bought a cervical traction device and negotiated with his company to adjust some of his working hours.

subevent.name: Sudden onset of cervical spine symptoms and emergency medical visit
subevent.description: On the morning of June 18, 2025, Feng Haoran, after staying up late for a week to supplement thesis data, suddenly experienced severe neck pain and numbness in his right arm at his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, and was unable to move normally. He immediately took a taxi to the Emergency Department of the Rehabilitation Department of the Fourth Hospital of Changsha. On the way, he called his colleague Zheng Wenbo to explain the situation and request temporary leave.
subevent.location: Rehabilitation Department, the Fourth Hospital of Changsha, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Accept diagnosis and treatment arrangements
subevent.description: At the Rehabilitation Department of Changsha Fourth Hospital, Feng Haoran received a detailed consultation and physical examination from the doctor. After cervical spine X-rays, he was diagnosed with an acute episode of cervical disc herniation. The doctor prescribed anti-inflammatory painkillers (ibuprofen sustained-release capsules and mecobalamin tablets) and arranged physical therapy three times a week, including cervical traction, medium-frequency electrotherapy, and ultrasound therapy. Feng Haoran booked the first physical therapy session on the spot for the afternoon of June 20.
subevent.location: Rehabilitation Department, the Fourth Hospital of Changsha, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Buy a cervical traction device
subevent.description: After leaving the hospital, Feng Haoran went to a medical device store near the company (Medical Device City, Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha) and purchased a medical-grade cervical traction device, spending about 680 yuan. He learned the correct usage from the store clerk, tried it on the spot and adjusted the tightness, then returned home with the device.
subevent.location: Medical Device City, Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Negotiating adjusted working hours with the company
subevent.description: After returning home, Feng Haoran communicated his condition by phone with his direct supervisor Qian Yongqiang, proposing to arrive late and leave early by 1 hour each day for the next two weeks, reduce continuous desk time, and apply for half-day remote work on physiotherapy days. Qian Yongqiang expressed understanding and agreed to the adjustment, while also asking Feng Haoran to hand over some urgent work to colleague Zheng Wenbo. Feng Haoran then submitted a work adjustment request in the internal system.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Prepare for and attend the company's internal quarterly investment strategy review meeting and post-meeting work
description: On April 28, Feng Haoran prepared meeting materials in the office in the morning, and in the afternoon attended the internal quarterly review meeting of the Investment Advisory Department at Huatai Securities. At the meeting, he reviewed the performance of the first-quarter investment portfolio with colleagues Zheng Wenbo and Sun Xiaoya, discussed expectations for second-quarter macro policy and the direction of asset allocation adjustments, and shared ideas on cross-border business from the Shanghai Summit, which won the approval of Director Qian Yongqiang. After the meeting, he sorted out the meeting minutes and began to refine the cross-border business plan.

subevent.name: Prepare meeting materials before the meeting
subevent.description: Feng Haoran was at his Huatai Securities office at 88 Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, organizing first-quarter portfolio data, Shanghai summit notes, and the second-quarter macro-policy analysis report, and compiling them into PPT and Excel charts to prepare for the afternoon review meeting.

subevent.name: First-quarter investment portfolio review discussion
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 28, in the conference room at Huatai Securities' Changsha headquarters, Feng Haoran, together with colleagues Zheng Wenbo and Sun Xiaoya, presented via projector the first quarter returns, risk exposure, and drawdowns of each asset class, analyzed the sources of excess returns and shortcomings one by one, and team members took turns offering improvement suggestions.

subevent.name: Discussion on second-quarter macro policy and allocation directions.
subevent.description: In the middle of the review meeting, presided over by Director Qian Yongqiang, all participants discussed the impact of central bank monetary policy expectations, fiscal stimulus intensity, and changes in the China-US interest rate spread on cross-border capital flows. Feng Haoran, based on his own research, suggested increasing allocation to the consumer and technology sectors. The team had a heated discussion on this and finally formed an initial allocation adjustment framework.

subevent.name: Shared cross-border business ideas at the Shanghai Summit and received positive feedback.
subevent.description: In the latter part of the meeting, Feng Haoran took 15 minutes to elaborate on policy trends he had learned about at the Shanghai Financial Summit, such as the Cross-boundary Wealth Management Connect and new QDII quota regulations. Combining these with the company's existing client structure, he proposed a preliminary plan for serving high-net-worth clients' cross-border asset allocation. Director Qian Yongqiang highly recognized this approach and asked Feng Haoran to further refine it into an executable report after the meeting.

subevent.name: After the meeting, organize the meeting minutes and refine the plan.
subevent.description: After the review meeting ended, Feng Haoran returned to his workstation, organized the meeting recording and notes, and sent a formal meeting minutes email to Director Qian Yongqiang and all colleagues who attended the meeting. Then he began to refine the framework for the cross-border business plan, listed the regulatory details and customer requirement checklist to be researched, and planned to complete the first draft within a week.

name: Because the thesis took up review time, the last final exam barely passed, lowering the weighted average.
description: On July 3, because he had been revising his thesis and had to cram for the exam, Feng Haoran took the last course exam of the semester in poor condition. On July 4, he checked his grades and confirmed that he had barely passed, avoiding a make-up exam. However, when he aggregated all course grades, he found that his weighted average had dropped significantly as a result, and his academic performance was barely maintained.

subevent.name: Attend the last final exam
subevent.description: Feng Haoran took the last course exam of the semester. Due to hasty review, his performance was not ideal, but he finally passed and avoided a makeup exam.
subevent.location: Changsha – teaching building of a university

subevent.name: Check final exam grades
subevent.description: After the exam, Feng Haoran checked the score of the last course, confirmed he passed, and was exempted from a makeup exam.
subevent.location: Changsha - at home, checking via the school system

subevent.name: Assess this semester's weighted average score
subevent.description: After learning the grade of the last course, Feng Haoran tabulated all course grades for the semester and found that his weighted average score had dropped noticeably due to the low grade in the final course, barely maintaining his academic performance.

name: Participate in a fluorescent night run and create photographic works.
description: On July 11, Feng Haoran and his running buddy Gao Yunfei agreed on a meeting time. On July 12, Feng Haoran prepared his equipment for the neon night run at home, then went to Orange Isle Park to meet up with Gao Yunfei. Together they completed a 5K neon night run. After the run, he used long exposure to shoot the neon trail, and on the way home he shared the edited photos to the photography association group.

subevent.name: Prepare gear for the glow night run.
subevent.description: At his home in Yuelu District, Feng Haoran organized the glow sticks, running gear, and camera needed for the glow night run, checked the batteries and memory card, and made sure the long-exposure shooting function was working properly.

subevent.name: Arrange meeting time with running buddy
subevent.description: Feng Haoran contacted his running partner Gao Yunfei via WeChat, confirming to meet at the exit of Orange Isle Park Metro Station at 7 PM to join the fluorescent night run together.

subevent.name: Going to Orange Isle Park
subevent.description: Feng Haoran took Metro Line 2 from Yingwanzhen Station to Juzizhou Station, walked to the east gate of the park to meet Gao Yunfei, and the two entered the night-running starting area together.

subevent.name: Completed a 5 km fluorescent night run.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei participated in a fluorescent night run along the riverside trail in Orange Isle Park, covering a total of 5 km. During the run, Feng Haoran stopped several times to adjust his breathing and observe the fluorescent effects of surrounding runners.

subevent.name: Long exposure shooting of fluorescent trails.
subevent.description: After the run, Feng Haoran fixed the camera on a tripod and used long-exposure mode to capture the flowing light trails formed by runners holding glow sticks. After trying multiple angles, he selected the most dynamic photo.

subevent.name: Shared photography works to the association group.
subevent.description: On his way home, Feng Haoran used his phone to edit and crop the selected fluorescent night run photos, added filters, and shared them with the photography association's WeChat group, along with the shooting parameters and his night run experience.

name: Celebration of mother Li Xiuying's 58th birthday
description: August 25 was the 58th birthday of his mother, Li Xiuying. Feng Haoran prepared a waist massager three days in advance and shipped it to the family home in Wuhan. On the night of the birthday, he had a video call with his parents for an hour, guided his mother remotely on using the massager, the family cut a cake online, and Feng Haoran sang the birthday song from afar. During the call, his mother mentioned that a neighbor was paying attention to retirement communities in Changsha. Feng Haoran took the opportunity to invite his parents to visit Changsha for a field inspection in early September, and they agreed. The warmth of family eased his anxiety caused by recent decision-making pressure.

subevent.name: Purchase a waist massage device
subevent.description: At home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Feng Haoran used the JD e-commerce platform to select a waist massager for his mother Li Xiuying as a 58th birthday gift. Considering that his mother has lower back discomfort from long-term desk work, he specifically chose a model with a heat therapy function and multiple massage modes, placed the order, and paid.

subevent.name: Send birthday gift
subevent.description: Feng Haoran packaged the purchased waist massager and sent it via SF Express from his home in Yuelu District, Changsha to his parents' home in Jiang'an District, Wuhan, and notified his mother Li Xiuying via WeChat to watch for the delivery, telling her it was a birthday gift.

subevent.name: Video call to celebrate mother's birthday
subevent.description: At 8 p.m., Feng Haoran video-called his parents at their home in Wuhan via WeChat. His mother Li Xiuying and father Feng Jianguo were in the living room. Feng Haoran first confirmed that his mother had received and unpacked the massager, then guided her remotely on using the heat and massage functions. Afterwards, the whole family cut a cake online (a birthday cake his mother had prepared in advance), and Feng Haoran sang the birthday song to his mother from afar. During the call, his mother mentioned that a neighbor was paying attention to retirement communities in Changsha. Feng Haoran took the opportunity to invite his parents to visit Changsha in early September to check out retirement communities in person. Li Xiuying and Feng Jianguo agreed on the spot. The call lasted about an hour, with a warm family atmosphere that eased Feng Haoran's recent work stress.

name: Had a video call with a childhood friend to encourage each other and set a follow-up reminder.
description: On the evening of Sunday, June 8, 2025, Feng Haoran had an hour-long video call in his home study in Yuelu District, Changsha with his childhood friend Zhang Mingxuan, who was in faraway Shenzhen. During the call, Zhang Mingxuan learned that Feng Haoran had neck discomfort, so he shared health advice for relieving the stress of prolonged sitting and encouraged him to pay attention to his health. The two also talked about housing prices and financial plans in their respective cities. Feng Haoran was happy for Zhang Mingxuan's work breakthrough, and they agreed to climb Moshan in Wuhan during the National Day holiday. After the call, Feng Haoran recorded the health advice in his phone memo, added the mountain climbing plan to his calendar, sent a WeChat message to Zhang Mingxuan to thank him, and agreed to have another video call next Sunday.

subevent.name: Had an hour-long video call with a childhood friend
subevent.description: From 8 pm to 9 pm on June 8, 2025, Feng Haoran had a video call with Zhang Mingxuan, who was far away in Shenzhen, from the study of his home in Yuelu District, Changsha. In the first half of the call, after learning that Feng Haoran had neck discomfort, Zhang Mingxuan proactively shared his experience with relieving the stress of prolonged sitting, including getting up to stretch every half hour and buying an ergonomic chair, encouraging him to pay attention to his health. In the second half, they talked about housing price trends and financial planning in their respective cities. Feng Haoran was happy that Zhang Mingxuan had recently made a breakthrough at work, and they agreed to return to Wuhan together to climb Mo Hill during the National Day holiday. The whole call was relaxed and pleasant, deepening their brotherly friendship.

subevent.name: Record key points of the call and set follow-up reminders
subevent.description: After the video call, Feng Haoran noted down the health advice shared by Zhang Mingxuan in his phone memo (such as replacing the ergonomic chair and stretching regularly), and added 'Climb Mo Mountain with Zhang Mingxuan in Wuhan during National Day' to his calendar to-do list. He also sent Zhang Mingxuan a WeChat message to thank him for his concern and encouragement, and agreed to have another video call next Sunday.

name: Younger sister collapsed after being laid off; suggesting CFA exam over the phone caused conflict; a few days later, apologized via WeChat to mend the relationship
description: On June 3, his younger sister Feng Xinran called, crying and emotionally distraught over being laid off by her company. On the phone, Feng Haoran directly suggested she take the CFA exam and switch to finance, but his tone was blunt and he didn't soothe her first, so his sister angrily hung up. After a few days of tension, Feng Haoran sincerely apologized on WeChat and patiently listened to her true thoughts, gradually repairing their relationship.

subevent.name: My younger sister called crying about being laid off; my suggestion to take the CFA exam led to a conflict.
subevent.description: On the evening of June 3, 2025, his younger sister Feng Xinran called Feng Haoran at his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, from her residence in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, crying that she had been laid off that day by an internet company in Shanghai. Instead of comforting her first, Feng Haoran directly assumed the tone of a career mentor and suggested she get a CFA certificate and switch to finance, his tone harsh and lacking empathy. Feeling invalidated and blamed, Feng Xinran became even more upset and hung up in anger. The siblings' relationship fell into a deadlock, and Feng Haoran realized he had misspoken.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Calm reflection and preparation to apologize
subevent.description: After two days of cooling down, on the evening of June 5, 2025, Feng Haoran thought repeatedly about his sister's feelings in his home study. He realized that he had been too rational at the time and lacked emotional support. He browsed his sister's past WeChat Moments, recalled their close relationship, and decided to take the initiative to apologize. That night, he carefully composed a long WeChat message, sincerely expressing his apology for his attitude and tone at the time, and invited his sister to lower her guard and talk about her true feelings.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: WeChat apology and relationship repair
subevent.description: On the morning of June 6, 2025, Feng Haoran sent the apology WeChat message, which he had edited on the evening of June 5, 2025, to Feng Xinran. After seeing the apology, Feng Xinran's mood softened, and she replied about her grievances and confusion about the future. The two had an in-depth exchange via a WeChat voice call for about an hour. Feng Haoran patiently listened to his sister's dissatisfaction with the layoff, her fear of career transition, and her genuine concerns about taking the CFA exam. Feng Haoran said he respected any decision she made and was willing to provide both financial support and career advice. The siblings ultimately reached mutual understanding, and their relationship gradually recovered.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Sending Teachers' Day greetings to professors and interacting
description: On Teachers' Day, September 10, 2025, Feng Haoran edited a blessing WeChat message in his study at his home in Changsha in the early morning, mainly thanking the professor of the Financial Technology course; during the morning commute and at the office, he sent blessings to several course professors, especially expressing gratitude and his determination for full attendance to the Financial Technology professor, who replied with encouragement; in the afternoon, during a break at work, he checked and politely responded to the professor's reply, and saved a screenshot as a memento.

subevent.name: Preparing a Teacher's Day WeChat greeting
subevent.description: On the morning of Teacher's Day, September 10, 2025, Feng Haoran, in his home study, used WeChat on his phone to edit blessing messages to several MBA professors one by one. He focused on writing a paragraph of gratitude and determination for the professor of the "Financial Technology" course, and checked the professors' WeChat contact information.
subevent.location: Home study, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Sent a blessing WeChat message to the professor.
subevent.description: On the morning of September 10, 2025, during his commute to work and at the office, Feng Haoran sent Teacher's Day greetings via WeChat to several MBA professors. Notably, he sent a message to the professor of the "FinTech" course with personalized thanks and his determination for perfect attendance this semester. The professor later replied with encouragement.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities office in Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Check and respond to the professor's reply
subevent.description: On the afternoon of September 10, 2025, during a break at work, Feng Haoran checked WeChat and saw the encouraging reply from the professor of Financial Technology and grateful responses from other professors. He replied politely one by one to express thanks and saved some screenshots to his phone album as a keepsake.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities office in Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Weekend street photography practice and a stage summary of Japanese language study.
description: On Saturday, April 26, Feng Haoran took his camera to Changsha IFS and Taiping Old Street for street photography, practicing composition and light and shadow. In the evening, he organized his works and uploaded them to a photography community. On Sunday, April 27, he completed the beginner course of the Japanese learning app, started practicing simple conversations, and planned to sign up for the online Japanese proficiency test after the May Day holiday.

subevent.name: Changsha IFS street photography practice
subevent.description: On Saturday morning, Feng Haoran brought his camera to the Changsha IFS business district in Furong District, Changsha, to practice street photography, focusing on composition skills and light-shadow capture, shooting scenes of modern architecture and pedestrian interaction.

subevent.name: Street photography practice at Taiping Old Street
subevent.description: On Saturday afternoon, Feng Haoran went to Taiping Old Street in Tianxin District, Changsha, to continue practicing street photography, capturing the cultural atmosphere of the old street and details of traditional architecture, and experimenting with shooting under different lighting conditions.

subevent.name: Evening: organize and upload works to the community
subevent.description: On Saturday evening, Feng Haoran returned to his home in Yuelu District, Changsha. He selected and post-processed the day's photos, uploaded a few excellent ones to a photography community, and shared his shooting insights with fellow members.

subevent.name: Complete the beginner course in the Japanese learning app.
subevent.description: On Sunday morning, Feng Haoran completed all elementary-level course content at home through a Japanese learning app, including basic grammar, vocabulary, and sentence pattern exercises, reaching the elementary completion level.

subevent.name: Practice simple Japanese conversation
subevent.description: On Sunday afternoon, Feng Haoran practiced simple Japanese conversation at home using the dialogue function of a Japanese learning app or with an online language partner, to consolidate what he had learned at the beginner level and improve his oral expression.

subevent.name: Plan to sign up for the Japanese language proficiency test.
subevent.description: On Sunday evening, Feng Haoran checked the registration time and requirements for the Japanese-language proficiency test (e.g., N5) at home, made a registration plan after the May Day holiday, and recorded key milestones to prepare for future exam preparation.

name: MBA online course case study group discussion and report preparation
description: On January 16, 2025, Feng Haoran prepared for the evening case study group discussion for the Strategic Management course. During the day, he previewed the case materials and organized key points using Porter's Five Forces analysis. At 7 PM that day, he discussed with four classmates via Tencent Meeting. His five-forces analysis framework was recognized, and he was selected as the lead writer of the group report. After the discussion, he immediately organized the core arguments and developed the report outline and task division plan.

subevent.name: Preview and preparation before class
subevent.description: During the daytime on January 16, 2025, Feng Haoran used spare time at home and in the office to carefully preview the case materials of a tech company transformation provided in the Strategic Management course, deeply analyzed the industry structure and competitive landscape using Porter's Five Forces model, sorted out discussion notes, and fully prepared for the evening group discussion.

subevent.name: Video conference group discussion and selection of the drafting person
subevent.description: At 7 p.m. that evening, Feng Haoran participated in the first case study group discussion for the Strategic Management course via Tencent Meeting, online with four classmates: Zhang Wei, Li Na, Wang Qiang, and Liu Fang. During the discussion, he proposed using Porter's Five Forces model to analyze the competitive framework of the tech company's transformation case. His logic was clear and to the point, which was unanimously recognized by the group members, and he was elected as the main writer of the group case report, responsible for leading the report writing.

subevent.name: Post-discussion summary and report outline development
subevent.description: After the group discussion ended, Feng Haoran immediately organized the core viewpoints, disagreements, and team members' suggestions that emerged during the discussion, clarified the central argument and structural framework of the case report, and developed a detailed report outline and writing assignment plan, laying a solid foundation for the subsequent writing work.

name: Mentor Qian Yongqiang had a long talk at a riverside tea house, sharing his own lessons and admonishing that 'leadership is about inspiring, not controlling'
description: On August 24, his mentor Qian Yongqiang invited Feng Haoran for a long talk at the Tingyuxuan Teahouse by the Xiangjiang River. He shared the lesson of how his core team dispersed due to aggressive expansion when he was 32, and warned him that 'true leadership is not control, but inspiration.' Feng Haoran was deeply moved, and after returning home that evening, he reflected and wrote an improvement plan.

subevent.name: Qian Yongqiang invited Feng Haoran to meet in the teahouse in the afternoon.
subevent.description: That morning, mentor Qian Yongqiang sent Feng Haoran a message via WeChat Work, asking him to meet at the 'Tingyuxuan' teahouse by the Xiang River at 3 p.m., saying he had important experience to share. Feng Haoran replied to confirm and arranged the afternoon work handover in advance.

subevent.name: Feng Haoran went to a teahouse by the Xiangjiang River.
subevent.description: At 2:45 p.m., Feng Haoran left the Huatai Securities office building and walked to the 'Listening to Rain Pavilion' teahouse by the Xiangjiang River near the company. On the way, he pondered the confusion he had recently encountered in team management and planned to seek advice from his mentor.

subevent.name: In-depth conversation with Qian Yongqiang in the tea room
subevent.description: From 3 pm to 5 pm, Feng Haoran sat with his mentor Qian Yongqiang at a window seat in a tea house by the Xiangjiang River, and ordered two cups of Anxi Tieguanyin tea. Qian Yongqiang spoke earnestly about the lesson he learned at age 32, when his eagerness to expand and over-control of the team led to the collective resignation of core members. He cautioned Feng Haoran: 'True leadership is not control, but inspiration.' Feng Haoran listened carefully, nodded from time to time, and jotted down key points, deeply moved inside.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Tingyuxuan Teahouse by the Xiangjiang River

subevent.name: Feng Haoran left the teahouse and returned to his residence
subevent.description: At 5:10 p.m., after the conversation ended, Feng Haoran said goodbye to Qian Yongqiang and walked alone along the Xiangjiang River back to his home in Yuelu District. On the way, he repeatedly savored his mentor's words, thought about the controlling behavior he had shown in the investment advisory team and university alumni group, and resolved to change.
subevent.location: Changsha - from the Xiang River to home in Yuelu District

subevent.name: Reflected at home in the evening and wrote down insights.
subevent.description: At 8 pm, Feng Haoran sat down in the study at home, opened his laptop, and organized the key points of the afternoon conversation into notes, specifically writing down the sentence 'Leadership is inspiring, not controlling.' He analyzed his behaviors of always rushing to make decisions in team meetings and dominating conversations in friend groups, and formulated an improvement plan: at next week's team meeting, he would first let everyone speak fully.
subevent.location: Home study room, Yuelu District, Changsha

name: Traveled to Wuhan to attend university roommate Zhao Tianyu's wedding and reunite with classmates.
description: On April 17, 2025, Feng Haoran purchased high-speed train tickets from Changsha to Wuhan for April 19 in advance. On the afternoon of April 19, he took the high-speed train from Changsha South Station and arrived in Wuhan in the evening to attend the wedding of his college roommate Zhao Tianyu. At the wedding banquet, he reunited with more than ten old classmates, including Wu Junjie, who works in Changsha, and Zhou Yuwei, who works in Shanghai. During the banquet, Zhao Tianyu shared Tencent product development experience and the potential of fintech tools, which inspired Feng Haoran to think about using technology to improve the efficiency of asset allocation reports, and he noted down a few ideas. After the wedding banquet that evening, he stayed at his parents' home at 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, and had a brief conversation with his mother Li Xiuying about his stomach illness recovery, telling her he was in good health.

subevent.name: Purchase a high-speed rail ticket to Wuhan
subevent.description: Feng Haoran bought a second-class high-speed rail ticket from Changsha South Station to Wuhan Station for April 19 in advance via the Railway 12306 app, preparing to attend the wedding of his college roommate Zhao Tianyu.

subevent.name: Take a high-speed train from Changsha to Wuhan
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 19, Feng Haoran took a high-speed train from Changsha South Station to Wuhan Station, expected to arrive in the evening, to attend the wedding of his college roommate Zhao Tianyu.

subevent.name: Attended Zhao Tianyu's wedding and reunited with old classmates
subevent.description: Feng Haoran attended the wedding of his college roommate Zhao Tianyu in Wuhan, where he reunited with more than a dozen old classmates at the wedding banquet, including Wu Junjie, who works in Changsha, and Zhou Yuwei, who works in Shanghai. During the banquet, Zhao Tianyu shared his product development experience at Tencent and talked about the potential of fintech tools.
subevent.location: Wuhan City - Hotel wedding banquet venue

subevent.name: Reflect on how fintech improves work efficiency
subevent.description: Inspired by the fintech tools shared by Zhao Tianyu at the wedding banquet, Feng Haoran began thinking about how to use technological means to improve the efficiency of asset allocation reports and briefly noted down a few ideas.
subevent.location: Wuhan City - Hotel wedding banquet venue

subevent.name: Stayed at parents' home and talked with mother.
subevent.description: After the wedding banquet, Feng Haoran returned to his parents' home at No. 368, Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, to stay. He had a brief conversation with his mother, Li Xiuying, who asked about his recovery from stomach illness. Feng Haoran said he was in good health.

name: Download a meditation app and start a daily mindfulness practice
description: Feng Haoran downloaded a meditation app on August 1. Starting from August 6, he did 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation every morning or before bed. At first his thoughts were scattered, but after persisting for a week he gradually adapted, and on August 12 he reviewed his progress, using it as a stabilizer to cope with decision pressure from the make-up exam and startup invitations.

subevent.name: Download a meditation app
subevent.description: Feng Haoran's psychological stress increased. To find ways to relieve it, he searched in the app store and installed a highly rated mindfulness meditation app, registered a personal account, and browsed the guided courses and feature settings within the app.

subevent.name: Persist in daily mindfulness meditation practice
subevent.description: For six consecutive days from August 6 to August 11, Feng Haoran laid out a yoga mat in his bedroom or on the balcony every morning after getting up or before going to bed at night, and used a meditation app to do 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation. In the early period (August 6-7), he still found it hard to concentrate, but in the later period (after August 8), he gradually became able to maintain focus for longer periods. After each daily practice, he recorded a brief journal to observe his emotional changes.

subevent.name: Meditation weekly review and habit consolidation
subevent.description: After persisting in meditation for a week, Feng Haoran, upon completing his practice on the morning of August 12, spent 15 minutes reviewing his meditation diary from the past week, summarized the changes in his attention and emotions, confirmed that meditation helps alleviate decision-making stress, decided to maintain this habit long-term, and set a daily reminder.

name: Deepening interest in pour-over coffee and making a first attempt
description: On June 18, after tasting hand-drip coffee at Shen Xinyi’s café, Feng Haoran developed a strong interest in hand-drip brewing. Shen Xinyi encouraged him to try it and recommended starter equipment. After buying the equipment, Feng Haoran received and unboxed it on the 19th. On the morning of the 20th, he tried hand-drip coffee for the first time in his home kitchen, following the instructions. Although his technique was unfamiliar, the process went smoothly. He sent photos to Shen Xinyi, received encouragement, and decided to keep practicing to deepen his interest.

subevent.name: Café tasting and conversation
subevent.description: On the afternoon of June 18, 2025, Feng Haoran went to Xinyi Hand-Brew Coffee Café on Jiefang West Road, Furong District, Changsha. He tasted two hand-brewed coffees recommended by the owner, Shen Xinyi (Yirgacheffe and Gesha). During the tasting, Feng Haoran asked Shen Xinyi for technical details of hand-brewing, and Shen Xinyi explained in detail the influence of water temperature, grind size, and pouring technique on flavor, encouraging Feng Haoran to try hand-brewing himself. Based on Feng Haoran's budget and needs, Shen Xinyi recommended a list of entry-level hand-brewing equipment, including a gooseneck kettle, drip filter, filter paper, server, and digital scale. Feng Haoran carefully noted the key points and developed a strong interest in hand-brewing technique.

subevent.name: Receiving goods and unboxing equipment
subevent.description: On the morning of June 19, 2025, the courier delivered the package to Feng Haoran's home. Feng Haoran opened the packaging and checked the integrity of the pour-over kettle, filter cup, filter paper, server, and electronic scale one by one. He checked the accessories against the manual to ensure they were complete, and rinsed the new equipment with water. Then he placed the equipment on the kitchen counter, prepared ground coffee beans (the coffee beans he usually kept), and got ready for his first pour-over experience.
subevent.location: Kitchen at home in Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: First pour-over coffee attempt
subevent.description: On the morning of June 20, 2025, Feng Haoran made his first attempt at pour-over coffee in his home kitchen following the steps guided by Shen Xinyi. He first used an electronic scale to weigh 15 grams of coffee beans, ground them to a medium coarseness, placed the filter paper in the dripper and wet it with hot water. Then he poured water for blooming, and then poured in sections in a circular motion until the total water volume reached 250 milliliters. Although his pouring technique was a bit unfamiliar, the overall process went smoothly. In the end, he got a cup of pour-over coffee. After tasting it, Feng Haoran felt the flavor was not as good as a professional café's, but found the experience very interesting. He took photos to record the result and gave feedback to Shen Xinyi via WeChat. Shen Xinyi gave encouragement and adjustment suggestions. Feng Haoran decided to continue practicing to deepen his interest in pour-over coffee.
subevent.location: Kitchen at home in Yuelu District, Changsha

name: MBA group assignment and reflection on communication
description: From February 15 to 20, during an MBA group assignment, Feng Haoran, as the group leader, clashed with team members over inconsistent data standards. Late at night, he re-analyzed the data by himself and reflected on his communication style. On February 19, he proactively called an online meeting and adopted a structured discussion approach, eventually reaching an agreement and submitting the assignment on time. This experience made him realize the importance of empathy in leadership and taught him risk management methods in project management.

subevent.name: Data standard conflict in group assignment
subevent.description: During an MBA group assignment discussion, due to inconsistent data standards, Feng Haoran, as the group leader, had a fierce conflict with group members, leading to a tense group atmosphere. The conflict occurred in an online video meeting, and the group members included several unnamed MBA classmates. Feng Haoran spoke in a tough tone during the conflict and failed to effectively listen to the group members' opinions.

subevent.name: Redoing data analysis alone late at night
subevent.description: Late on the night after the conflict, Feng Haoran sat alone in his home study, reorganized all the data, unified the data standards, and completed the analysis to resolve the fundamental issue behind the team's divergence. He worked from 10 p.m. to 2 a.m. to ensure the data was accurate.

subevent.name: Reflected on my communication style and learned about risk management.
subevent.description: After redoing the data analysis, Feng Haoran calmed down and reflected on his communication style during the conflict, realizing that he lacked empathy. He proactively consulted project management books and online resources to learn methods for preventing and resolving risks, and wrote down his insights.

subevent.name: Took the initiative to hold an online structured discussion meeting
subevent.description: Feng Haoran took the initiative to organize an online group meeting, using a structured discussion method: setting a clear agenda, taking turns to speak, first presenting unified data and then discussing differences. He guided the group members to communicate effectively about the data analysis results, and ultimately all members reached a consensus and agreed to continue with the unified plan.

subevent.name: Summarize leadership insights
subevent.description: After submitting the assignment, Feng Haoran recorded the experience in detail in his personal electronic journal, concluding the importance of empathy in leadership and risk management methods in project management. He believes that good communication and preventive mechanisms can effectively avoid team conflicts. This insight will serve as a lesson for future career development.

name: Weekend movie and mall shopping leisure
description: At noon on the weekend of March 23, Feng Haoran took the subway alone to Changsha Wanda Cinema and purchased a ticket for a newly released sci-fi movie at the midday showing in advance on his mobile app. The movie lasted about 2 hours, and he was immersed in the plot, temporarily forgetting work pressure and physical discomfort. After the movie, he strolled around the mall where the cinema was located and bought a photography album. After the afternoon activities, he took the subway back to his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, organized the album, and prepared for the next day's work.

subevent.name: Heading to Wanda Cinema
subevent.description: At noon on March 23, Feng Haoran left home, took the subway to Wanda Cinema in Changsha, and purchased tickets in advance through a mobile app on the way, choosing the matinee show to avoid the peak crowd.

subevent.name: Watch a science fiction movie
subevent.description: In a screening room at Wanda Cinema, Feng Haoran watched a newly released sci-fi film for about 2 hours, immersed in the plot and momentarily forgetting work pressure and physical discomfort.

subevent.name: Strolled around the mall and bought a photography book
subevent.description: After the movie ended, Feng Haoran wandered around the mall where Wanda Cinema was located. Passing by a bookstore, he was attracted by a photography album, bought it, and spent a leisurely afternoon.
subevent.location: Shopping mall near Wanda Cinema, Changsha.

subevent.name: Return home.
subevent.description: After the afternoon activities, Feng Haoran took the subway back to his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, organized the purchased art albums, and prepared for the next day's work.

name: Prepare photography works in advance and go to the coffee shop to install decorations
description: On September 23, Feng Haoran selected and framed 5 street photography works at home. On September 25, he took the works to the coffee shop on Jiefang West Road in Furong District, checked the finishing of the renovation, agreed on the hanging plan with the shop owner Shen Xinyi, and completed the installation together, integrating his personal photography into the coffee shop space.

subevent.name: Select and frame photographic works
subevent.description: Feng Haoran carefully selected 5 photos from his years of street photography in his home study that matched the coffee shop's atmosphere (including night views of the Xiangjiang River, autumn scenery on Yuelu Mountain, old Changsha alleys, etc.), then contacted a professional framing shop to have the photos high-quality printed and mounted with solid wood frames to ensure the decorative effect.

subevent.name: Carrying my works to the coffee shop
subevent.description: Feng Haoran wrapped the five framed photography works in protective film and placed them in the car trunk, then drove his private car from his home in Yuelu District to Shen Xinyi's coffee shop on Jiefang West Road in Furong District, driving carefully to avoid damaging the works.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yuelu District to Jiefang West Road, Furong District

subevent.name: Inspect the renovation progress and finalize the decoration plan.
subevent.description: After arriving at the coffee shop, Feng Haoran first inspected the final phase of the renovation project that had started in August, confirming that infrastructure such as walls and lighting was ready. He then discussed in detail with shop owner Shen Xinyi where to hang the photographic works, taking into account the shop's style and customer sight lines. They finally decided on a specific plan: hang 3 pieces on the main wall and 2 pieces beside the bar counter, and marked the installation positions on site.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Xinyi Hand-Brewed Coffee Shop, Jiefang West Road, Furong District

subevent.name: Install photography works
subevent.description: Following the agreed plan, Feng Haoran and Shen Xinyi used tools such as a spirit level and an electric drill to hang the 5 photographs one by one at the predetermined wall positions, adjusting the height and spacing of each work to ensure a coordinated overall visual effect. After installation, the two stepped back together to admire the result, confirming that the decorative effect met expectations.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Xinyi Hand-Brewed Coffee Shop, Jiefang West Road, Furong District

name: Morning run physical warnings and adjustments
description: On the morning of February 22, Feng Haoran, due to continuous overtime and lack of sleep, suddenly felt dizzy and nearly fell while jogging on Yuelu Mountain. His running partner Gao Yunfei forcibly stopped him and reminded him that he must rest. That afternoon, Feng Haoran went to the hospital for a basic check-up. The doctor diagnosed overfatigue and advised reducing exercise intensity and ensuring rest. After that, he changed his morning jog to slow walking combined with stretching, and gradually recovered.

subevent.name: Sudden dizziness during morning jog
subevent.description: Because of continuous overtime and lack of sleep, Feng Haoran suddenly felt dizzy and nearly fell while running in the morning at 6:30 on Yuelu Mountain. His running partner Gao Yunfei quickly pulled him back, forced him to stop running and rest, and reminded him that he must take a break and have a physical examination.

subevent.name: Adjusted exercise and recovery plan
subevent.description: Following the doctor's advice, from February 23 to 28, Feng Haoran did 30 minutes of slow walking and 15 minutes of stretching on Lushan South Road every morning at 7:00; in addition, starting from February 24, he adjusted his routine by finishing washing up and reading before 22:00 each night, ensuring he went to bed before 22:30 to promote recovery.

subevent.name: Daily morning slow walk and stretching training
subevent.description: Following the doctor's advice, Feng Haoran set out from home punctually at 7 a.m. every day from February 23 to 28 for restorative exercise on Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha. He first walked at a steady slow pace for 30 minutes, round-tripping about 2 km along Lushan South Road, taking two rest breaks on roadside benches. He then performed 15 minutes of stretching exercises for the lower and upper limbs, including standing forward bends, quadriceps stretches, and shoulder circles. He returned home around 7:50 after the exercise.

subevent.name: Daily routine adjustment and early sleep habit.
subevent.description: To support the recovery plan, Feng Haoran adjusted his nightly routine: he finished washing up before 22:00, turned off electronic device screens, read a paper book for 15 minutes, then turned off the lights to ensure falling asleep by 22:30. He used a smart bracelet to monitor sleep quality, recorded daily bedtime and deep sleep duration, and set his phone to Do Not Disturb mode to prevent work messages from disturbing his sleep.

name: Rock climbing training and meditation inspiration.
description: On the evening of August 1, Feng Haoran attended regular climbing training at the climbing gym. After completing three V2 routes, Lao Zhou shared his experience of using meditation to cope with competition pressure in the rest area, and suggested he try 10 minutes of mindfulness practice daily during high-pressure periods. Feng Haoran noted down the app name and decided to start practicing from August 5.

subevent.name: Went to the climbing gym
subevent.description: On the evening of August 1, 2025, after work, Feng Haoran drove from his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, to a climbing gym near Lushan South Road in Yuelu District, preparing to participate in the regular climbing training that night. He carried his climbing gear bag and arrived at the gym around 18:30.
subevent.location: Changsha - on the way from home to the climbing gym.

subevent.name: Climbing training: completed three V2 routes
subevent.description: On the evening of August 1, 2025, Feng Haoran conducted routine climbing training at the climbing gym. He challenged three V2 routes in sequence, completing each after several attempts, taking about 1.5 hours. After training, he returned to the rest area to hydrate and rest.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yuelu District - Rock Climbing Gym

subevent.name: Exchange meditation experiences in the rest area
subevent.description: On the evening of August 1, 2025, after training ended, Feng Haoran met a regular, Lao Zhou, in the rest area of the climbing gym. Lao Zhou shared his experience of using 10 minutes of daily mindfulness meditation to cope with competition pressure and improve focus, and suggested Feng Haoran try this method during high-pressure periods. Feng Haoran listened carefully and noted down the name of the meditation app Lao Zhou recommended in his phone's memo.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District - Climbing Gym Rest Area

subevent.name: After getting home, he downloaded a meditation app and learned about mindfulness exercises
subevent.description: Late at night on August 1, 2025, Feng Haoran returned home, searched on his phone and downloaded the meditation app recommended by Lao Zhou, opened the app to browse the introductory course of mindfulness practice and the daily 10-minute practice plan, and gained a preliminary understanding of how to use it. He decided to officially start daily mindfulness meditation from August 5, and set a reminder in his calendar.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District - Home study

name: Received the March salary and adjusted the budget.
description: On March 5, Feng Haoran received his March salary from Huatai Securities, about 14,000 yuan after tax. After logging into mobile banking to verify the amount was correct, he divided the salary into four parts—savings, investment, living expenses, and emergency reserve—according to the budget plan made at the beginning of the month, and transferred the funds to the corresponding accounts.

subevent.name: Check Salary Deposit Notification
subevent.description: At his home in Changsha, Feng Haoran received a bank SMS notification on his phone about Huatai Securities paying the March salary, showing that about 14,000 yuan after tax had arrived. He checked that the amount in the SMS matched his expectation and confirmed the salary payment was successful.

subevent.name: Logging into mobile banking to verify salary
subevent.description: Feng Haoran opened the mobile banking app, checked the salary credit record, confirmed that the after-tax amount was 14,000 yuan, consistent with the SMS notification. Also checked the bank account balance to ensure the funds were correctly credited.

subevent.name: Review the budget plan at the beginning of the month
subevent.description: Feng Haoran opened the budget plan saved in mobile banking at the beginning of the month, or flipped through his notebook, and confirmed this month's salary allocation: savings 4,000 yuan, investment 5,000 yuan, living expenses 3,000 yuan, emergency reserve 2,000 yuan, preparing for transfers.

subevent.name: Transfer to savings account
subevent.description: Feng Haoran transferred 4,000 yuan from his salary to a personal time deposit account via mobile banking, for long-term capital accumulation and future large expenditure plans.

subevent.name: Transferred to investment account
subevent.description: Feng Haoran transferred 5,000 yuan from his salary into his securities investment account for subsequent purchase of funds, stocks, or other wealth management products to optimize his personal investment portfolio.

subevent.name: Transfer to living expenses account.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran transferred 3,000 yuan from his salary into a current savings account as daily living expenses for this month, covering meals, transportation, entertainment, and other costs.

subevent.name: Transfer to emergency reserve fund account
subevent.description: Feng Haoran transferred 2000 yuan from his salary into a dedicated emergency reserve account to handle unexpected expenses such as sudden medical needs and repairs, enhancing financial security.

name: Spring Festival return and reflection.
description: On January 31 (the third day of the Lunar New Year), Feng Haoran drove back to Changsha early to avoid the return-travel peak. The traffic was smooth along the way. As he drove, he recalled his mother's aging face and his father's instructions, feeling vaguely uneasy. He decided that after returning to Changsha, he would first make a scientific health plan for himself and contact his doctor friend to book a comprehensive check-up for his mother.

subevent.name: Drove back to Changsha from Wuhan
subevent.description: On the morning of January 31, 2025 (the third day of Chinese New Year), Feng Haoran set off early from his parents' home in Wuhan (368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiang'an District, Wuhan) to avoid the return travel peak. He drove his family car along the Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau Expressway back to Changsha. Traffic was sparser than usual and the drive was smooth. Along the way, as he drove, he recalled his mother Li Xiuying's aged face and his father Feng Jianguo's advice, feeling uneasy and guilty. Reflecting on how his busy work had led him to pay too little attention to his family's health, he decided to take immediate action to improve his own health and care for his parents after returning to Changsha.
subevent.location: From Hubei Province to Hunan Province - Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau Expressway

subevent.name: Develop a personal scientific health plan
subevent.description: After returning to his home in Changsha (156 Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha) that afternoon, Feng Haoran opened his computer in the study. Referring to authoritative fitness and nutrition materials, and taking into account his own physique (height 189 cm, weight 75 kg, BMI about 21) and existing morning running habit, he formulated an annual health plan for himself. The plan included increasing the number of morning runs from 5 to 6 times a week, adding core strength training, adjusting his diet to reduce high-oil and high-salt intake, increasing the proportion of vegetables and protein, and having a comprehensive physical examination every quarter, along with regular reminders and evaluation checkpoints.

subevent.name: Contacted a doctor friend to schedule a physical examination for his mother.
subevent.description: That evening, Feng Haoran contacted his friend Dr. Wang Zhiqiang, who works at Wuhan Central Hospital (a college classmate and attending physician in gastroenterology), via WeChat. He explained in detail his mother Li Xiuying's recent physical condition (some white hair, less energy than before) and his concerns, hoping that his friend could help arrange a comprehensive elderly health check-up package, including cardiovascular and cerebrovascular screening, tumor screening, bone density, and other routine items. Wang Zhiqiang agreed to coordinate and arranged to take his mother to the hospital on a weekday morning in early February. Feng Haoran then informed his mother of the appointment details and precautions.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha (WeChat call)

name: Street photography on Taiping Street and exchange in the photography group
description: On the afternoon of January 18, 2025, Feng Haoran took his telephoto lens to Taiping Street in Changsha for street photography, documenting the everyday life of the streets during renovation. After shooting, he selected nine works and posted them in the photography group, where he had in-depth discussions with friends such as Xu Jianing about composition techniques, and they agreed to do urban street photography together in Shenzhen after the Spring Festival.

subevent.name: Heading to Taiping Street
subevent.description: At 13:30 on January 18, 2025, Feng Haoran left home and took Metro Line 2 to Taiping Street Station. He arrived at the entrance of Taiping Street in Tianxin District, Changsha at about 14:00, and walked through the western part of the block to check the shooting environment.
subevent.location: Taiping Street, Tianxin District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Street photography on Taiping Street
subevent.description: From 14:00 to 16:30 on January 18, 2025, Feng Haoran did street photography in the Taiping Street old neighborhood. Using his newly acquired telephoto lens, he captured scenes such as details of old buildings under renovation, interactions between street vendors and pedestrians, and traditional handicraft-making processes, focusing on documenting the everyday lives of residents. During this time, he adjusted his composition multiple times at the old street entrances, around Jia Yi's Former Residence, and in front of the newly renovated commercial street, spending about 2 hours in total to take about 120 photos.
subevent.location: Taiping Street, Tianxin District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Select photos and share them to the photography group.
subevent.description: From 18:00 to 19:00 on January 18, 2025, Feng Haoran turned on his computer in his study, carefully selected nine street photography works from the 120 photos he had taken that best reflected the blend of old and new and the everyday atmosphere of Taiping Street, used Lightroom for basic color grading and cropping, then stitched the nine photos into a nine-grid collage and posted it to a photography enthusiasts WeChat group, accompanied by shooting insights and a location introduction.
subevent.location: Home, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Exchanged photography tips with friends including Xu Jianing and agreed on a future street photography session
subevent.description: From 19:00 to 20:30 on January 18, 2025, Feng Haoran discussed the nine works he had posted with group friends in a photography WeChat group. Xu Jianing (a photography partner) offered suggestions on improving composition and lighting for two of the works. Feng Haoran replied with his creative thoughts and exchanged techniques with other group friends about using telephoto lenses in street photography. At the end of the discussion, Feng Haoran and Xu Jianing agreed that when Feng Haoran went on a business trip to Shenzhen after the Spring Festival, they would do urban street photography together at Shenzhen OCT Loft or Nantou Ancient Town.
subevent.location: Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province - Home (online)

name: Cross-institution industry networking after the financial cocktail party
description: After the cocktail reception, Feng Haoran, Zhang Wei, and Li Ming connected on WeChat. Over the following two months, the three shared industry reports and market opinions from time to time. Li Ming expressed interest in the REITs portfolio Feng Haoran mentioned and invited him to join a small online seminar to share the allocation logic. Although no formal cooperation had yet formed, it laid the groundwork for future cross-institutional collaboration.

subevent.name: Added WeChat contact after the reception
subevent.description: After the financial reception ended, Feng Haoran took the initiative to exchange WeChat business cards with Zhang Wei (an analyst at a public fund company) and Li Ming (an investment manager at an insurance asset management firm). The three added each other as friends to establish an online contact channel, and briefly exchanged pleasantries about their respective organizations.

subevent.name: Industry report and opinion-exchange phase.
subevent.description: On January 24, 2025, Feng Haoran established contact with Zhang Wei and Li Ming via WeChat and shared the report '2025 Q1 Financial Market Outlook'. From then until March 5, the three had multiple discussions on topics such as the equity market and REITs. Li Ming showed strong interest in Feng Haoran's REITs portfolio strategy and proactively followed up on details. Feng Haoran proposed holding a seminar, and both Zhang Wei and Li Ming agreed, laying the foundation for future cooperation.

subevent.name: Establish contact and share preliminary report
subevent.description: Feng Haoran reached out to Zhang Wei and Li Ming via WeChat, first sending greeting messages, then sharing his recently written industry report "2025 Q1 Financial Market Outlook", and inviting both to comment. Zhang Wei replied agreeing with the equity market view in the report, while Li Ming raised preliminary questions about the REITs section.

subevent.name: Discuss equity market views.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran initiated a deeper discussion in the WeChat group based on Zhang Wei's previous agreement with the equity market, sharing his analysis and predictions for the CSI 300 and ChiNext trends. Zhang Wei supplemented with foreign capital inflow data, while Li Ming raised a dissenting opinion from a technical analysis perspective. The three had about an hour of text exchange.

subevent.name: In-depth discussion on REITs strategy
subevent.description: Feng Haoran posted his REITs portfolio strategy analysis report in the group, detailing the allocation logic in sub-sectors such as infrastructure and warehousing logistics. After seeing it, Li Ming showed strong interest and proactively asked about the portfolio's risk-return characteristics and liquidity management plan. Feng Haoran answered each question, and Zhang Wei also shared overseas REITs cases she had studied.

subevent.name: Li Ming proactively followed up on REITs details
subevent.description: Li Ming @Feng Haoran in the WeChat group that morning, saying he had carefully studied the previous REITs portfolio strategy and wanted to learn more about the underlying asset screening criteria and rebalancing mechanism. Feng Haoran replied that evening with a detailed operational framework and suggested that future exchanges could be conducted more formally via offline or online seminars. Li Ming and Zhang Wei both agreed.

subevent.name: Attended the online seminar and shared the REITs logic
subevent.description: Through the Tencent Meeting platform, Feng Haoran participated in a small online seminar with Li Ming, Zhang Wei, and several other peers from different institutions. As the presenter, Feng Haoran shared his logic for REITs portfolio allocation, including underlying asset selection, portfolio balancing strategy, and historical performance backtesting, and answered participants' questions. After the meeting, the three continued discussing the possibility of future cooperation in the group chat.

name: Met with Peng Yuqing to refine the debt and entrepreneurship plans, activated the 30,000 yuan loan, and started preparations for self-media creation.
description: On May 4, Feng Haoran sorted out his personal debt details and a preliminary plan for self-media entrepreneurship at home. On May 5, he met his friend Peng Yuqing at a café, went through the remaining debts item by item, determined the priority order of repayment, and detailed the execution steps for the self-media venture (first-phase content, platform selection, etc.). On the same day, the two signed an agreement to formally convert the 30,000 yuan advanced last month into an interest-free loan, with repayment to be made in installments. On May 6, Feng Haoran started preparing for self-media creation according to the agreed plan, shooting video materials and registering an account.

subevent.name: Organizing debt and startup materials
subevent.description: In his home study, Feng Haoran organized a detailed list of his remaining personal debts, including each creditor, amount, interest rate, and maturity date. At the same time, based on his earlier ideas, he sorted out the first-phase content outline and platform selection plan for his self-media startup, preparing for the detailed discussion with Peng Yuqing the next day.

subevent.name: Meet with Peng Yuqing for a debt and entrepreneurship discussion.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran went to a cafe in Yuelu District, Changsha at the agreed time to meet his friend Peng Yuqing. They first exchanged pleasantries about recent updates, then Feng Haoran took out the prepared debt list and startup planning materials and officially began discussing the details of debt restructuring and self-media entrepreneurship.
subevent.location: A café in Yuelu District, Changsha.

subevent.name: Sort through debts item by item and determine repayment priority
subevent.description: In the café, Feng Haoran and Peng Yuqing went through the debt list item by item, including credit card balances, online loans, and borrowings from relatives and friends. They reordered the debts by interest rate and urgency, clarified a strategy to prioritize paying off high-interest debt, and calculated the minimum monthly payment they could arrange.
subevent.location: A café in Yuelu District, Changsha.

subevent.name: Refine the execution steps for self-media entrepreneurship
subevent.description: Feng Haoran and Peng Yuqing had an in-depth discussion about their self-media entrepreneurship plan. The two finalized the first-phase content themes (financial investment knowledge popularization), publishing platforms (Xiaohongshu and Douyin), and content formats (short videos + images/text), and made an initial schedule of two updates per week. Peng Yuqing, leveraging her experience in new media operations, provided topic directions and promotion suggestions.
subevent.location: A café in Yuelu District, Changsha.

subevent.name: Sign a 30,000 yuan interest-free loan agreement
subevent.description: At the end of the interview, Feng Haoran and Peng Yuqing signed a simple loan agreement, formally converting the 30,000 yuan advanced last month into an interest-free loan. The agreement specified the loan amount, the interest-free conditions, the installment repayment schedule (12 months, 2,500 yuan per month), and the signatures and seals of both parties. Peng Yuqing transferred the 30,000 yuan to Feng Haoran's account on the spot via mobile banking, and the funds were officially activated.
subevent.location: A café in Yuelu District, Changsha.

subevent.name: Start self-media content creation preparation
subevent.description: According to the plan agreed with Peng Yuqing, Feng Haoran started the first round of preparation for his self-media entrepreneurship. At home, he used professional photography equipment to shoot material for the first batch of short finance videos, wrote accompanying image-text copy, and applied for accounts on Xiaohongshu and Douyin, completing the basic profile settings.

name: Discuss next year's Sichuan-Tibet self-driving route with camping partner Xie Yutong on the phone
description: On the morning of September 28, Feng Haoran called his camping partner Xie Yutong and excitedly shared the photography gains and self-driving experiences from the trip to Mount Heng the day before. The two then had a preliminary discussion about the Sichuan-Tibet self-driving route next September, identified the general direction and key waypoints, and set it as a life goal.

subevent.name: Had a phone conversation with Xie Yutong.
subevent.description: On the morning of September 28, Feng Haoran called his camping partner Xie Yutong from his home in Changsha, excitedly sharing the photographs and self-driving experience from the trip to Mount Heng the day before. The two then had a preliminary discussion about the Sichuan-Tibet self-driving route for next September, identified the general direction and key stops (such as Chengdu, Kangding, Litang, Nyingchi, Lhasa, etc.), and set it as a life goal.
subevent.location: Home, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Contribute the annual limit to the personal pension account.
description: On the afternoon of November 28, Feng Haoran deposited the annual maximum limit of 12,000 yuan into his personal pension account via mobile banking, and completed the subscription according to the selected fund ratios, with a memo note [long-term retirement reserve, do not treat as short-term trading].

subevent.name: Check personal pension account information
subevent.description: On the morning of November 28, Feng Haoran logged into his personal pension account via mobile banking, checked the current account balance, annual contribution limit usage, and fund position details, confirmed the amount available to deposit, and selected the fund products he planned to purchase.

subevent.name: Transferred 12,000 yuan to the pension account.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of November 28, Feng Haoran transferred 12000 yuan to his personal pension account via mobile banking, reaching the annual maximum contribution limit. He entered his payment password to complete the transfer.

subevent.name: Subscribe to selected fund products.
subevent.description: After the funds arrived, Feng Haoran, according to the previously selected fund allocation, used mobile banking to purchase all 12,000 yuan of target-date retirement funds, confirmed the subscription shares and fee rate, and took a screenshot to save the transaction record.

subevent.name: Record Notes and Confirm Documents
subevent.description: Feng Haoran noted “long-term pension reserve, do not make short-term trades” in his phone memo, downloaded and saved the electronic transaction voucher, organized it into a cloud folder for archiving, and completed the entire contribution process.

name: Purchased and gifted a smart wristband for father
description: In early June, during a video call with his father, Feng Haoran noticed that his father occasionally forgot to measure his blood pressure, and decided to buy a smart band as a Father's Day gift. After comparing several products online on June 3, he ordered a Huawei Band 8. He received it on June 5, tested its functions, packaged it that same day, and shipped it to his father's home in Wuhan. His father received the gift on June 8, and Feng Haoran guided his father via video on how to use it and reminded him to wear it.

subevent.name: Learn about smart bracelet features online
subevent.description: After talking to his father, Feng Haoran immediately used his laptop in the home study to browse e-commerce platforms such as JD.com and Huawei Mall, checking product details and user reviews of several smart bands. Focusing on health features like blood pressure monitoring, heart rate detection, and fall alarm, he shortlisted two candidates: Huawei Band 8 and Xiaomi Band 8 Pro.

subevent.name: Compare options, make a decision, and place the order.
subevent.description: After comparing functions and prices, Feng Haoran finally chose the Huawei Band 8 (with blood pressure monitoring and heart rate reminder features), placed an order on JD.com, entered his current location (home in Yuelu District, Changsha) as the delivery address, chose standard express delivery, and expected delivery in 2-3 days. He also noted that he required an invoice and gift packaging.

subevent.name: Receive the goods and test the wristband's functions
subevent.description: Feng Haoran received the Huawei Band 8 delivered by JD Express at his home in Changsha. After opening the package, he charged and set up the band, tested whether core functions such as blood pressure measurement, heart rate monitoring, and sleep monitoring worked properly, and after confirming the product quality was fine, he restored the band to factory settings so his father could use it.
subevent.location: Changsha City - living room at home

subevent.name: Wrapping and sending the Father's Day gift
subevent.description: Feng Haoran put the tested smart wristband back into its original packaging, handwrote a Father's Day greeting card (content: 'Dad, Happy Father's Day! This smart wristband can help you measure your blood pressure anytime. Take care!'), then used SF Express to send it from his home in Changsha to Feng Jianguo's home at No. 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiang'an District, Wuhan. He paid the shipping fee and purchased the insured delivery service to ensure delivery before June 15.
subevent.location: Changsha City - living room at home

subevent.name: Father received the gift and confirmed via video call.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran's father, Feng Jianguo, received a smart band delivered by SF Express at their home in Wuhan. Feng Haoran immediately connected with his father via WeChat video call, guided him through pairing the band, setting up personal information, enabling automatic blood pressure monitoring, and repeatedly urged him to wear it every day. After trying it on, his father said he liked it very much and thanked his son for the thoughtful gesture.
subevent.location: Changsha - home bedroom (Feng Haoran's side); Wuhan - home living room (Feng Jianguo's side)

name: Met with Peng Yuqing to discuss self-media and review the debt restructuring
description: On the evening of April 17, Feng Haoran met Peng Yuqing in Changsha. They discussed her self-media positioning in detail, suggested focusing on "financial science + lifestyle" as the field, and helped formulate the first month's content plan. They also checked the debt restructuring execution and confirmed that the first installment repayment was in place. The two agreed to review once a month.

subevent.name: Discuss self-media positioning and content plan
subevent.description: Feng Haoran met Peng Yuqing at a café in Yuelu District, Changsha, and discussed in detail the direction of Peng Yuqing's self-media entrepreneurship. Feng Haoran suggested focusing on the field of "financial science popularization + lifestyle" and helped Peng Yuqing formulate a first-month content plan, including topic selection, publishing frequency, and interaction strategy.

subevent.name: Check the implementation of debt restructuring.
