subevent.description: In addition to discussing self-media, Feng Haoran checked the implementation of his debt restructuring, communicated with the relevant parties to confirm that the first installment had been received on time, ensuring his personal financial plan proceeded as expected.

name: Received a colleague's wedding invitation and carefully selected a gift
description: In early October, Feng Haoran received a wedding invitation from his colleague Sun Xiaoya and decided to attend. He bought a pair of custom champagne glasses as a gift in advance and confirmed the wedding date as October 18. This gesture also reflected his emphasis on workplace relationships.

subevent.name: Received a wedding invitation
subevent.description: Feng Haoran received a wedding invitation sent by courier from colleague Sun Xiaoya at Huatai Securities' Changsha office, inviting him to attend the wedding in Hangzhou on October 18. After opening the invitation, Feng Haoran confirmed the date and location.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities Office, Kaifu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Confirm wedding attendance and communicate information
subevent.description: Feng Haoran contacted Sun Xiaoya via WeChat, verbally confirmed that he would attend the wedding, asked about the specific schedule on the wedding day and whether help was needed, and they exchanged congratulations.

subevent.name: Conceiving and choosing a wedding gift plan.
subevent.description: At home, Feng Haoran searched e-commerce platforms and social media for wedding gifts suitable for the new couple. Considering that Sun Xiaoya likes a refined lifestyle, he finally decided to customize a pair of champagne glasses engraved with the couple's names and wedding date, and contacted a customization merchant to confirm the craftsmanship and price.
subevent.location: Home study room, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Place an order for custom champagne glasses.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran placed an order at an online custom gift store, choosing white ceramic champagne cups engraved with Sun Xiaoya's and her partner's names and wedding date. After paying, he received a shipping notification estimating delivery before October 12.

subevent.name: Inspected and wrapped wedding gifts
subevent.description: After receiving the delivery, Feng Haoran opened the gift box, confirmed that the champagne glasses were of good quality and the engraving was correct, then rewrapped them with elegant gift paper and ribbon, and attached a handwritten blessing card, preparing for the wedding.

name: The initial draft of the paper was rejected, so I resubmitted it to a local journal.
description: On March 15, the paper co-authored with Zhou Yuwei received a rejection notice from the Journal of Financial Research. After two days of discussion, they decided on the 17th to revise and submit it to Hunan Finance instead, and their academic goal was forced to be lowered. Feng Haoran still made time to coordinate revisions amid his busy schedule, but he inevitably felt disappointed.

subevent.name: Received a rejection notice from 'Journal of Financial Research'
subevent.description: While checking email in his study at home in Changsha, Feng Haoran received a rejection notice for the paper co-authored with Zhou Yuwei from the journal Journal of Financial Research. The email included reviewer comments and the reason for rejection. Feeling disappointed, he immediately contacted Zhou Yuwei in Shanghai via WeChat to inform her of the situation and arranged a time to discuss next steps.

subevent.name: Discussed with Zhou Yuwei the reasons for the rejection and directions for revision.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran and Zhou Yuwei had two in-depth discussions via video call: on March 15, they first communicated, analyzing the specific revision suggestions from the reviewers and exploring possible resubmission options; on March 16, they further exchanged ideas, and based on their academic backgrounds and the positioning of journals, they initially shortlisted local journals such as Hunan Finance as alternative targets.
subevent.location: Changsha - Home Study / Huatai Securities Office

subevent.name: Decided to revise and resubmit to Hunan Finance
subevent.description: After two days of thorough discussion, Feng Haoran and Zhou Yuwei finally reached an agreement and decided to revise the paper according to the submission requirements of Hunan Finance and then resubmit it to the journal. The two analyzed the review cycle and acceptance preferences of Hunan Finance and believed that its research direction was a better fit for the revised paper. Feng Haoran coordinated the division of work during breaks, and Zhou Yuwei agreed to handle the adjustments to the abstract and references.

name: The coffee shop officially started renovation. Feng Haoran accepted the long-term plan and agreed to postpone the opening to November.
description: On August 4, after final negotiations, Feng Haoran and Shen Xinyi accepted her long-term plan and agreed to postpone the opening of the coffee branch to November to ensure the quality of the renovation. The construction team officially moved into the store in Furong District and began a two-month renovation project. Feng Haoran learned the value of 'slow work yields fine work' in making this concession.

subevent.name: Final negotiation with Shen Xinyi on the opening time
subevent.description: On the morning of August 4, 2025, Feng Haoran held final negotiations with shop owner Shen Xinyi at Xinyi Hand-Drip Coffee on Jiefang West Road, Furong District, Changsha. Shen Xinyi explained in detail the importance of long-term planning, including renovation quality, brand reputation, and market pacing. After careful consideration, Feng Haoran agreed to postpone the opening of the coffee branch to November and accepted the renovation schedule proposed by Shen Xinyi. The two reached an agreement on follow-up cooperation details, and Feng Haoran came to appreciate the value of slow, meticulous work through this compromise.
subevent.location: Xinyi Pour-over Coffee, Furong District, Changsha

subevent.name: Renovation construction team enters the storefront.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 4, 2025, after the contract was signed, the renovation crew contacted by Shen Xinyi officially moved into the coffee branch storefront in Furong District. The crew leader, together with Feng Haoran and Shen Xinyi, conducted an on-site survey and confirmed key construction details such as the plumbing and electrical layout, wall modifications, and bar counter position. The crew then began setting up temporary barriers and moving renovation materials and tools, preparing for the formal construction the next day. Feng Haoran took original photos of the storefront on site as a record.
subevent.location: Coffee branch storefront in Furong District, Changsha.

name: A light-packing camping healing trip to Dawei Mountain in Liuyang with Xie Yutong and Peng Yuqing
description: To make up for the Xiangxi camping trip canceled in April, from May 9 to 12, Feng Haoran, Xie Yutong, and Peng Yuqing completed a full camping experience from preparation to follow-up. On May 9, Feng Haoran checked equipment, purchased supplies, and confirmed arrangements with his companions. From May 10 to 11, the three went ultralight camping at Dawei Mountain in Liuyang, with the trip centered on healing conversations, sharing stress and insights, and photography as a mere backdrop. The camping became an emotional outlet, alleviating Peng Yuqing's anxiety about her debt. They returned on May 11, and on the 12th Feng Haoran sorted out the gear, shared photos, and reviewed the warm moments.

subevent.name: Camping supplies preparation and purchase.
subevent.description: After work on May 9, Feng Haoran checked his camping gear at home in Yuelu District, Changsha, including a tent, sleeping bag, moisture-proof mat, cookware, etc., and went to a nearby supermarket to buy two days' worth of food and drinking water. He confirmed the meeting time and place with Xie Yutong and Peng Yuqing via WeChat, reminding everyone to bring warm clothing and mosquito repellent.
subevent.location: Changsha City, Hunan Province - home in Yuelu District and nearby supermarket.

subevent.name: Drive to Dawei Mountain and set up camp
subevent.description: At 7 a.m. on May 10, Feng Haoran drove a family car to pick up Peng Yuqing and Xie Yutong, and set off from Changsha for Liuyang Dawei Mountain National Forest Park. About 2 hours later, they arrived at the scenic area parking lot. The three of them, with light backpacks, hiked to the designated camping area halfway up the mountain, collaborated to set up the tent, lay out the ground mat, organized their personal belongings, and made preparations for camping.
subevent.location: Liuyang City, Hunan Province - Dawei Mountain National Forest Park mountainside campsite

subevent.name: Mountain hiking and healing conversation
subevent.description: From the morning to evening of May 10, the three walked slowly along the trail of Dawei Mountain, stopping to rest at azalea bushes, streams, and other spots. The time was mainly spent in healing conversations. Xie Yutong shared her recent work pressure and thoughts about career transition, Peng Yuqing revealed her anxiety over debt, and Feng Haoran talked about the bottleneck in his career advancement. Feng Haoran occasionally used his phone to take candid shots of scenery and people, but photography was just a side activity.
subevent.location: Along the trails of Dawei Mountain National Forest Park, Liuyang City, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Bonfire dinner and late-night emotional sharing
subevent.description: On the evening of May 10, the three of them cooked instant noodles and hot tea by the campfire with a portable gas stove, sitting around the fire to keep warm. Under the moonlight, the conversation extended from life pressures to the meaning of life. Feng Haoran, from the professional perspective of an investment advisor, gave Peng Yuqing some advice on relieving debt, and Xie Yutong shared her feelings of freedom from outdoor travel. Late at night, the three returned to their own tents to sleep.
subevent.location: Beside the campfire at the mountainside campsite of Dawei Mountain, Liuyang, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Break camp and return
subevent.description: On the morning of May 11, after a simple meal, the three began packing up the tent, cleaning up trash, and organizing gear. At around 9 a.m. they hiked down the mountain to the parking lot, then drove back to Changsha. On the way, they had a simple lunch at a roadside restaurant and continued sharing reflections on the trip. They returned to downtown Changsha at 1 p.m., dropped Peng Yuqing off near her residence, and Feng Haoran took Xie Yutong to Changsha South Railway Station to catch a high-speed train back to Shenzhen.
subevent.location: Hunan Province, Changsha City, Liuyang City - along the route from Dawei Mountain to Changsha

subevent.name: Post-camping tidying and sharing
subevent.description: On the evening of May 12, Feng Haoran cleaned the camping gear at home, hung the tent and sleeping bag to dry, and organized and archived the photos on his phone. He shared the day's group photos and scenery shots with Xie Yutong and Peng Yuqing via a WeChat group. The three recalled the warm moments of the camping trip in the group chat and agreed that this healing journey was very helpful in relieving stress.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Childhood friend Zhang Mingxuan proposed joint entrepreneurship. After researching, Feng Haoran politely declined but promised to serve as an advisor.
description: On August 10, Feng Haoran's childhood friend Zhang Mingxuan returned from Shenzhen to Changsha to visit family. During dinner that evening, he proposed co-founding a cross-border e-commerce consulting company. Feng Haoran spent a week (August 11 to 17) conducting market research and financial calculations. On August 17, he met with Zhang Mingxuan and politely declined the partnership due to limited energy, but promised to serve as an external advisor providing industry analysis support. Their friendship was unaffected.

subevent.name: Proposed joint startup idea at a dinner gathering
subevent.description: In the evening, Feng Haoran had dinner with Zhang Mingxuan at a well-known Hunan restaurant in Furong District, Changsha. During the meal, Zhang Mingxuan elaborated on the business model, market opportunities, and initial plans for starting a cross-border e-commerce consulting company, and formally invited Feng Haoran to join as a co-founder. Feng Haoran expressed interest in the project but needed time for market research and financial evaluation before making a decision. The two agreed to give a reply within a week.
subevent.location: Furong District, Changsha City - Hunan restaurant

subevent.name: Market research and financial estimation
subevent.description: Using weekday lunch breaks and after-work time, Feng Haoran researched the cross-border e-commerce consulting market's size, competitive landscape, potential customers, and risk factors by reviewing industry reports (such as iResearch's cross-border e-commerce white paper), analyzing financial reports of peer companies (such as Anker Innovations and Youkeshu), and consulting relevant industry experts through his financial network. Meanwhile, based on the preliminary business plan proposed by Zhang Mingxuan, he built a financial forecasting model to evaluate startup capital, operating costs, expected revenue, and investment payback period. He eventually concluded that the current market opportunity is acceptable, but his energy cannot be split to support full-time entrepreneurship.
subevent.location: Changsha - Huatai Securities office and home study

subevent.name: Review cross-border e-commerce industry reports
subevent.description: During a workday lunch break, Feng Haoran used the corporate database and network resources at Huatai Securities office to consult the cross-border e-commerce white paper released by iResearch Consulting and the latest industry research reports. He systematically sorted out the market size, growth rate, main participants, and technology trends of the cross-border e-commerce consulting market, and excerpted key data into his notebook for subsequent analysis.

subevent.name: Analyze peer company financial reports
subevent.description: After work, Feng Haoran returned to his home study and used the East Money terminal and public annual report information to deeply analyze the financial reports of cross-border e-commerce listed companies such as Anker Innovations and Youkeshu, focusing on their revenue structure, cost composition, profit margins, and business expansion strategies. He extracted key financial indicators and recorded them in comparison tables to assess the industry's profit level and competitive landscape.

subevent.name: Consult industry experts in the financial field
subevent.description: In the evening, Feng Haoran contacted his college classmate Zhou Yuwei (now a financial analyst at HSBC) via WeChat video call for professional consultation on the investment prospects, risk factors, and market entry strategies of the cross-border e-commerce consulting market. Zhou Yuwei shared foreign banks' views on the cross-border e-commerce industry and provided risk assessment suggestions based on her own experience. The call lasted about 40 minutes, and Feng Haoran organized the key opinions.

subevent.name: Building a financial projection model
subevent.description: Feng Haoran used his after-work time at home to build a financial estimation model in Excel based on the preliminary business plan proposed by Zhang Mingxuan. The model includes start-up capital (such as company registration, office equipment, marketing, etc.), operating costs (labor, rent, travel, marketing, etc.), expected revenue (estimated by monthly consulting project fees), and investment payback period calculations, with scenario analysis for different situations.

subevent.name: Evaluate financial metrics and refine the model.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran continued to improve the financial model during his lunch break and after work, adjusting key assumptions based on data from earlier research, recalculating the net profit margin, break-even point, and payback period. By comparing different growth scenarios, he assessed the feasibility of the current market opportunity, quantified his time investment cost (balancing energy between a full-time job and entrepreneurship), and preliminarily judged that the risk was too high.
subevent.location: Changsha - Huatai Securities office and home study

subevent.name: Draw research conclusions and make decisions.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran used the weekend time to compile all the research materials and financial calculation results in his home study and wrote a concise research report. The conclusion was: the market opportunity is passable but competition is fierce, and the startup capital and energy requirements are high; he cannot currently manage full-time entrepreneurship while working. He decided to shelve the entrepreneurial plan for the time being and planned to feed this conclusion back to Zhang Mingxuan, suggesting that they consider it again when conditions are ripe.

subevent.name: Prepare to politely decline the proposal and arrange a meeting with Zhang Mingxuan.
subevent.description: On the morning of August 17, based on his research findings, Feng Haoran drafted a written statement and oral explanation in his study to politely decline the partnership, clearly stating that due to work pressure and career promotion plans he could not participate full-time, but was willing to provide industry analysis and investment advice as an external consultant. He then communicated with Zhang Mingxuan by phone and arranged to meet that afternoon at a pour-over coffee shop in Yuelu District, Changsha.
subevent.location: Yuelu District, Changsha - Home and café

subevent.name: Politely declined the partnership and promised to serve as an advisor
subevent.description: That afternoon, Feng Haoran met Zhang Mingxuan at Shen Xinyi's Xinyi Hand-Drip Coffee Shop in Yuelu District, Changsha. Feng Haoran candidly explained that after a week of research, he believed the project had good prospects, but he was currently at a critical point in his career advancement and could not devote enough energy to a full-time startup, so he politely declined the invitation to become a co-founder. At the same time, he expressed willingness to regularly provide Zhang Mingxuan with analysis reports, risk assessments, and investment advice on the cross-border e-commerce industry as an external consultant. Zhang Mingxuan thanked Feng Haoran for his candor and respected his decision. The friendship between the two was unaffected, and they agreed to stay in touch frequently.
subevent.location: Xinyi Pour-Over Coffee Shop, Yuelu District, Changsha

name: Peng Yuqing's company went bankrupt and was in debt; Feng Haoran promised to help and implemented a debt restructuring.
description: On the afternoon of April 3, Feng Haoran received a call from his friend Peng Yuqing in the ward, learning that her company had gone bankrupt due to poor management, with personal debts of about 150,000 yuan. Feng Haoran immediately promised full support. After returning to Changsha on April 8, he stayed up late sorting out the details of Peng Yuqing's debts, formulated a phased restructuring plan, and suggested she leverage her copywriting strengths and pivot to new media operations. On April 10, Feng Haoran advanced 30,000 yuan as emergency working capital. Peng Yuqing gratefully accepted and decided to try self-media entrepreneurship.

subevent.name: Received a call for help from Peng Yuqing.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 3, 2025, Feng Haoran was at a hospital in Changsha (for a personal physical examination) when he received a call from his good friend Peng Yuqing. He learned that her company had gone bankrupt due to poor management, leaving her with personal debts of about 150,000 yuan, and she was feeling down. Feng Haoran immediately promised to do his best to help, including providing financial support and career advice.

subevent.name: Returned home in Changsha.
subevent.description: On April 8, Feng Haoran took a high-speed train from elsewhere (originally to Wuhan to visit his parents) back to his home in Changsha, preparing to deal with Peng Yuqing's debt problem.

subevent.name: Sort out debts and formulate a restructuring plan
subevent.description: On the evening of April 8, Feng Haoran stayed up late at his home in Changsha to sort out Peng Yuqing's debt details. He calculated total liabilities of about 150,000 yuan and drew up a phased restructuring plan, including prioritizing repayment of high-interest loans and negotiating extensions with creditors. At the same time, he suggested that Peng Yuqing leverage her copywriting skills and move into new media operations to start her own business.

subevent.name: Advance funds and transfer them to Peng Yuqing
subevent.description: On April 10, Feng Haoran went to the Human Resources Department of Huatai Securities to apply for a salary advance of 30,000 yuan as emergency working capital. After it was approved, he transferred the amount to Peng Yuqing's account via bank transfer. Peng Yuqing was very grateful after receiving it and said she was willing to follow the advice and try self-media entrepreneurship.

name: Video chat with Xie Yutong to discuss the Dragon Boat Festival camping plan and prepare equipment to repair the relationship
description: On the evening of April 10, Feng Haoran explained in detail to Xie Yutong via video the reasons for canceling the Qingming camping trip, voluntarily bore the losses, and made a transfer as an apology. To make up for the disappointment, Feng Haoran proposed postponing the Xiangxi camping trip to the Dragon Boat Festival holiday and adding a hiking route in Zhangjiajie, and Xie Yutong agreed. The two shared equipment reviews and agreed to have a short trial camping before the Dragon Boat Festival. On the afternoon of April 12, Feng Haoran went to an outdoor goods store and, following Xie Yutong's recommendation, bought a down sleeping bag and an inflatable sleeping pad, completing the equipment upgrade. At that point, the relationship between the two was restored, and they were fully prepared for the Dragon Boat Festival camping.

subevent.name: Video call with Xie Yutong to explain the reason
subevent.description: At 21:00 in the evening, Feng Haoran had a video call with Xie Yutong, who was far away in Shenzhen, via WeChat. He explained in detail that the Qingming camping trip was forced to be canceled due to an important client meeting temporarily arranged by the company, took the initiative to bear the loss of the camping equipment already purchased, and transferred 200 yuan via WeChat, while sincerely apologizing. Xie Yutong expressed understanding but revealed regret in her words.

subevent.name: Propose a camping plan for the Dragon Boat Festival
subevent.description: During the video call, Feng Haoran, to make up for the disappointment, proposed postponing the originally planned camping trip to western Hunan to the Dragon Boat Festival holiday (May 31 to June 2), and adding a hiking route in Zhangjiajie as a new highlight. He also said he would be responsible for itinerary planning and route research. Xie Yutong's mood clearly improved after hearing this, and she expressed approval of the new plan.

subevent.name: Equipment exchange and short trial camping plan
subevent.description: During the video, Xie Yutong shared an unboxing review video of her newly purchased tent. Feng Haoran promised to upgrade his own sleeping bag and moisture-proof pad in the near future to match the team's equipment level. The two also agreed to choose a weekend before the Dragon Boat Festival holiday to go on a short trial camping trip (such as Heimifeng near Changsha), in order to re-tune their tacit cooperation and test the new equipment. The specific time and location are to be discussed separately.

subevent.name: Buying upgraded gear
subevent.description: On Saturday afternoon, April 12, Feng Haoran went to a professional outdoor gear store in Yuelu District, Changsha (Decathlon Meixihu Store), and based on the brand and model recommended by Xie Yutong, purchased a down sleeping bag with a -5°C comfort rating (worth ¥499) and an inflatable sleeping pad (worth ¥299), spending a total of ¥798, to prepare gear for the Dragon Boat Festival camping trip.
subevent.location: Outdoor supplies store, Yuelu District, Changsha

name: Compile anti-theft tips and post them on Weibo, promoting data security awareness
description: On the morning of October 18, after recovering his data, Feng Haoran systematically organized subway anti-theft tips and cloud backup solutions, and posted them on Weibo to alert friends. The post unexpectedly received hundreds of retweets and comments; many running buddies and colleagues said they had strengthened their personal data protection, and he felt the positive impact of sharing experience through the interaction.

subevent.name: Organize anti-theft tips content.
subevent.description: From 7:00 to 7:30 on the morning of October 18, 2025, Feng Haoran, in his home study in Yuelu District, Changsha, used his computer and phone to organize previously collected subway anti-theft tips and cloud backup plans, summarized the key points in bullet form, and supplemented them with his personal data recovery experience as a case, forming a complete long Weibo post.
subevent.location: Home study room, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Posted on Weibo with tips attached.
subevent.description: From 7:30 to 7:45 on October 18, 2025, Feng Haoran logged into his personal Weibo account and published the organized anti-theft tips and cloud backup plan as public Weibo posts, tagging several friends and running buddies to call on everyone to raise awareness of data security. The posts contained detailed subway anti-pickpocketing techniques and steps for setting up automatic cloud backup.
subevent.location: Home study room, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Interacted and responded with running friends and colleagues.
subevent.description: From 7:45 to 8:30 on October 18, 2025, and throughout the rest of the day, Feng Haoran checked Weibo notifications and found that the post had received hundreds of reposts and comments. He replied one by one to comments from running friend Gao Yunfei, colleague Zheng Wenbo, and others, discussed data protection methods, and shared the link in running groups and colleague groups, feeling the positive impact of sharing experience.
subevent.location: Yuelu District, Changsha - home study and online platform

name: Community digital literacy volunteer service for seniors
description: On the morning of July 12, 2025, Feng Haoran, at the invitation of the Yuelu District community, participated in the "Silver Hair Digital Literacy" volunteer service, teaching elderly people one-on-one in the community activity room how to use smartphone photography, WeChat video calls, and anti-fraud features. He combined his experience in the financial industry to share real fraud cases, and the elderly were enthusiastic about learning. After the activity, the community issued a certificate of thanks, and several elderly people held him to express their gratitude, making him deeply appreciate the value of serving society with professional skills. He quietly decided to participate in at least two similar activities each year.

subevent.name: Preparation before the event
subevent.description: At 7:30 AM on July 12, 2025, Feng Haoran organized digital literacy teaching materials for seniors in his home study, including smartphone operation diagrams and anti-fraud case brochures, and debugged his own phone for live demonstration.
subevent.location: Home study, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Went to the community and set up the venue
subevent.description: At 8:00 AM, Feng Haoran walked to the community activity room in Yuelu District, met up with Social Worker Li, a community staff member, and together they arranged the teaching desks and chairs, connected the projector equipment, and confirmed the WiFi and mobile phone signals.
subevent.location: Community Activity Room, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

subevent.name: One-on-one instruction on basic smartphone functions
subevent.description: From 9:00 to 10:30 AM, Feng Haoran provided one-on-one guidance to several elderly people (such as Uncle Wang, Grandma Zhang, etc.) in the community activity room, teaching them to use smartphones for taking photos, contacting their children via WeChat video calls, and patiently answering their operational questions.
subevent.location: Community Activity Room, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Anti-fraud case sharing and awarding of certificates of appreciation
subevent.description: From 10:30 to 11:30 a.m., Feng Haoran shared real cases such as impersonating police, procurators, and judges and health product fraud with the elderly, drawing on his financial industry experience, and explained identification techniques. Afterwards, the community director presented Feng Haoran with a certificate of appreciation for volunteer service, and several elderly people held his hand and thanked him repeatedly.
subevent.location: Community Activity Room, Yuelu District, Changsha City, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Reflection and decisions after the event
subevent.description: After the event ended at 11:30, Feng Haoran returned home, deeply moved. He profoundly understood the value of professional service to society and decided to participate in at least two similar community volunteer services every year from now on, and incorporated this into his personal annual plan.
subevent.location: Home study, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Spring Festival reunion and worry about mother's health
description: From Lunar New Year's Eve to the second day of the first lunar month (January 28 to 30), Feng Haoran returned to Wuhan to reunite with his parents. He noticed that his mother Li Xiuying had become visibly thinner and urged his father to take her for a comprehensive medical check-up. His father, in turn, reminded Feng Haoran to take care of his own health, but Feng Haoran privately dismissed it and didn't take his father's reminder to heart. Amid the warmth of the family reunion, his mother's health condition planted a hidden worry.

subevent.name: Return-home transportation (Changsha to Wuhan)
subevent.description: On the morning of January 28, Feng Haoran left his home in Changsha, took a high-speed train to Wuhan, arrived at Wuhan Station around noon, and then took a taxi to his parents' home at 368 Jiefang Avenue, Jiang'an District, Wuhan.
subevent.location: Wuhan, Hubei Province - Wuhan Station and home.

subevent.name: Family Reunion on Chinese New Year's Eve
subevent.description: On the evening of January 28, Feng Haoran had New Year's Eve dinner with his parents at their home in Wuhan. During the meal, Feng Haoran noticed that his mother Li Xiuying had visibly lost weight and looked unwell compared to last year. He felt worried but did not mention it on the spot. After dinner, the family watched the Spring Festival Gala and chatted, in a warm atmosphere.
subevent.location: Parents' home living room, Jiang'an District, Wuhan, Hubei Province.

subevent.name: Privately urged father to take mother for a physical exam.
subevent.description: Late on New Year's Eve, after his mother had gone to bed, Feng Haoran privately spoke with his father, Feng Jianguo, in the study. He described in detail how he had noticed his mother losing weight, and strongly suggested that his father take her to Wuhan Union Hospital for a comprehensive check-up as soon as possible. His father agreed and promised to arrange it after the Spring Festival holiday.
subevent.location: Hubei Province, Wuhan City - Study in parents' home

subevent.name: Family activities on the first day of the Chinese New Year
subevent.description: On the morning of January 29, Feng Haoran and his parents worshipped their ancestors and ate tangyuan at home in Wuhan, then visited several nearby relatives to pay New Year calls. In the afternoon, the family returned home to rest. Feng Haoran accompanied his mother for a walk and chat in the residential compound, observing her physical condition again. He found that his mother got tired easily, which strengthened his idea of having his father take her for a physical examination.
subevent.location: Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province - at parents' home and surrounding area

subevent.name: Father reminded son to pay attention to health.
subevent.description: During breakfast on the morning of the second day of the Chinese New Year, his father Feng Jianguo earnestly reminded Feng Haoran that although work is important, he should also pay attention to his health, and suggested he have regular check-ups and reduce staying up late. Feng Haoran nodded in agreement on the surface, but inwardly thought he was young and healthy, and did not take his father's words to heart, instead turning the conversation to his investment performance.
subevent.location: Wuhan, Hubei Province - Parents' home dining room

subevent.name: Return to Changsha
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 30, Feng Haoran said goodbye to his parents and took a high-speed train back to Changsha. After boarding, he sent a message to his mother reminding her to go for a medical checkup, and she replied telling him not to worry. In the evening, he returned to his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, unpacked his luggage, and rested.
subevent.location: Wuhan Station, Wuhan, Hubei Province to home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Follow up on mother's physical examination
subevent.description: On the evening of January 31, Feng Haoran had a video call with his father at home in Changsha and learned that his father had booked a physical examination package at Wuhan Union Hospital for February 2. At noon on February 2, Feng Haoran called his father to ask about his mother's physical exam results. His father said most indicators were normal, and the doctor advised supplementing nutrition and getting appropriate exercise. Feng Haoran felt relieved and urged his parents to take care of themselves.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province (video call) and Wuhan Union Hospital, Wuhan, Hubei Province

subevent.name: Video call with father to confirm mother's physical examination arrangement
subevent.description: On the evening of January 31, Feng Haoran had a WeChat video call with his father Feng Jianguo at home in Wuhan, from his home in Yuelu District, Changsha. His father said he had booked a physical examination package at Wuhan Union Hospital for February 2, and planned to take his mother Li Xiuying for a full-body checkup. After learning this, Feng Haoran reminded his father to keep warm in the weather, and agreed to call after the checkup.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Phone call to ask about mother's physical exam results
subevent.description: At noon on February 2, Feng Haoran called his father Feng Jianguo at home in Changsha to ask about his mother's physical examination results. His father said most indicators were normal, but the doctor advised his mother to pay attention to nutritional supplements (increase calcium and vitamin intake) and appropriate exercise (such as walking). Feng Haoran was relieved and told his parents to take care of themselves, saying he would contact them again on the weekend.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Start home yoga practice
description: On February 10, in order to improve his body flexibility and relieve stress, Feng Haoran bought a yoga mat and downloaded tutorials to prepare for practice. Starting from February 11, he began to follow videos at home on Tuesday and Thursday evenings to practice yoga, 30 minutes each time. At first the movements were unfamiliar, but after persisting for two weeks, he gradually adapted and incorporated yoga into his health plan.

subevent.name: Prepare yoga supplies
subevent.description: On the evening of February 10, at his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Feng Haoran bought a yoga mat online and downloaded a 30-minute beginner-friendly yoga follow-along tutorial from a video platform. He checked the living room space at home to ensure there was enough area to move, and cast his phone to the TV, preparing for subsequent practice.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yuelu District, home living room

subevent.name: First yoga practice
subevent.description: At 8 p.m., Feng Haoran spread out his yoga mat in the living room at home and followed a pre-downloaded yoga video for a 30-minute practice. At first, his movements were unfamiliar and his body was not flexible enough, but he managed to complete the basic poses (such as Cat-Cow, Downward-Facing Dog, and Warrior I). After the practice, he felt slightly sweaty and relaxed.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yuelu District, home living room

subevent.name: Third yoga session
subevent.description: At 8 p.m., Feng Haoran did his third yoga practice in his home living room. After adapting through the first two sessions, his movements were more fluid and he could better control his core muscles. He tried a new video tutorial that included balancing poses and soothing stretches. After the practice, he felt his body coordination had improved and his interest in yoga increased.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yuelu District, home living room

subevent.name: Fourth yoga session
subevent.description: At 8 p.m., Feng Haoran did his fourth yoga practice in his living room. This time he chose a slightly more difficult vinyasa flow sequence and completed the linking movements under video guidance. Although he paused twice due to unstable balance, his overall completion improved, and at the end his forehead was slightly sweaty and he felt calm.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yuelu District, home living room

subevent.name: Fifth yoga practice
subevent.description: At 8 pm, Feng Haoran did his fifth yoga practice in his living room. He gradually mastered the coordination of breathing and movement, and the duration of poses extended. During practice, he focused on strengthening twisting and backbending poses to improve the stiffness in his neck and shoulders caused by prolonged desk work. After 30 minutes, he recorded a clear improvement in his body flexibility.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yuelu District, home living room

subevent.name: Sixth Yoga Practice
subevent.description: At 8 p.m., Feng Haoran did his sixth yoga session in his living room. As the final session of the two-week plan, he tried a complete beginner yoga sequence. His postures were largely standard, with only a few poses needing fine-tuning. After the session, he felt light and noticeably less stressed, and decided to incorporate yoga into his long-term health plan.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yuelu District, home living room

name: Friends gathering on the eve of Spring Festival and agreeing to go on a road trip
description: On the evening of Saturday, January 25, 2025, Feng Haoran had dinner with friends Peng Yuqing and Wu Junjie at Xiangweixuan Hunan Restaurant in Changsha. During the meal, they exchanged recent updates and agreed to drive to Zhangjiajie after the Spring Festival. The next day, Feng Haoran created a WeChat group chat to discuss the itinerary, and the three initially planned to depart on the fifth day of the Lunar New Year.

subevent.name: Gathering with friends for dinner and lively conversation on the eve of Chinese New Year's Eve
subevent.description: At 6:30 p.m. on Saturday, January 25, 2025, Feng Haoran set out from home and walked to Xiangweixuan Hunan Restaurant, arriving on time at 7:00 to meet Peng Yuqing and Wu Junjie. The three ordered Hunan dishes such as steamed fish head with chopped chili and stir-fried pork with green chili. As they ate, they chatted: Peng Yuqing shared a creative plan for a Spring Festival special feature in new media; Wu Junjie mentioned his intention to move after the New Year and asked for advice; Feng Haoran mentioned that his mother Li Xiuying had recently had high blood pressure and he was somewhat worried; Peng Yuqing recommended a specialist at Wuhan Union Hospital, and Wu Junjie shared his father's experience with health management. The atmosphere was relaxed and cheerful, with laughter throughout. Near the end, the three agreed to drive together to Zhangjiajie after the Spring Festival (around the fifth day). At 9:30 p.m., Feng Haoran paid the bill, and the three each took a taxi home.
subevent.location: Xiangweixuan Hunan Restaurant, Shaoshan South Road, Yuhua District, Changsha

subevent.name: Set up a discussion group for the road trip
subevent.description: On the morning of January 26, Feng Haoran created a WeChat group chat named 'Zhangjiajie Self-Driving Squad', added Peng Yuqing and Wu Junjie, and was the first to propose the itinerary framework of departing on the fifth day of the Lunar New Year and returning on the seventh. He also shared the link to the Zhangjiajie self-driving guide he had compiled last year. The three began initial discussions on the route, accommodation, and budget, and agreed to refine the plan within the next week.

name: Injured by a food delivery e-bike scraping past during the morning run
description: Around 6 a.m. on September 7, while running as usual on Lushan South Road, Feng Haoran was grazed by a food-delivery e-bike that veered into the non-motor vehicle lane in the wrong direction. The outside of his left calf was scraped and slightly bleeding. Accompanied by his running buddy Gao Yunfei, he went to a nearby clinic for disinfection and bandaging. The doctor advised him to stop running for a week. The accident disrupted his half-marathon training rhythm and also made him seriously examine urban non-motor vehicle management for the first time. He posted on Weibo calling for regulation, which unexpectedly received hundreds of reposts.

subevent.name: Preparation before morning run
subevent.description: Around 5:30 a.m. on September 7, 2025, Feng Haoran got up at his home on Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, changed into running gear and did warm-up exercises, preparing to start his daily morning run training.

subevent.name: Injured by a food delivery e-bike scraping past during the morning run
subevent.description: At about 6 a.m. on September 7, 2025, while Feng Haoran was jogging on the non-motor vehicle lane of Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, a delivery electric bike going against traffic suddenly scraped the side of his left calf, causing abrasions on the outer skin and slight bleeding. After the accident, the e-bike driver did not stop and left the scene.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Lushan South Road non-motorized lane

subevent.name: A running companion accompanied me to the clinic to treat the wound
subevent.description: After the accident, Gao Yunfei, a running buddy who was jogging nearby (Feng Haoran's long-time running partner), noticed the situation, immediately went to support Feng Haoran, and accompanied him on foot to the community health service center near Lushan South Road for wound treatment. The clinic nurse used iodine to disinfect and bandage the wound.
subevent.location: Changsha - Lushan South Road Community Health Service Center

subevent.name: The doctor diagnosed and recommended pausing running.
subevent.description: At the community health service center, the doctor examined Feng Haoran's wound, confirmed it was only a superficial abrasion with no risk of fracture, but advised him to stop running for a week to ensure wound healing and avoid friction-induced infection. Feng Haoran accepted the medical advice and planned to adjust his subsequent training schedule.
subevent.location: Changsha - Lushan South Road Community Health Service Center

subevent.name: Returned home to recuperate and posted an appeal on Weibo.
subevent.description: After the bandaging was done, Feng Haoran, accompanied by Gao Yunfei, returned home to rest. At around 9 a.m., he posted an appeal on Weibo about the management of non-motorized vehicles in cities, describing in detail the collision he experienced this morning, and suggesting strengthening efforts to stop violations such as riding against traffic and occupying pedestrian walkways. The post unexpectedly received hundreds of reposts and sparked discussion among netizens.

name: Promotion candidate list announced, competition situation clear.
description: On October 9, the first working day after the holiday, at the management meeting of Huatai Securities Changsha Branch, the list of candidates for next year's investment director promotion was officially announced. Feng Haoran and Team Leader Wang from the neighboring team were both selected. The leadership clearly stated that the evaluation would be based on performance data, customer feedback, and team management performance over the next three months, making the competition public. After the meeting, Feng Haoran pondered for a long time at his desk, reviewed his strengths and weaknesses, and formulated a detailed sprint plan, including strengthening customer relationships, improving team collaboration, and producing high-quality investment research reports.

subevent.name: Attended the meeting announcing the promotion candidate list
subevent.description: On the morning of October 9, 2025, Feng Haoran attended a management meeting in the meeting room of Huatai Securities' Changsha branch. At the meeting, the list of candidates for promotion to investment director for the next year was officially announced. Feng Haoran and Team Leader Wang from the neighboring team were both selected. Leader Qian Yongqiang explicitly stated that the evaluation would be based on performance over the next three months, client feedback, and team management performance.
subevent.location: Meeting room, Huatai Securities Changsha Branch, Kaifu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Brief communication with the supervisor after the meeting.
subevent.description: After the meeting, Feng Haoran proactively approached his direct supervisor Qian Yongqiang to briefly consult about the specific scoring criteria and weights for the promotion review. Qian Yongqiang advised him to focus on improving customer satisfaction and team collaboration cases, and said he would provide guidance over the next three months.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Kaifu District - Huatai Securities Changsha Branch Office Corridor

subevent.name: At his workstation, reflecting and sorting out his own strengths and weaknesses
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 9, 2025, Feng Haoran returned to his workstation at Huatai Securities' Changsha branch, seriously reviewed his work performance over the past year, compared business data with Team Leader Wang, sorted out his strengths (solid investment analysis ability, some high-net-worth client resources) and weaknesses (insufficient team management experience, few cross-department collaboration cases), and recorded the key points in his notebook.
subevent.location: Changsha - Kaifu District - Huatai Securities Changsha Branch workstation.

subevent.name: Formulate a three-month sprint plan.
subevent.description: On the evening of October 9, 2025, after work, Feng Haoran stayed at the company and spent about an hour detailedly formulating a sprint plan for the next three months: visit at least 3 core clients each week and collect feedback, organize a team internal sharing session each month, publish a high-quality investment research report every two weeks, and sign up for a leadership training course. The plan was saved as an electronic document with periodic reminders set.
subevent.location: Changsha - Kaifu District - Huatai Securities Changsha Branch workstation.

name: Video-called to teach father how to use the smart fitness band
description: On June 8, Feng Haoran, at his home in Changsha, used a video call to guide his father, who was at home in Wuhan, step by step on how to use the smart bracelet's blood pressure monitoring, heart rate recording, and data analysis functions. His father expressed willingness to cooperate in health monitoring, and the father and son had a warm interaction. Earlier, on June 5, Feng Haoran had bought the bracelet and couriered it to his father, who received it on June 8.

subevent.name: Purchased a smart band and had it delivered
subevent.description: Feng Haoran ordered a smart bracelet that supports blood pressure monitoring and heart rate recording on an e-commerce platform at his home in Changsha, filled in the delivery address of his father in Wuhan, and sent it out the same day via SF Express.

subevent.name: Father received the wristband package
subevent.description: Feng Haoran's father, Feng Jianguo, received the smart bracelet package delivered by SF Express at his home in Wuhan. After opening the package, he checked the bracelet's appearance and accessories.

subevent.name: Prepare video teaching materials.
subevent.description: During his lunch break at home in Changsha, Feng Haoran organized the smart bracelet's usage instructions into concise key points, installed the companion app on his phone, and confirmed that the bracelet had been successfully paired with his father's phone.

subevent.name: Video call to teach fitness band usage
subevent.description: At 8:00 PM, Feng Haoran contacted his father at home in Wuhan via WeChat video and guided him step by step on how to wear the wristband, view blood pressure monitoring and heart rate record data, and use the mobile app to check historical trends. His father carefully followed the operations and expressed willingness to monitor his health daily. The father and son interacted in a warm atmosphere for nearly an hour.

name: He took a walk with his mother and talked deeply, and in the evening had a video call with his younger sister to encourage each other.
description: After dinner on the evening of November 27, Feng Haoran accompanied his mother for a walk along the greenway in the community. His mother mentioned his sister Feng Qian's stubbornness and thoughtfulness, and he smiled knowingly. At night, he proactively video-called his sister. She showed him the video editing she had just learned and made a short film for their parents. Feng Haoran gave her praise and suggestions. Before hanging up, the siblings rarely said to each other [you've had it hard too], ending on a warm note.

subevent.name: After dinner, accompanied my mother for a walk and deep talk on the community greenway
subevent.description: On the evening of November 27 after dinner, Feng Haoran accompanied his mother Li Xiuying for a walk on the greenway in the community of his parents' home in Jiangan District, Wuhan. During the walk, his mother mentioned his younger sister Feng Qian's recent stubbornness and thoughtfulness, sharing some small details of her life. Feng Haoran smiled knowingly, and the mother and son chatted as they walked, in a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
subevent.location: Wuhan City - Jiangan District - Community Greenway

subevent.name: Night video call with my younger sister to encourage each other.
subevent.description: That night, Feng Haoran proactively made a video call via WeChat with his sister Feng Xinran, who was far away in Shanghai. In the video, his sister showed off her newly learned video editing skills and had made a warm short film for their parents. After watching, Feng Haoran fully affirmed his sister and offered some optimization suggestions. Before hanging up, the siblings rarely said to each other, 'You've had a hard time too,' expressing understanding and support for each other's life pressures. The call ended in a warm atmosphere.
subevent.location: Wuhan City - Jiangan District - Living room in parents' home

name: Completed regular fund investment and purchased accident insurance
description: On September 15, Feng Haoran completed the monthly fund periodic investment on time, investing 3,000 yuan in the CSI 300 index fund and 2,000 yuan in the technology theme fund. Given his morning running injury earlier in the month, he additionally purchased a one-year accidental insurance for himself with an annual premium of 1,200 yuan, transferring accidental risks through insurance and improving his personal protection system.

subevent.name: Execute the CSI 300 index fund regular investment plan.
subevent.description: In the Huatai Securities app, Feng Haoran found the preset systematic investment plan for the CSI 300 Index Fund, confirmed the investment amount of 3000 yuan, clicked to execute the purchase, and the system prompted that the subscription was successful, with 3000 yuan deducted from the linked bank card.
subevent.location: Hunan Province, Changsha City, Yuelu District - home study (via mobile app)

subevent.name: Executed the scheduled investment in a technology-themed fund
subevent.description: Feng Haoran continued the automatic investment plan for the technology theme fund in the Huatai Securities app. He manually entered the investment amount of 2000 yuan, confirmed the subscription, and the system indicated success, with 2000 yuan deducted from the linked bank card.
subevent.location: Hunan Province, Changsha City, Yuelu District - home study (via mobile app)

subevent.name: Choose accident insurance products online and complete the insurance purchase.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran screened annual accident insurance products through the insurance channel in the Huatai Securities APP or a third-party insurance platform. After comparison, he chose a comprehensive accident insurance with an annual premium of 1,200 yuan. He filled in basic personal information (name, ID number, contact information, etc.), confirmed the coverage terms and premium, and then paid 1,200 yuan by bank card to complete the purchase. The system generated an electronic policy and sent it to the reserved email address.
subevent.location: Hunan Province, Changsha City, Yuelu District - home study (via mobile app)

name: Photography Advanced Course, Session 2: Portrait and Street Photography Post-Processing
description: Feng Haoran enrolled in an advanced online course taught by a renowned landscape photographer, systematically learning color management and mask blending techniques. The second session, held from May 16 to 17, focused on post-processing for portrait and street photography, with live broadcasts throughout the day. He completed his assignments on time and, after class, applied the new skills to his street photography on Jiefang West Road, significantly improving the quality of the works. Xu Jianing praised them as "having the quality of commercial photography."

subevent.name: Pre-class preparation
subevent.description: Feng Haoran organized the equipment needed for the online course in his home study, including adjusting the computer camera, installing the live-streaming software Zoom, and testing network stability. He also downloaded the course materials folder provided by the instructor and previewed the basics of portrait and street photography post-processing to ensure he could smoothly participate in the next day's full-day live course.

subevent.name: First day course: learning portrait post-processing through live streaming.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran fully participated in the first day of the second session of the advanced photography course, an online live class on portrait post-processing taught by a well-known landscape photographer. In the morning he learned color management theory and Lightroom color grading techniques; in the afternoon, the instructor explained in depth the application of Photoshop mask compositing in fine portrait retouching. He took notes all day and followed along with the instructor's hands-on practice.

subevent.name: Completed the first day's homework assignments
subevent.description: After the livestream ended that day, Feng Haoran spent the evening working on the first day's assignment assigned by the instructor: using the newly learned color management and mask compositing techniques to retouch a portrait photo, adjusting skin tone, background blur, and light-shadow layering. After finishing, he submitted it to the course assignment group.

subevent.name: Next day's lesson: learn street photography post-processing via live stream.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran continued to participate in the live broadcasts on the second day of the course, in the morning and afternoon, focusing on unique post-processing methods for street photography, including high-contrast black-and-white conversion, enhancement of urban light and shadow, and artistic noise treatment. The instructor used real-time demonstrations to analyze how to retain the narrative feel of street shots while improving image texture.

subevent.name: Complete the homework for the second day.
subevent.description: That evening, Feng Haoran completed the next day's course assignment: using street photography post-processing techniques to process one of his own street shots, focusing on high-contrast black-and-white tonal control and partial brightening techniques. After submitting the assignment, he received preliminary feedback from the instructor and made fine adjustments based on the suggestions.

subevent.name: Street photography practice and feedback.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran applied the post-processing techniques learned during the two-day course to practice. He took his camera to Jiefang West Road in Changsha for street photography, shooting multiple scenes of crowds, light, and shadows. After returning home, he used the newly mastered masking compositing and color management methods to refine five finished works, and shared them via WeChat with photography partner Xu Jianing. When Xu Jianing saw them, she praised, "They have the texture of commercial photography." Feng Haoran was deeply encouraged.

name: Book and attend a Yin Yoga class to experience static adjustment.
description: On the recommendation of Xie Yutong, Feng Haoran booked a yin yoga class for Wednesday evening, October 22, on October 20. On the evening of the 22nd, he went to the yoga studio in Yuhua District to attend the class. Under the coach's guidance, he focused on breathing and stretching. Although he joked that he was "as stiff as iron," his body was noticeably more relaxed after class and his sleep quality improved. After class, he shared his feelings with Xie Yutong via WeChat and agreed to try it again next time.

subevent.name: Book a Yin Yoga class
subevent.description: On October 20, Feng Haoran contacted the yoga studio recommended by Xie Yutong via WeChat, booked the Yin yoga class at 19:00 on Wednesday evening, October 22, and confirmed the course content and the equipment needed to bring.

subevent.name: Going to the yoga studio
subevent.description: At 18:30 on Wednesday evening, October 22, Feng Haoran changed into his workout clothes, brought a yoga mat and a water bottle, took the metro from his home in Yuelu District to the designated yoga studio in Yuhua District, arrived at 18:55, and checked in.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Metro Line 4 and Yuhua District Yoga Studio

subevent.name: Attend a yin yoga class
subevent.description: On Wednesday, October 22, from 19:00 to 20:30, Feng Haoran attended the second yoga experience at the Yuhua District Yoga Studio—Yin Yoga. Under the guidance of a professional instructor, he focused on breathing and stretching, practicing multiple static postures. Despite being stiff, he clearly felt relaxed after the class. After class, he briefly exchanged self-practice suggestions with the instructor.
subevent.location: Changsha - a yoga studio in Yuhua District

subevent.name: Post-class rest and feedback.
subevent.description: After the class ended at 20:30 on October 22, Feng Haoran drank water and relaxed in the rest area of the yoga studio, then walked to a nearby convenience store to buy fruit to replenish energy. At 20:50, he sent his post-class feedback to the recommender Xie Yutong via WeChat, sharing the experience of physical relaxation and improved sleep, and agreed to continue trying it next month. Afterwards, he took the subway home, arrived home at 21:30, did simple stretching, and recorded today's exercise log.
subevent.location: From Yuhua District yoga studio to home in Yuelu District, Changsha

name: Confirmed pension arrival and sorted out individual income tax deduction vouchers.
description: On the evening of November 28, 2025, Feng Haoran confirmed the pension receipt in his home study in Changsha. The account balance was 32,000 yuan. He then saved the receipt screenshot and payment voucher into the tax folder on his personal computer for annual individual income tax deduction.

subevent.name: Confirmed the pension arrived
subevent.description: On the evening of November 28, 2025, Feng Haoran logged into his pension account in his home study in Yuelu District, Changsha, to check whether the November 2025 pension had been credited. He confirmed that the account balance showed 32,000 yuan, consistent with the expected amount, and took a screenshot of the crediting record as proof.

subevent.name: Store the payment receipt in the tax folder
subevent.description: After confirming that the pension had been credited, Feng Haoran organized the screenshot of the receipt and the payment certificate, then saved them into the tax folder on his personal computer. The folder was named '2025 Annual Individual Income Tax Deduction Materials' so that they could be used for declaring special additional deductions (personal pension) during the annual income tax settlement in the following year.

name: Made piecemeal revisions to ESG thesis while accompanying a patient at the hospital
description: Starting from April 2, while accompanying his mother at a hospital in Wuhan, Feng Haoran used fragmented time when his mother was resting or undergoing examinations to collaborate remotely with Zhou Yuwei via laptop, adjusting the introduction logic and literature review in response to the rejection comments. Although the environment was disruptive and progress was slow, the academic continuity was maintained, laying a foundation for subsequent complete revision.

subevent.name: Arrived at the hospital in Wuhan and started paper collaboration
subevent.description: On the morning of April 2, Feng Haoran took the high-speed train from Changsha to Wuhan. After arriving at Wuhan Central Hospital in Jiangan District, Wuhan, he handled the procedures for accompanying and caring for his mother. After settling his mother in, he communicated with Zhou Yuwei via WeChat about the paper revision plan, assigned the paragraphs each was responsible for, and began using the gaps between caregiving to revise the introduction and literature review of the ESG paper.

subevent.name: Made piecemeal revisions to the thesis while providing care.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran accompanied his mother at the inpatient department of Wuhan Central Hospital (April 3 to 6, 2025). During this period, he used fragmented time such as his mother's treatment, lunch breaks, examinations, visits from relatives and friends, and nighttime sleep to collaborate remotely with Zhou Yuwei via Tencent Meeting or voice calls, and gradually revised the paper in response to the rejection comments: on the first day, he focused on adjusting the introduction logic and the historical context of the literature review; on the second day, he supplemented the coherence of the literature review in the early morning and at night, and improved the comparative analysis in the afternoon; on the third day, he completed the connection between the introduction and methodology, unified terminology and reference format; on the final day, he concentrated on polishing the remaining sections, generated a response-to-reviewers document, and completed the integration of all fragmented revisions. The cumulative effective revision time over the four days was about 10.5 hours, maintaining academic continuity.
subevent.location: Wuhan City - Inpatient Department of Wuhan Central Hospital

subevent.name: On the first day of accompanying care, used snippets of time to revise the paper's introduction
subevent.description: While accompanying his mother at the inpatient department of Wuhan Central Hospital, Feng Haoran used the 1.5-hour gap after his mother's IV drip started at 9 a.m. to open his laptop on the connected chairs in the ward corridor and connect with Zhou Yuwei via Tencent Meeting, discussing paragraph by paragraph the logic issues in the introduction raised in the rejection feedback. During his mother's lunch break (12:30-13:30), he focused on revisions again, adjusting the paragraph on the historical development of asset pricing models in the literature review. The actual effective revision time for the whole day was about 2 hours, interrupted multiple times by nurse rounds and his mother's calls.
subevent.location: Wuhan City - Inpatient Department of Wuhan Central Hospital

subevent.name: The next day while accompanying a patient, used breaks to revise the literature review.
subevent.description: During the hospital stay, Feng Haoran completed the first round of revisions in the early morning (6:30-7:30) while his mother was washing up and having breakfast, focusing on supplementing the coherence of the literature review according to the rejection comments. In the afternoon, during his mother's CT scan, he sat in the waiting area and continued voice communication with Zhou Yuwei, revising the comparative analysis of the cited literature. In the evening, after his mother fell asleep (21:00-22:30), he completed the third round of revisions under the dim bedside lamp, reorganizing the chapter structure of the review. The fragmented time throughout the day totaled about 2.5 hours of revision.
subevent.location: Wuhan City - Inpatient Department of Wuhan Central Hospital

subevent.name: Third day of accompanying: used fragmented time to put together the manuscript.
subevent.description: During his caregiving period, Feng Haoran used the 45-minute gap while his mother was receiving physical therapy to work on the transitional revisions between the introduction and methodology sections on his laptop in the rehabilitation department waiting area. In the afternoon, while relatives and friends were visiting his mother, he collaborated online with Zhou Yuwei from a bench in the garden downstairs via his phone hotspot, unifying the terminology and reference format throughout the paper. Before bed, after his mother fell asleep (22:00-23:00), he reviewed the revisions again to confirm the overall logical chain was complete. The total effective revision time for the day was about 2 hours.
subevent.location: Wuhan City - Inpatient Department of Wuhan Central Hospital

subevent.name: On the last day of caregiving, focused on polishing the thesis.
subevent.description: On the last day of Feng Haoran's caregiving, in the morning while his mother's condition was stable and she was napping in the ward, he focused for 3 hours in the ward rest area on polishing the remaining chapters, including adding two literature citations and revising the conclusion section. In the afternoon, while waiting for the discharge procedures, he had a final online video confirmation with Zhou Yuwei, responding to the rejection comments one by one and generating a revision explanation document. That day, as the caregiving burden was lighter, the actual revision time was about 4 hours, and he completed the integration of all fragmented revisions.
subevent.location: Wuhan City - Inpatient Department of Wuhan Central Hospital

subevent.name: Caregiving ended and the thesis revision stage is complete.
subevent.description: On April 7, his mother's condition improved and she was preparing to be discharged from the hospital. Feng Haoran helped his mother go through the discharge procedures and pick up medicine in the morning. In the afternoon, he sorted out the progress of his paper revisions, sent the current version to Zhou Yuwei by email for the next round of feedback, and agreed on a schedule for the subsequent full revision.

name: Won the rare stamp 'The Whole Country Is Red' at auction for 42,000 yuan.
description: On May 23, Feng Haoran logged into the online auction platform to confirm funds and rules, setting a psychological price cap of 45,000 yuan. On the afternoon of May 24, he participated in the auction and, after more than ten rounds of bidding, won the rare stamp 'The Whole Country Is Red' for 42,000 yuan, and also won a set of Republic of China airmail stamps for about 3,000 yuan as a supplement. After paying a total of about 45,000 yuan, he shared the good news in the collection group that evening and received congratulations from fellow collectors. Afterward, he decided to cut non-essential expenses for the next six months.

subevent.name: Pre-auction funds and rules confirmation
subevent.description: The day before the auction, Feng Haoran logged into the online auction platform, re-confirmed his personal bank card balance and payment limit, carefully read the auction rules and details of the treasures, set a maximum psychological bid price of 45,000 yuan, and ensured sufficient funds were prepared.

subevent.name: Participated in the auction and successfully acquired a rare stamp
subevent.description: That afternoon, Feng Haoran logged on to the online stamp auction platform and participated in bidding for the rare stamp 'The Whole Country Is Red.' After more than ten rounds of fierce bidding with an anonymous buyer, he finally won the bid for this rare stamp with excellent quality at 42,000 yuan. It was tense throughout, and every price increase was quickly weighed.

subevent.name: Supplementary acquisition of a Republic of China aviation stamp
subevent.description: At the same auction, Feng Haoran noticed a well-preserved set of Republic of China-era aviation stamps and successfully bid about 3,000 yuan for them, as a supplement to his collection system, further enriching his stamp collection.

subevent.name: Pay the auction amount and commission.
subevent.description: After the auction, Feng Haoran immediately paid the remaining amount for the two items and the auction commission through the online payment system, totaling about 45,000 yuan (including commission). He confirmed the payment was successful and saved the electronic receipt and transaction confirmation, completing the transaction process.

subevent.name: Shared the good news about the auction item in the collection group
subevent.description: That evening, Feng Haoran excitedly posted high-definition photos and the transaction price of a rare stamp in the stamp-collecting WeChat group, drawing congratulations and discussions from fellow collectors such as Luo Zhenyu. He replied to the group members' comments one by one, shared his bidding insights, and felt delighted.

name: The fluorescent night run photography works received praise and deepened friendships, and ultimately signed up as a photography volunteer for the Changsha Marathon.
description: On the evening of July 13, Feng Haoran participated in a fluorescent night run at West Lake Park in Yuelu District, Changsha, and took photos. That evening, he shared the works in the photography association group and was praised by many members; his running buddy Gao Yunfei also liked them and invited him to create together. On July 15, the two practiced joint morning-run photography and deepened their friendship. This series of recognition and encouragement prompted Feng Haoran to officially submit the registration form for a photography volunteer at the Changsha Marathon on July 22.

subevent.name: Participated in the fluorescent night run and took photos.
subevent.description: On the evening of July 13, Feng Haoran participated in the Fluorescent Night Run at Xihu Park in Yuelu District, Changsha. Using a camera he carried with him, he photographed the night run scenes, light and shadow effects, and the movements of participants, with the outing lasting about 2 hours. During this time, he focused on capturing the moments of interaction between fluorescent installations and runners, taking about 50 photos in total.
subevent.location: Yuelu District, Changsha - West Lake Park.

subevent.name: Shared fluorescent night run photos in the photography group and received praise
subevent.description: After returning home on the night of July 13, Feng Haoran sent five selected photos from the fluorescent night run to the WeChat group of his photography association (about 30 members), along with his shooting insights. Within minutes, several members replied praising the photos as 'creative' and 'novel in composition.' One member with the nickname 'Guangying Laozhang' particularly pointed out the clever use of color. This positive feedback made Feng Haoran feel recognized and encouraged.

participant.name: Old Zhang of Light and Shadow
Other members of the photography group

subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District - Home study

subevent.name: Fellow runner Gao Yunfei appreciated the photo and sent an invitation for joint creation
subevent.description: After seeing Feng Haoran's neon night run work reposted to his Moments in the running group, fellow runner Gao Yunfei messaged Feng Haoran privately on WeChat, praised the photos as full of dynamism and creativity, and suggested trying combined shooting on the next morning run together, using their different perspectives to create a series of works. Feng Haoran readily agreed, and the two arranged to meet early on the morning of July 15 at Lushan South Road for their first collaboration attempt.

subevent.name: Morning run with Gao Yunfei and collaborative photography practice.
subevent.description: At 6 AM on July 15, Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei met as agreed at the intersection of Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, and jogged together along Lushan South Road for about 5 kilometers. Along the way, they took turns capturing running shots of each other, and tried using burst mode and slow shutter techniques to record their running postures in the morning light. During breaks, they commented on each other's work, and Gao Yunfei suggested applying the theme of combining running and photography to larger scenes. This collaboration further deepened their friendship.
subevent.location: Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Formally submit the application form for Changsha Marathon photography volunteer.
subevent.description: On the morning of July 22, after confirming that he met the registration requirements, Feng Haoran filled out the photography volunteer application form on the official website of the Changsha Marathon, uploaded his personal photography portfolio (including the Fluorescent Night Run series photos) and resume. After submission, he received a system confirmation email, indicating that the review would be conducted in early August. This move marked his formal practice of combining photography and running, and was the result of a series of previous events.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District - Home study

name: Completed substantive revisions to the ESG paper and submitted it to Hunan Finance
description: After gaining industry insights at the Shanghai summit, Feng Haoran used weekday evenings and weekends to collaborate remotely with Zhou Yuwei, making structural adjustments to the ESG paper based on rejection feedback and supplementing it with the latest REITs and low-carbon economy cases. As he needed to travel to Wuhan for a wedding from April 19 to 20, he concentrated on data analysis from April 15 to 18 in advance. After returning on April 21, he continued polishing, finalized it on April 24, and submitted it via email to the editorial office of Hunan Finance on the 25th.

subevent.name: ESG thesis data analysis work launched
subevent.description: Feng Haoran, based on the rejection feedback from Hunan Finance, began to focus on the data analysis section of his ESG paper. He first organized the raw data in his home study in Yuelu District, Changsha, then communicated via video conference with his university classmate Zhou Yuwei, who is far away in Shanghai, to confirm the analytical framework and the REITs and low-carbon economy case data that needed to be supplemented.

subevent.name: ESG paper case data supplement
subevent.description: Feng Haoran used weekday evenings at home to supplement the REITs case data for his ESG paper. He consulted the latest financial databases and industry reports, screened out typical REITs projects related to the low-carbon economy, and integrated the data into the analysis chapter of the paper.

subevent.name: Data analysis wrap-up and discussion
subevent.description: Feng Haoran focused on finishing the data analysis section of his ESG paper over the weekend. He generated and checked all data charts to ensure they were consistent with the textual analysis, then had a remote video call with Zhou Yuwei via WeChat to verify the analysis results item by item. After confirming the data was correct, he finalized the data analysis section.

subevent.name: Initiate paper polishing and structural adjustment
subevent.description: After returning to Changsha from a wedding in Wuhan, Feng Haoran began restructuring and polishing his ESG paper in his home study that evening. He reorganized the paper's logic according to the rejection feedback, adjusted the chapter order, and again discussed the revision direction remotely with Zhou Yuwei to ensure the revision approach was consistent.

subevent.name: Evening paper polishing and formatting adjustments.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran continued to polish his ESG paper in his home study on weekday evenings. He focused on optimizing the language of the introduction and conclusion sections, unifying terminology and citation formats throughout the paper, and checking the completeness and accuracy of the references.

subevent.name: Weekend polishing of the final thesis draft
subevent.description: Feng Haoran spent the whole day over the weekend in his home study doing a final comprehensive polish of his ESG paper. He read the paper aloud paragraph by paragraph to ensure fluent language, checked the accuracy of all data and cases, and revised several imprecise expressions, finally producing a near-final version.

subevent.name: Paper finalization and final confirmation
subevent.description: Feng Haoran and Zhou Yuwei confirmed the final version of the ESG paper via video conference. The two checked the full text page by page to ensure all revisions had been implemented. Zhou Yuwei made a final suggestion on line spacing adjustment. Feng Haoran then generated the final PDF version on his computer and saved both the Word source file and the PDF file.

subevent.name: Paper submitted to the editorial office of Hunan Finance
