subevent.description: In his study at home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Feng Haoran used his personal email to send the final ESG paper (PDF version) as an attachment to the submission email address specified by the editorial office of 'Hunan Finance'. In the email body, he briefly explained the main revisions of the paper and attached his personal contact information. After confirming the send, he took a screenshot to save the sending record.

name: Phone stolen during subway commute, a wake-up call for data security
description: During the evening rush hour on October 15, 2025, Feng Haoran discovered his phone was stolen on Metro Line 1. He immediately borrowed a colleague's phone to report the SIM card lost and remotely locked the device. The next day, after getting a replacement SIM card, he found that some unbacked-up photography works and investment notes were permanently lost, so he decided to strengthen data backups. This accident made him deeply realize the importance of data security.

subevent.name: Mobile phone stolen during subway commute.
subevent.description: At around 18:00 on the evening of October 15, 2025, during the evening rush hour on Changsha Metro Line 1, Feng Haoran found that his mobile phone had been stolen while in the carriage. He immediately searched his pockets and backpack to confirm the loss, feeling anxious and realizing that he needed to take emergency measures right away.

subevent.name: Report the SIM card as lost and remotely lock the device
subevent.description: After discovering his phone was stolen, Feng Haoran borrowed the phone of his colleague Zheng Wenbo, who also works at Huatai Securities, between 18:05 and 18:20. He first called the carrier's customer service to report the SIM card lost and block it to prevent unauthorized use of his number. Then he remotely locked the stolen phone through his cloud service account and attempted to locate the device. He also urgently changed the passwords for key applications such as WeChat and Alipay to prevent further leakage of funds and privacy.
subevent.location: Changsha City - station hall of a station on Metro Line 1

subevent.name: SIM card replacement and data security reflection
subevent.description: On the morning of October 16, 2025, Feng Haoran went to the China Mobile business hall in Yuelu District, Changsha, to get a replacement SIM card and restore his phone's communication functions. After returning home, he checked his computer and cloud storage and found that some unbacked-up street photography works and investment notes were permanently lost with the phone, which he deeply regretted. He immediately organized his current data backups, decided to buy an encrypted external hard drive and enable a cloud backup service, and establish a habit of regular automatic backups to avoid similar accidents causing data loss again.
subevent.location: Changsha City, Yuelu District, China Mobile service hall; home study room

name: Client referral: professional reputation brings new business opportunities.
description: On October 15, long-time client Lin Zhihao proactively contacted Feng Haoran, saying he had carefully read his paper on localized investment strategies published in Hunan Finance and strongly agreed with it. That afternoon, Lin Zhihao introduced a local entrepreneur Mr. Li from the building materials industry. During the meeting, Feng Haoran, relying on his in-depth research of the industry, accurately analyzed the client's needs and showcased past successful cases, quickly gaining initial trust, and agreed to submit a customized asset allocation plan by the end of the month. This referral not only boosted Feng Haoran's confidence in his work, but also further consolidated his professional reputation among clients.

subevent.name: Lin Zhihao called to recommend a client
subevent.description: On the morning of October 15, 2025, long-time client Lin Zhihao contacted Feng Haoran, who works at the Huatai Securities Changsha branch office, via WeChat voice call. He praised Feng's recent paper on localized investment strategy published in 'Hunan Finance', and proactively offered to introduce a local building materials industry entrepreneur, Mr. Li. Feng Haoran expressed his gratitude and agreed to meet that afternoon in the company meeting room.
subevent.location: Changsha - Huatai Securities Investment Advisory Department.

subevent.name: Referral meeting and initial negotiation
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 15, 2025, in the meeting room of Huatai Securities Changsha Branch, Lin Zhihao brought Mr. Li (full name Li Jianguo), an entrepreneur in the building materials industry, to meet with Feng Haoran. Based on his in-depth research on the building materials industry, Feng Haoran precisely analyzed Mr. Li's asset allocation needs and presented successful cases of serving similar enterprises in the past, winning Mr. Li's initial trust. The two parties reached a consensus on investment philosophy and strategy and agreed that Feng Haoran would submit a customized asset allocation plan by the end of the month.
subevent.location: Changsha - Huatai Securities Investment Advisory Department Meeting Room

subevent.name: Organizing meeting materials and planning proposals
subevent.description: After the referral meeting, Feng Haoran returned to his workstation, organized the information recorded during the afternoon discussion, including Mr. Li's financial situation, investment preferences, and risk tolerance, and filed the materials into the customer management system. At the same time, he preliminarily planned the work steps to complete the customized asset allocation plan by the end of the month, including industry data research, model construction, and backtesting analysis, to prepare for the subsequent plan writing.
subevent.location: Changsha - Huatai Securities Investment Advisory Department.

name: Taking over a colleague's clients and coping with work pressure
description: In early February, colleague Zheng Wenbo formally went through resignation procedures. Feng Haoran proactively took over some of his high-net-worth clients and immediately sorted out the clients’ investment preferences and historical communication records, formulating personalized service plans. Since February 5, he has had to maintain both original and new clients at the same time, with average weekly working hours exceeding 50 hours, and frequent overtime has become the norm. However, he did not complain, but actively reported work progress to his direct supervisor Qian Yongqiang and sought suggestions for optimizing work processes, initially demonstrating professional resilience.

subevent.name: Organize the information of newly assigned clients.
subevent.description: In the office, Feng Haoran carefully read each client file, extracted key information (risk preference, holdings structure, historical communication frequency, etc.), updated remark tags in the company CRM system, created dedicated folders, and laid the foundation for future services.

subevent.name: Develop a personalized service plan
subevent.description: Based on the customer analysis results, Feng Haoran spent the afternoon drafting preliminary service plans for each client, including suggested asset allocation adjustment directions, regular communication cadence (frequency of phone calls/face-to-face meetings), and recently recommended key products, and compiled them into a document.

subevent.name: Reported work progress to his direct supervisor, Qian Yongqiang.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran proactively asked for a meeting with investment director Qian Yongqiang, submitted a customer handover progress report and service plan draft, reported his current workload, and asked for advice on optimizing time management and customer service processes. Qian Yongqiang suggested prioritizing high-value clients.

subevent.name: High-intensity maintenance of existing and new clients and handling overtime
subevent.description: Since the report, Feng Haoran has fully entered a mode of doubled-up customer service: handling existing client inquiries daily, making initial phone calls to new clients, executing asset allocation adjustments in service plans, while also participating in department morning meetings and market analysis. His average weekly working hours exceed 50, with overtime every day until after 8 p.m., and he uses commuting time to study background information on new clients, demonstrating professional resilience.

subevent.name: High-intensity client service and overtime on a workday.
subevent.description: At 8:30 a.m., attended the department morning meeting to hear market dynamics and investment strategy analysis; then called new client Huang Siqi for initial communication to understand her asset status and investment goals, and agreed on the next detailed consultation time. In the afternoon, handled asset allocation adjustment requests from three existing clients. Based on recent market fluctuations, lowered stock positions and increased bond fund allocations for two of them, and optimized the mixed fund portfolio for the other. In the evening, organized the day's client service records and prepared materials for new clients to be contacted the next day. Worked overtime and left the company at 8:30 p.m.

subevent.name: Two consecutive days of high-intensity client maintenance.
subevent.description: In the morning, I replied to the follow-up questions raised yesterday by client Huang Siqi, and provided her with a preliminary asset allocation proposal; at the same time, I handled routine inquiries from two other long-standing clients, including account queries and dividend reinvestment advice. At noon, I discussed recent stock market trends with colleague Zheng Wenbo, and we cross-checked each other's adjustment plans for our respective clients. In the afternoon, I executed the asset allocation adjustment instructions confirmed the previous day, completing 6 fund switches and 2 stock orders in the trading system. In the evening, I worked overtime until 8:15, and used the time after work to study the industry background materials of a new client (real estate executive Lin Zhihao), preparing for the meeting next Monday.

subevent.name: Weekend at home organizing client materials and remote communication
subevent.description: Although it was the weekend and he was not at the office, Feng Haoran continued working in his home study: in the morning, he had a video meeting with client Lin Zhihao via WeChat Work to discuss his large-scale asset allocation needs and noted down the key service points for the next stage. In the afternoon, he organized the communication minutes for all clients of the week and updated the remarks in the customer management system. He then studied the background information of three new clients, including their investment experience and risk tolerance, and formulated a preliminary service plan for the following week. In the evening, he had a remote discussion with colleague Sun Xiaoya about the client event arrangements for next week, and worked overtime until after 8 p.m.

subevent.name: Overtime work on the weekend to prepare next week's client service plan
subevent.description: Worked from home all day Sunday: In the morning, customized three asset allocation plans for new clients visiting next week, and made a PPT for presentation. In the afternoon, handled client emails and messages, replied to weekend inquiries from two long-term clients, and adjusted the automatic investment plan for one of them. In the evening, had an impromptu call with project manager Gao Yunfei (running buddy), and exchanged investment views, but most of the time was still spent on clearing up paperwork backlogged from overtime this week, including writing client service reports and market analysis summaries. Worked late until 8:30 PM to ensure a smooth start on Monday.

name: Selected new media equipment and ordered flowers for his younger sister Feng Xinran.
description: On May 10, while browsing online, Feng Haoran noticed that his younger sister Feng Xinran had been frequently sharing short-video editing practice on WeChat Moments, and he keenly sensed her passion for new-media creation. On May 11, he chose a portable video-editing device she had longed for, and on May 15, he ordered same-city flower delivery to Shanghai.

subevent.name: Discovered younger sister's need for new media creation
subevent.description: On the evening of May 10, 2025, while browsing his phone at home in Changsha, Feng Haoran scrolled through his sister Feng Xinran's Moments and noticed she frequently shared clips of short video editing practice. He keenly sensed her passion for new media creation, and then decided to buy her a portable video editing device and order flowers to show support.

subevent.name: Selected and ordered video editing equipment
subevent.description: On May 11, 2025, Feng Haoran, at his home in Changsha, searched and selected the portable video editing device his sister had long wanted (such as DJI Pocket 2 or similar products) on an e-commerce platform, confirmed the delivery address was his sister's address in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and completed the order and payment.

subevent.name: Book same-city flower delivery to Shanghai.
subevent.description: On May 15, 2025, at his home in Changsha, Feng Haoran chose a bouquet of flowers for his sister Feng Xinran via a flower booking platform, specified same-city delivery to her residence in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and completed payment and order confirmation.

name: Communicated with Investment Director Qian Yongqiang about career advancement path and formulated a plan.
description: On September 28, Feng Haoran first organized his personal performance and thoughts on promotion. That afternoon, he had an in-depth exchange with his direct supervisor Qian Yongqiang about career development paths. Qian Yongqiang suggested focusing on maintaining high-net-worth clients and improving research capabilities. The next day, Feng Haoran formulated a three-year phased career goal plan based on the discussion, making his career planning clearer.

subevent.name: Organize personal performance and promotion ideas
subevent.description: On the morning of September 28, Feng Haoran organized his work summary of the past two years at his desk, including results in maintaining high-net-worth clients, number of investment strategy reports, client satisfaction feedback, and self-improvement plans. He listed specific suggestions he hoped to get from Qian Yongqiang, such as how to break through current bottlenecks and what skills and resources he needed to supplement.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Kaifu District - Huatai Securities Office

subevent.name: Communicated with Qian Yongqiang about the promotion path.
subevent.description: At 2 p.m. on September 28, Feng Haoran arrived punctually at Qian Yongqiang's office, and the two engaged in an in-depth discussion about career advancement for about an hour. Based on the company's investment advisor promotion system, Qian Yongqiang pointed out Feng Haoran's strengths and weaknesses in client resource development, research report quality, and industry network building. He advised him to focus on maintaining 3-5 high-net-worth clients (each with over 10 million yuan) over the next two years and to obtain the CFA certification. Feng Haoran took careful notes and asked specific questions about the promotion timeline.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Kaifu District - Huatai Securities Office

subevent.name: Develop a phased career goal plan.
subevent.description: After work on September 29, following the advice of Qian Yongqiang during the interview, Feng Haoran formulated phased career goals for the next three years on his computer, including: in the first year, consolidate existing clients and tap into potential high-net-worth clients; in the second year, focus on the CFA exam and write in-depth industry research reports; in the third year, strive for promotion to investment director. He printed out the plan and posted it by his desk, and set aside time for a quarterly review.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District - Home study

name: Adjust personal investment portfolio and buy index funds
description: On October 12, after receiving his salary, Feng Haoran transferred 30,000 yuan into his securities account and bought 15,000 yuan each of the CSI 300 and CSI 500 index funds. Based on his judgment of market trends, he optimized his asset allocation while reserving liquidity for goals such as the year-end half marathon and coffee shop operations. This move reflected his steady investment style.

subevent.name: Confirm salary arrival and plan investments
subevent.description: Feng Haoran received a mobile SMS notification at his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, that his October salary had been credited. He then logged into mobile banking to verify the credited amount, opened the Huatai Securities app to check his securities account balance and the day's NAV of the CSI 300 and CSI 500 index funds, and made an investment plan based on his personal investment goals and market trends, deciding on a plan to buy 30,000 yuan of index funds.

subevent.name: Transfer from bank card to securities account
subevent.description: Feng Haoran used mobile banking to transfer 30,000 yuan from his China Merchants Bank salary card to his Huatai Securities fund account. After entering the transfer amount, he completed identity verification via SMS verification code, confirmed the funds arrived, and closed the banking app.

subevent.name: Buy index funds separately
subevent.description: Feng Haoran logged into the Huatai Securities trading software, and on the fund trading interface successively bought 15,000 yuan of the CSI 300 Index Fund and 15,000 yuan of the CSI 500 Index Fund, set the purchase shares to amount subscription method, confirmed the fee rate, and submitted the order.

subevent.name: Confirm transaction and record adjustments
subevent.description: Feng Haoran checked the trading system and saw that both orders had been successfully filled. He recorded the fill prices and the shares obtained, then updated the asset allocation ratios in his personal Excel investment ledger, checked whether the reserved liquidity funds were sufficient (reserved for the year-end half marathon registration, coffee shop operations, etc.), and finally sent a screenshot to his friend Peng Yuqing to share the investment operations.

name: Organized meditation insights and shared them to help a friend relieve stress, then received positive feedback.
description: On the afternoon of October 6, 2025, Feng Haoran was in his study at his home in Changsha organizing meditation steps and reflection notes. That evening from 20:00 to 20:30, he had a WeChat call with his good friend Peng Yuqing and learned that she was still troubled by the pressure of starting a business, so he shared his insights and recommended a meditation app. After Peng Yuqing tried it and practiced on October 7, she reported on October 8 that her sleep had improved and her anxiety had eased, which deeply comforted Feng Haoran.

subevent.name: Organize meditation insights and finally select insurance products
subevent.description: In the afternoon, I returned to the study in my new home, organized meditation steps and reflection notes for beginners. At the same time, from the two options I had screened, I selected a comprehensive accident insurance with high accidental medical coverage and hospitalization allowance, and recorded the policy link.

subevent.name: Call Peng Yuqing to share meditation insights.
subevent.description: On the evening of the Mid-Autumn Festival, October 6, 2025, from 20:00 to 20:30, Feng Haoran contacted his friend Peng Yuqing via WeChat voice call at his home in Changsha. During the call, he learned that Peng Yuqing was still troubled by the pressure of starting a business. Feng Haoran shared his compiled meditation insights and recommended the same meditation app, encouraging her to try practicing for 10 minutes every night before bed. Peng Yuqing said she was willing to try, and the two also exchanged updates on their recent lives.

subevent.name: Peng Yuqing gave feedback on the effects of meditation.
subevent.description: On October 7, 2025, after Peng Yuqing practiced with the meditation app as recommended by Feng Haoran, her sleep quality improved significantly that night. The next day, she gave feedback to Feng Haoran via WeChat, saying she fell asleep faster and felt less anxious, and thanked him for his concern. Feng Haoran was pleased when he saw the message and once again felt the sense of value that comes from helping others.

name: Introduce sleep monitoring and recovery optimization
description: Starting August 20, Feng Haoran used a smart bracelet to monitor sleep quality. After discovering insufficient deep sleep time, he adjusted his routine: going to bed before 11 pm every night, avoiding blue light from screens before bed, and trying to fall asleep directly after meditation. A week later, morning fatigue decreased, and his morning run pace improved by about 5%.

subevent.name: Start sleep monitoring and record baseline data
subevent.description: Before going to sleep on the night of August 20, 2025, Feng Haoran took out the smart band used at home (a domestic sports band brand), bound it to the phone app according to the manual, and set it to sleep monitoring mode. He wore the band to sleep, completing the first overnight sleep data recording. The band automatically monitored indicators such as time to fall asleep, deep sleep, light sleep, and REM duration.

subevent.name: Analyze sleep data and formulate a schedule adjustment plan
subevent.description: After getting up on the morning of August 21, Feng Haoran checked the sleep report generated by the fitness band app and found that his deep sleep time last night was only 42 minutes, far below the healthy standard (1.5-2 hours). Realizing the problem, he decided to adjust his routine immediately. In his home study, he recorded the adjustment plan in a notebook: 1) go to bed before 11 p.m. every night; 2) stop using the phone and tablet one hour before bed to avoid blue light interference; 3) do 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation before bed to relax the nerves, then go straight to sleep. At the same time, he set the band's sleep reminder to vibrate at 22:30 every night.

subevent.name: Implement schedule adjustments and evaluate the week's results
subevent.description: Starting from the evening of August 21, Feng Haoran strictly carried out a schedule adjustment plan: every night, after the wristband reminder at 10:30 p.m., he stopped using electronic devices, meditated for 10 minutes, fell asleep before 11:00 p.m., and wore the wristband to monitor sleep. He continued to record the feel and pace of his morning run for several days. By the morning of August 27, he clearly felt that fatigue was greatly reduced and his mental state was better. The morning run pace improved from an average of 5:30 per kilometer to 5:14 per kilometer, an improvement of about 5%. He confirmed that the schedule adjustment had achieved initial results and decided to continue maintaining this habit.
subevent.location: Changsha – Yuelu District home bedroom and outdoor morning run route

subevent.name: Started implementing the routine adjustment
subevent.description: At 10:30 p.m. on August 21, Feng Haoran was in his bedroom at home. After the wristband vibrated as a reminder, he immediately stopped using electronic devices such as his phone and tablet, did a 10-minute meditation to relax, and then lay down to sleep before 11:00. He wore the wristband before sleep to monitor sleep quality, preparing for subsequent data recording.

subevent.name: One-week effect evaluation
subevent.description: On the morning of August 27, after waking up at his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Feng Haoran clearly felt that his fatigue had greatly reduced and his mental state was better; then, while running along Lushan South Road, he recorded a pace of 5 minutes 14 seconds per kilometer, about 5% faster than his previous average of 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. He confirmed that the adjustment to his daily routine was beginning to show results and continued to maintain the same habits.
subevent.location: Changsha – Yuelu District home bedroom and outdoor morning run route

name: Assist parents with cross-provincial medical insurance and community registration
description: As the National Day holiday drew to a close, after his parents moved into their new home in Changsha, Feng Haoran on October 7 prepared in advance the documents needed for his parents to apply for cross-province medical insurance and community health records, including ID cards, household registration books, medical insurance cards, and property ownership certificates. On October 8, he accompanied his parents to the Yuelu District Subdistrict Office and Community Health Service Center to complete the cross-province medical insurance registration and community health record registration respectively. On October 9, at home, he used the policy brochures obtained after completion and the mobile app to explain in detail to his parents Changsha's medical insurance reimbursement policies and how to use them, ensuring that his parents could smoothly access local medical resources.

subevent.name: Prepare the materials required for off-site medical insurance and community registration.
subevent.description: After his parents moved into the new home in Changsha, Feng Haoran prepared in advance their ID cards, household registration booklets, medical insurance cards from their original insured location, and the property ownership certificate or lease contract for the new Changsha home, and made photocopies as backups, ensuring all materials were complete and fully preparing for the next day's procedures for remote medical insurance filing and community health record registration.

subevent.name: Go to the Yuelu District Sub-district Office to handle cross-region medical insurance filing
subevent.description: Feng Haoran accompanied his parents to the Yuelu District Sub-district Office in Changsha on the morning of October 8. At the off-site medical insurance window, they submitted the materials prepared in advance, filled out the application form for off-site medical treatment filing, and after the staff reviewed and approved, the filing procedure was completed. During the process, Feng Haoran helped his parents communicate and confirm the information to ensure the filing was successful.
subevent.location: Medical insurance service window at the subdistrict office, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Go to the community health service center to register for a health record.
subevent.description: That afternoon, Feng Haoran accompanied his parents to the Yuelu District Community Health Service Center to register their community resident health records. Staff entered basic information, medical history, and medication details, and scheduled a follow-up free physical examination appointment. Feng Haoran made detailed inquiries about chronic disease management services to ensure his parents could access local community medical resources.
subevent.location: Changsha City Yuelu District - Community Health Service Center

subevent.name: Explaining Changsha medical insurance reimbursement policy to parents
subevent.description: On the morning of October 9, Feng Haoran used the policy brochures from the medical insurance window and the official medical insurance app on his phone to explain to his parents in detail the reimbursement ratio for out-of-town medical treatment in Changsha, the outpatient coordination policy, and the selection of designated medical institutions. He also demonstrated how to use the app to look up information, ensuring that his parents understood and could do it themselves later.
subevent.location: Yuelu District, Changsha - living room at home

name: Camping with friends at Mount Heng, where friendship was strengthened through collaboration
description: From May 29 to June 2, Feng Haoran, with his friends Xie Yutong and Peng Yuqing, co-planned and completed a camping trip to Nanyue Hengshan. On May 29, Feng Haoran purchased supplies and confirmed the itinerary and division of labor online. On the 31st, the three drove to the Zhurong Peak camping area, working together to carry equipment and set up tents. At night, they sat around the campfire and had deep conversations about work and life stress, listening to each other's advice, and their friendship deepened through honest communication. On the morning of June 1, they packed up the camp, had a simple breakfast, and returned to Changsha. On the 2nd, Feng Haoran organized and cleaned the equipment, shared photos, and agreed on the next activity. Throughout the trip, they cooperated fluidly, and outdoor collaboration and emotional support further enhanced their friendship.

subevent.name: Camping supplies procurement and itinerary confirmation
subevent.description: Feng Haoran was at home in Changsha organizing a camping gear list. He went to an outdoor supply store to purchase missing items such as gas canisters, portable stoves, and outdoor utensils. Via WeChat, he confirmed with Xie Yutong and Peng Yuqing the specific time and place to meet on the morning of May 31 at Furong Middle Road, and discussed the allocation of tents, sleeping bags, and food each would bring.
subevent.location: Hunan Province, Changsha City - Home and Outdoor Supplies Store

subevent.name: Drive to Hengshan Scenic Area
subevent.description: At 8 a.m. on May 31, Feng Haoran left his home in Changsha by private car, picked up Xie Yutong and Peng Yuqing, and the three drove south along the Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau Expressway for about 2 hours, arriving at the entrance of the Mount Hengshan Scenic Area in Hengyang City. They parked in the parking lot and bought scenic area tickets.
subevent.location: Hengyang, Hunan Province - entrance to Nanyue Hengshan Scenic Area

subevent.name: Carrying equipment and setting up the tent camp.
subevent.description: The three divided the work to move camping gear such as tents, sleeping bags, cooking utensils, and food from the parking lot to the designated camping area near Zhurong Peak in the scenic area. Feng Haoran was responsible for pitching and securing the tents, Xie Yutong assisted with pulling the wind ropes, and Peng Yuqing laid out the moisture-proof mats and inner tents. It took about half an hour to set up the two tents and tidy the camping area.
subevent.location: Camping area at Zhurong Peak, Mount Heng, Hengyang City, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Night Bonfire Deep Exchange
subevent.description: After nightfall, the three lit a small campfire in the open area in front of the campsite (using a fire-resistant mat permitted by the scenic area) and sat around it talking. Feng Haoran proactively shared his recent work stress and goal of being promoted to investment director; Xie Yutong confided her confusion about changing jobs; Peng Yuqing talked about the challenges of new media operations. The three listened to each other and offered advice, until around 11 p.m. they each returned to their tents to rest, their friendship deepening through sincere conversation.
subevent.location: Campfire site at Zhurong Peak camping area, Mount Heng, Hengyang City, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Morning camp teardown and simple breakfast
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on June 1, the three got up one after another, worked together to take down the tent, pack up the sleeping bags and ground pads, clean up the campsite garbage, and sort and pack it. They used a portable stove to brew coffee and cook oatmeal as breakfast, eating simply with compressed biscuits. Then they confirmed no equipment was lost and prepared to go down the mountain.
subevent.location: Camping area at Zhurong Peak, Mount Heng, Hengyang City, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Drove back to Changsha
subevent.description: At 8 a.m., the three of them backpacked down the mountain to the scenic area exit and loaded their equipment into the car in the parking lot. Feng Haoran drove back to Changsha along the same route, taking a short rest and buying water at a service area along the way. They arrived in downtown Changsha around 11 a.m., dropped Xie Yutong and Peng Yuqing off near their residences separately, ending the camping trip.
subevent.location: Hengyang, Hunan Province to Changsha, Hunan Province - during a self-driving trip

subevent.name: Cleaning and putting away camping gear
subevent.description: On the evening of June 2, Feng Haoran took out the tent, sleeping bag, and other equipment at his home in Changsha to dry them, washed the muddy outdoor cookware and tableware, checked the equipment for wear, and replenished the first aid kit. After the equipment dried, he sorted and stored it in the storage cabinet by category, edited the camping photos on his phone, and sent them to the three-person WeChat group, agreeing on the next activity.
subevent.location: Changsha, Hunan Province - balcony and storage room at home

name: Attended the Fintech Summit in Shenzhen, met up with friends, and reflected on it later.
description: From January 9 to 12, Feng Haoran went to Shenzhen to attend the 'Greater Bay Area Fintech Summit' (Jan 9-10), learning about the frontier of blockchain applications in asset allocation. After the summit ended on the 11th, he paid a special visit to his childhood friend Zhang Mingxuan and had a meal together. Zhang Mingxuan shared internet product thinking and suggested developing a personal investment portfolio visualization tool. On the same day, he also briefly met with Wang Lina and Dong Haoran to expand cross-industry connections. That evening, he took a high-speed train back to Changsha. On the 12th, he organized his summit notes and business cards at home, wrote down his reflections, compared the differences between traditional finance and the pace of the internet, felt a brief sense of identity anxiety, and decided to incorporate Zhang Mingxuan's suggestion into his next learning plan.

subevent.name: Attending the first day of the summit
subevent.description: Feng Haoran took a high-speed rail from Changsha to Shenzhen, went to the Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center to attend the opening ceremony and main forum of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Fintech Summit, listened to a cutting-edge speech on the application of blockchain in asset allocation, and communicated with peers attending the conference.
subevent.location: Shenzhen - Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center

subevent.name: Second day at the summit
subevent.description: Feng Haoran continued attending the summit sub-forum, learning real-world cases of combining robo-advisory with blockchain, and exchanged business cards with several fintech practitioners during the lunch break to build industry connections.
subevent.location: Shenzhen - Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center

subevent.name: Visited childhood friend Zhang Mingxuan and had a meal together.
subevent.description: After the summit, Feng Haoran made a special trip to Tencent Binhai Tower to visit his childhood friend Zhang Mingxuan. The two had dinner at a nearby Hunan restaurant. Zhang Mingxuan shared internet product thinking and suggested that Feng Haoran develop a personal investment portfolio visualization tool. The exchange lasted about 2 hours.
subevent.location: Shenzhen - Hunan restaurant near Tencent Binhai Building

subevent.name: A short get-together with Wang Lina and Dong Haoran
subevent.description: In the afternoon, after visiting Zhang Mingxuan, Feng Haoran met Wang Lina and Dong Haoran, who are also developing their careers in Shenzhen, in Nanshan District. The three had a brief gathering to exchange career development insights and expand cross-industry connections, then parted after about an hour.

subevent.name: Return to Changsha
subevent.description: Feng Haoran finished all his itinerary in Shenzhen, took the high-speed rail that evening from Shenzhen back to Changsha, and arrived home late at night.
subevent.location: Shenzhen - Shenzhen North Station to Changsha - Home

subevent.name: Organized the conference materials and reflections
subevent.description: Feng Haoran sorted out the summit notes and collected business cards at home, wrote down his reflections on the conference, thought about the difference between his traditional financial path and the pace of the Internet, briefly felt identity anxiety, but decided to incorporate Zhang Mingxuan's suggestion into his next study plan.

name: Monthly morning run cumulative distance exceeded 100 km, setting a personal record
description: On the morning of November 24, Feng Haoran went for his usual run along Lushan South Road. After finishing 10 kilometers, he opened the fitness app and found that his monthly cumulative mileage had reached 102 kilometers, setting a personal record for the most miles in a single month. He sent a screenshot to his running buddy Gao Yunfei, and they agreed to take on a half marathon together next month. This event reflected the improvement in his physical fitness from long-term consistent running training.

subevent.name: Preparation and warm-up before the morning run
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on November 24, Feng Haoran got up in his bedroom at his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, changed into running gear and running shoes, and did 5 minutes of dynamic warm-up and stretching in the living room to prepare for a 10-kilometer morning run.

subevent.name: Morning 10 km run along Lushan South Road
subevent.description: After warming up, Feng Haoran set off from home, jogging along Lushan South Road toward Yuelu Mountain, passing Hunan University and Dongfanghong Square, and finally looping back to the starting point, covering about 10 kilometers in about 55 minutes, with pace controlled at 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer.
subevent.location: Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Check exercise records and discover the monthly cumulative total surpassed 100.
subevent.description: After finishing his run and returning home, Feng Haoran opened the fitness app on his phone to check the running data, and found that his cumulative mileage in November had reached 102 kilometers, setting a new personal monthly record. He was satisfied with this and took a screenshot to save the achievement page.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yuelu District, home living room

subevent.name: Share with fellow runners and schedule next month's challenge
subevent.description: Feng Haoran sent a screenshot of his cumulative running distance of 102 kilometers to his running friend Gao Yunfei via WeChat. During their chat, the two agreed to challenge a half marathon (21.1 kilometers) together in December and decided to each train according to plan, confirming the specific date and location at the end of the month.
subevent.location: Changsha - Home in Yuelu District (online communication)

name: Mother called to arrange a blind date, and I went to the appointment.
description: On the evening of September 8, his mother Li Xiuying called, telling him that a community auntie had introduced a girl who teaches in Changsha, and had already made an appointment for him to meet her at Starbucks in the Wuyi commercial area on the evening of September 10. Feng Haoran, though helpless, agreed to go. In the evening of September 10, after work, he went home to prepare and drove to the coffee shop at 18:30. At 19:00, he met his blind date Lin Fang on time. They talked for about an hour and a half and exchanged WeChat. After it ended, Feng Haoran called his mother on the way home to give a brief report.

subevent.name: Mother called to arrange a blind date
subevent.description: On the evening of September 8, Feng Haoran's mother, Li Xiuying, called him from home in Wuhan. She said that an auntie in her community had introduced a girl who teaches at a middle school in Changsha, and had already arranged a meeting at Starbucks in the Wuyi commercial district on the evening of September 10. Although Feng Haoran was a bit reluctant, he agreed to go to put his mother at ease. The call lasted about 20 minutes, and his mother repeatedly told him what to be careful about.

subevent.name: Prepare before going out and head to the coffee shop.
subevent.description: After work on the evening of September 10, Feng Haoran went home and made some preparations. He changed into a dark blue casual shirt and jeans, briefly styled his hair, took his phone and wallet, set off from his home in Yuelu District at around 18:30, and drove to the Starbucks coffee shop located at Wuyi Square, Furong District, about 25 minutes away by car.
subevent.location: At home in Yuelu District, Changsha, and on the way to the city center

subevent.name: Met a blind date at a coffee shop.
subevent.description: At 19:00 on the evening of September 10, Feng Haoran arrived on time at the Starbucks in the Wuyi commercial area to meet the girl introduced by his mother. Her name was Lin Fang, 25 years old, a Chinese language teacher at Changsha No.1 Middle School. The two each ordered drinks and chatted for about an hour and a half, covering topics such as work, hobbies, and family backgrounds. Feng Haoran had a mixed impression of Lin Fang, but remained friendly out of politeness, and they exchanged WeChat contacts.
subevent.location: Starbucks Coffee Shop, Wuyi Business Circle, Furong District, Changsha

subevent.name: Report the blind date situation to my mother.
subevent.description: After the blind date ended, Feng Haoran called his mother Li Xiuying on the way home, briefly reported the meeting with Lin Fang, said that she was good on paper but needed further understanding. His mother was delighted and encouraged her son to keep in touch. The call lasted about 10 minutes, and Feng Haoran ended it citing the need to rest.

name: Parents visited Changsha and toured retirement communities
description: From September 5 to 7, his parents Feng Jianguo and Li Xiuying came to Changsha from Wuhan. Feng Haoran accompanied them to visit two retirement communities, comparing facilities, prices, and medical support. During the visit, he also took his parents to taste Changsha-style Hunan cuisine, spending a warm weekend together. This field visit gave Feng Haoran a clearer direction for his parents' retirement planning and strengthened family bonds.

subevent.name: Parents departed from Wuhan and arrived in Changsha.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran's father Feng Jianguo and mother Li Xiuying arrived at Changsha South Railway Station from Wuhan by high-speed rail on the morning of September 5, 2025. Feng Haoran took leave from work in advance to greet them at the station, drove his parents to his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, to settle in, and briefly introduced the recent developments in Changsha and the upcoming itinerary.
subevent.location: Changsha City – Changsha South Railway Station and home

subevent.name: Accompanied parents for dinner, tasting Hunan cuisine.
subevent.description: On the evening of September 5, Feng Haoran drove his parents to a well-known Hunan restaurant (Xiangyue Tower) in Furong District, Changsha, where they tasted authentic Hunan dishes such as chopped pepper fish head, stir-fried yellow beef, and spicy crayfish. During the meal, his parents were full of praise for the taste of Hunan cuisine. Feng Haoran shared interesting stories about living in Changsha. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious, and the dinner lasted about two hours.
subevent.location: Xiangyue Lou Hunan Restaurant, Furong District, Changsha

subevent.name: Visit Xingcheng Yiyang Senior Living Community (morning).
subevent.description: At 9 a.m. on September 6, Feng Haoran accompanied his parents by car to the Xingcheng Yiyang Senior Living Community in Yuelu District, Changsha. Led by community staff, they toured the independent living area, nursing building, dining hall, activity center, and other facilities, and learned in detail about the fee structure, medical support (in cooperation with the Third Xiangya Hospital), and admission requirements. Feng Haoran recorded key information on the spot, and his parents were satisfied with the community environment and hardware.
subevent.location: Xingcheng Yiyang Elderly Care Community, Yuelu District, Changsha City

subevent.name: Visit Meixi Lake Health and Wellness Center (afternoon)
subevent.description: At 2 p.m. on September 6, Feng Haoran took his parents to visit the Meixi Lake Health and Wellness Center in Yuelu District, Changsha. The community focuses on an integrated medical and elderly care model, equipped with a community hospital and rehabilitation center. Staff led them through areas such as suite layouts, activity rooms, and gardens, and introduced its membership-based fee plan as well as green-channel services with several nearby Grade-A tertiary hospitals. His parents were impressed by the natural environment of Meixi Lake, and Feng Haoran carefully compared the pros and cons of the two institutions he visited in the morning and afternoon.
subevent.location: Meixi Lake Health and Wellness Center, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Family dinner discussion on retirement planning (evening)
subevent.description: In the evening of September 6, Feng Haoran cooked a home-style meal for his parents at home (pork rib and lotus root soup, steamed fish, etc.). After dinner, the three sat in the living room and began discussing a comparison of two senior care communities. The parents preferred Xingcheng Yiyang because it was closer to Feng Haoran's residence, while Feng Haoran suggested considering the medical-care facilities at Meixi Lake. Considering factors such as price, location, and services, they initially formed a plan for further visits. During the conversation, Feng Haoran also consulted colleagues via WeChat about their evaluations of the senior care communities.
subevent.location: Feng Haoran's home, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Take parents back to Wuhan
subevent.description: On the morning of September 7, Feng Haoran had breakfast with his parents at home and had a final discussion, deciding that Feng Haoran would later compile two detailed information tables about retirement communities and send them to his parents, and that they would make a decision after his mother learned more. At noon, Feng Haoran drove his parents to Changsha South Railway Station, accompanying them into the station up to the ticket gate. His parents took the 13:00 high-speed train back to Wuhan. Feng Haoran told his parents to take care of themselves and agreed to visit Wuhan during the National Day holiday.

name: Attended a colleague's wedding and took photos for documentation and sharing.
description: On October 18, after preparing his Canon camera equipment at home, Feng Haoran went with colleague Zheng Wenbo to a hotel in Yuhua District, Changsha, to attend a colleague's wedding. During the ceremony and banquet, he actively took candid shots of the couple exchanging rings, giving speeches, interacting with relatives and friends, and toasting, continuing until the evening, and then archived the photos. On October 20, he carefully edited 50 selected photos at home and shared them with the newlyweds and the colleague group via WeChat, receiving thanks and praise.

subevent.name: Photography equipment check and charging
subevent.description: A colleague of Feng Haoran's is getting married soon. Before going out in the morning, at his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Feng Haoran checked and charged his Canon camera battery, cleaned the lens, and prepared the memory card and spare battery, ensuring the equipment was in good condition to complete the wedding photography task.
subevent.location: Home, 156 Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Set off for the wedding venue
subevent.description: Feng Haoran drove from home with his photography equipment to a wedding venue at a hotel in Yuhua District, Changsha. On the way, he met up with his colleague Zheng Wenbo and went together.
subevent.location: A hotel in Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Photographic documentation of the wedding scene
subevent.description: During the wedding ceremony on October 18, Feng Haoran proactively used a Canon camera to capture candid moments of the couple exchanging rings, giving speeches, and interacting with family and friends. The shooting lasted about 2 hours and covered all parts of the wedding. He also discreetly communicated with the couple to confirm the key shots to focus on.
subevent.location: A hotel banquet hall in Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Wedding dinner and casual photos
subevent.description: During the wedding dinner, Feng Haoran continued to film warm scenes of friends and family interacting and the newlyweds toasting while eating. The filming lasted until about 9 p.m., and he finally archived the hundreds of photos taken that day to his laptop.
subevent.location: A hotel banquet hall in Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Wedding photo organization and sharing.
subevent.description: The day after the wedding, Feng Haoran used his computer at home to fine-tune 50 selected photos, and shared the electronic album via WeChat to the newlyweds and colleague group, receiving thanks and praise.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Invited to give a public lecture for Xianjiahu Community in Yuelu District on “Preventing Financial Fraud, Safeguarding Retirement Money”
description: On May 24, Feng Haoran prepared the lecture PPT at home and contacted Director Chen from the community to confirm the agenda. On the morning of May 25, he went to the Xianjiahu Community Activity Center in Yuelu District to set up the venue. From 9 to 11 a.m., he gave a public lecture to about 50 residents, explaining fraud techniques and prevention measures with easy-to-understand cases. The interaction was lively, and after the lecture several elderly residents expressed their gratitude. After returning home in the afternoon, he wrote down his reflections in his diary, feeling for the first time the deep sense of accomplishment of applying his professional skills to serve society.

subevent.name: Pre-lecture preparation.
subevent.description: In his home study, Feng Haoran created a PPT for the lecture "Preventing Financial Fraud, Protecting Retirement Money," collected recent common financial fraud cases, prepared an easy-to-understand presentation script, and contacted Director Chen of Xianjiahu Community via WeChat to confirm the lecture process, equipment, and audience details.

subevent.name: Go to the community and set up the lecture venue
subevent.description: Feng Haoran set off from home at 8 a.m. on May 25 and drove to Xianjiahu Community Activity Center in Yuelu District. After arriving, he set up the venue with community staff, debugged the projector equipment, arranged seats, and completed all preparations before 9 a.m.
subevent.location: Xianjiahu Community Activity Center, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Host a public interest lecture
subevent.description: From 9 to 11 AM, Feng Haoran held a public lecture titled “Preventing Financial Fraud, Protecting Retirement Money” at the Xianjiahu Community Activity Center for about 50 community residents. Combining his professional financial knowledge, he used real cases to explain common methods of telecom fraud, illegal fundraising, health product scams, and other tricks, and taught prevention techniques. The lecture included an interactive session where the elderly actively asked questions, and the atmosphere was lively.
subevent.location: Xianjiahu Community Activity Center, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Personal reflection and record
subevent.description: In the afternoon, after returning home, Feng Haoran recorded in detail in his diary the experience and feelings of this public welfare lecture. For the first time, he experienced the deep sense of accomplishment of using professional financial knowledge to serve the elderly in the community, reflected on the meaning of professionals' social responsibility, and planned to participate regularly in such public welfare activities in the future.

name: Watched the play 'Dream of the Red Chamber' with Gao Yunfei and took a walk to discuss.
description: On November 21, after work, Feng Haoran went home to prepare, then went to Meixi Lake International Culture and Arts Center to meet his running buddy Gao Yunfei. Together they watched the play 'Dream of the Red Chamber' produced by Shanghai Dramatic Arts Center. The two-and-a-half-hour performance gave him new insights into the rise and fall of a family; after the show, the two strolled by the lake in Meixi Lake Park, discussing the plot and their thoughts.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparations
subevent.description: After work, Feng Haoran returned to his home at No. 156 Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha. He changed into casual clothes, took his performance ticket and camera, checked his belongings, and prepared to go watch a drama in the evening.

subevent.name: On the way to the theater
subevent.description: Feng Haoran set off from home, took Metro Line 2 to Meixi Lake West Station, met up with his running buddy Gao Yunfei at the agreed spot near Meixi Lake International Culture and Arts Center, and the two walked to the theater.
subevent.location: Changsha - near Meixihu International Culture and Art Center

subevent.name: Watched the play Dream of the Red Chamber.
subevent.description: From 19:30 to 22:00 in the evening, Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei watched the play “Dream of the Red Chamber” produced by Shanghai Dramatic Arts Centre at the Grand Theatre of Meixi Lake International Culture and Arts Center. The two-and-a-half-hour performance gave Feng Haoran new insights into the rise and fall of a family.
subevent.location: Changsha – Meixi Lake International Culture and Arts Center Grand Theatre

subevent.name: After the show, they took a walk by the lake and discussed the plot.
subevent.description: After the play ended, Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei strolled by the lake in Meixi Lake Park, reflecting on the fate of the characters while exchanging their thoughts on the rise and fall of families and the impermanence of life, sharing their impressions of the show.

name: Experienced a murder mystery game with relatives and friends, first taste of the fun of role-playing
description: Feng Haoran was dragged into two murder mystery game sessions by his younger sister Feng Xinran and his good friend Peng Yuqing. The first was on August 15 at a Republic-era themed store in Wuyi Square, Changsha. He played an accountant and, with his rigorous logic, led the team to uncover the truth, enjoying the fun of role-playing. The second session was planned for October 17 to try a light horror theme. This experience changed his conservative impression of tabletop games.

subevent.name: Invite and book a murder mystery game.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran was at home in Changsha, and his younger sister Feng Xinran contacted him via WeChat to plan a murder mystery game with their friend Peng Yuqing. After discussing, the three decided to choose a Republic of China-themed mystery game store in Wuyi Square, Changsha, and booked an afternoon session on August 15, reserving seats for four players (including themselves).
subevent.location: Changsha - a Republic of China-themed murder mystery game venue at Wuyi Square

subevent.name: Went to the murder mystery game store.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 15, 2025, Feng Haoran, his sister Feng Xinran, and his friend Peng Yuqing met as scheduled at Wuyi Square Metro Station in Changsha. The three walked to a reserved Republic of China-themed murder mystery game shop. On the way, Feng Xinran and Peng Yuqing introduced the rules of the game, and Feng Haoran was somewhat curious but said he was willing to try.

subevent.name: Republic of China-themed murder mystery experience.
subevent.description: At a Republic of China-themed murder mystery game store on Wuyi Square in Changsha, Feng Haoran, Feng Xinran, Peng Yuqing, and other players—five in total—started the game. Feng Haoran played a Republican-era accountant. Using the logical reasoning skills cultivated in his financial investment work, he analyzed the clues step by step and ultimately led the team to successfully reconstruct the truth of the case. Through the game, he experienced the joy of role-playing and changed his conservative impression of tabletop games.
subevent.location: Changsha - a Republic of China-themed murder mystery game venue at Wuyi Square

subevent.name: Exchange feedback after the experience.
subevent.description: After the murder mystery game ended, Feng Haoran, Feng Xinran, and Peng Yuqing rested and chatted at a Sexy Tea shop near Wuyi Square. Feng Haoran said the experience exceeded expectations and he really liked the combination of role-playing and deduction. The three had a lively discussion about the plot. Feng Xinran and Peng Yuqing took the opportunity to recommend other themes, and Feng Haoran said he was willing to try again.

subevent.name: Discuss the plan for the second micro-horror themed plan
subevent.description: The next morning, after Feng Haoran's morning run at the company, he received group chat messages from Feng Xinran and Peng Yuqing, who suggested trying a light-horror themed murder mystery game. Feng Haoran recalled that after his first experience he didn't feel averse to it and was actually a bit curious. The three discussed and initially decided to have their second session on October 17, and planned to choose a store and make a reservation then.

name: Feng Haoran had an in-depth discussion with his parents and planned a pension plan
description: On September 15, 2025, Feng Haoran made a series of preparations and communications to discuss elderly care plans with his parents. In the morning, at his home study in Changsha, he organized the comparative materials on retirement communities in Changsha that his parents had visited at the beginning of the month. From 8:00 pm to 9:30 pm, he had a video call in the living room with his parents, who were in Wuhan, analyzing the pros and cons of each community in detail, and creatively proposing the idea of alternating residence between Changsha and Wuhan, which was approved by his parents. The three decided to check out elderly care options in Wuhan before the end of the year. After the call, Feng Haoran recorded the consensus, marked the December trip to Wuhan on his phone calendar, and compiled a list of retirement communities in Wuhan, which he sent to his parents via WeChat for confirmation.

subevent.name: Organize the retirement community site-visit materials
subevent.description: On the morning of September 15, 2025, Feng Haoran, in the study of his home in Changsha, organized the materials on retirement communities that his parents had inspected in Changsha at the beginning of the month (including comparative information on environment, medical care, costs, transportation, etc.) into electronic documents and comparison tables, fully preparing for the video call with his parents that evening.

subevent.name: Video call to discuss retirement plan.
subevent.description: On the evening of September 15, 2025, from 8:00 to 9:30, Feng Haoran had a video call in the living room of his home in Changsha with his parents, who were at their home in Wuhan. He analyzed in detail the pros and cons of the two senior care communities in Changsha that his parents had inspected earlier in the month (e.g., medical support, living environment, cost-effectiveness, etc.), and creatively proposed a care plan in which his parents could live alternately in Changsha and Wuhan, which would both take into account his father's social circle in Wuhan and make it convenient for him to visit regularly. His parents approved of his thoughtful analysis, and ultimately the three of them decided to conduct an on-site inspection of local senior care options in Wuhan before the end of the year before making a final decision.
subevent.location: Changsha City - living room at home

subevent.name: Recording call decisions and planning follow-up actions
subevent.description: After the video call on September 15, 2025, Feng Haoran recorded in his study at his Changsha home the consensus reached during the call: to conduct an on-site inspection of elderly care options in Wuhan before the end of the year. He marked in his phone calendar his plan to return to Wuhan in December, and compiled a list of major retirement communities in Wuhan for further discussion with his parents. He also organized the key points of the call and sent them to his parents via WeChat for confirmation.

name: Continued progress on CFA Level I preparation
description: Starting from February 5, Feng Haoran used the fragmented time of his daily commute and lunch break to study the CFA Level 1 course through a mobile app, focusing on reviewing ethics and quantitative methods, and completed a total of 30 class hours. He used electronic notes to record key points and difficulties, and discussed online with a study group, effectively consolidating his knowledge. By the end of the month, he had completed the ethics and quantitative sections, and planned to study financial statement analysis next month. During the exam preparation, he combined theoretical knowledge with work practice to improve his investment analysis ability.

subevent.name: CFA exam preparation and plan formulation
subevent.description: Feng Haoran, at home in Changsha, downloaded and configured the CFA Level 1 exam preparation app through the mobile app store, formulated a detailed study plan for February based on his own schedule, decided to focus on the Ethics and Quantitative Methods modules, and arranged study content for fragmented time during daily commutes and lunch breaks.

subevent.name: Study the quantitative methods module
subevent.description: Feng Haoran started studying the CFA Level I Quantitative Methods module on February 16 and made a 10-day study plan. On February 18, he organized his electronic notes on probability theory in his home study. On the evening of February 21, he discussed difficult problems online with study group members including Zhang Mingxuan via Tencent Meeting. On February 22, he spent the whole Saturday reviewing intensively and completed 100 official practice questions. On February 25, he wrapped up by summarizing incorrect questions and previewed the next module. The entire process took place at home in his study or online, covering topics such as probability theory and statistics.

subevent.name: Develop a study plan for quantitative methods
subevent.description: In his home study at No. 156 Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, Feng Haoran used his Sunday rest time to turn on his electronic devices, organize the lecture notes and question bank for the CFA Level I Quantitative Methods module, and formulate a detailed 10-day study plan, planning to complete 2 lessons per day using spare moments during his commute, and scheduling intensive weekend review and online discussions.

subevent.name: Organize probability theory notes
subevent.description: After returning to his home in Changsha from work in the evening, Feng Haoran organized the scattered formulas and example problems he had recorded during commutes over the past two days into the electronic note-taking software Notion, categorizing probability distribution types, expected value calculation formulas, and supplementing solution steps for after-class exercises. It took about 1 hour to complete the probability theory notes.

subevent.name: Online study group discussion
subevent.description: From 8 to 9 PM on Friday, Feng Haoran had an online discussion via Tencent Meeting with the other two members of his CFA study group (Zhang Mingxuan, a childhood friend who was also preparing for CFA Level I). They went through the difficult questions accumulated during the week one by one (such as the transformation between probability density functions and cumulative distribution functions, and the interpretation of p-values in hypothesis testing), with Feng Haoran using an electronic whiteboard to draw diagrams to aid understanding. After the discussion, he recorded the meeting and saved the replay to the cloud.

subevent.name: Focused review and problem-set training
subevent.description: Feng Haoran spent the whole Saturday at home in Yuelu District systematically reviewing the probability theory and statistics content he studied this week. He first browsed his electronic notes to sort out the knowledge framework, then opened the CFA official question bank software and focused on completing 100 practice questions in the quantitative methods chapter. Wrong questions were automatically added to the wrong-question collection. During this period, he got up every hour to stretch and drink coffee to stay focused. It took about 6 hours in total, and he completed 70% of the questions.

subevent.name: Summarize the module and preview the next phase
subevent.description: On Tuesday evening after work, Feng Haoran did the final wrap-up for the Quantitative Methods module. He exported his collection of wrong answers, recalculated the error-prone problem types by hand, and confirmed that all concepts were correct. He then opened the preview materials for the next module (Economics), browsed the table of contents and key chapters, and downloaded two trial lessons to his phone in advance to prepare for starting the new learning module the next day. The entire process took 2 hours, marking the preliminary completion of the Quantitative Methods module.

subevent.name: Participate in online discussion of the study group
subevent.description: Feng Haoran had two online discussions with his CFA exam study group via WeChat, the first on ethics case analysis questions and the second on quantitative methods exercises. He exchanged problem-solving approaches and shared electronic notes with his group members, further consolidating what he had learned.

subevent.name: Completed the review summary for the ethics and quantitative sections
subevent.description: At the end of February, Feng Haoran comprehensively reviewed the two modules he had completed, Ethics and Quantitative Methods, systematically sorted out the key and difficult points in his electronic notes, and did practice questions to test his mastery. Then he formulated a specific plan and schedule for studying Financial Statement Analysis next month.

name: Signed up for the running group's year-end training sharing session
description: On December 2, Feng Haoran saw the notice of the year-end training sharing session in the running group's WeChat group, and immediately discussed it with his running partner Gao Yunfei and decided to sign up. On December 4, the two submitted their registration information and completed payment separately, successfully registering.

subevent.name: Check the notice for the running group's year-end training sharing session.
subevent.description: During the rest period after his morning run, Feng Haoran opened WeChat on his phone and saw a notice posted in the running group about the year-end training sharing session. The notice detailed the theme of the session as winter endurance training and half-marathon tactics, along with registration methods and schedule. He read all the information carefully.

subevent.name: Discussing registration matters with Gao Yunfei.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran used WeChat private chat to contact fellow runner Gao Yunfei, forwarded the sharing session notice, and discussed whether to sign up. The two exchanged views on the theme, speaker, and schedule of the session, agreed that it would be helpful for winter training, and decided to sign up together.

subevent.name: Submit registration information.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei agreed on a time and each filled in their personal information (name, contact information, running experience, etc.) on the running group's official registration platform, chose to attend the year-end training sharing session, completed the online payment, and received the successful registration confirmation message sent by the system.

name: Pre-trip preparation for a self-driving photography trip to Mount Heng before the National Day holiday.
description: On the evening of September 25, Feng Haoran had the idea of taking a short self-drive trip to test both the vehicle and his photography skills, and decided to go to Mount Heng for a photography expedition on the last weekend before the National Day holiday. In the following days, he checked the driving route and weather, inspected the vehicle, and prepared photography equipment and outdoor gear, making comprehensive preparations for the trip.

subevent.name: Came up with the idea of self-driving and made initial plans
subevent.description: On the evening of September 25, Feng Haoran was resting in his home study when he came up with the idea of a short self-driving trip to test the vehicle and his photography capabilities. He decided to go to Hengshan on the last weekend before the National Day holiday for a photography outing, as a warm-up for a future long road trip to Sichuan and Tibet. He opened the map app on his phone to check the approximate location and distance to Hengshan, estimated a round trip of about 300 kilometers, and confirmed it was suitable for a short test.
subevent.location: Family study, Lushan South Road, Changsha

subevent.name: Check self-driving route and weather for Hengshan
subevent.description: On the morning of September 26, before going to work, Feng Haoran used his phone to check the detailed driving route from Changsha to Hengshan, confirming that taking the Beijing-Hong Kong-Macao Expressway would take about 2 hours. He also checked the one-week weather forecast for Hengshan, confirmed that the weekend weather was suitable for outdoor photography, and recorded sunrise and sunset times to plan shooting periods.

subevent.name: Check the vehicle condition
subevent.description: After work on September 27, Feng Haoran went to the underground parking garage of his residential community to perform a simple check on his private car: test tire pressure and wear, check oil and coolant levels, and test the brake system to ensure the vehicle was suitable for long-distance driving. After confirming everything was normal, he filled the gas tank and prepared the car for the weekend trip.
subevent.location: Changsha - Lushan South Road Residential Community Underground Garage

subevent.name: Prepare photography equipment and outdoor gear
subevent.description: On the evening of September 28, Feng Haoran packed his photography backpack at home, checking the camera, wide-angle lens, tripod, spare batteries, memory cards, and other equipment, and wiped the lens. At the same time, he prepared outdoor gear: a hardshell jacket, hiking shoes, a flashlight, a first-aid kit, and drinking water, making sure everything was complete and ready for an early departure the next morning.
subevent.location: Family study, Lushan South Road, Changsha

name: Parents officially moved into their new home in Changsha, settled in and got familiar with the surroundings; mother cooked for the first time, a warm family reunion.
description: Continuing the formal move after his parents had settled into a rental home in Changsha last month, Feng Haoran rented a van on November 1 and went to Wuhan to move the remaining large furniture to the two-bedroom apartment in Yuelu District, Changsha. He assisted with disassembly and installation all day until everything was arranged in the evening. The next day, he took leave to accompany his parents to learn about the community: they walked to the community health center to register and set up health records, and he introduced commonly bought items at the vegetable market. In the evening, his mother used the new stove to cook braised fish and lotus root soup. Feng Haoran took photos and posted them on Moments to record the [home to Changsha] moment, and the three of them smiled at each other under the light.

subevent.name: Moving furniture and setting up the new home
subevent.description: Feng Haoran rented a van to move remaining large furniture from his home in Wuhan to his new two-bedroom apartment in Yuelu District, Changsha. Throughout the day, he assisted his father Feng Jianguo and mother Li Xiuying with furniture disassembly, installation, and interior layout, until the new home was basically arranged in the evening. Participants included Feng Haoran (himself), father Feng Jianguo, and mother Li Xiuying.
subevent.location: Wuhan, Hubei Province - home; new residence in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Accompany parents to get familiar with the community environment
subevent.description: Feng Haoran took a day off to accompany his parents in getting familiar with the community environment around their new home in Yuelu District, Changsha. First, they walked to the community hospital to register and establish health records for his parents, then went to the nearby vegetable market, where his mother, Li Xiuying, learned about the stalls and prices of frequently purchased dishes. Feng Haoran patiently introduced the surrounding facilities to help his parents adapt to their new home life as soon as possible. Participants included Feng Haoran (himself), his father Feng Jianguo, and his mother Li Xiuying.
subevent.location: Community hospital and vegetable market in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Mother's First Home-Cooked Meal: A Warm Reunion
subevent.description: That evening, mother Li Xiuying used the new stove to cook Hubei home-style dishes, including braised fish and pork rib and lotus root soup. The whole family sat around the dining table in the new home to enjoy dinner. Feng Haoran took photos of the dishes with his phone and posted them on Moments to record the 'Home to Changsha' moment. The three of them smiled at each other under the lights in a warm family reunion. Participants included Feng Haoran (himself), father Feng Jianguo, and mother Li Xiuying.
subevent.location: At the new residence in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Annual check-up showed decreased blood lipids, weight stable in healthy range.
description: On the morning of Saturday, October 12, Feng Haoran went to the hospital for an annual health check-up. The report showed that after six months of dietary control and regular rock climbing, blood lipid indicators had significantly improved compared to last year, though still slightly above the normal upper limit. Weight remained at 77 kg, BMI 22.3. The doctor affirmed his muscle gain results and advised him to continue controlling red meat intake and maintain aerobic exercise. Feng Haoran took a photo of the report and sent it to his mother in Wuhan to reassure her.

subevent.name: Undergo the annual physical examination.
subevent.description: On the morning of October 12, Feng Haoran, fasting, went to the Physical Examination Center of Xiangya Hospital, Central South University in Changsha, and completed annual physical exam items in sequence: blood draw, blood pressure measurement, ECG, abdominal ultrasound, etc., with emphasis on blood lipid and weight indicators. The medical staff guided him the whole time, taking about 2 hours.

participant.name: Medical staff at the physical examination center.

subevent.location: Changsha - Health Examination Center, Xiangya Hospital, Central South University

subevent.name: The doctor interpreted the medical examination report and provided health advice.
subevent.description: About half an hour after the physical examination, Feng Haoran met with the attending physician in the report room of the examination center. The doctor presented the report: blood lipid indicators were significantly lower than last year but still slightly above the normal upper limit, weight was 77 kg, and BMI 22.3 was in the healthy range. The doctor affirmed his muscle-building results achieved through diet control and regular rock climbing, and advised him to continue controlling red meat intake and maintain at least three sessions of aerobic exercise per week.
subevent.location: Changsha - Health Examination Center, Xiangya Hospital, Central South University

subevent.name: Send the physical examination report to mother.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran used his phone to take photos of the medical examination report page by page, sent them via WeChat to his mother Li Xiuying in Wuhan, and left a voice message briefly reporting the results, saying that his blood lipids had improved and his weight remained healthy, to reassure her. His mother immediately replied with encouragement and urged him to stick to a healthy lifestyle.
subevent.location: Changsha - Xiangya Hospital, Central South University

name: In his diary, he calmly reviewed the coffee shop's small loss in its first month.
description: On the evening of November 30, Feng Haoran checked the coffee shop's first full month of accounts. After deducting rent, labor, raw materials, and other costs, the net profit was negative 2,000 yuan. He did not disturb his partner. Before bed, he wrote in his diary [the first month's loss is expected; the foot traffic brought by the photo exhibition shows the direction is right; in the long run, we still need to polish the offerings and service], and drew a cup of steaming coffee in the corner of the page as a sign of confidence.

subevent.name: Check the coffee shop's first-month accounts
subevent.description: On the evening of November 30, 2025, Feng Haoran carefully checked the complete financial accounts of the first month of operation at his own coffee shop. After calculating costs such as rent, labor, and raw materials, he confirmed that the net profit was negative 2,000 yuan. Sitting by the bar, he used his laptop to export detailed income and expense statements, and compared purchase receipts and sales records item by item to ensure the data was accurate.

subevent.name: Diary review: first month's losses.
subevent.description: After checking the accounts, Feng Haoran returned to the bedroom at home, and before going to bed, he took out his diary and wrote down his reflections. He recorded that the small loss in the first month was to be expected, and that the foot traffic brought by the photography exhibition he had held earlier confirmed the coffee shop was on the right track, but the quality of products and service would still need polishing over the long term. In the corner of the page, he drew a simple sketch of a steaming cup of coffee to remind himself to stay confident.

name: Completed the first 15 km long-distance run with Gao Yunfei at a steady pace.
description: On the morning of October 20, after getting up early and preparing at home, Feng Haoran met up with his running buddy Gao Yunfei under the Orange Isle Bridge.
