After warming up, they successfully completed a 15.02 km run along the east bank of the Xiang River, with an average pace of 6 minutes 25 seconds per kilometer and no obvious slowdown in the latter half. After the run, Feng Haoran said goodbye to Gao Yunfei and walked home.

subevent.name: Pre-run preparation and departure
subevent.description: At 5:30 a.m. on October 20, Feng Haoran got up and put on his running gear (running shoes, quick-dry clothing, sports watch), carried a water bottle and energy gels, ate a banana, and left his home on Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, at 5:50, walking to the meeting point under the Orange Isle Bridge beside the Xiang River.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, and along the Xiangjiang River

subevent.name: Meeting and warm-up.
subevent.description: At 6:00 AM on October 20, Feng Haoran arrived on time under the Orange Isle Bridge to meet Gao Yunfei. After checking each other's gear, they did a 10-minute dynamic warm-up (high knees, lunges, joint circles) to get their bodies into exercise mode, then started a 15-kilometer run along the east bank of the Xiang River.
subevent.location: Changsha - under the Orange Isle Bridge by the Xiangjiang River

subevent.name: Completed a 15-kilometer long-distance run.
subevent.description: From 6:10 to 7:46 a.m. on October 20, Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei set off from Juzizhou Bridge, ran south along the east bank of the Xiangjiang River to Heishipu Bridge, then turned back to the starting point, covering a total of 15.02 km, with an average pace of 6:25 min/km and a heart rate stable at around 148 bpm, without any obvious slowdown in the latter part. Feng Haoran felt slight fatigue in the final 2 km, but under Gao Yunfei's pace, he completed the run smoothly.
subevent.location: Changsha - Xiang River bank (section from Juzizhou Bridge to Heishipu Bridge)

subevent.name: Returning home after running and recording
subevent.description: At 8:10 a.m., after saying goodbye to Gao Yunfei, Feng Haoran walked home, buying two bottles of mineral water on the way to rehydrate. After arriving home, he showered and changed clothes, synced his running data to the fitness app and recorded his thoughts, then enjoyed a breakfast of eggs, oatmeal, and fruit to refuel for the day's work.

name: Systematic climbing training: from basics to continuously completing V2 routes.
description: From May 14 to 30, Feng Haoran undertook five systematic training sessions at Matrix Climbing Gym under coach Lao Zhou, learning basic hand and foot techniques, weight shifting, lateral cross-hand moves, and dynamic power. He gradually conquered V1-V2 difficulty routes, finally completing four V2 routes in a row. At the end of the month, he summarized and organized his progress, and his finger grip strength and body coordination had improved significantly.

subevent.name: First systematic rock climbing training
subevent.description: At the climbing gym, Feng Haoran began his first systematic training under coach Lao Zhou, learning basic hand techniques (grab, hold, crimp) and footwork (step, push), becoming familiar with climbing safety procedures and equipment use, and completed 2 routes on V1 difficulty.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yuelu District Matrix Climbing Gym

subevent.name: Second rock climbing training—weight transfer practice.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran did his second training session at the climbing gym, focusing on practicing weight transfer technique. Under the guidance of coach Lao Zhou, he completed 3 V1 routes and 1 V2 route, and began to pay attention to keeping his body close to the wall and using leg power.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yuelu District Matrix Climbing Gym

subevent.name: Third Rock Climbing Training — Side Body and Cross-Hand Moves
subevent.description: Feng Haoran had his third training session at the climbing gym, learning side-body movements and cross-hand techniques, consecutively conquered 2 V2-difficulty routes, significantly improved grip strength and shoulder-back strength, and discussed movement details with the coach.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yuelu District Matrix Climbing Gym

name: Organize parents' health records and follow up on vaccine needs
description: On November 14, Feng Haoran remotely guided his parents to find and photograph their vaccination records and send them to him, then entered the information into the family health file, and called the community doctor to confirm the follow-up vaccines needed by his parents. On November 15, he categorized, archived and backed up the collected photos of records, and finally improved the family health management plan based on the doctor's advice and shared it with his parents.

subevent.name: Searched for and organized parents' vaccination records
subevent.description: Feng Haoran, at his home in Changsha, searched for the vaccination record book that his parents Feng Jianguo and Li Xiuying kept at their home in Wuhan. He confirmed the location of the records with his father over the phone and asked his mother to take photos and send them. In the end, he collected his parents' vaccination records from the past five years.

subevent.name: Take photos of vaccination records and archive them.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran organized the photos of his parents’ vaccination records received on his phone, categorized them by name and year, and saved them to a dedicated folder in the family health archive. At the same time, he uploaded the photos to cloud storage for backup to ensure the original records were not lost.

subevent.name: Enter family health records
subevent.description: Feng Haoran opened the family health management spreadsheet and entered item by item his parents' names, ages, medical history, allergy history, and the vaccination dates and vaccine types collected this time, and noted the next vaccination reminder time, improving the family health records.

subevent.name: Contact the community doctor to confirm vaccine needs
subevent.description: Feng Haoran contacted the doctor at the community health service center in his parents' community (Jiangan District, Wuhan) by phone, provided his parents' vaccination history, consulted about the vaccines needed this season (such as flu vaccine, pneumonia vaccine, etc.), and recorded the specific vaccination time, place, and precautions recommended by the doctor.

subevent.name: Refining the family health management plan
subevent.description: Following the community doctor's advice, Feng Haoran added the list of vaccines and appointment times that his parents need to receive to the family health record, formulated a follow-up vaccination reminder plan (such as reminding his parents to go to the community hospital on time for vaccination), and shared the organized health record with his parents, urging them to pay attention to their health.

name: Organize and share the 'One Day at Hengshan' photo album, and refine the Sichuan-Tibet route guide with Xie Yutong.
description: On September 27, Feng Haoran sorted photos of Mount Heng at his home in Changsha, created an album titled “One Day at Mount Heng”, and shared it in a photography group, earning praise from fellow photographers. On September 28, he contacted Xie Yutong and had a video call to jointly refine the Sichuan-Tibet self-driving route, shared his experience from the Mount Heng self-driving test, and incorporated short-distance self-driving tests as a preliminary step in the Sichuan-Tibet plan.

subevent.name: Organized Mount Heng photos and made a photo album
subevent.description: In his study at home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Feng Haoran selected 30 representative photos from the ones he had taken during his trip to Mount Heng, used Lightroom software for color correction and cropping, arranged them into a photo album titled One Day at Mount Heng in the order of the visit, added brief captions to each photo, and finally exported two versions: a high-definition PDF and a social media sharing version.

subevent.name: Post an album in the photography group and interact
subevent.description: Feng Haoran posted the finished PDF album 'One Day at Mount Heng' and a sharing link to his street photography WeChat group, along with his shooting insights and parameter settings. Many photography friends in the group (including Xu Jianing, etc.) liked and commented. Feng Haoran replied to each one with thanks and had brief discussions on composition and post-processing techniques, lasting about 40 minutes.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District, home study (online)

subevent.name: Contact Xie Yutong to arrange a time to refine the route plan
subevent.description: Feng Haoran contacted his camping partner Xie Yutong via WeChat, told her that he had finished organizing the Hengshan photo album, and proposed to refine the Sichuan-Tibet self-driving route guide that evening as originally planned. The two confirmed a video call at 8 p.m. that evening and agreed that Xie Yutong would prepare the current version of the route guide document in advance.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District, home study (online)

subevent.name: In the video, he detailed the Sichuan-Tibet self-driving route plan and shared his Mount Heng experience.

Feng Haoran first shared the experience accumulated from the short self-drive test to Mount Heng, including vehicle inspection points, preparation for altitude sickness, and selection of photography spots along the way. He also suggested formally incorporating short self-drive trips like the Hengshan test into the pre-phase of the Sichuan-Tibet plan to verify vehicle condition and team coordination. Then the two discussed the Sichuan-Tibet route section by section, adjusted daily driving hours, accommodation stops, and scenic spot arrangements, optimized the alternate route, and updated the supply list and emergency plan. The discussion lasted about 2 hours and finally resulted in a new version of the route document.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District, home study (online)

name: CFA Level I Financial Reporting and Analysis Study
description: As planned, Feng Haoran focused on the CFA Level I Financial Statement Analysis subject in March. He used weekday evenings and weekend afternoons to work through textbooks and online courses, but frequent overtime and client proposal research often interrupted his progress. By the end of the month, he had completed only two-thirds of the content. He recorded the difficult points and planned to catch up in April.

subevent.name: CFA Level I Financial Statement Analysis chapter study (Week 1)
subevent.description: From March 3 to March 7, 2025, Feng Haoran used weekday evenings and weekend afternoons to systematically study the CFA Level I Financial Statement Analysis subject in his home study in Changsha. On Monday, he studied the basic methods of financial statement analysis and ratio calculations; on Tuesday, he delved into income statement and balance sheet items; on Wednesday, he focused on the preparation of the cash flow statement; on Thursday, he studied financial reporting quality and accounting standards (IFRS vs US GAAP); on Friday evening and Saturday afternoon, he conducted chapter review and self-test summary.

subevent.name: Learn basic financial statement analysis methods
subevent.description: In his home study in Changsha, Feng Haoran studied the basic methods of financial statement analysis on Monday evening (19:00-22:00). He focused on vertical analysis (common-size statements), horizontal analysis (trend analysis), and ratio analysis (liquidity, solvency, profitability, and market value ratios). He read chapters 9-11 of the textbook, and against the public financial statements of a listed company (Kweichow Moutai), manually calculated key indicators such as the current ratio, quick ratio, debt-to-asset ratio, and return on net assets. He used Excel on his laptop to build a calculation template and compared it with industry averages. After studying, he completed a set of CFA official practice questions (20 questions), with an accuracy rate of 82%.

subevent.name: Deep dive into the income statement and balance sheet.
subevent.description: In his study at home in Changsha, Feng Haoran spent Tuesday evening (19:30-22:30) deeply studying the specific items of the income statement and balance sheet. He carefully read the textbook sections on revenue recognition principles (five-step method), capitalization vs. expensing of costs, depreciation methods (straight-line, accelerated), and accounting treatment of contingent liabilities. Regarding difficult concepts in the balance sheet such as long-term equity investment, intangible assets, deferred tax assets/liabilities, he repeatedly consulted examples and took detailed notes. He also watched a CFA video course segment specifically explaining these two statements (about 1.5 hours). Finally, he completed 10 comprehensive practice questions and marked the incorrect ones for later review.

subevent.name: Focused on learning the cash flow statement
subevent.description: In his home study in Changsha, Feng Haoran focused on the statement of cash flows on Wednesday evening (19:00-22:00). He systematically studied the process of preparing a cash flow statement using the indirect method, distinguishing cash flows from operating, investing, and financing activities. Using changes in a company's income statement and balance sheet from the textbook, he prepared a simplified cash flow statement by hand and understood the key adjustments from net profit to operating cash flow (depreciation and amortization, changes in accounts receivable, changes in inventory, etc.). He also learned the calculation of free cash flow (FCFF/FCFE). He completed 15 related exercises with an accuracy rate of 78%.

subevent.name: Study financial reporting quality and standards
subevent.description: In his home study in Changsha, Feng Haoran studied financial reporting quality and accounting standards (IFRS vs US GAAP) on Thursday evening (19:30-22:00). He read the textbook sections on qualitative characteristics of financial reporting (relevance, faithful representation, comparability, verifiability, etc.) and international differences in accounting standards. He focused on comparing the different provisions between IFRS and US GAAP regarding inventory valuation (LIFO vs FIFO), capitalization of development expenditures, and reversal of asset impairment. He completed 10 conceptual questions through the CFA online question bank and organized the easily confused points into a comparison table. After finishing, he reviewed all his study notes from the week to prepare for the weekend review.

subevent.name: Chapter review and self-test summary.
subevent.description: In the study room at his home in Changsha, Feng Haoran conducted a systematic review and self-test of the first week's financial statement analysis chapter on Friday evening and Saturday afternoon. He first quickly reread all the notes and key highlights from the week (1 hour), then focused on doing 20 multiple-choice questions from the financial statement analysis section of the CFA official mock exam, with a time limit of 40 minutes, achieving an accuracy rate of 85%. Next, he analyzed the reasons for each wrong question one by one, and recorded weak knowledge points (such as deferred income tax and lease accounting) in his error notebook. Finally, he formulated a study plan for the second week—focusing on tackling the accounting treatment of inventory and long-term assets. The entire review process lasted about 3 hours, ensuring a solid grasp of basic concepts.

subevent.name: Learning the Income Statement and Balance Sheet chapters (Week 2)
subevent.description: Feng Haoran studied in depth the preparation and analysis of the income statement and balance sheet, focusing on difficult points such as revenue recognition, expense capitalization, and depreciation and amortization with the help of online courses. Progress was occasionally delayed due to overtime interruptions.

subevent.name: Weekend: tackle the income statement structure and revenue recognition
subevent.description: All day Saturday, Feng Haoran opened the 'Financial Statement Analysis' textbook and accompanying online course in his home study in Changsha, systematically studying the components of the income statement (operating revenue, operating costs, various expenses, profit items, etc.). He focused on mastering the five-step model of revenue recognition: identify the contract, identify performance obligations, determine the transaction price, allocate the transaction price, and recognize revenue. He took detailed notes while watching, and completed 10 multiple-choice questions and 2 case analysis questions from the textbook to reinforce his understanding.

subevent.name: Weekend study: balance sheet and expense capitalization.
subevent.description: All day Sunday, Feng Haoran continued studying the structure of the balance sheet (classification of assets, liabilities, and owner's equity) and its preparation logic in his home study. He deepened his understanding of the difference between capitalizing expenses and expensing them, and by using cases from the online course such as real estate development and R&D of intangible assets, he mastered the five conditions for capitalizing development expenditures. He organized a comparison table to summarize which expenditures should be capitalized and which should be expensed, and completed the after-class exercises for the relevant chapters.

subevent.name: Monday evening: worked through depreciation and amortization methods
subevent.description: On Monday evening, Feng Haoran returned home and went to his study at around 19:30 after work. Continuing the study progress from the previous two days, he focused on tackling the four calculation methods for fixed asset depreciation: straight-line method, double-declining balance method, sum-of-the-years'-digits method, and units of production method, as well as the straight-line method and accelerated amortization method for intangible assets. By working through example problems and adapted questions from past exams, he practiced the calculation process for each method and marked common pitfalls.

subevent.name: Tuesday evening, studied the reconciliation relationships among accounting statements
subevent.description: Tuesday evening, Feng Haoran watched an online course in his home study about the articulation relationship between the income statement and the balance sheet. He focused on understanding how net profit affects owners' equity through retained earnings, the difference between operating cash flow and net profit, and the data linkage between statements. He then manually prepared a simple trial balance table, filling in numbers to verify the articulation relationship, strengthening his grasp of the overall framework of the statements.

subevent.name: Overtime work on Wednesday delayed learning progress (review and consolidation)
subevent.description: On Wednesday, due to an urgent company project, he worked overtime until 21:30. After returning home, Feng Haoran felt tired, but he insisted on spending 30 minutes quickly going through the notes and mistake book compiled in the previous four days, focusing on reviewing the five-step method of revenue recognition and the calculation formulas for depreciation and amortization. He consolidated his memory by verbally reciting them to ensure that the interruption would not make him forget core knowledge points.

subevent.name: Thursday Night: Breaking Through Complex Revenue Recognition and Asset Impairment
subevent.description: On Thursday evening, Feng Haoran continued studying as scheduled in his home study, making a focused breakthrough on the complex revenue recognition issues he had found confusing before (variable consideration estimates, significant financing components, customer options for additional purchases, etc.). At the same time, he learned the basic steps for impairment testing of long-term assets (fixed assets, intangible assets, goodwill): identifying impairment indicators, calculating the recoverable amount, and comparing the carrying amount. He deepened his understanding with real corporate cases from the online course and completed 4 comprehensive calculation problems.

subevent.name: Friday evening summary and chapter quiz
subevent.description: On Friday evening, Feng Haoran made a comprehensive summary of the week's study on the income statement and balance sheet in his home study. He organized a mind map, connecting knowledge points such as revenue recognition, capitalization of expenses, depreciation and amortization, interstatement relationships, and asset impairment. He then independently completed the mock test at the end of the textbook chapter (30 multiple-choice questions + 2 comprehensive questions), self-graded and recorded the wrong questions, and marked the difficult points that still needed further digestion (such as the calculation of financing components in complex revenue recognition), preparing for the next week's study.

subevent.name: Cash Flow Statement and Financial Ratios chapter study (Week 3)
subevent.description: From March 15 to 21, Feng Haoran systematically studied the basic concepts of the cash flow statement, the indirect method of preparation, and financial ratio analysis including solvency, operating, profitability, and growth ability. On March 17, due to an urgent consultation from client Huang Siqi, the progress of learning the indirect method was hindered, and he only completed 30% that day. The rest of the time he studied according to plan and completed the corresponding exercises, and on the 21st he did a comprehensive exercise. The overall learning progress was about 70% completed.

subevent.name: Learn the basic concepts and classification of cash flow statements.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran, in his home study in Changsha, used the textbook "Financial Statement Analysis" and online course videos to systematically learn the basic concepts and functions of the cash flow statement, as well as the specific classification of cash flows from operating/investing/financing activities. While listening to the lecture, he recorded key definitions and classification criteria in his notebook, and organized a list of typical items for the three activities to ensure a solid grasp of the fundamentals.

subevent.name: Only completed part of the learning (preparation using the indirect method) due to client needs.
subevent.description: In the morning, as Feng Haoran was about to study the indirect method for preparing the cash flow statement, he received an urgent consultation on a plan from client Huang Siqi, so he temporarily paused his studies to work on the client's case. After handling the client matters in the afternoon, he continued studying the adjustment rules for the indirect method in his study, but progress was limited. He only completed the basic logic of the indirect method and two examples of adjusting entries, and did not do practice questions. Overall, his study progress only reached 30% of the day's plan.

subevent.name: Study solvency and operating capability financial ratios.
subevent.description: In his study, Feng Haoran focused on the financial ratio analysis module, studying in depth the calculation formulas and meanings of solvency ratios (current ratio, quick ratio, interest coverage ratio) and efficiency ratios (accounts receivable turnover, inventory turnover, total asset turnover). He derived each indicator one by one, performed actual calculations using a listed company's financial statements, completed the corresponding practice problems, and noted difficult points.

subevent.name: Study financial ratios for profitability and growth capability.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran continued with financial ratio analysis, learning profitability indicators (return on equity, return on total assets, gross profit margin) and growth indicators (revenue growth rate, net profit growth rate). He used textbook cases to conduct comparative analysis of multiple companies, and completed the calculation and analysis problems in the after-class exercises, deepening his understanding of the economic meaning of the indicators.

subevent.name: Comprehensive Practice on Cash Flow Statement and Financial Ratios
subevent.description: Feng Haoran did comprehensive practice problems in the study for the cash flow statement preparation and financial ratio analysis he studied this week. He chose a set of real exam questions covering cash flow statement preparation, calculating and interpreting multiple financial ratios. After completing independently, he self-checked against the scoring criteria, categorized mistakes, reviewed corresponding knowledge points, and marked areas he was still unfamiliar with.

subevent.name: Comprehensive review and simulated practice (Week 4)
subevent.description: Feng Haoran's review plan was affected by continuous overtime; he only completed a comprehensive review of the first three weeks' content and part of the mock exam practice, and did not finish reviewing all chapters as planned.

subevent.name: Comprehensive review of key points from the previous three weeks.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran spent focused time on Saturday morning and afternoon in his home study to reorganize the content from the previous three weeks of review, including key knowledge points from the chapters on financial market fundamentals, securities investment analysis, and laws and regulations, and organized notes on wrong questions. Due to limited energy from consecutive overtime work, he only completed establishing the main framework and did not go into details.

subevent.name: Mock exam practice (partial).
subevent.description: On Sunday, Feng Haoran used exam preparation software in his home study to complete the first 30 multiple-choice questions and some calculation questions in a set of practice tests. Due to time constraints and poor condition, he only completed about 40% of the questions, briefly marked the wrong ones, and planned to make up for them later.

subevent.name: End-of-month summary and record of difficulties.
subevent.description: In his study at home in Changsha, Feng Haoran reviewed his study progress for the month and confirmed that he had only completed two-thirds of the textbook content for the Financial Statement Analysis subject. He organized the difficult and important points he had not yet mastered (such as deferred taxes, lease accounting, etc.) into notes.

subevent.name: Make a catch-up plan for April
subevent.description: Based on his March study progress and remaining difficulties, Feng Haoran readjusted his CFA Level I review plan in his home study, scheduling the remaining content of the Financial Statement Analysis subject and intensive practice for the first two weeks of April, and reserving buffer time for overtime work.

subevent.name: Sort out data protection strategy
subevent.description: At noon on October 17, 2025, Feng Haoran, at his home in Yuelu District, organized the data protection experience from this incident, formulated a future digital asset protection plan, and recorded a backup checklist and precautions.

name: Signed up for and experienced an oil painting class for the first time; shared the artwork and received encouragement from mother

subevent.name: First oil painting experience class — painting a starry night landscape

name: Autumn street photography along the Xiangjiang River, capturing urban light and shadows.

This street photography session made him rediscover the peace and joy that photography brings.

subevent.name: Autumn street photography creation along the Xiangjiang River.

The post received likes and comments from several friends. His running buddy Gao Yunfei set one of the photos as his phone wallpaper, and Feng Haoran had a private message conversation with Gao Yunfei about photography techniques.

subevent.name: Review 2025 financial status
subevent.description: Feng Haoran is at home in his study in Changsha. He pulled up the 2025 annual financial statements, item by item checked the full-year income, expenses, investment returns, and side-business profit/loss, compared them with the savings rate and portfolio targets set at the beginning of the year, recorded the deviation data, and prepared for making new plans.

subevent.name: Write and save the 2026 financial planning document with encryption

name: Completed V1 in the rock gym exchange competition and won the newcomer award, starting a systematic climbing training plan.

Subsequently, on June 24, 26, and 28, he carried out special training along with core strength training, officially starting systematic climbing training.

subevent.description: On the afternoon of June 22, 2025, Feng Haoran went to the climbing gym in Yuelu District, Changsha to participate in the monthly internal exchange competition. In the competition, he attempted the V2 route twice and failed both times, but he completed all V1 routes cleanly.

subevent.name: Received the Newcomer Encouragement Award

subevent.name: Discussed the training plan with the coach after the competition.

They analyzed the competition performance and his strengths and weaknesses. subevent.location: Rest area of a climbing gym in Yuelu District, Changsha.

subevent.name: Purchase climbing training equipment.

subevent.name: Create a training schedule with three sessions per week.

subevent.name: First dedicated training session (Tuesday)
subevent.description: According to the training plan, Feng Haoran went to the climbing gym after work on Tuesday afternoon, June 24, for his first specialized training session. Under the guidance of Coach Lao Zhou, he focused on the difficult moves of the V1 route and completed 30 minutes of core strength training (plank, lying leg raises, etc.).

subevent.name: Second special training (Thursday)
subevent.description: On the afternoon of June 26 (Thursday), Feng Haoran went to the climbing gym again for his second training session, focusing on pull-ups and fingerboard training to strengthen his upper limbs, and repeatedly practicing the V1 route to improve his success rate. The training lasted 1.5 hours.
subevent.location: A climbing gym in Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Third Specialized Training (Saturday)
subevent.description: On the afternoon of Saturday, June 28, Feng Haoran had his third training session of the week. He made his first attempt at the V2 route (unsuccessful) while consolidating his V1 route climbing techniques. After training, he exchanged experiences with running buddy Gao Yunfei about how morning running and rock climbing complement each other physically.
subevent.location: A climbing gym in Yuelu District, Changsha

name: The thesis re-review required supplementing ESG data; undertaking 80% of the work independently led to worsening of cervical spine problems.
description: On June 11, the supervisor returned the review comments on the proposal defense report, requiring a substantial addition of ESG data from local Changsha enterprises as empirical support. The collaborator Zhou Yuwei was unable to assist due to the urgent tasks of a Shanghai project. Feng Haoran single-handedly undertook about 80% of the literature review, enterprise interviews, and data cleaning work, staying up late into the early morning for several consecutive days, which exacerbated his neck pain and caused mild headaches.

subevent.name: Receive re-review feedback and formulate a plan.
subevent.description: The supervisor returned the revised comments on the thesis proposal by email, requiring a substantial addition of ESG data from Changsha local enterprises as empirical support. Feng Haoran had a video call with the supervisor to discuss the specific requirements, then contacted collaborator Zhou Yuwei to confirm the division of work. Learning that Zhou Yuwei could not share the workload due to an urgent project in Shanghai, he decided to take on about 80% of the work alone and made a detailed plan to complete literature review, corporate interviews, and data cleaning within one week.

subevent.name: Literature search and preliminary reading
subevent.description: Feng Haoran spent the whole day in his home study in Changsha doing literature retrieval. He used databases such as CNKI and Wanfang Data to search for academic papers and industry reports on ESG-related topics for local Changsha enterprises. He downloaded about 30 core papers, quickly browsed their abstracts and keywords, and initially selected 10 key papers for close reading. The work continued until 1 a.m., and his neck already felt slightly uncomfortable.

subevent.name: Close Reading of Literature and Interview Outline Design
subevent.description: Feng Haoran carefully read the 10 key selected papers, sorted out the current status of ESG disclosure and empirical methods among Changsha enterprises, and based on the literature designed an enterprise interview outline containing 10 questions on ESG data sources, indicator selection, case enterprises, etc. That evening, he video-called his supervisor to confirm the feasibility of the outline and began contacting local Changsha enterprises to schedule interviews. He worked until 1:30 a.m., and his neck pain worsened.

subevent.name: Conduct company interviews
subevent.description: Feng Haoran, in the order of appointments, interviewed ESG-related department personnel of three local Changsha companies (Zoomlion Heavy Industry, Sany Heavy Industry, and Aier Eye Hospital) by phone and video link respectively, each interview lasting about 45 minutes, focusing on obtaining corporate ESG data disclosure practices and specific indicators. After the interviews, he organized the recording notes and summarized key information. He worked until 11 p.m., with persistent neck pain.

subevent.name: Data cleaning and preprocessing
subevent.description: Feng Haoran cleaned the qualitative data obtained from interviews and the quantitative data extracted from public annual reports, removed outliers and duplicate records, and unified the data format standards. He used Python for preliminary data preprocessing to generate a structured dataset. He worked continuously for 12 hours until 2 a.m., and his neck pain intensified with a mild headache.

name: After revisions, the paper was submitted and ultimately accepted by 'Hunan Finance'.
description: Based on the supplementary ESG data added in June, Feng Haoran submitted the revised paper on July 2. After nearly three weeks of waiting, he received the acceptance notice from Hunan Finance magazine on July 18, with publication expected in September. He sighed, "Although the level is not high, at least there is a result," and the academic pressure was partially relieved.

subevent.name: Supplement ESG data and complete the final revision of the paper.
subevent.description: On the weekend, Feng Haoran used the home study to supplement the paper with 2024 ESG data based on reviewer comments, revised the argumentation logic and data charts paragraph by paragraph, and completed the final revision of the paper that evening.

subevent.name: Final format and reference check before submission
subevent.description: In the morning, Feng Haoran opened the submission system in his study and checked the paper format, reference citations, equation numbering and other details item by item to ensure compliance with the requirements of the journal Hunan Finance, and generated the final manuscript in PDF format.

subevent.name: Submit the revised paper through the system.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Feng Haoran used his laptop to log in to the Hunan Finance online submission system, uploaded the revised paper PDF, filled in the revision notes, added supplementary data attachments, and clicked submit after confirming everything was correct. The system displayed a successful submission.

subevent.name: Received acceptance notice from Hunan Finance.
subevent.description: In the morning, while checking his email at the office, Feng Haoran found an acceptance notification from the editorial department of Hunan Finance. The email confirmed that his paper had passed the final review and was scheduled to be published in the September 2025 issue, with formatting requirements and a copyright agreement attached. After reading it, he felt gratified and relieved.

name: Promotion review postponed and long talk with mentor.
description: On December 29, the department announced that the promotion review results would be postponed to January of the following year. Feng Haoran and Team Leader Wang were in a tight race, with a margin of less than one percentage point. In the evening, his mentor Qian Yongqiang invited him for a long talk in the office, candidly saying that he had also experienced a similar wait, emphasizing that "solid work matters more than speed," and encouraged him to stay true to his original aspiration regardless of the outcome. That night, Feng Haoran wrote in his notes, "A pending decision is exactly the whetstone," and felt calmer instead.

subevent.name: The department announced that the promotion selection has been postponed.
subevent.description: On the morning of December 29, 2025, the Investment Advisory Department of Huatai Securities held an internal meeting. The department head, Qian Yongqiang, officially announced that this year's promotion review results would be postponed to January of the following year. At the same time, the meeting disclosed the tight vote counts between Feng Haoran and team leader Wang Lei, with a difference of less than one percentage point, attracting team attention. As one of the candidates, Feng Haoran learned of this news at the meeting.
subevent.location: Conference room, Investment Advisory Department, Huatai Securities, Changsha, Hunan

subevent.name: A long talk with mentor Qian Yongqiang in his office
subevent.description: In the evening of December 29, 2025, Feng Haoran's direct supervisor and mentor Qian Yongqiang separately invited him to his office for an in-depth conversation. Qian Yongqiang candidly shared his own mental journey of experiencing similar waiting in his early career, emphasized that 'solidity matters more than speed,' and encouraged Feng Haoran to maintain his original aspiration regardless of the promotion outcome. Feng Haoran listened attentively, and his mood gradually shifted from initial slight anxiety to calm.
subevent.location: Investment Director's Office, Huatai Securities, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Write a mood journal.
subevent.description: On the evening of December 29, 2025, after ending his conversation with Qian Yongqiang, Feng Haoran returned to his home study and wrote in his personal notes that unresolved matters are precisely the whetstone. He reflected on the day's experiences and instead felt more serene, and planned to continue focusing on improving his investment analysis skills while waiting for the result, while also preparing for either outcome.
subevent.location: Home study in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Started daily mood monitoring and mindfulness meditation.
description: Facing multiple pressures such as his mother's hospitalization and Peng Yuqing's debt, Feng Haoran started a 10-minute mindfulness meditation before bed every night beginning April 10, using a meditation app to guide breathing and relaxation. At the same time, he kept a diary to record daily mood changes and found that on April 12, his anxiety index peaked because of his father's elevated blood pressure, which gradually subsided after a phone call with his father and adjusting his mindset. In mid-to-late April, meditation became a habit, sleep quality improved, and concentration at work also increased.

subevent.name: Prepare meditation and journaling tools
subevent.description: Feng Haoran used his phone to download a mindfulness meditation app (such as Headspace) at his home in Changsha, and found an unused notebook and pen to prepare for the daily mood tracking and mindfulness meditation starting the next day.

subevent.name: Started meditation, journaling, and coping with anxiety peaks
subevent.description: On the evening of April 10, Feng Haoran began a 10-minute daily mindfulness meditation in his bedroom at his home in Changsha, using a meditation app to guide breathing and relaxation, and recording his emotions for the day in his diary. On April 12, upon learning that his father's blood pressure had risen, his anxiety index peaked. Through a phone call with his father before bed to discuss the illness and adjust his mindset, he recorded the emotional changes in his diary and wrote down coping strategies. The subsequent meditation helped calm his mind.

subevent.name: First mindfulness meditation and mood journal launched.
subevent.description: At 21:00 on the evening of April 10, Feng Haoran, in his bedroom at home in Changsha, used a meditation app (such as Calm or Headspace) to do his first 10-minute mindfulness meditation, following the guided audio to practice breathing and relaxation. Afterwards, he recorded the day's work stress and emotional state in his diary, wrote down his first meditation experience, and set a goal to meditate every night in the future.

subevent.name: Continue meditation and journaling practice
subevent.description: On the evening of April 11 at 21:00, Feng Haoran continued with a 10-minute mindfulness meditation at home to consolidate breathing relaxation techniques. After meditation, he recorded the day's emotions in his diary, focused on reflecting on work-life balance, and wrote encouraging statements for a positive mindset.

subevent.name: Managing anxiety over my father's rising blood pressure.
subevent.description: On the evening of April 12, after learning that his father Feng Jianguo's blood pressure had risen, Feng Haoran's anxiety index peaked. He first had a video call with his father via WeChat, learned the details of his condition, reassured him, and suggested he go to the hospital for a check-up. After the call, he recorded his anxious feelings in his diary and wrote down specific coping strategies (such as arranging a doctor's visit for his father and staying calm). He then did 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on his breathing, gradually calming down, and planned to follow up on his father's health the next day.

subevent.name: Mid-Term Consolidation Meditation and Mood Log
subevent.description: Feng Haoran continued to do 10 minutes of mindful meditation every night, and used a diary to record emotional changes before bed. Through this process, he gradually mastered breathing relaxation techniques, his sleep quality began to improve, and his focus at work during the day increased. During this period, by adjusting his mindset and practicing regularly, he effectively managed multiple pressures from his mother's hospitalization and Peng Yuqing's debt.

subevent.name: Started intermediate meditation practice.
subevent.description: At 10 p.m., Feng Haoran did his first 10-minute mindfulness meditation in the bedroom, trying to relax by following his breath. After finishing, he used a diary to record the day's emotional state and feelings of stress. He noticed his mind wandered easily but persisted through the entire practice.

subevent.name: Continued meditation and emotion recording.
subevent.description: At 10 p.m., Feng Haoran did his second mindfulness meditation in the bedroom. This time he tried to focus on his breath. Although distracting thoughts still arose, he could notice them more quickly and bring his attention back. Before bed, he wrote about the day's work stress and worries about his mother's hospitalization in his diary, and found that he felt calmer after writing.

subevent.name: Preliminary mastery of breathing relaxation techniques.
subevent.description: At 10 p.m., Feng Haoran did his third meditation session in the bedroom. He found that he could actively use abdominal breathing to relax his body, and his concentration improved compared to the previous two days. When recording his emotion diary, he found his anxiety score had decreased, and decided to make meditation a fixed habit before bed.

subevent.name: Meditation day for improved daytime focus
subevent.description: At 10 p.m., Feng Haoran meditated in the bedroom. During the day at work, he found himself able to focus better on investment analysis tasks and less distracted. When recording his emotions before bed, he mentioned that the stress caused by Peng Yuqing's debt problem had lessened, and he felt that meditation helped with emotional management.

subevent.name: Sleep quality has started to improve.
subevent.description: At 10 p.m., Feng Haoran meditated in the bedroom. After lying down, he fell asleep faster than usual, sleep continuity increased, and he felt more refreshed upon waking. In his diary, he recorded last night's sleep quality score of 7 (previous average was 5), and analyzed that it might be the relaxing effect of meditation.

subevent.name: Stress management is showing results
subevent.description: At 10 p.m., Feng Haoran meditated in the bedroom. During the practice, he actively guided himself to face the stress of his mother's hospitalization and Peng Yuqing's debt, releasing tension through breathing. In his diary, he noted that mood swings were significantly fewer than in the previous week, and he wrote down three things he was grateful for.

subevent.name: Automating the meditation habit
subevent.description: At 10 p.m., Feng Haoran meditated in the bedroom. He no longer needed an alarm reminder and naturally entered the state, able to sit quietly for 10 minutes without feeling it was long. In his diary, he noted that he could maintain a peaceful mindset even during rest on weekends, and in the afternoon, when meeting with friends, he proactively shared his meditation insights.

subevent.name: Phase summary and consolidation
subevent.description: At 10 p.m., Feng Haoran performed his final mid-term meditation in the bedroom. After the practice, he wrote a stage summary diary: sleep quality was stable at 7-8 points, daytime work efficiency improved by 20%, he successfully coped with multiple pressures, and he decided to continue incorporating meditation into his daily routine.

subevent.name: Maturation of meditation habit and emerging effects
subevent.description: Feng Haoran's pre-sleep meditation has become an automatic habit, allowing him to naturally enter a relaxed state without app guidance. Diary records show that emotional fluctuations have flattened out, sleep quality has steadily improved, and focus duration during work has lengthened. On April 30, he summarized the month's meditation and emotional management, confirming the positive impact of long-term adherence on mental health.

name: Persisted in the advanced climbing training camp, challenging the V3 route
description: Feng Haoran prepared his equipment in advance on October 4, and then attended the advanced training camp at an indoor climbing gym in Changsha for four consecutive Sunday evenings (October 5, 12, 19, and 26). He gradually challenged three V3 routes, progressing from failing all of them to completing all of them on the fourth attempt. His pull-ups and grip strength improved continuously, and climbing became a way to relieve pressure under high stress.

subevent.name: Pre-training equipment check and preparation
subevent.description: On Sunday afternoon, Feng Haoran took time to check the condition of climbing equipment such as climbing shoes, chalk bag, and harness at home, confirmed the climbing gym's course schedule for Sunday evening, and planned the transportation route in advance to the climbing gym in Yuelu District, Changsha.

subevent.name: First advanced rock climbing training (V3 route challenge).
subevent.description: On Sunday evening from 19:00 to 21:00, Feng Haoran attended an advanced training camp at the indoor climbing gym in Yuelu District, Changsha. Under the coach's guidance, he tried 3 V3 routes. Although he did not complete any of them, through repeated practice his pull-up strength significantly increased and his grip strength also showed initial improvement. After class, he did stretching and relaxation.

subevent.name: Second advanced rock climbing training session (V3 route challenge)
subevent.description: On Sunday evening, Feng Haoran continued attending the advanced training camp at the same climbing gym. This time he focused on breaking through the routes he had failed the previous week. He completed one V3 route, and was one move short on the other two, but his number of pull-ups increased and grip strength improved noticeably. After class, he discussed technical details with the coach.

subevent.name: Third advanced climbing training (V3 route challenge)
subevent.description: On Sunday evening, Feng Haoran attended the training camp for the third time. This time, he successfully completed the second V3 route and failed to finish the third due to decreased stamina. After class, he recorded his progress data, shared training insights with running partner Gao Yunfei, and planned to complete all routes next week.

subevent.name: Fourth advanced rock climbing training (V3 route challenge)
subevent.description: Feng Haoran completed the final training session of the month on Sunday evening. He successfully climbed all planned V3 routes, and his pull-ups and grip strength reached the staged goals. After the class, the coach affirmed his progress, and he decided to challenge the more difficult V4 routes next month. This training was also an important way for him to relieve stress under high-pressure work.

name: Focus on conquering the CFA Level I Financial Statement Analysis module and pass the mock exam.
description: After returning to Changsha, Feng Haoran made a catch-up plan. From 9 pm to 11 pm each night, he focused on the remaining chapters of CFA Level I Financial Statement Analysis, interspersed with review of Ethics and Quantitative Methods. On weekends, he went to the library or a coffee shop to study introductory Corporate Finance. After submitting his thesis on April 24, he intensified his efforts. On April 25, he completed the module mock exam with a 70% accuracy rate, then moved on to reviewing Derivatives and Alternative Investments.

subevent.name: Sprint mock exam stage
subevent.description: After submitting the thesis on April 24, Feng Haoran increased his study intensity and spent the whole day intensively reviewing the key points and error-prone areas of financial statement analysis. On the morning of April 25, he took a mock exam for the financial statement analysis module in the library; in the afternoon, he graded and reviewed the results, ultimately achieving an accuracy rate of 70%. After reaching the target, he immediately ended the review for that module.

subevent.name: All-day intensive review of financial statement analysis
subevent.description: After submitting the paper on April 24, Feng Haoran returned to his home study and then went to Changsha City Library, where he spent the whole day intensively reviewing the key points and easily mistaken areas of financial statement analysis, including modules such as income statement analysis, balance sheet analysis, and cash flow statement analysis, consolidating them by taking notes, reviewing the collection of wrong questions, and practicing typical examples.

subevent.name: Mock exam for the financial statement analysis module
subevent.description: On the morning of April 25, took a mock exam for the financial statement analysis module at Changsha Library, completing all questions within the time limit to test the effectiveness of the previous full-day review.

subevent.name: Graded and reviewed, and finished the module review
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 25, he graded mock exam papers in his home study, checking answers question by question and analyzing the reasons for errors. His final accuracy rate reached 70%. Upon meeting the target, he immediately ended the review of that module and moved on to the next stage of preparation.

subevent.name: Derivatives and Alternative Investments review stage
subevent.description: From April 26 to April 30, Feng Haoran shifted his review focus to the CFA Level I Derivatives and Alternative Investments subjects, using evening and weekend time to study systematically at home or in the library, preparing for the next stage of mock exams.

subevent.name: Review derivatives valuation models on Saturday
subevent.description: On Saturday, Feng Haoran spent the whole day in his home study, using CFA official textbooks and video courses to systematically review the pricing and valuation models of forwards, futures, options, and swaps in the Derivatives subject. Starting at 9 a.m., he first read the derivatives section of chapters 8 to 10, focusing on futures pricing formulas and put-call parity. From 2 p.m. to 5 p.m., he completed 50 derivatives practice questions through an online question bank and marked the ones he got wrong. From 7 p.m. to 9 p.m., he reviewed the wrong questions and organized his notes. He studied alone throughout and had no interaction with others.

subevent.name: On Sunday, review alternative investment strategies
subevent.description: Feng Haoran went to the Yuelu District Library for the whole day on Sunday to focus on reviewing the alternative investments subject. From 9 am to 12 pm, he read the alternative investments chapter of the CFA textbook, focusing on hedge fund strategies, private equity valuation, and the characteristics of real estate investment trusts (REITs); from 1 pm to 4 pm, he practiced alternative investment calculation questions through online mock tests, such as management fee and performance fee calculations; from 5 pm to 6 pm, he took a relaxing walk in the park near the library. He studied alone all day without communicating with others.

subevent.name: Monday evening review of derivatives practice problems.
subevent.description: After work on a weekday, from 7 p.m. to 9 p.m., Feng Haoran reviewed the wrong questions and key difficult points from the weekend practice in the derivatives subject in his study at home. He opened the CFA online question bank, re-did the 15 derivatives questions he had gotten wrong over the weekend, and read the answer explanations in detail; then he used a mind-mapping tool to organize the derivatives knowledge framework to strengthen memory. He studied alone throughout, with no external distractions.

subevent.name: Tuesday evening review of alternative investment notes
subevent.description: After work, Feng Haoran reviewed the alternative investments subject at home from 7:00 to 8:30 PM. He took out the notes he had organized on Sunday, focusing on hedge fund fee structures, the private equity J-curve, and characteristics of commodity investments; then he used a mobile app to do 30 multiple-choice questions on alternative investments, achieving an accuracy rate of 85%. He noted down unfamiliar concepts and planned to strengthen them during the mock exam phase. He studied alone throughout.

subevent.name: Wednesday evening comprehensive review and mock exam preparation.
subevent.description: After work on Wednesday, April 30, Feng Haoran conducted a comprehensive review of derivatives and alternative investments at home from 7 to 9 PM. He cross-compared the knowledge points of the two subjects and made short review cards; meanwhile, he downloaded the software and test papers needed for the next stage of mock exams and planned the mock exam schedule starting May 1. Finally, he spent 30 minutes quickly going over the high-frequency exam points for derivatives and alternative investments to confirm nothing was missed. The entire process was done alone.

name: Career development interview with Director Qian Yongqiang
description: On the previous day (November 11), Feng Haoran confirmed the interview time with his direct supervisor Qian Yongqiang, reviewed his work, and prepared a draft plan for qualification improvement. On the morning of November 12, he conducted a formal career development interview at the Huatai Securities office at 88 Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha. Qian Yongqiang affirmed the customer acquisition results brought by his opening a column and hosting a photography exhibition, suggested he take the CFA Level II exam, and planned to arrange for him to host the high-net-worth client salon next quarter. Feng Haoran listened carefully, took notes, and expressed his gratitude.

subevent.name: Pre-interview preparation and appointment confirmation
subevent.description: The day before the interview, Feng Haoran confirmed the time of the career development interview on the morning of November 12 with his direct supervisor Qian Yongqiang, briefly reviewed his recent work performance (cases such as starting a column and holding a photo exhibition), sorted out the career development questions he wanted to discuss, and prepared a draft of his personal professional qualification improvement plan.

subevent.name: Conducting a career development interview
subevent.description: On the morning of November 12, 2025, Feng Haoran had a scheduled 30-minute career development talk with his direct supervisor Qian Yongqiang in the Huatai Securities office at 88 Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha. Qian Yongqiang affirmed the client acquisition results brought about by Feng Haoran's recent opening of an investment column and holding a personal photography exhibition, suggested that he register for the CFA Level II exam to enhance his professional qualifications, and planned to arrange for him to host the next quarter's high-net-worth client salon. Feng Haoran listened carefully to the suggestions, took notes, and expressed his gratitude.

name: Signed up for an advanced rock climbing training camp, set a clear goal to break through V3, and previewed the course.
description: On August 30, Feng Haoran paid 2,400 yuan at the climbing gym to sign up for the advanced climbing technique training camp recommended by Lao Zhou, and wrote down his goal of climbing V3 consistently by the end of the year in the rest area. The next day, he previewed the training manual and instructional videos at home to prepare for the course.

subevent.name: Pay training camp tuition
subevent.description: At the climbing gym front desk, Feng Haoran paid the full tuition of 2400 yuan for the advanced climbing technique training camp via mobile banking transfer, and received a receipt and course schedule.

subevent.name: Set personal climbing breakthrough goals
subevent.description: After signing up, Feng Haoran wrote down the core goal for his physical breakthrough in the second half of the year in the rest area of the climbing gym using his phone's memo: to consistently climb V3-difficulty routes by the end of the year, and planned to record his progress after each weekly training session.

subevent.name: Preview training course materials
subevent.description: After returning home, Feng Haoran opened the training manual and online instructional videos provided by the climbing gym, previewed the key points of dynamic climbing and core strengthening movements, and prepared for the first class next Sunday.

name: Personal investment portfolio exceeded 1 million.
description: After the A-share market closed on December 31, Feng Haoran logged into his account, where the total financial assets stood at 1.002 million yuan, achieving the million-target set at the beginning of the year for the first time. He took a screenshot and sent it to his younger sister, then deleted the drafted Moments post he was about to publish, muttering to himself, 'Numbers are not the end.' Still, he couldn't help but smile toward the window. He then updated the last row of his personal finance dashboard and checked off the 'million milestone' on his goals list.

subevent.name: Took a screenshot and sent it to my younger sister.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran took a screenshot of his account assets page and sent it to his sister Feng Xinran via WeChat, sharing the good news of achieving the million-yuan goal.

subevent.name: Delete the WeChat Moments draft.
subevent.description: After sending the screenshot to his younger sister, Feng Haoran immediately deleted the draft of the celebratory Moments post he had prepared, choosing to keep this achievement low-key.

subevent.name: Talking to oneself and smiling
subevent.description: When alone, Feng Haoran murmured to himself, 'Numbers are not the end,' but couldn't help smiling at the window, feeling gratified internally for reaching his goal.

subevent.name: Update financial dashboard and cross off goals
subevent.description: Feng Haoran opened his personal financial dashboard, updated the asset data in the last row, and solemnly checked off the 'million-yuan milestone' on his annual goal list, marking the official completion of this financial goal.

name: Purchase accident insurance for father
description: On October 8, Feng Haoran purchased a comprehensive accidental injury insurance policy for his father Feng Jianguo through an online platform, with an annual premium of 2,000 yuan and a coverage amount of 500,000 yuan. Considering that his father is nearing retirement and his mother has just recovered, this move aims to prevent risks and demonstrates his thoughtful planning for family protection.

subevent.name: Research accident insurance products for my father
subevent.description: During his spare time at work, Feng Haoran compared the coverage, premiums, insured amounts, and claims conditions of comprehensive accident insurance from various companies on online insurance platforms such as Ping An, ZhongAn, and Taikang, as well as professional insurance review websites. He screened out the most cost-effective insurance plan and finally determined the insurance product suitable for his father, Feng Jianguo.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities office, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Researched accident insurance on the Ping An insurance platform.
subevent.description: During a break at work, Feng Haoran opened the Ping An Insurance official website and app, browsed comprehensive accident insurance products, and noted key information such as coverage (accidental death, disability, medical expenses, etc.), premiums, sum insured, and claim conditions, to prepare for later comparison.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities office, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Research accident insurance on the Taikang Insurance platform
subevent.description: After getting off work, Feng Haoran opened the Taikang Insurance official website and official app at home to study the details of its comprehensive accident insurance products, including expanded high-risk sports coverage, sudden death liability clauses, etc. At the same time, he took screenshots of key pages and organized the core parameters of three companies.

subevent.name: Side-by-side product comparison via professional review websites
subevent.description: On a weekend morning, Feng Haoran opened professional insurance review websites such as Shenlanbao and Baoxianshi to search for horizontal comparison articles on three comprehensive accident insurance products from Ping An, ZhongAn, and Taikang. Combining his own collected data, he created a comparison table in Excel, focusing on coverage, cost-effectiveness, and claims reputation.

subevent.name: Screen the most cost-effective insurance plans
subevent.description: Based on the comparison table, Feng Haoran took into account his father Feng Jianguo's age (58) and daily activities (often staying at home and within the community after retirement), and shortlisted 2-3 products with comprehensive coverage and reasonable premiums. He went through the insurance application instructions and exclusions clause by clause, eliminating options with occupational restrictions or those not suitable for retirees.

subevent.name: Finalize the accident insurance product suitable for Father
subevent.description: Feng Haoran reconfirmed the screening results. Taking into account his father's health condition (no chronic diseases) and budget (annual premium no more than 500 yuan), he finally selected a comprehensive accident insurance product with high accidental medical coverage and hospitalization allowance, recorded the enrollment link and precautions, and prepared to discuss the purchase with his father later.

name: Evaluating and enrolling in an ESG investment training course
description: From December 8 to 10, in order to improve his ESG research capabilities, Feng Haoran searched for ESG course information on platforms such as CICC Wealth Online Academy at the company, compared course content and student reviews at home, and finally on December 10 used the 5,000 yuan company innovation award to register online for the 'ESG Investment Strategy and Practice' advanced course. After receiving the confirmation email, he made a plan to study intensively during the Spring Festival holiday.

subevent.name: Searched for information on ESG investment training courses
subevent.description: Feng Haoran used his lunch break to search for ESG-related courses on the company computer on CICC Wealth Online Academy and other platforms, compared the course outlines, instructors, and fees, and initially shortlisted target courses.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities Office, Kaifu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Compare course and reading student evaluations
subevent.description: Feng Haoran returned to his home study in the evening and read in detail the introduction, student reviews, and certificate information for the 'ESG Investment Strategy and Practice' course on the CICC Wealth Online Academy, confirming that the course was suitable for him to enhance his ESG research capabilities.
subevent.location: Home study room, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Use the innovation bonus to pay the registration fee
subevent.description: Feng Haoran logged in to the CICC Wealth Online Academy official website, used the 5,000 yuan innovation award issued by the company to pay the registration fee via online banking, filled in personal information and educational background, and successfully submitted the application.
subevent.location: Home study room, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Confirm successful registration and formulate a study plan
subevent.description: Feng Haoran received the enrollment confirmation email sent by the course platform, which contained the course schedule, material download links, and login instructions. He immediately marked the course start and end dates in his calendar, and planned to use the Spring Festival holiday to focus on studying the content of the first two weeks.
subevent.location: Home study room, Yuelu District, Changsha

name: Mount Heng self-driving photography day trip
description: At 5 a.m. on September 27, he set off alone by car, arrived at Mount Heng at 8 a.m., hiked to photograph ancient temples, sea of clouds, and porters, enjoyed tea at the mountaintop at noon, and after descending the mountain, tasted local dishes and returned to Changsha that night. He selected and compiled the photos into an album titled "One Day at Mount Heng" and posted it in the photography group.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparations
subevent.description: Feng Haoran got up at 4 a.m. at his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, organized his photography backpack, checked the camera, lenses, tripod, and spare batteries, prepared water, dry food, and warm clothing, and checked the fuel level and tire pressure of his self-driving vehicle to ensure everything was ready.

subevent.name: Self-drive to Mount Heng
subevent.description: At 5 a.m., Feng Haoran drove his private car alone from his home in Changsha, heading south along the Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau Expressway, passing through Xiangtan City, and arrived at the parking lot of Hengshan Scenic Area in Nanyue District, Hengyang City at 8 a.m.
subevent.location: Self-driving route from Changsha to Nanyue District, Hengyang.

subevent.name: Hiking to photograph an ancient temple, sea of clouds, and porters.
subevent.description: After arriving at Mount Heng at 8 a.m., Feng Haoran, carrying his photography equipment on his back, started hiking up the mountain. Along the way, he took photos of ancient temple buildings such as the Nanyue Grand Temple and Zhurong Peak, the misty mountain scenery, and the working scenes of porters along the trail, until he reached the summit around noon.
subevent.location: Hengyang City - Nanyue District - Hengshan Scenic Area

subevent.name: Resting and tasting tea at the mountaintop.
subevent.description: From 12:00 to 13:00, Feng Haoran was at a teahouse on the summit of Mount Heng, ordered a cup of local high-mountain tea, enjoyed the surrounding sea of clouds while savoring the tea, took a short break, and organized his shooting ideas.
subevent.location: Hengyang City - Nanyue District - Mount Heng summit teahouse

subevent.name: Drive back to Changsha
subevent.description: Around 5 p.m., after dinner, Feng Haoran drove back from Hengshan to Changsha along the same route, arriving safely at his home in Yuelu District, Changsha around 8 p.m.
subevent.location: Hengyang to Changsha - along the self-driving route

subevent.name: Organize the photos and publish the album.
subevent.description: From 8 PM to 10 PM, in his home study, Feng Haoran imported the photos taken that day into his computer, selected 20 representative works for post-processing color grading and layout, created a photo album titled "A Day at Mount Heng," and then uploaded it to a photography WeChat group to share and exchange ideas with group members.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District - Home study

name: Second oil painting experience and artwork sharing/decorating
description: On December 5, 2025, Feng Haoran attended his second oil painting trial class. At the 'Yijing Oil Painting Experience Studio', he used a palette knife to copy a street scene, creating unique textures. After class, he took a photo of the work and sent it to his mother, Li Xiuying, who joked that it was 'better than what you drew as a child.' On December 6, he took both oil paintings to the 'Xinyi Hand-Brewed Coffee Shop' and hung them on the second floor as decoration, sparking discussions among customers.

subevent.name: Go to the oil painting experience studio to copy and create.
subevent.description: On December 5, 2025, Feng Haoran set off from home and went to the "Art Realm Oil Painting Experience Studio" located in a business district in Changsha to attend his second oil painting experience class. Under the guidance of the studio teacher, he copied a street scene work with a palette knife, unexpectedly creating a unique texture effect. The whole creation process lasted about 2 hours.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yijing Oil Painting Experience Studio

subevent.name: Share my work with my mother and engage with her
subevent.description: After the oil painting class, Feng Haoran used his phone to photograph the just-completed street scene work, and sent it together with photos of his first starry night work via WeChat to his mother Li Xiuying, who was in Wuhan. After seeing the photos, his mother replied jokingly, 'Better than when you were a kid.' Feng Haoran then shared with his mother his feelings and gains from learning oil painting.

subevent.name: Hang two oil paintings as decoration in the coffee shop
subevent.description: On December 6, 2025, Feng Haoran brought his first and second completed oil paintings to the 'Xinyi Hand-Drip Coffee Shop' he frequents. After communicating with the owner Shen Xinyi, he hung the two paintings on the wall on the second floor of the cafe. These paintings have become a unique decoration of the cafe, often arousing customers' curiosity and discussion.

name: Ask Shen Xinyi for pour-over techniques to improve coffee skills and collaborative rapport
description: On the evening of July 6, Feng Haoran sent photos of his pour-over practice to Shen Xinyi on WeChat for advice. Shen Xinyi carefully pointed out issues with water temperature control and grind size. From then until August, Feng Haoran practiced once or twice a week and exchanged insights with Shen Xinyi via WeChat, significantly improving his brewing skills. The coffee collaboration brought them closer and laid the foundation for quality control at future branches.

subevent.name: First pour-over coffee practice and seeking advice on WeChat.
subevent.description: On the evening of July 6, Feng Haoran practiced pour-over coffee at the coffee corner of his home in Yuelu District, Changsha. After finishing, he sent the brewing photos to Shen Xinyi via WeChat, asking about water temperature control and grind size. After viewing the message in her apartment in Furong District, Changsha, Shen Xinyi pointed out in detail that his water temperature was too high and the grind was too coarse, and gave specific adjustment suggestions.
subevent.location: Home coffee corner, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Second pour-over practice and WeChat exchange
subevent.description: On July 13, Feng Haoran adjusted the water temperature and grind size according to Shen Xinyi's suggestion from last week, and practiced pour-over again at his home coffee corner. After finishing, he took a photo and sent it to Shen Xinyi. The two exchanged insights via WeChat. Shen Xinyi acknowledged his progress and noted that the blooming time could be slightly extended.
subevent.location: Home coffee corner, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Third hand-drip coffee practice and WeChat communication
subevent.description: On July 20, Feng Haoran did his third pour-over coffee practice at home, focusing on the blooming stage. After the practice, he chatted with Shen Xinyi on WeChat; Shen Xinyi shared tips for improving extraction uniformity, and Feng Haoran took notes.
subevent.location: Home coffee corner, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Fourth pour-over practice and WeChat exchange.
subevent.description: On July 27, Feng Haoran practiced pour-over coffee for the fourth time, experimenting with different coffee bean varieties to compare flavors. He sent brewing parameters and tasting notes to Shen Xinyi via WeChat, and she gave guidance on pouring technique and circling rhythm.
subevent.location: Home coffee corner, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Fifth pour-over coffee practice and WeChat exchange
subevent.description: On August 3, while practicing pour-over coffee, Feng Haoran focused on improving the stability of circular water pouring. After finishing, he had a video call with Shen Xinyi to exchange ideas. Shen Xinyi observed his technique online and pointed out a wrist angle issue. After Feng Haoran adjusted on the spot, the brewing result improved significantly.
subevent.location: Home coffee corner, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Sixth pour-over coffee practice and WeChat communication
subevent.description: On August 10, while practicing pour-over coffee, Feng Haoran began trying to control the total brew time and sent the recorded brew curve to Shen Xinyi. Shen Xinyi replied from Xinyi Pour-Over Coffee in Furong District, Changsha, affirming his control over the extraction rhythm and suggesting an adjustment to the water ratio for the final pour.
subevent.location: Home coffee corner, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Seventh pour-over practice and WeChat communication
subevent.description: On August 17, Feng Haoran used the coffee beans recommended by Shen Xinyi during practice and exchanged flavor notes with her on WeChat. Shen Xinyi praised his tasting ability as approaching a professional level, and the two agreed to conduct offline practice at the café later.
subevent.location: Home coffee corner, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Final hand-brewing practice and summary exchange.
subevent.description: On August 31, Feng Haoran did his last pour-over practice of August, and his brewing technique had improved greatly compared with the beginning of the month. He sent the brewing results and insights to Shen Xinyi via WeChat. Shen Xinyi highly praised his progress and encouraged him to keep consolidating. Their relationship grew closer through their coffee collaboration, laying the foundation for future branch quality control.
subevent.location: Home coffee corner, Yuelu District, Changsha

name: Created an annual financial dashboard to analyze gaps.
description: On December 1, Feng Haoran organized 2025 financial data in his home study in Changsha, created a multi-page Excel dashboard, compared income, expenses, investment returns, side-business losses in detail, marked the coffee shop loss amount, portfolio growth rate, and analyzed the gap against the beginning-of-year million-yuan goal.

subevent.name: Organize Personal Financial Data
subevent.description: In his home study, Feng Haoran exported the raw financial data for 2025 (income, expenses, investment returns, side-business losses, etc.) from various platforms and organized them into a unified format, preparing to create a dashboard.

subevent.name: Build the Excel dashboard framework
subevent.description: Feng Haoran used Excel on his personal computer to create a new workbook, and designed and built a multi-page dashboard framework, including income, expense, investment, and overview pages, setting chart types and data ranges.

subevent.name: Compare with the targets set at the beginning of the year and analyze the gaps.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran compared each actual value on the dashboard with the million-yuan investment goal set at the beginning of the year, calculated the gap percentage, and generated a gap analysis report and text summary on the overview page.

name: Received the company's annual innovation award and used it for self-improvement
description: On December 9, Feng Haoran received a company email confirming that the semi-automated asset allocation model he developed had won the 5,000 yuan Annual Innovation Award, and he prepared the award-acceptance materials in the office. On the morning of December 10, he attended the company's annual innovation commendation conference, went on stage to receive 5,000 yuan in cash and a certificate of honor. Department director Qian Yongqiang presented the award in person and spoke highly of it, and colleagues congratulated him one after another. He decided to use the bonus for self-improvement. On December 11, he enrolled in a 4,800 yuan CFA Level II exam cram course via an online platform in his home study, and planned to spend the remaining 200 yuan on finance books.

subevent.name: Confirm the award and prepare to receive it
subevent.description: On December 9, Feng Haoran received an internal company email confirming that the semi-automated asset allocation model he developed had won the Annual Innovation Award with a bonus of 5,000 yuan. He read the email and prepared the award materials in his office at Huatai Securities, located at No. 88 Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, to get ready for the commendation ceremony the next day.

subevent.name: Attend the company's annual innovation commendation conference.
