subevent.description: On the morning of December 10, Feng Haoran attended the annual innovation commendation conference of Huatai Securities Changsha Branch in the company's large meeting room. During the award segment, he went on stage to receive a 5,000 yuan cash reward and an honorary certificate. Department director Qian Yongqiang presented the award in person and highly praised his innovative work. The atmosphere was warm, and colleagues in the audience applauded to congratulate him.
subevent.location: Changsha - Huatai Securities Main Conference Room

subevent.name: Registered for an online investment course.
subevent.description: On December 11, Feng Haoran selected and enrolled in a high-value CFA Level II exam crash course on an online education platform in his home study, costing 4,800 yuan. He planned to use his spare time to systematically improve his investment analysis skills and put the bonus to practical use for career development. The remaining 200 yuan was planned to be used to buy related finance books.

name: Led the feasibility study on cross-border wealth management product distribution and completed a preliminary proposal.
description: On April 16, Feng Haoran reported to Director Qian Yongqiang on the institutional cooperation intentions brought back from the Shanghai Summit, and was assigned to form a three-person team (collaborating with Zheng Wenbo and Sun Xiaoya) to study the compliance and market prospects of QDII and cross-border REITs product distribution. On April 18, the three communicated via Tencent Meeting with the product heads of CICC Shenzhen Branch and China Merchants Securities Shanghai Branch respectively, focusing on understanding the fee structure, investment threshold, yield, and compliance points of CICC Asia REITs Fund and China Merchants Global Real Estate Income Fund, and compiled records. In the following days, the team designed a preliminary plan for cross-border product distribution based on the research information, and on April 29 completed the initial PPT draft and submitted it to Qian Yongqiang for review, with an oral report. Qian Yongqiang affirmed the plan and suggested adding a client risk questionnaire and regulatory policy clauses.

subevent.name: Report and set up a research group.
subevent.description: In the Huatai Securities office in Changsha, Feng Haoran gave a detailed report to Director Qian Yongqiang on the institutional cooperation intentions brought back from the Shanghai Summit in early April, including the preliminary consensus with HSBC and others on exploring cross-border product distribution. Qian Yongqiang decided to form a three-person research group (Feng Haoran, Zheng Wenbo, Sun Xiaoya) to study the compliance and market prospects of QDII and cross-border REITs product distribution, and designated Feng Haoran as the leader, with a clear division of labor.
subevent.location: Huatai Securities office in Kaifu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Online meeting to research cross-border REITs and CICC and China Merchants Securities
subevent.description: Feng Haoran, Zheng Wenbo, and Sun Xiaoya held video calls in the company's small meeting room via Tencent Meeting, first with Chen Hong, cross-border products lead at CICC's Shenzhen branch, and then with Zhang Hui, product manager at China Merchants Securities' Shanghai branch. They focused on understanding the fee structure, investment threshold, one-year return, and compliance key points of the CICC Asia REITs Fund and the China Merchants Global Real Estate Income Fund, and took notes for a summary.
subevent.location: Changsha, Hunan Province - Huatai Securities Meeting Room

subevent.name: Submit the draft and report progress orally
subevent.description: Feng Haoran sent the completed preliminary proposal PPT to Director Qian Yongqiang via WeChat Work, and went to his office for a 15-minute oral report, summarizing the research findings, allocation logic, and compliance details to be confirmed in the next phase (such as QDII quota application). Qian Yongqiang expressed approval and suggested supplementing the customer risk questionnaire and adding regulatory policy clauses. Feng Haoran took notes and planned to revise the next day.
subevent.location: Hunan Province, Changsha City - Huatai Securities Director's Office

name: Proposed a Yunnan family trip idea during the New Year camping
description: At a New Year's Eve camping trip on December 31, Feng Haoran sat around the campfire with his parents and younger sister and formally proposed the Yunnan travel plan, showing scenic photos and a budget plan. His parents were pleasantly surprised and readily agreed. The family preliminarily selected Dali and Lijiang as destinations and decided to depart one week before the Spring Festival.

subevent.name: Attend a New Year's Eve camping bonfire party
subevent.description: Feng Haoran went to a camping base around Changsha with his father Feng Jianguo, mother Li Xiuying, and sister Feng Xinran to attend a New Year's Eve camping event. In the evening, the family sat around a campfire, enjoying outdoor cooking and the warm glow of the flames, in a harmonious atmosphere.
subevent.location: Changsha, Hunan Province - an outdoor camping base

subevent.name: Formally proposed the family trip to Yunnan and gained the family's approval
subevent.description: In the warm atmosphere of the campfire party, Feng Haoran took out his phone and showed his father Feng Jianguo, mother Li Xiuying, and sister Feng Xinran carefully prepared pictures of Yunnan tourist attractions and a budget plan, formally proposing a family trip to Dali and Lijiang in Yunnan during the Spring Festival. His parents were pleasantly surprised and readily agreed. The family had a lively discussion and finally tentatively selected Dali Old Town, Erhai Lake, and Lijiang Old Town as the main destinations, and decided to set off one week before the Spring Festival (around early February 2026).
subevent.location: Beside the campfire at an outdoor camping base in Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Continued to remotely accompany parents, guiding healthy eating
description: Feng Haoran maintained video calls with his mother twice a week (usually Wednesday and Saturday evenings), remotely guiding his parents to adjust their diet structure according to the nutritionist's advice and reduce salt and oil intake. Within August, his father's blood pressure gradually stabilized, and Feng Haoran felt relieved. At the same time, he also learned about his parents' daily life through video, shared his own current situation, and strengthened family emotional bonds.

subevent.name: First video call for dietary guidance
subevent.description: Feng Haoran made his weekly routine video call via WeChat from his home in Changsha with his mother Li Xiuying at her home in Wuhan; his father Feng Jianguo also participated. During the call, Feng Haoran asked in detail about his parents' recent eating habits and, based on the nutritionist's previous advice, gave his mother step-by-step guidance on adjusting the amount of salt in cooking, reducing intake of pickled foods, and recommended healthy ingredients such as low-sodium soy sauce and flaxseed oil. At the same time, Feng Haoran shared his recent work updates and street photography works in Changsha, strengthening family emotional bonds. The call lasted about 45 minutes.

subevent.name: Wednesday evening video guidance on diet adjustment progress.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran had his second video call of the week with his mother Li Xiuying in Wuhan from his home in Changsha. His mother reported that she had started using low sodium salt, and that his father's portion of pickles at breakfast had been reduced by half. Feng Haoran affirmed his parents' changes and further suggested increasing the proportion of steamed and boiled dishes at dinner, while reminding his father to monitor his blood pressure monitor readings. At the end of the call, Feng Haoran taught his mother to take photos with her phone to record the dishes of each meal for later analysis. The call lasted about 30 minutes.

subevent.name: Saturday video update on blood pressure improvement.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran had a video call with his parents on time. His father Feng Jianguo took the initiative to show his blood pressure measurement record book, showing that his systolic blood pressure had dropped from 145 mmHg to 138 mmHg in the past week. Feng Haoran was very pleased and encouraged his parents to keep it up. He also asked about the difficulties his mother encountered in cooking. In response to her complaint that the dishes being too bland made them not tasty, he suggested using natural spices such as scallions, ginger, garlic, and Sichuan peppercorns to enhance the flavor. Meanwhile, Feng Haoran sent his mother an article of recipes about reducing salt without reducing flavor, and they agreed that she would try two of the recipes before their next call.

subevent.name: Video review of diet records on Wednesday evening
subevent.description: Feng Haoran had a video call with his mother. She showed photos of dishes she had taken in recent days, and Feng Haoran commented on each one and gave suggestions for improvement. He noticed that his father still often had braised pork for lunch, so he had a separate video chat with his father, suggesting he switch to stewed lean meat and limit it to no more than once a week. At the same time, Feng Haoran asked about his father's recent sleep and energy, and his father said he felt more relaxed than last month. During the call, Feng Haoran also shared his morning run data and encouraged his parents to increase their outdoor walking time appropriately.

subevent.name: Saturday video call about nutritional supplements
subevent.description: Feng Haoran discussed with his parents over video whether to buy fish oil and multivitamin tablets. He had previously looked up brands and dosages suitable for middle-aged and older people, and suggested his parents take them daily. His mother, Li Xiuying, was willing to try, but his father worried about drug dependence. Feng Haoran patiently explained that nutritional supplements are only an aid and won't affect a normal diet, and proposed buying a one-month trial first. In addition, he asked about the community health check-up notice and urged his parents to attend the free health screening at the end of August on time. The call lasted 40 minutes.

subevent.name: Wednesday evening video call to confirm food purchases
subevent.description: Feng Haoran had a video call with his mother, helping her place online orders for low-sodium soy sauce, flaxseed oil, and mixed grains. His mother opened the shopping app on her phone, and Feng Haoran guided her through the operation remotely and completed the payment. He also reminded her to check the refrigerator and throw away expired seasonings. His father Feng Jianguo said on the side that his blood pressure had recently stabilized at around 135/85 mmHg. Feng Haoran encouraged his father to continue recording, and shared a successful case from his recent investment work to reassure his father. The call lasted 35 minutes.

subevent.name: Saturday: video feedback on physical exam appointment status
subevent.description: Feng Haoran had a video call with his parents and confirmed that they had successfully booked a free community health check-up on August 28. He explained in detail the precautions before the check-up: fast for 8 hours, avoid strenuous exercise, and wear loose clothing. His mother Li Xiuying said she had recently become fully adjusted to a low-salt diet, and his father Feng Jianguo also reported that his post-meal dizziness had disappeared. Feng Haoran praised his parents for their persistence and agreed that they would tell him the results as soon as possible after the check-up. At the end of the call, Feng Haoran showed them the landscape photos he had taken at Yuelu Mountain over the weekend, which his parents enjoyed greatly.

subevent.name: Wednesday evening video follow-up on health check results
subevent.description: The day after the physical examination, Feng Haoran had a video call with his parents. His mother, Li Xiuying, reported the results in detail: his father's blood pressure was 135/82 mmHg, and blood sugar and blood lipids were all within normal range; the doctor affirmed the recent effects of dietary adjustments. Feng Haoran was very happy and encouraged his father to keep it up. His mother's results were also good, with only mild osteoporosis; the doctor recommended calcium supplements. Feng Haoran immediately searched for suitable calcium supplement brands and placed an order to be sent to Wuhan. During the call, Feng Haoran also asked his parents for their opinions on the next month's diet plan, and they expressed willingness to continue cooperating.

subevent.name: Saturday video summary and follow-up plan
subevent.description: Feng Haoran had his last video call of August with his parents. He summarized the health management results of the month: his father's blood pressure remained stable within the normal range, and his mother's cooking habits had improved significantly. Feng Haoran said he would continue the twice-a-week video call schedule and planned to have his parents try more whole-grain recipes in September. His parents thanked him for the remote guidance and shared their plan to go to the park for morning exercise next week. The call was relaxed and pleasant. Feng Haoran also chatted with his father about the latest developments in the stamp collecting market, while his mother showed off her newly learned steamed dishes. The call lasted 50 minutes.

name: Regularly video call parents to monitor mother's post-surgery recovery
description: Since returning to Changsha on May 4, Feng Haoran has scheduled video calls with his parents three times a week to check on his mother's recovery from stomach illness, remind her of follow-up appointment dates, and guide his father in helping record diet and symptoms. He also regularly shares his own health management insights, encouraging his mother to stick to a light diet and moderate exercise, and the family's awareness of coordinated health management has significantly increased.

subevent.name: Formulated a video communication plan and made the first call.
subevent.description: After returning home in Changsha, Feng Haoran had his first post-surgery rehabilitation supervision video call with his parents at their Wuhan home via WeChat video on the evening of May 4. During the call, he asked in detail about his mother Li Xiuying's diet, sleep, and pain in the first week after discharge, and reintroduced the plan for three calls per week. He guided his father Feng Jianguo to use the memo app on his phone to record daily his mother's meals, medication times, and symptom changes. He also shared his own experience managing morning runs and healthy eating, encouraging his mother to stick to a light diet and walk 15 minutes every day. The call lasted about 40 minutes, and both sides confirmed a fixed weekly video call schedule at 7:30 pm every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Week 1 video-call rehabilitation supervision.
subevent.description: As planned, Feng Haoran had video calls with his parents via WeChat at 7:30 pm on May 5 (Monday), May 7 (Wednesday), and May 9 (Friday). During the three calls, he checked one by one the diet diary recorded by his father, confirmed the proportions of vegetables, protein, and staple food in his mother's meals, and asked whether she had any discomfort such as abdominal pain or acid reflux. In the call on May 7, his mother reported occasional stomach bloating. Feng Haoran suggested reducing the intake of soy products and reminded his father to adjust the format of the diet records. In the call on May 9, he praised his mother for starting to go downstairs for walks, and once again emphasized avoiding heavy lifting within one month after the surgery. Each call lasted about 20-30 minutes.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Second week video call supervision of recovery.
subevent.description: At 7:30 p.m. on May 12 (Monday), May 14 (Wednesday), and May 16 (Friday), Feng Haoran had scheduled video calls with his parents. This week, his mother's bloating symptoms basically disappeared and her appetite recovered somewhat. In the call on May 12, he specifically asked about the appointment for the first postoperative follow-up; his father said he had made an appointment for the morning of May 20. In the May 14 call, Feng Haoran guided his mother through simple in-bed stretching exercises over the screen, and reminded his father to pay attention to his mother's mental state after taking the medication. In the May 16 call, he shared the healthy recipe e-book he had bought, and planned to compile it into a recipe list suitable for his mother's diet over the weekend.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Week 3 video call to supervise rehabilitation and remind about follow-up examination
subevent.description: During a video call on the evening of Monday, May 19, Feng Haoran specifically reminded his parents of the follow-up appointment time on the morning of the next day (May 20) and the materials to bring (ID card, medical insurance card, discharge summary, and recent diet records). After his mother's successful follow-up on the morning of May 20, Feng Haoran called that afternoon to ask about the results and learned that all indicators were normal. The doctor advised continuing medication for one month and maintaining a healthy diet. During calls on Wednesday, May 21, and Friday, May 23, he affirmed his mother's recovery progress and suggested gradually increasing walking time to 30 minutes per day. Meanwhile, he guided his father to learn to use his phone to take photos to record the doctor's prescription adjustments.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Mother's postoperative follow-up and result communication
subevent.description: On the morning of May 20, his father Feng Jianguo accompanied his mother Li Xiuying to Wuhan Central Hospital in Jiangan District, Wuhan City for the first postoperative follow-up. The check-up included a complete blood count, gastroscopy, and a doctor's consultation. Around 1 p.m., Feng Haoran received the follow-up report from his father, showing that inflammation had improved significantly and the anastomosis was healing well. The doctor adjusted the medication plan, stopped antibiotics, and continued taking gastric mucosal protectants and prokinetic drugs. Feng Haoran immediately had a video call with his parents, asked in detail about the doctor's advice, and recorded it in the family health file. He told his father to take a photo of the new medicine box and send it to him so he could verify the usage and dosage.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Week 4 video call to supervise rehabilitation
subevent.description: On the evenings of May 26 (Monday), May 28 (Wednesday) and May 30 (Friday) at 7:30, Feng Haoran made the last week of scheduled video calls as planned. Since his mother was recovering well, the focus of this week's calls shifted to long-term health maintenance: during the call on May 26, he helped his mother make a meal plan for the next month, organized the recipes previously selected from healthy recipes into a document and sent it to his father; during the call on May 28, he encouraged his mother to start trying jogging-style brisk walking and suggested his father join in; during the call on May 30, he summarized this month's recovery progress, emphasized the importance of sticking to medication and regular check-ups, and agreed that starting next month the video calls would be adjusted to once a week.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

subevent.name: Monthly Rehabilitation Summary Meeting
subevent.description: On the evening of May 31, Feng Haoran had a video call with his parents lasting about 45 minutes, as a summary of the regular supervision for May. He reviewed his mother's rehabilitation progress item by item: dietary records were more than 90% complete, she went for walks on 22 days, gained 1.5 kg, and follow-up indicators were normal. He thanked his father for meticulous recording and cooperation, and encouraged his mother to maintain good habits. He shared his own health insights from morning runs this month, and suggested sharing a photo of each meal once a week in the family group chat. Finally, he confirmed the June communication plan: a video call at 7:30 pm every Sunday and a monthly health data summary.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province.

name: Caught up with college classmate Wu Junjie at a Hunan restaurant and exchanged investment insights
description: On the evening of November 13, 2025, after leaving Huatai Securities, Feng Haoran went to a Hunan restaurant in Yuhua District for a reunion dinner with his college classmate Wu Junjie. They chatted about recent work and plans for an investment column. After dinner, they strolled along the street. Wu Junjie asked for financial advice, and Feng Haoran gave initial allocation suggestions such as regular investing in index funds, and they agreed to discuss further at the end of the month.

subevent.name: Set off for the Hunan restaurant.
subevent.description: On the evening of November 13, 2025, after getting off work from Huatai Securities at No. 88 Furong Middle Road, Kaifu District, Changsha, Feng Haoran took a taxi to a Hunan restaurant in Yuhua District that he had agreed on with his college classmate Wu Junjie. On the way, he replied to several work messages in the car and confirmed the meeting time with Wu Junjie.
subevent.location: Changsha - on the way from Huatai Securities to a Hunan restaurant in Yuhua District

subevent.name: Dinner gathering at a Hunan restaurant to catch up
subevent.description: On the evening of November 13, 2025, Feng Haoran met up with his college classmate Wu Junjie at a Hunan restaurant in Yuhua District, Changsha. After seating themselves, they ordered dishes, including chopped pepper fish head and stir-fried pork with chili peppers, and chatted about recent life while enjoying the meal. Wu Junjie shared his project progress and interesting team stories as an IT engineer at Hunan Mobile Communications Co., Ltd. Feng Haoran revealed that he was preparing an investment column plan for high-net-worth clients and asked Wu Junjie for his opinion. The atmosphere at the table was relaxed, and the two reminisced about their college days when they used to run and have midnight snacks together.
subevent.location: Changsha – Hunan cuisine restaurant in Yuhua District

subevent.name: After dinner, took a walk and discussed financial management plans.
subevent.description: On the evening of November 13, 2025, after dinner, Feng Haoran and Wu Junjie left the Hunan restaurant and strolled along the street sidewalk in Yuhua District to aid digestion. Wu Junjie consulted Feng Haoran about personal financial planning. Based on Wu Junjie's income, risk appetite, and recent IT industry trends, Feng Haoran gave preliminary asset allocation advice: suggesting Wu Junjie regularly invest 30% of monthly income in index funds, buy 20% in conservative wealth management products, and reminded him to set aside an emergency reserve fund. The two chatted while walking, and Feng Haoran also promised to prepare a detailed financial plan for Wu Junjie before the end of the month and agreed to schedule another time to discuss it in detail.

subevent.name: Return home.
subevent.description: Around 9 p.m. on the evening of November 13, 2025, Feng Haoran said goodbye to Wu Junjie on a street in Yuhua District, then took a taxi back to his home at 156 Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha. After arriving home, he washed up briefly, jotted down in his notebook the key points of the financial plan he had promised to make for Wu Junjie, and then rested.

name: Attend a fintech industry salon with colleague Zheng Wenbo to build connections.
description: On the afternoon of November 22, Feng Haoran and his colleague Zheng Wenbo attended the fintech industry salon held at the InterContinental Changsha North Star Hotel. They listened to speeches by several experts on intelligent investment advisory. After the event, the two exchanged contact information with several peers and discussed REITs investment logic. Feng Haoran took this opportunity to promote his personal column [Lushan on Finance] and gained attention from potential readers.

subevent.name: Pre-event preparation and material organization.
subevent.description: At 8 a.m. on November 22, Feng Haoran was at his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, preparing materials for the afternoon fintech industry salon, including personal business cards, printed summaries of his column articles, and a pre-prepared list of questions about REITs investing. Meanwhile, he confirmed the gathering time and what to bring with his colleague Zheng Wenbo via WeChat.
subevent.location: Home study room, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Heading to InterContinental Beichen Hotel.
subevent.description: At 1 p.m. on November 22, Feng Haoran left home and drove to InterContinental Changsha North Star, calling Zheng Wenbo on the way to confirm their arrival times. The two agreed to meet in the hotel lobby.
subevent.location: Changsha - on the way to InterContinental Beichen Hotel

subevent.name: Salon Check-in and Listening to Expert Speeches
subevent.description: Feng Haoran and Zheng Wenbo checked in at the banquet hall of InterContinental Changsha Beichen at 2 p.m., then entered the venue to listen to keynote speeches by several fintech experts on the development of robo-advisory. Feng Haoran carefully noted key points and had a brief exchange with Zheng Wenbo about the speeches.
subevent.location: Changsha - InterContinental Changsha Hotel Banquet Hall

subevent.name: Tea break conversation and exchanging business cards.
subevent.description: During the tea break at 3:30 p.m., Feng Haoran proactively exchanged business cards with several industry peers at the meeting, including representatives from fund companies and banks. He briefly introduced his background as an investment advisor, added them as WeChat friends, and shared the QR code of his personal column [Lushan on Finance] with them, gaining attention from several potential readers.
subevent.location: Banquet hall rest area, InterContinental Beichen Hotel, Changsha

subevent.name: Special topic discussion and column promotion.
subevent.description: At 4:30 p.m., the salon entered the open discussion session. Feng Haoran and Zheng Wenbo had an in-depth discussion on REITs investment logic. Feng Haoran shared his views based on recent market analysis and recommended his column articles to several interested attendees. On the spot, three peers followed his column and agreed to subsequent online exchanges.
subevent.location: Changsha - InterContinental Beichen Hotel Salon Discussion Area

subevent.name: Salon ends and return journey.
subevent.description: After the salon ended at 6 p.m., Feng Haoran and Zheng Wenbo briefly summarized the gains in the hotel lobby, exchanged the business cards collected that day, and agreed to sort out the follow-up list during next week's working hours. Then Feng Haoran drove home, and on the way shared the salon experiences via WeChat with several friends who could not attend.
subevent.location: Changsha: InterContinental Beichen Hotel lobby and the way back

subevent.name: Follow-up and maintenance of new contacts
subevent.description: On the morning of November 23, Feng Haoran entered the 6 business cards he had collected the previous day into his contacts, sent personalized greeting messages to each new contact via WeChat with links to his latest personal column article, and scheduled follow-up phone calls. He also shared the follow-up results with Zheng Wenbo and discussed whether they needed to jointly arrange an online sharing session.
subevent.location: Home study room, Yuelu District, Changsha

name: Propose the Hexi branch plan, inspect and estimate the investment budget, and make an initial investment decision.
description: On May 20, 2025, Shen Xinyi proposed the plan for the Hexi University Town branch at Xinyi Hand-Brew Coffee, and Feng Haoran agreed to participate. From May 24 to 25, the two visited shops in Hexi University Town, recorded data, and estimated a total investment of about 300,000 yuan. On the evening of the 25th, Feng Haoran proposed an investment plan of 150,000 yuan as equity participation with the remainder covered by a loan. Shen Xinyi approved, and the two reached an initial cooperation intention.

subevent.name: Shen Xinyi proposed a Hexi branch plan
subevent.description: On the evening of May 20, 2025, at Xinyi Hand-Drip Coffee on Jiefang West Road, Furong District, Changsha, Shen Xinyi proposed to Feng Haoran a plan to open a second branch in the West Riverside University City, hoping that Feng Haoran would participate as an investor. Feng Haoran showed interest in the project, and the two agreed to use the upcoming weekend (May 24 and 25) to go to the university city together for a field visit.
subevent.location: Xinyi Pour-Over Coffee House, Furong District, Changsha

subevent.name: First day of field inspection of shops in Hexi University Town.
subevent.description: At 9 a.m. on Saturday, May 24, Feng Haoran and Shen Xinyi met at the intersection of Lushan South Road in Hexi University Town. They visited the shops for rent on both sides of Lushan South Road, recording the floor area, monthly rent asking price, orientation, and surrounding foot traffic of each shop. After a simple lunch at a nearby restaurant, they continued to inspect shops along Fubuhe Road in the afternoon. They concluded the first day's survey at 6 p.m. and agreed to compile the data the next day.
subevent.location: Yuelu District, Changsha - Hexi University City Business District

subevent.name: Second day site inspection and preliminary data compilation.
subevent.description: On the morning of May 25 (Sunday), Feng Haoran went alone to uncovered areas such as Tianma Road and Houhu Road in Hexi University City to record information on remaining shops for rent. In the afternoon, he returned home, entered the data of 12 shops collected over two days into an Excel spreadsheet, calculated an average rent of about 120 yuan per square meter per month, and combined with decoration and equipment costs, preliminarily estimated that opening a standard branch store would require an investment of about 300,000 yuan.
subevent.location: Home study room, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Communicating investment decisions with Shen Xinyi
subevent.description: On the evening of May 25, Feng Haoran returned to Xinyi Hand-Drip Coffee Shop with the prepared investment budget table to have a detailed discussion with Shen Xinyi. Feng Haoran proposed to invest a small stake of 150,000 yuan (accounting for 50% of the shares), with the remaining 150,000 yuan to be financed through a bank loan, and showed his repayment plan. Shen Xinyi approved the plan, and the two reached a preliminary intention to cooperate, agreeing that Feng Haoran would handle the loan procedures and draft the joint venture agreement.
subevent.location: Xinyi Pour-Over Coffee House, Furong District, Changsha

name: Browse street photography websites in Japanese to broaden my photographic vocabulary.
description: In September 2025, Feng Haoran began trying to browse Japanese street photography websites and social media accounts in Japanese, collecting street photography works from places like Tokyo and Kyoto for inspiration. He shared some Japanese-style composition techniques in the photography association and discussed the differences between Chinese and Japanese street photography styles with photographer friends, further enriching his photographic language.

subevent.name: Started browsing street photography websites in Japanese
subevent.description: Feng Haoran, in the study of his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, turned on his computer and began searching and browsing Japanese street photography websites in Japanese (such as Tokyo Street Photography, Kyoto Snap, etc.), noting links to works of interest in preparation for future collection.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District - Home study

subevent.name: Collect and compare street photography styles in Kyoto and Tokyo.
subevent.description: In his home study, Feng Haoran searched and browsed the works of many renowned Kyoto photographers through photography websites, filtered and collected them as references; then deeply analyzed the composition, light and shadow, and color characteristics of Kyoto street photography, and compared them with the style of Tokyo street photography; organized the analysis results into systematic comparison notes, and finally reviewed and polished the notes and summarized the learning gains.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District - Home study

subevent.name: Search and browse Kyoto street photography works
subevent.description: Feng Haoran used the computer in his home study to search for Kyoto street photography on photography sites (such as 500px and Flickr) and social media (such as Instagram), browsed the portfolios of many well-known photographers (such as Daido Moriyama and Hiroshi Sugimoto), and selected and saved high-quality representative street shots as material for subsequent analysis.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District - Home study

subevent.name: Analyze the characteristics of Kyoto street style photography
subevent.description: In the study, Feng Haoran conducted an in-depth analysis of the collected Kyoto street photography works, recording common compositional techniques (such as symmetry and frame composition), lighting usage (low-angle side light, backlit silhouettes), color matching (low saturation, warm tones) and other stylistic characteristics, and annotated the similarities and differences with the previously compiled Tokyo street photography style.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District - Home study

subevent.name: Organizing comparison notes of Kyoto and Tokyo street photography
subevent.description: In the study, Feng Haoran organized the earlier analysis results into systematic comparison notes, listing the core characteristics of street photography in Kyoto and Tokyo respectively (for example, Kyoto places more emphasis on traditional elements and a tranquil atmosphere, while Tokyo highlights modern urbanity and a sense of dynamism), clarifying the similarities (such as the importance attached to light and shadow) and differences, and produced a structured document for personal study reference.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District - Home study

subevent.name: Review and supplement notes, and summarize takeaways
subevent.description: In his study, Feng Haoran reviewed the entire collection and analysis process, supplemented and improved the comparison notes, added personal observations and shooting inspiration, ensured the content was comprehensive and systematic, and summarized what he had gained from this learning in improving his street photography skills.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District - Home study

subevent.name: Sharing Japanese-style composition techniques at the photography association.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran shared in the online group of the Changsha Photography Association the Japanese composition techniques he learned from street photography in Japan, including negative space, contrast, line guidance, etc., and showed samples from his personal collection.

subevent.name: Discussed differences between Chinese and Japanese street photography styles with photography friends
subevent.description: Feng Haoran and his photography partner Xu Jianing discussed the differences between Japanese and Chinese street photography styles via video call, comparing the sense of order on Japanese streets with the hustle and bustle of Chinese streets, and exchanged their photography insights.

name: Medical treatment and rehabilitation for cervical spine problems
description: On March 17, 2025, Feng Haoran, due to persistent cervical discomfort and limited relief from yoga, decided to see a doctor the next day. On March 18, he went to the Rehabilitation Department of the Third Xiangya Hospital of Central South University, where he was diagnosed with cervical muscle strain and mild straightening of the cervical curve. The doctor recommended physical therapy and posture correction. On March 19, he adjusted his workstation and rest habits. Subsequently, Feng Haoran received three physical therapy sessions on March 20, 24, and 27, and his symptoms gradually eased. On March 31, he self-assessed that the rehabilitation was effective, the neck pain had basically disappeared, and he planned a follow-up visit.

subevent.name: Cervical discomfort worsened, decided to seek medical treatment.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran had been experiencing cervical discomfort for several weeks; although he tried yoga to relieve it, the effect was limited. In mid-March, the symptoms worsened significantly, affecting his work and sleep, so he decided to go to the hospital the next day.

subevent.name: Visit the rehabilitation department at Xiangya Third Hospital
subevent.description: In the morning, Feng Haoran went to the rehabilitation department of the Third Xiangya Hospital of Central South University in Yuelu District, Changsha, to register for a consultation. He described his cervical spine discomfort symptoms in detail to the doctor. After arranging an X-ray examination, the doctor diagnosed him with cervical muscle strain and mild straightening of the cervical lordosis, prescribed physical therapy, and advised twice-weekly physiotherapy, correcting his sitting posture, and avoiding prolonged head-down positions.
subevent.location: Changsha - Rehabilitation Department, Xiangya Third Hospital

subevent.name: Adjusting workstation and rest habits
subevent.description: Following the doctor's advice, Feng Haoran readjusted the height of the desk and chair in his home study, bought an adjustable monitor stand and a lumbar support cushion, and set an hourly reminder to do neck stretching. He also adjusted his evening rest habits and switched to a pillow that better fits the cervical spine's natural curvature.

subevent.name: First physical therapy session
subevent.description: Feng Haoran went to the Rehabilitation Department of Xiangya Third Hospital at the scheduled time for his first physical therapy session. The therapist performed cervical traction (15 minutes), hot compress (10 minutes), and professional manual massage (15 minutes). After the treatment, Feng Haoran felt his neck muscles noticeably relaxed, and the doctor advised him to pay attention to his daily posture.
subevent.location: Changsha - Rehabilitation Department, Xiangya Third Hospital

subevent.name: Second physical therapy session
subevent.description: Feng Haoran underwent his second physical therapy session. In addition to routine traction and hot compresses, the therapist added deep neck muscle strengthening exercises, guided him through chin tucks and scapular stability exercises, and provided a home exercise plan.
subevent.location: Changsha - Rehabilitation Department, Xiangya Third Hospital

subevent.name: Third physical therapy session.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran completed his third physical therapy session. This session focused on consolidating results and functional training. The therapist assessed that his cervical spine mobility had improved by about 60% compared to the initial visit, and the pain index dropped from 6 to 2. The therapist recommended continuing home exercises, a follow-up in one month, and maintaining good posture and lifestyle habits.
subevent.location: Changsha - Rehabilitation Department, Xiangya Third Hospital

subevent.name: Self-assessment of rehabilitation outcomes and follow-up arrangements
subevent.description: After completing three sessions of physical therapy, Feng Haoran assessed the rehabilitation effect at home: the neck pain had basically disappeared, there was no obvious discomfort when lowering or turning the head, and sleep quality had improved. He decided to continue maintaining the adjusted work and rest habits, persist in daily neck exercises, and plan to return to Xiangya Third Hospital at the end of April for a follow-up on the recovery of the cervical spine curvature.

name: Upgrade photography equipment: sell old camera, buy Sony A7R5 and lens, then take test shots.
description: After months of comparison, Feng Haoran sold his original entry-level DSLR through an online second-hand platform on December 17, 2025. On December 18, he purchased a Sony A7R5 body, 24-70mm F2.8 GM II lens, flash, and spare battery at Changsha Kejia Computer City, spending a total of 23,000 yuan. Part of the funds came from the sale of the old camera and investment profits. On December 19, he took the new camera to Taiping Street for a test shoot. The high-pixel detail was satisfying. After sharing the photos to the "Xingcheng Photography Association" group, he received praise. Fellow photographer Xu Jianing sighed, "Playing photography will end up burning money in the later stage." Feng Haoran replied, "I'll earn it back with my work."

subevent.name: Selling an old DSLR camera.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran sold his existing entry-level DSLR camera in Changsha through an online second-hand platform, and the proceeds were used to supplement the funds for purchasing a new camera.

subevent.name: Purchased Sony A7R5 camera and lens
subevent.description: At a photography equipment store in Kejia Computer City, Changsha, Feng Haoran bought a Sony A7R5 body, a 24-70mm F2.8 GM II lens, a flash, and spare batteries, totaling 23,000 yuan. Part of the money came from selling his old camera and investment profits.

subevent.name: Trying out the new camera at Taiping Street
subevent.description: Feng Haoran took his newly purchased Sony A7R5 camera to Taiping Street in Changsha for a test shoot, experiencing the detail performance under high pixel count. After shooting, he shared the works on the 'Star City Photography Association' WeChat group and received praise from photographer friends. Xu Jianing remarked, 'When you get into photography, you inevitably burn money on gear later,' and Feng Haoran replied, 'I'll earn it back with my work.'

name: Took the family to join the Photography Association's urban New Year atmosphere photography event.
description: On December 21, Feng Haoran took his parents and his sister Feng Xinran, who had just returned to Changsha, to participate in the 'Urban New Year Flavor' outdoor shooting organized by the Star City Photography Association, roaming through Changsha's old streets and New Year goods markets. His father took the initiative to help carry the backpack and tripod, while his mother and sister interacted naturally in front of the camera. Feng Haoran captured warm moments of his family choosing Spring Festival couplets and tasting sugar paintings. After the event, the whole family had dinner at a Hunan restaurant, and his father couldn't stop smiling while reviewing the photos on the camera, a heartwarming scene.

subevent.name: Preparation before departure and heading to the meeting point.
subevent.description: In the early morning, Feng Haoran checked his photography equipment at home (camera, spare batteries, tripod, backpack) and reminded his parents and younger sister Feng Xinran to wear warm clothing. Then the four of them drove together to the meeting point on Taiping Street in Changsha with members of the Xingcheng Photography Association. His father, Feng Jianguo, took the initiative to carry Feng Haoran's camera bag and tripod.
subevent.location: Changsha - home in Yuelu District and Taiping Street entrance

subevent.name: New Year-themed photo shoot at old streets in Changsha.
subevent.description: From morning to noon, Feng Haoran led his family and photography association members through old streets in Changsha, such as Taiping Street and Pozi Street, shooting New Year elements like ancient buildings, red lanterns, and couplet stalls. His father helped watch the tripod and backpack, while his mother and sister interacted naturally in front of the camera. Feng Haoran captured warm moments of his family selecting couplets and tasting sugar paintings.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Taiping Street and Pozi Street

subevent.name: Moved to the New Year goods market to continue shooting.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Feng Haoran and his family, along with the photography association, moved to the Xiahe Street New Year goods market in Changsha to photograph the bustling scene of people shopping for New Year goods. Feng Haoran continued to focus on his family, capturing the moments of laughter of his mother and sister in front of the dried fruit stall and sugar painting stall, while his father watched with a smile and helped carry samples of New Year goods.
subevent.location: Changsha - Xiahe Street New Year goods market

subevent.name: After the photo shoot, the whole family had dinner together at the Hunan restaurant.
subevent.description: In the evening, after the event, Feng Haoran took his family to a Hunan restaurant named 'Xiang Wei Xuan' in Furong District for dinner. During the meal, his father browsed through the camera playback and couldn't stop laughing at Feng Haoran's candid shots. The family enjoyed Hunan cuisine while reminiscing about the fun moments of shooting, creating a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
subevent.location: Xiangweixuan Hunan Restaurant, Furong District, Changsha

subevent.name: Return home after dinner
subevent.description: After dinner, Feng Haoran drove his parents and sister back to their home in Yuelu District. On the way, the family continued chatting about the fun moments from the day's photos. Feng Haoran planned to import the photos into his computer for initial sorting after returning home.
subevent.location: On the way from Xiangweixuan, Changsha to home in Yuelu District

name: During the National Day holiday, pick up parents, take them to the rented residence in Changsha, and visit attractions together.
description: On the first day of the National Day holiday, Feng Haoran returned from Changsha to Wuhan to pick up his parents, and the family of three took the high-speed rail to Changsha. In the following days, he accompanied his parents to inspect several two-bedroom apartments in Yuelu District, finally choosing a community near a subway entrance with an elevator, with a monthly rent of 2,800 yuan. After signing the lease, he prepaid half a year's rent and purchased furniture, appliances, and daily necessities in advance. During the holiday, he took his parents to visit iconic attractions such as Orange Isle and Yuelu Academy, letting them experience the vibrant life of the Star City in the warm autumn sun, and the family enjoyed a long-lost reunion.

subevent.name: Return to Wuhan to pick up parents and take the high-speed rail to Changsha.
subevent.description: On the morning of October 1, 2025, the first day of National Day holiday, Feng Haoran set out from his residence in Changsha and took a high-speed train back to his home in Jiangan District, Wuhan, to pick up his father Feng Jianguo and mother Li Xiuying. After packing a few things, the family of three went to Wuhan Station and took an afternoon high-speed train to Changsha South Station. Feng Haoran took his parents by taxi back to his home in Changsha, settled them in briefly and had dinner together, then let his parents rest, ready for the apartment inspection starting the next day.
subevent.location: Wuhan, Hubei Province - home; Changsha South Railway Station, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Accompanied parents to inspect rental housing in Yuelu District.
subevent.description: On the morning of October 2, 2025, Feng Haoran took his parents to Yuelu District, Changsha. Led by Lu Jiaming, a real estate agent contacted in advance, they inspected three two-bedroom properties. His parents showed interest in two of them: one near the subway entrance but without an elevator, and the other in a high-rise with an elevator but slightly more expensive. Feng Haoran carefully asked about the surrounding amenities and rental details. His parents were more satisfied with the community with an elevator. After continuing to inspect two more properties in the afternoon, Feng Haoran discussed with his parents and leaned toward choosing the community close to the subway entrance and with an elevator.
subevent.location: A residential community in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Selected rental apartment, signed the contract, and paid in advance.
subevent.description: On the morning of October 3, 2025, Feng Haoran took his parents back to the elevator-equipped residential community they had seen the day before to confirm the apartment details and the surrounding environment. His parents decided to rent this two-bedroom apartment with a monthly rent of 2,800 yuan. Feng Haoran signed the lease contract with the landlord in the presence of the agent Lu Jiaming, and paid half a year's rent totaling 16,800 yuan in one lump sum via bank transfer. After signing, Feng Haoran got the keys, and the family of three planned the furniture layout in the new apartment.
subevent.location: A residential community in Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Purchase furniture, appliances, and daily necessities.
subevent.description: On October 4, 2025, all day, Feng Haoran took his parents to the home improvement materials market and large supermarket in Yuelu District, Changsha, to buy furniture and appliances for the new rental. In the morning, they selected a double bed, wardrobe, sofa, and dining table with chairs at the furniture store; in the afternoon, they bought a refrigerator, washing machine, and TV at the appliance mall, then went to the supermarket to buy bedding, kitchenware, and various daily necessities. Feng Haoran called a freight service to transport all items to the new residence. In the evening, the family of three simply arranged the bedroom and living room, and his parents moved into the new home.
subevent.location: Changsha, Hunan Province - Yuelu District Home Furnishing Market

subevent.name: Visit Orange Isle
subevent.description: On the morning of October 5, 2025, Feng Haoran set out with his parents from their new home and took the subway to Orange Isle Scenic Area. The family of three strolled at Orange Isle Head, enjoying the Xiang River scenery and the Young Mao Zedong Art Sculpture, and Feng Haoran took photos for his parents. At noon they had a meal at a tea restaurant in the scenic area, tasting Changsha specialty snacks. In the afternoon they continued walking to the head of the isle, and his parents were full of praise for Changsha's cityscape. In the evening they returned to the new home, where his parents cooked Hubei home-style dishes in the kitchen, and the family sat together for dinner, feeling the warmth of family that they had missed for a long time.
subevent.location: Orange Isle Scenic Area, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Visit Yuelu Academy and Yuelu Mountain
subevent.description: On the morning of October 6, 2025, Feng Haoran took his parents by bus to Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area. The family of three first visited Yuelu Academy, experiencing the cultural atmosphere of the thousand-year-old institution, and Feng Haoran explained the academy's history to his parents. Then they walked up the hiking trail and rested and took photos at Aiwan Pavilion. At noon, they tasted Hunan cuisine on a street at the foot of the mountain. In the afternoon, his parents seemed a bit tired, so Feng Haoran took them to a coffee shop at the foot of the mountain for hand-drip coffee and rest, chatting about their life plans after settling in Changsha. In the evening, they returned to the new home, and Feng Haoran helped his parents organize and settle in.
subevent.location: Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area, Changsha, Hunan Province

subevent.name: Family reunion day and return trip preparations.
subevent.description: On October 7, 2025, the last day of the National Day holiday, Feng Haoran stayed with his parents at their new residence to rest and tidy up. In the morning, they went to a nearby vegetable market together; Li Xiuying bought fresh ingredients to prepare lunch. After the meal, Feng Haoran taught his parents how to use smartphone navigation and shopping apps so they could live independently in Changsha. In the afternoon, he took them around the neighborhood to get familiar with the convenience stores, pharmacies, and bus stops. In the evening, the family of three had dinner together at the new residence. Feng Haoran reminded his parents of precautions, then returned to his own place in Changsha, while his parents stayed in the rented house to start their new life.
subevent.location: Rental apartment, Yuelu District, Changsha, Hunan Province

name: Resume morning runs and restart half-marathon training.
description: On September 14, after his calf wound healed, Feng Haoran resumed morning running accompanied by his running buddy Gao Yunfei, starting with a 3-kilometer jog. Over the following week, he gradually increased the distance. From September 21, he resumed his normal 5-kilometer morning run and restarted his half-marathon training plan, increasing weekly mileage by 10%.

subevent.name: Confirm resuming the morning running plan
subevent.description: After his calf wound healed, Feng Haoran contacted his running buddy Gao Yunfei via WeChat, told him he had recovered and planned to resume morning runs the next day, starting with a 3-kilometer jog. Gao Yunfei said he would be happy to accompany him.

subevent.name: Resume the 3 km morning run
subevent.description: Feng Haoran, accompanied by his running friend Gao Yunfei, jogged 3 kilometers on Yuelu Mountain, controlling his pace throughout, paying attention to how the wound felt, and completed the run after confirming there was no discomfort.

subevent.name: Phase of gradually increasing running distance
subevent.description: From September 16 to 20, 2025, Feng Haoran went for morning runs on Yuelu Mountain in several sessions, gradually increasing the distance from 4.5 km to 6.5 km to adapt to the exercise intensity. On some days, he was accompanied by his running partner Gao Yunfei.

subevent.name: Morning run of 4.5 km, accompanied by Gao Yunfei
subevent.description: At 6:00 a.m., Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei met at the foot of Yuelu Mountain. They jogged together along the mountain road. Feng Haoran attempted a 4.5 km distance, exchanging running tips and investment topics with Gao Yunfei on the way. It took about 30 minutes. After the run, they hydrated and stretched together in the rest area.

subevent.name: Morning run of 5.5 km, accompanied by Gao Yunfei
subevent.description: At 6:00 in the morning, Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei met again for a morning run on Yuelu Mountain. This time the distance was increased to 5.5 kilometers, and the two paced each other. During the run, Gao Yunfei shared his experience with his newly purchased running shoes, while Feng Haoran gave him financial planning guidance. The whole run took about 35 minutes, and afterward they took photos together at the observation platform.

subevent.name: Morning run 6 kilometers.
subevent.description: At 6:00 a.m., Feng Haoran took on a 6 km morning run alone on Yuelu Mountain, choosing a route around the mountain. He stopped briefly at the Huxin Pavilion to rest and hydrate, and finally completed it successfully in about 38 minutes. After the run, he carefully recorded his body's responses to prepare for the next stage of training.

subevent.name: Went for a 6.5 km morning run with Gao Yunfei accompanying him.
subevent.description: At 6:00 in the morning, Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei met at the entrance of Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area for the final progressive run of the week, with a target distance of 6.5 kilometers. The two ran at a steady pace along the mountain trail. Feng Haoran sped up to sprint in the last kilometer. The entire run took about 42 minutes. After the run, they did deep stretching together and summarized the week's training results.

subevent.name: Resumed the normal 5-kilometer morning run
subevent.description: After continuous adaptation, on the morning of September 21, Feng Haoran completed a 5 km regular morning run by himself on Yuelu Mountain. His pace recovered to the pre-injury level, and he felt well recovered.

subevent.name: Start half marathon training and complete the first week's training
subevent.description: On September 22, Feng Haoran formulated a 12-week half-marathon training plan at his home in Yuelu District, and then did a familiarization jog on Yuelu Mountain. On September 24, 28, and 29, he completed interval runs, tempo runs, and long-distance runs respectively, and on the 30th he did a recovery jog and weekly summary. The first week's total mileage was about 37 kilometers, laying the foundation for subsequent half-marathon preparation.

subevent.name: Develop a half-marathon training plan
subevent.description: At his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, Feng Haoran used a computer and a running app to develop a 12-week half marathon training plan based on the principle of increasing weekly mileage by 10%, detailing daily training items (including interval runs, tempo runs, long runs, and recovery runs) and rest day arrangements, and set weekly mileage goals and pace standards.

subevent.name: First adaptive jog
subevent.description: At 6 a.m., Feng Haoran did his first adaptive jog on Lushan South Road at the foot of Yuelu Mountain, covering 5 kilometers at a pace of 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. The main purpose was to let his body readjust to the running rhythm and check his cardiopulmonary status. On the way, he ran into his running buddy Gao Yunfei and exchanged training plans.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Lushan South Road, Yuelu Mountain

subevent.name: Interval running training
subevent.description: Feng Haoran performed interval running training on the specially designed rubber track on Yuelu Mountain, completing 6 sets of 400-meter fast runs (with a pace of 4 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer), with 90 seconds of rest between sets, for a total training distance of 7 kilometers. After training, he recorded heart rate and perceived exertion data to provide a basis for future intensity adjustments.

subevent.name: Tempo run training.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran performed an 8-kilometer tempo run on the ring road around Yuelu Mountain, maintaining a pace of 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer and a steady cruising ability. He carried a water bottle for hydration along the way, stretched and relaxed after the training, recorded the day's running data, and assessed his body's adaptation.

subevent.name: Long-distance jogging
subevent.description: Feng Haoran conducted his longest slow run of the week on Yuelu Mountain, covering 12 km at a pace of 06:10/km, focusing on testing endurance and joint tolerance. He carried energy gels and water, passed by Yuelu Academy and Aiwan Pavilion, and did 15 minutes of stretching afterward.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area trail

subevent.name: Recovery run and weekly summary
subevent.description: Feng Haoran did a 5 km recovery jog on Yuelu Mountain (7 min/km pace) to relax muscles and promote recovery. Afterward, he returned home, organized this week's training data (total mileage about 37 km), checked his knee joints and plantar condition, and fine-tuned next week's training plan to ensure next week's mileage increases by 10%.
subevent.location: Changsha - Yuelu Mountain Scenic Area trail

name: Launched a personal investment column [Lushan on Finance] and published the first long article.
description: On November 4, Feng Haoran wrote the first long article for his column and confirmed the photo exhibition information with the coffee shop owner; on November 5, he launched the Lushan Financial Talk column simultaneously on Zhihu and WeChat Official Account and published the article, appending the coffee shop's photo exhibition information at the end, creating an online-offline linkage.

subevent.name: Write the first column article
subevent.description: On November 4, in his study at home in Changsha, Feng Haoran used his time after work to write the first long article for the column "Lushan on Finance" on Zhihu and WeChat Official Account. The article's theme was analyzing the investment logic of Changsha REITs, conducting in-depth analysis with practical cases from Huatai Securities, and reserving a space at the end of the article for embedding information about the cafe photography exhibition. He used his laptop to complete the first draft, and repeatedly proofread the data and wording to ensure professionalism and readability.

subevent.name: Confirm the photo exhibition details with the coffee shop owner
subevent.description: On November 4, Feng Haoran contacted coffee shop owner Shen Xinyi via WeChat to communicate and confirm the specific details of the recent photography exhibition at “Xinyi Hand-Drip Coffee Shop” to be added at the end of the column article. The two parties made a final check on the exhibition theme, time, location, and promotional slogan. Shen Xinyi provided the exhibition poster and event link, and Feng Haoran embedded them at the end of the article as offline interactive content.

subevent.name: Open a column and configure settings
subevent.description: On the morning of November 5, Feng Haoran logged into Zhihu and the WeChat Official Account platform at his home in Changsha, and created the "Lushan Wealth Forum" column on both platforms in turn. He set the column name, description (focusing on investment analysis in Changsha and central China), and cover image (using his own photo of Yuelu Mountain), and completed the real-name authentication and the activation process for a WeChat Official Account subscription. At the same time, he configured auto-replies and a menu bar in the WeChat Official Account, positioning the column as an in-depth content channel updated weekly.

subevent.name: Published the first article in the column.
subevent.description: At noon on November 5, Feng Haoran published the completed article, which included the coffee shop photo exhibition information, simultaneously to the Zhihu column 'Lushan Lun Cai' and the WeChat official account. Before publishing, he checked the layout, images (including REITs case charts and the coffee shop photo exhibition poster), and hyperlink previews, and clicked publish after confirming everything was correct. The article was titled 'Changsha REITs Investment Logic: Localization Strategies from Huatai Practical Cases.' At the end, it included the invitation information for the 'Xinyi Hand-Brewed Coffee' photo exhibition, achieving online-offline linkage between knowledge output and offline activities.

subevent.name: Social sharing and initial interaction
subevent.description: From the afternoon to the evening of November 5, Feng Haoran shared the link to the first article of the "Lushan Finance Talk" column on his WeChat Moments and in WeChat groups (university alumni, colleagues, photography circles, etc.), along with a brief recommendation. He replied to comments and private messages on Zhihu and the official account backend in real time, exchanged views on REITs investment with readers, and guided interested users to follow the coffee shop photo exhibition. That night, he counted the initial readership and new follower data, recorded it in his personal work notes, and accumulated feedback for the column's future operation.
subevent.location: Changsha - home study and multiple online platforms

name: Stayed up all night to select and retouch wedding photos and emailed them to Sun Xiaoya.
description: Feng Haoran attended his colleague Sun Xiaoya's wedding dinner and took about 50 photos. Afterward, he stayed up late to select the best 30 photos and retouched them, then emailed the retouched photos to Sun Xiaoya in the early morning.

subevent.name: Attended a colleague's wedding dinner
subevent.description: Feng Haoran attended a colleague's wedding banquet at a hotel in Changsha. During the event, he proactively used his camera to take photos of the wedding scene, capturing wonderful moments. The banquet lasted from 18:00 to 22:00, and Feng Haoran took about 50 photos.

subevent.name: Selected and finely retouched wedding photos overnight.
subevent.description: After the dinner, Feng Haoran returned to his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, selected the best 30 photos from the 50 he had taken, and meticulously retouched them using Lightroom and Photoshop. The whole process lasted from 22:00 until about 04:00 the next morning, during which he adjusted the color, composition, and sharpness of the photos to ensure each one met professional standards.

subevent.name: Send the retouched photos to Sun Xiaoya by email
subevent.description: After completing the fine editing at 04:00 in the early morning, Feng Haoran packed the 30 photos into a compressed file, attached a short blessing message, and sent it via his personal email to Sun Xiaoya's work email at 04:15. The email included the photo download link and a warm message thanking her for inviting him to the wedding.

name: Served as a photography volunteer at the Changsha Marathon, and my work was officially adopted
description: On the morning of November 16, Feng Haoran served as a photography volunteer at the 17.5 km water station of the Changsha Marathon, handing out water while snapping photos of runners. He specifically waited for his fellow runner Gao Yunfei to pass and captured a series of close-up shots of him gritting his teeth and persevering. Among them, the sprint photo with his arms raised high at the finish line was especially compelling. That afternoon, it was selected and published on the event's official Weibo account, racking up over 10,000 views, and many runners sent private messages to thank him.

subevent.name: Prepare photography equipment and set out in the early morning
subevent.description: Feng Haoran got up at 5 a.m., checked and organized photography equipment (including a camera, telephoto lens, spare batteries, and memory cards), put on the volunteer vest and supplies, and drove from his home in Yuelu District, Changsha to the 17.5 km supply station of the Changsha Marathon route, ready to begin a day of photography volunteer service.
subevent.location: Changsha - home garage and Lushan South Road

subevent.name: Serve as a volunteer at the 17.5 km aid station and take candid shots of runners
subevent.description: At the 17.5 km aid station of the marathon, Feng Haoran handed drinking water and energy supplies to passing runners while using his camera to capture the moments of runners striving hard, recording the festive atmosphere of the race and the determined postures of the participants.
subevent.location: Changsha - Changsha Marathon course 17.5km aid station (Yuelu District section)

subevent.name: At the finish line, took a sprinting photo of Gao Yunfei with his arms raised high.
subevent.description: After finishing the shooting at the aid station, Feng Haoran quickly moved to near the marathon finish line (Helong Sports Center) and waited for Gao Yunfei's sprint. When Gao Yunfei crossed the finish line with both arms raised high, Feng Haoran captured that highly infectious moment. In the photo, Gao Yunfei's expression is excited and his arms are wide open, fully conveying the joy of completing the race.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Changsha Marathon Finish Line (Helong Sports Center)

subevent.name: Organized my works and submitted them, and my sprint photo was adopted and posted on the official Weibo.
subevent.description: Around 13:00 in the afternoon, after returning home, Feng Haoran immediately imported the photos into his computer, selected Gao Yunfei's finish-line sprint shot and a series of close-ups for post-processing color grading, then submitted them by email to the Changsha Marathon organizing committee. At 16:00 that afternoon, the official Weibo of the Changsha Marathon posted the sprint photo he took, with a caption praising the runner's spirit, and thanked @Feng Haoran. The post quickly exceeded 10,000 reads.

subevent.name: Received thank-you messages from running friends and replied to each one
subevent.description: After the official Weibo post, many fellow runners expressed their gratitude to Feng Haoran via private messages, praising him for capturing the spirit of the runners, including thanks from Gao Yunfei himself. Feng Haoran replied one by one to express his gratitude and shared some original photos with runners who needed them. The interaction lasted until 9 p.m. that evening.

name: Take parents on a family trip to Zhangjiajie to deepen family bonds.
description: From October 23 to 27, 2025, Feng Haoran planned and executed a family trip to Zhangjiajie with his parents. On October 23, he completed preparations such as vehicle inspection and supply purchases; on October 24, he drove his parents from Changsha to Zhangjiajie, checked into the Pullman Hotel, and in the evening tasted Tujia sanxiaguo (a local hot pot dish); on October 25, they visited Bailong Elevator, Yuanjiajie, and the Glass Skywalk, supporting and encouraging his mother who was afraid of heights throughout the journey, while his father recorded with his phone; on the morning of October 26, after packing luggage and buying souvenirs, they drove back to Changsha, and he sent his parents back to Wuhan by high-speed rail; on October 27, Feng Haoran organized the photos, shared them in the family group, and checked the total travel expense of about 11,000 yuan. This trip deepened the emotional bond among family members.

subevent.name: Pre-trip preparation and supplies shopping
subevent.description: On the day before departure, Feng Haoran made final pre-trip preparations, including checking the SUV's condition, planning the navigation route from Changsha to Zhangjiajie, packing luggage (clothes, medicine, camera, etc.), and going to the supermarket to buy snacks and drinking water for the road. At the same time, he confirmed the meeting time and precautions with his parents by phone.

subevent.name: Drive from Changsha to Zhangjiajie
subevent.description: On the morning of October 24, Feng Haoran drove his SUV from his home in Yuelu District, Changsha, taking his parents along the Chang-Zhang Expressway to Zhangjiajie City. They rested once at a service area along the way. Feng Haoran chatted with his parents and shared his expectations for the trip. His mother, Li Xiuying, felt slightly unwell from sitting too long, so Feng Haoran thoughtfully adjusted her seat and played soothing music. The whole trip took about 4 hours, and they arrived in downtown Zhangjiajie before noon.
subevent.location: Changsha City to Zhangjiajie City - Changzhang Expressway

subevent.name: Checked into Pullman Zhangjiajie
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 24, Feng Haoran drove to the five-star Pullman Hotel near the core scenic area of Zhangjiajie City and checked in. He had booked two adjacent deluxe rooms, one for his parents and one for himself. The three of them entered the rooms and rested briefly. Feng Haoran helped his parents adjust the air conditioner and TV, confirmed the hotel's surrounding facilities, and planned the afternoon's leisure activities.

subevent.name: In the evening, tasted Tujia San Xiaguo at the foot of Tianmen Mountain
subevent.description: On the evening of October 24, Feng Haoran took his parents on foot to a well-known Tujia restaurant at the foot of Tianmen Mountain, and tasted the local specialty dish Tujia Sanxiaguo. During the meal, his father Feng Jianguo enthusiastically recorded the dishes with his phone, while his mother Li Xiuying had not yet adapted to the mountain view due to acrophobia. Feng Haoran kept encouraging her and talked about the travel arrangements, creating a warm atmosphere. After dinner, the three strolled along Tianmen Mountain Square, enjoyed the sunset, and returned to the hotel to rest.
subevent.location: Zhangjiajie City - Tujia restaurant at the foot of Tianmen Mountain

subevent.name: Take the Bailong Elevator to visit Yuanjiajie
subevent.description: On the morning of October 25, Feng Haoran took his parents to Zhangjiajie National Forest Park and rode the Bailong Elevator, the world's tallest outdoor elevator. His mother, Li Xiuying, felt nervous as the elevator ascended; Feng Haoran held her hand the whole time and explained the scenery outside to distract her. His father, Feng Jianguo, excitedly used his phone to capture the stunning visuals of the vertical ascent. After arriving at Yuanjiajie, the three visited classic attractions such as Mihun Terrace and Hallelujah Mountain, and Feng Haoran took photos of his parents.
subevent.location: Zhangjiajie City - Bailong Elevator and Yuanjiajie Scenic Area

subevent.name: Experience the glass walkway and encourage mother.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 25, the three went to the Glass Plank Road at Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon. His mother, Li Xiuying, hesitated several times at the entrance because of her fear of heights. Feng Haoran patiently supported her, taught her to look into the distance and slow down, and they finally completed the entire plank road. His father, Feng Jianguo, walked ahead and kept recording, capturing the warm moment of mother-son interaction. After the plank road experience, the three bought souvenirs and sampled local snacks in the rest area of the scenic spot. Feng Haoran specially ordered a cup of hot tea for his mother to calm her nerves.
subevent.location: Zhangjiajie - Grand Canyon Glass Plank Road Scenic Area

subevent.name: Hotel tidying and return trip preparation.
subevent.description: On the morning of October 26, after having a buffet breakfast with his parents at the Pullman Hotel, Feng Haoran returned to the room to pack luggage and check for forgotten items. He helped his parents pack their belongings, checked out, and settled extra charges. After checking out, the three went to a specialty store near the hotel to buy gifts such as Zhangjiajie rock ear and eucommia tea. Feng Haoran used his phone to capture the last wonderful moments.
subevent.location: Zhangjiajie City - Pullman Hotel and surrounding area

subevent.name: Drove back to Changsha and ended the trip
subevent.description: At noon on October 26, Feng Haoran drove his SUV, carrying his parents from Zhangjiajie back to Changsha along the same route. On the way, his mother rested in the passenger seat due to fatigue, while his father discussed the travel experience with Feng Haoran and planned the next trip. After arriving in Changsha in the afternoon, Feng Haoran initially changed his plan to send his parents back to Wuhan and instead invited them to stay overnight at his home in Changsha (because it was late). However, according to the original plan, his parents were to return to Wuhan, so a reasonable adjustment here is: Feng Haoran took his parents to Changsha Railway Station, and they took the high-speed rail back to Wuhan (which is more realistic). Feng Haoran then drove alone back to his home in Yuelu District, tallied the total travel expenses of about 11,000 yuan, and planned to organize the photos later.
subevent.location: Zhangjiajie City to Changsha City - Chang-Zhang Expressway

subevent.name: Post-trip organization and photo sharing
subevent.description: On October 27, Feng Haoran was at his home in Changsha organizing the photos and videos taken during the trip, categorizing them by date and selecting 20 family group photos to upload to the family WeChat group. He had a video call with his parents via WeChat, shared untold interesting stories from the trip, and discussed intentions for the next trip with his mother. At the same time, he checked the detailed total travel expenses (accommodation, dining, tickets, fuel, etc., totaling about 11,000 yuan), confirmed they were within budget, and recorded the expenses in his personal financial management spreadsheet.

name: Family reunion at Yuelu Mountain with New Year's Eve stargazing camping
description: On December 30, his younger sister Feng Xinran arrived in Changsha from Shanghai. After picking her up at the station, Feng Haoran reunited with his parents and the whole family and discussed plans for a New Year's Eve camping trip. On the morning of December 31, Feng Haoran assembled camping supplies and confirmed the itinerary. In the evening, he climbed Yuelu Mountain with his parents and sister. After reaching the summit, they set up camp with 22 people from the photography association and climbing community, and Shen Xinyi set up a coffee station. At the stroke of midnight, Feng Haoran received six blessing text messages from his parents, sister, friends, supervisor, and photography partners. Under the starry sky, he replied to each one, then showed the screen to his family, saying, 'This is my year-end summary.'

subevent.name: Feng Xinran arrived in Changsha from Shanghai to reunite with family.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran's sister Feng Xinran took the high-speed rail from Shanghai and arrived at Changsha South Railway Station on the afternoon of December 30. After work, Feng Haoran drove to pick her up, and they returned together to their home in Yuelu District, where they had dinner with their parents Feng Jianguo and Li Xiuying, and discussed the itinerary for the next day's New Year's Eve camping activity.

subevent.name: Prepare supplies for the New Year's Eve camping
subevent.description: On the morning of December 31, Feng Haoran sorted out camping gear at home, including tent, sleeping bag, ground mat, headlamp, first aid kit, etc., then went to the supermarket to buy snacks, fruit and drinks for New Year's Eve. He also put a homemade home exercise tip card into his backpack, confirmed that Shen Xinyi had prepared the pour-over coffee equipment and coffee beans, and confirmed the meeting time and place with the heads of the photography association and climbing community via WeChat.

subevent.name: Feng Haoran climbed Yuelu Mountain with his parents and younger sister.
subevent.description: At 17:00 in the evening of December 31, Feng Haoran, together with his parents Feng Jianguo and Li Xiuying and his younger sister Feng Xinran, drove to the East Gate of Yuelu Mountain. Feng Haoran carried most of the camping equipment and led the family up the mountain along the hiking trail, explaining the history and culture of Yuelu Mountain along the way, and arrived at the predetermined campsite on the top of Yuelu Mountain at about 18:30.

subevent.name: Camping at the summit of Yuelu Mountain and event opening
