subevent.description: After arriving at the mountaintop campsite at 19:00 on December 31, Feng Haoran, along with a total of 22 members of the photography association and rock climbing community who had arrived one after another, set up tents and arranged the campsite. Shen Xinyi set up a hand-brewed coffee stand in a corner of the campsite and supplied hot coffee to the members present. Feng Haoran helped his parents and younger sister set up the family tent, and guided everyone to sit around the bonfire area.

subevent.name: New Year's Eve countdown and blessing text message interaction
subevent.description: At 23:59 on December 31, Feng Haoran counted down to the New Year together with his family and camp partners. When the midnight bell rang, Feng Haoran's phone received six blessing text messages one after another: his father Feng Jianguo reminded him to take care of his health; his mother Li Xiuying sent a photo of braised pork at home with the message "Waiting for you to come home and eat"; his younger sister Feng Xinran teased, "Brother, don't be too stubborn next year"; his good friend Peng Yuqing thanked him for his previous help and informed him that half of the loan had been repaid; his immediate superior Qian Yongqiang said, "Next year we'll let you mentor new people"; and his photography partner Xu Jialin invited him to shoot at the Pear Garden of East Lake in Wuhan next spring. Under the starry sky, Feng Haoran replied to each message one by one, turned the phone screen to his family, and said, "This is my year-end summary."

name: Planning to start an investment column and systematically organize creative materials
description: After the publication of his paper in September and client referrals in October, Feng Haoran realized that his local investment insights could help a broader audience. Starting October 20, he used time before bed every night and on weekends to systematically organize past research cases, market notes, and daily investment insights, while conceiving the positioning of his column—focusing on analysis of Hunan-based listed companies and asset allocation strategies. He initially planned 12 topics and began writing the first draft, intending to officially launch after the industry forum at the end of the year, thus building his personal brand.

subevent.name: Plan the column topics and finalize the first column article
subevent.description: Feng Haoran spent four days in his home study completing the first article of his column series. On the first day, he planned the framework for 12 column themes and made a publishing schedule. On the second day, he systematically collected information on leading advanced manufacturing enterprises in Hunan. On the third day, he wrote a draft of about 2,000 words of in-depth analysis based on the materials. On the fourth day, he revised and polished the draft and finalized it, planning to publish it online after the year-end forum.

subevent.name: Planning the framework for 12 column topics
subevent.description: At 9 a.m., Feng Haoran sat at his desk in his home study, opened his laptop and notebook, and based on his long-term observation of financial markets and investment research experience, listed 12 column theme directions, including industry analysis, company deep dives, investment strategy, market trends, etc., and formulated a publication order and timeline framework for each theme. The entire process took about 4 hours. After a brief lunch in the study at noon, he continued polishing the framework details, and by 5 p.m. completed the first draft of the framework document.

subevent.name: Collect information on leading enterprises in Hunan's advanced manufacturing industry.
subevent.description: Starting at 8 a.m. in his home study, Feng Haoran systematically collected financial data, business structure, industry position, and recent news of leading advanced manufacturing enterprises in Hunan through channels such as Huatai Securities’ internal data terminal, Wind Information, and company annual reports. As he collected, he organized key data into Excel spreadsheets and recorded key analysis points, fully preparing for the first draft of his first column. He finished the data collection and organization by 5 p.m.

subevent.name: Wrote the first column draft (in-depth analysis of Hunan's advanced manufacturing industry).
subevent.description: Feng Haoran got up at 7 a.m., went for a morning run, and then began writing his first column with full concentration in his home study at 8:30. Based on materials collected the day before, he took leading companies in Hunan's advanced manufacturing industry as the entry point, analyzing from the perspectives of corporate history, core competitiveness, financial performance, and future prospects, while incorporating his own investment views. The writing process lasted until 7 p.m., with two short breaks in between, and he eventually completed a draft of about 2,000 words, saved as a Word document.

subevent.name: Revising and polishing the first draft of the first column
subevent.description: At 9 a.m., Feng Haoran opened the previous day's draft in his home study, reviewed it paragraph by paragraph, corrected data citation errors, optimized sentence phrasing, and added an industry comparative analysis section to enhance the depth of the article. He also adjusted the article title and subtitles to make the structure clearer. At 3 p.m., he finished the revisions, finalized and saved the final version, and planned to officially publish it after the year-end industry forum.

name: Feng Haoran’s year-end community anti-fraud volunteer service and habit formation.
description: On December 5, 2025, Feng Haoran gathered recent high-incidence telecom fraud cases at home and in the office, organized them into a PPT and flyers, and prepared for the lecture. On the morning of December 6, he gave a special lecture on 'Preventing Year-End Financial Fraud' to about 40 elderly residents at Lushan Community Activity Center, Yuelu District, Changsha, explaining identification methods with cases, with the assistance of Community Director Liu. After the lecture, he helped 12 elderly people one-on-one set up mobile phone security features, including installing anti-fraud apps. On December 8, based on the event's success, he decided to make the community anti-fraud volunteer service a semiannual habit, set annual reminders for early June and early December in the electronic calendar, and confirmed cooperation intentions with Director Liu for the first half of next year, incorporating the volunteer service into his life schedule.

subevent.name: Prepare lecture materials and cases.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran collected recent high-incidence telecom fraud cases at home and in the office, organized them into easy-to-understand PPT presentations and paper flyers, prepared demonstration steps for mobile security feature settings, and contacted the community to confirm the availability of on-site projection equipment.
subevent.location: Home study in Yuelu District, Changsha, and Huatai Securities office

subevent.name: Conduct a special lecture on financial fraud prevention
subevent.description: On the morning of December 6, 2025, Feng Haoran gave a special lecture on "Preventing Year-End Financial Fraud" to about 40 elderly residents at Lushan Community Activity Center in Yuelu District, Changsha. Drawing on recent real cases such as telecom fraud and pension investment scams, he explained identification methods and countermeasures in plain language, and answered residents' questions on the spot. The lecture lasted about 1.5 hours, and the community provided the venue and refreshments.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District Lushan Community Activity Center

subevent.name: One-on-one help for an elderly person to set up mobile phone security features
subevent.description: After the lecture, Feng Haoran stayed on site to help elderly residents one-on-one with setting up mobile phone security features, including enabling spam blocking, installing the National Anti-Fraud Center app, teaching how to identify fraudulent text messages and calls, and patiently answering other questions about phone operation. He helped 12 elderly people in total, lasting about 1 hour.
subevent.location: Changsha City - Yuelu District Lushan Community Activity Center

subevent.name: Incorporate volunteer service into the annual schedule
subevent.description: Based on the success of this lecture, Feng Haoran decided to make community anti-fraud volunteer service a twice-a-year habit, and set annual reminders in his electronic calendar and journal: organize a community financial safety awareness talk in early June and early December each year. He also confirmed preliminary cooperation intentions for the first half of the following year with Community Director Liu via WeChat.

name: Adjust running training methods to strengthen half-marathon preparation
description: After the sharing session, Feng Haoran changed Wednesday's tempo run to a fartlek run based on the coach's advice, and added core strength training. In late December, he tried a 16 km run with Gao Yunfei, with a steady pace, and became more confident about next year's half marathon.

subevent.name: Create a plan for fartlek running and core training.
subevent.description: Following the coach’s advice from the sharing session, Feng Haoran used his computer and notebook in his study to redesign his Wednesday running training plan, changing the original tempo run to a Fartlek run, and planned to add two extra core strength training sessions per week (including planks, sit-ups, etc.) to strengthen his preparation for next year’s half marathon.

subevent.name: Execute the first fartlek run
subevent.description: At 6:30 Wednesday morning, Feng Haoran did his first Fartlek run training on Yuelu Mountain. Following the new plan, he alternated fast running and jogging over a total distance of about 10 kilometers, feeling the changes in running rhythm and recording heart rate data.

subevent.name: Perform the second fartlek run.
subevent.description: On Wednesday morning at 6:30, Feng Haoran continued his second Fartlek run training on Yuelu Mountain, further adapting to the variable pace, comparing his pace and heart rate with the previous session, and adjusting his breathing strategy.

subevent.name: Perform the third Fartlek run
subevent.description: At 6:30 Wednesday morning, Feng Haoran completed the last Fartlek run of the month on Yuelu Mountain, summarized the training effects of the past three weeks, recorded the best pace and his feelings, and prepared for the next phase of training.

subevent.name: Perform core strength training
subevent.description: Feng Haoran performed core strength training in his living room on the evenings of December 18 and December 25, with each session including planks, sit-ups, crunches, and other exercises, about 30 minutes each time, aiming to enhance core stability of the waist and abdomen to improve running endurance.
subevent.location: Changsha City - living room at home

subevent.name: Trial run of 16 km with Gao Yunfei
subevent.description: Feng Haoran invited running buddy Gao Yunfei for a 16-kilometer long-distance run test along the Xiangjiang River Scenic Belt. The two ran together at a steady pace, completing the entire distance in about 1 hour 28 minutes. After the run, they exchanged training insights, and Feng Haoran felt more confident about the half marathon next year.

name: Systematically study ESG courses and exchange ideas with peers.
description: From December 15 to 30, Feng Haoran systematically studied the six modules of the ESG online course, covering ESG rating systems, mainstream investment strategies, data analysis and impact investing, portfolio construction and risk management, reporting and disclosure standards, and future trends. During this period, he twice had video discussions with his college classmate Zhou Yuwei (a financial analyst at HSBC) about the application of ESG investing in China, combining theory with practice. After completing the course, he wrote in his diary: "Turning a bonus into knowledge is the real investment."

subevent.name: Study modules 1 and 2 of the ESG course.
subevent.description: On December 15, 2025, Feng Haoran began systematically studying the ESG online course in his study at home in Changsha. That day he completed Module 1 (ESG Rating System) and Module 2 (Mainstream Investment Strategies), spending about 2 hours on each module. Through the study, he learned about the ESG rating framework and common investment strategies, laying a foundation for further in-depth study.

subevent.name: First video discussion with Zhou Yuwei on ESG applications
subevent.description: Feng Haoran had a video call with his college classmate Zhou Yuwei (a financial analyst at HSBC) at his home in Changsha, lasting about 1.5 hours. The two had an in-depth exchange on the application scenarios of ESG investment in China. Zhou Yuwei shared ESG cases encountered by foreign banks in actual business, and Feng Haoran raised some thoughts based on the rating system he had just learned. The two inspired each other.
subevent.location: Changsha City - living room at home

subevent.name: Study the third module of the ESG course
subevent.description: Feng Haoran continued studying the third module of the ESG online course in his home study in Changsha, themed on ESG data analysis and impact investing strategies. He spent about 2 hours completing the video course and after-class exercises, mastering how to extract ESG indicators from public data and the evaluation methods for impact investments.

subevent.name: Study ESG course Module 4
subevent.description: Feng Haoran studied Module 4 of the ESG course in his study at home in Changsha, focusing on ESG portfolio construction and risk management. Through case analysis, he learned how to integrate ESG factors into portfolios and corresponding risk hedging strategies, spending about 2 hours on the study.

subevent.name: Second video discussion with Zhou Yuwei on ESG strategy.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran held a second discussion with Zhou Yuwei via video at home, lasting about 1.5 hours. This exchange focused on the specific implementation of ESG investment strategies, including how to integrate ESG ratings into existing investment models and domestic policy developments. Zhou Yuwei provided a reference for HSBC's internal ESG analysis framework, while Feng Haoran, drawing on his own experience as an investment advisor, proposed optimization ideas.
subevent.location: Changsha City - living room at home

subevent.name: Studied the fifth module of the ESG course.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran studied Module 5 of the ESG course in his study at his Changsha home, on the topic of ESG Reporting and Disclosure Standards. He spent about 2 hours learning about global ESG reporting frameworks (such as GRI and SASB) and the challenges companies face in the disclosure process, taking detailed notes.

subevent.name: Study the sixth module of the ESG course and summarize.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran completed the sixth module of the ESG course in his study at his home in Changsha, which covered future trends in ESG and career development. After that, he organized all his study notes and wrote in his diary, 'The bonus being transformed into knowledge is the real investment.' The entire summarization process took about 2.5 hours, marking the end of this systematic learning session.

name: Compare and select personal pension fund products.
description: Starting on November 11, 2025, Feng Haoran collected information on personal pension fund products through multiple bank platforms. After initial screening, in-depth analysis, and comparison, he finally selected three balanced funds on November 20 and determined the allocation ratio. On November 22, he organized the records and set a reminder, planning to complete the contribution before December 15 to enjoy tax benefits.

subevent.name: Collect pension product information.
subevent.description: On Saturday, November 15, in his study at home in Changsha, Feng Haoran logged into the mobile apps and official websites of multiple banks, including the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, China Construction Bank, and China Merchants Bank, via his phone and computer. He checked the lists of personal pension fund products one by one, focusing on product type, risk level, historical returns, and fee information. He recorded the names and basic parameters of more than ten selected balanced funds in an Excel spreadsheet to prepare for subsequent comparative analysis.

subevent.name: Preliminary screening of fund products
subevent.description: On Monday evening, November 17, after work, Feng Haoran used professional financial analysis software in the company office and, combined with his own investment knowledge, conducted a preliminary screening of the collected pension fund products. He focused on comparing indicators such as risk level (R2-R3), annualized return since inception, and maximum drawdown. He excluded funds with excessive volatility or too low returns, narrowed the candidate list to 6 products, and detailed the manager, custodian bank, and fee structure of each fund.

subevent.name: In-depth analysis of candidate funds
subevent.description: On Tuesday, November 18, Feng Haoran used his lunch break and after-work time in his home study to conduct an in-depth analysis of six candidate funds through platforms such as Tiantian Fund Network and Morningstar Ratings. He reviewed each fund's quarterly holdings reports, fund managers' career experience, and historical ranking trends within their categories, and used Excel to build a comparison model, calculating risk-adjusted return metrics such as the Sharpe ratio and information ratio. In the end, he narrowed his focus to three balanced funds with stable long-term performance and low fees.

subevent.name: Finally Selected Three Funds
subevent.description: On Thursday, November 20, after finishing the day's work, Feng Haoran made the final selection among three deeply analyzed funds in his home study in Changsha. He checked each fund's subscription and redemption rules, whether automatic investment plans were supported, and account management convenience. Considering his own risk tolerance (steady type) and long-term retirement goals, he officially selected three balanced personal pension funds (Fund A, Fund B, and Fund C), planning to allocate them at 40%, 35%, and 25% respectively, making product preparations for the annual contribution in December.

subevent.name: Record the selected result and plan the contribution.
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, November 22, at his home in Changsha, Feng Haoran organized the detailed information of the three finally selected balanced funds, including product codes, subscription channels, and planned regular investment amounts, into a document and saved it in his personal finance folder. At the same time, he set a reminder on his phone calendar to complete the contribution to his personal pension account by December 15, 2025 (before the annual contribution deadline), to ensure he enjoys the tax benefits for that year.

name: Accompanied parents to get flu shots
description: On November 14, at his parents' home, Feng Haoran guided his father by phone to find the vaccination record book, organized the family health electronic file, and called the community health service center to consult, booking flu vaccines for his parents for the next day from 9:00 to 9:30. Early on the 15th, he accompanied his parents on foot to the community health service center, completed registration, verification, and vaccination, and returned home after a 30-minute observation with no abnormalities.

subevent.name: Organized family health records and contacted the community doctor
subevent.description: At 1:30 p.m., returned to the office. Asked my father over the phone to find the previous vaccination record booklet and take photos to send over. Feng Haoran entered his parents' vaccination records for hepatitis B, influenza, pneumonia, etc. into the family health spreadsheet one by one. Then he called the Yuelu District Community Health Service Center in Changsha to ask for the doctor's advice: mother Li Xiuying, due to chronic gastritis, needed influenza + pneumonia vaccines; father Feng Jianguo could just get the influenza vaccine. The doctor said there were appointments the next morning and sufficient vaccine supply. Feng Haoran booked appointments for his parents for the 15th, 9:00-9:30, on the APP.
subevent.location: Hubei Province - Wuhan City - Jiang'an District - parents' home

subevent.name: Received flu vaccination and stayed for observation
subevent.description: After arriving at the community health service center, Feng Haoran accompanied his parents to go through registration, identity verification, and vaccination in turn. The three of them each received the current season's flu vaccine. After the vaccinations, they rested and observed for 30 minutes in the observation area as instructed by the doctor. During that time, Feng Haoran chatted with his parents to confirm there were no adverse reactions.
subevent.location: Vaccination room and observation area, Community Health Service Center, Jiangan District, Wuhan, Hubei Province

name: Mother was hospitalized with erosive gastritis; took leave to accompany her and handle the family health crisis
description: After last month's mother's stomach discomfort was not taken seriously, on April 1st she was diagnosed with erosive gastritis with mild bleeding and required hospitalization. Feng Haoran returned from Changsha to Wuhan overnight, asked for a week's leave from work (April 1 to 7) to stay with her throughout. The Qingming holiday (April 4 to 6) was spent in the hospital, and he was unable to return to his hometown to pay respects to his ancestors, deeply feeling the urgency of 'wanting to care for his parents but time doesn't wait.' During that period, his father's blood pressure rose due to anxiety and fatigue. Feng Haoran arranged for his aunt to help take turns caring, and consulted a doctor to formulate a low-salt, low-fat diet plan for his father. On the night of April 6, he had a long talk with his father late into the night. His father stressed that health and family come first. For the first time, Feng Haoran truly reflected on his previous disregard for such advice and was deeply moved. On April 7, his mother improved and was discharged. Feng Haoran escorted her home and settled her well, then drove back to Changsha in the evening, ending a week of care.

subevent.name: Returned to Wuhan urgently and took leave
subevent.description: In the early morning of April 1, 2025, Feng Haoran received a phone call from his father at home in Changsha and learned that his mother had been diagnosed with erosive gastritis with mild bleeding and needed hospitalization. He immediately packed his bags and drove overnight from his residence in Yuelu District, Changsha, back to Wuhan, arriving at Wuhan Central Hospital in Jiang'an District, Wuhan at around 4 a.m. In the morning, he called his immediate supervisor, Qian Yongqiang, to ask for a week's leave (April 1 to 7). After it was approved, he arranged a work handover and then went through the hospital admission procedures for his mother, taking part in the entire emergency admission process.

subevent.name: Taking care of mother and coordinating family responsibilities.
subevent.description: During the day on April 2, Feng Haoran accompanied his mother at the hospital for IV fluids and examinations, and her condition gradually stabilized. Because his father, Feng Jianguo, had elevated blood pressure of 150/95 mmHg due to anxiety, Feng Haoran calmed his father down and called his aunt Feng Xiuzhen, who lives in Wuhan, to discuss a rotating care plan. They agreed that his aunt would come to the hospital for two hours every afternoon to help so that his father could go home and rest. At the same time, Feng Haoran began recording the doctor's ward-round instructions to understand the treatment cycle and care points for erosive gastritis.
subevent.location: Wuhan City - Gastroenterology Ward, Wuhan Central Hospital

subevent.name: Consult a doctor to formulate a diet plan for my father
subevent.description: On the morning of April 3, Feng Haoran proactively consulted his mother's primary physician to learn about low-salt and low-fat dietary precautions for his father, who has hypertension. The doctor provided a detailed dietary recommendation list based on his father's condition. Feng Haoran photographed the list and immediately organized a weekly family meal plan in his phone notes, planning to reduce salt and oil intake at home and buy fresh vegetables and whole grains. In the afternoon, he continued to accompany his mother in the ward, while relaying the doctor's rehabilitation advice to her and encouraging her to actively cooperate with treatment.
subevent.location: Wuhan - Doctor's office and ward at Wuhan Central Hospital

subevent.name: Accompanying a patient at the hospital during the Qingming holiday
subevent.description: On April 4th, Qingming Festival, Feng Haoran spent the whole day at Wuhan Central Hospital accompanying his mother, and was unable to return to his hometown in Jiangan District as planned to perform ancestral rites. From the ward balcony, he paid a distant tribute in the direction of his hometown, feeling the urgency of the saying, "A son wants to care for his parents, but they do not wait." During the day, he monitored his mother's blood pressure and heart rate, assisted nurses with changing dressings, and recorded fluid intake and output. His father Feng Jianguo came to visit in the morning. Because his blood pressure was still high, Feng Haoran made sure his father took his antihypertensive medication on time, and advised him to reduce anxiety and stay emotionally stable. Aunt Feng Xiuzhen came to take over in the afternoon, giving Feng Haoran a brief rest.
subevent.location: Wuhan City - Gastroenterology Ward, Wuhan Central Hospital

subevent.name: Accompany mother and have family communication
subevent.description: On the morning of April 5, Feng Haoran continued to stay at the hospital with his mother. Her stomach bleeding had stopped, and she had begun to eat liquid food. Feng Haoran printed out the low-salt, low-fat diet plan prescribed by the doctor, gave his father and aunt a copy each, and bought suitable ingredients with his father. In the evening, his father came to the hospital to stay for the night. Feng Haoran chatted with his father in the corridor outside the ward, again discussing the importance of family health management. His father's mood was calmer than the previous day.
subevent.location: Wuhan City - Inpatient Department of Wuhan Central Hospital

subevent.name: Late-night heart-to-heart talk with father and reflection.
subevent.description: On April 6, the mother's condition improved significantly. After the ward round, the doctor told them she could be discharged next week. At 10 p.m., Feng Haoran had a long conversation with his father Feng Jianguo on the hospital rooftop. The father earnestly advised: health and family come first; making money and career are secondary. Previously, Feng Haoran had always urged his father to pay attention to his health, but he himself didn't take it seriously. This time, his mother's illness made him fully realize this. Feng Haoran truly reflected for the first time on his own neglect of family health advice. Deeply moved, he hugged his father and cried, promising to take his parents for regular checkups and adjust his lifestyle in the future. The two didn't return to the ward until 11 p.m.
subevent.location: Wuhan City – rooftop of Wuhan Central Hospital

subevent.name: Assist mother with hospital discharge and return to Changsha
subevent.description: On the morning of April 7, with all of his mother Li Xiuying's indicators reaching their target levels, Feng Haoran completed the hospital discharge procedures and obtained the discharge summary and a list of follow-up medications (gastric mucosal protectants and dietary restrictions). He accompanied his mother back to her home on Jiefang Avenue, Jiangan District, Wuhan, settled her daily routine, and confirmed that his father had mastered low-salt, low-fat cooking methods. In the afternoon, he handed over follow-up care arrangements to his aunt, confirming that she would visit twice a week. In the evening, Feng Haoran drove from Wuhan back to his residence in Yuelu District, Changsha, ending a week of caregiving and preparing to return to work the next day.
subevent.location: Home in Jiangan District, Wuhan, and residence in Yuelu District, Changsha

name: Attend the advanced rock climbing system training camp and achieve monthly progress.
description: Starting in September, Feng Haoran attended the advanced climbing systematic training camp every Sunday evening. Under the coach's guidance, he focused on strengthening finger strength, core, and pull-up training. The successful completion of V2 and the breakthrough in pull-ups at the September 20 climbing exchange competition proved the effectiveness of the training. By the end of September, he could consistently complete V2 routes and began challenging V3 difficulty. Training data records showed a 15% increase in grip strength.

subevent.name: V3 climbing route challenge and breakthrough training
subevent.description: From October 5 to November 9, 2025, Feng Haoran conducted special training on V3 routes every Sunday evening at the Extreme Climbing Gym in Changsha. In the early phase starting October 5, he warmed up on V2 routes, focused on challenging three V3 routes, and worked on overcoming slopers and insufficient pinky endurance, with intermittent fingerboard strengthening and incremental pull-up training. After October 26, he entered the breakthrough phase, stably completing three V3 routes, adding V3+ route challenges, strengthening finger endurance and weighted pull-ups, and reviewing moves with coach Li Qiang after class.

subevent.name: Early challenges on the V3 difficulty route
subevent.description: Based on consistently completing V2 routes, Feng Haoran began attempting V3-difficulty routes every Sunday evening. During training, he first warmed up with two V2 routes, then focused on challenging three V3 routes, trying each route 3–5 times, with a focus on overcoming slopers and insufficient pinky endurance. Li Qiang guided him on weight distribution and footwork choices, and during rest breaks he performed fingerboard strength training. In the latter half of the session, he did pull-ups with an increasing number of reps, gradually going from 6 reps per set to 8, and recorded the completion status each time.

subevent.name: V3 Route Breakthrough and Intensive Training
subevent.description: Entering the V3 route breakthrough stage, Feng Haoran does high-intensity training every Sunday evening at the Ultimate Climbing Gym and can now stably complete three V3 routes. The training routine has been adjusted: first complete one V3 route as a warm-up, then challenge the more complex V3+ routes, with emphasis on strengthening finger endurance. Each session includes a 15-minute dedicated pull-up training, alternating between wide grip, narrow grip, and weighted pull-ups, with repetitions increased to 10 per set. After class, he discusses movement sequence optimization with Li Qiang and records videos for technical review.

name: The [Baozi] life photo corner at the photo exhibition became a heartwarming highlight
description: In the '[The Warmth of the Street Corner]' photo exhibition, Feng Haoran set up a special corner displaying four candid shots of Baozi on the windowsill and bookshelf. These photos, with their everyday warmth, drew comments from visitors. A friend from the photography association praised him for capturing ordinary warmth through his lens. This experience made him realize the appeal of life-themed subjects and also brought more human warmth to the coffee shop.

subevent.name: Preparations for the photography exhibition.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran began preparing on November 3, 2025, for the photography exhibition "The Temperature of the Street Corner." He first selected four life photos of Baozi in his home study, and the next day went to a print shop in Furong District to develop and frame them in uniform frames. Over the following days, he confirmed the booth with the organizers by phone, and went to Xinyi Hand-Drip Coffee to discuss the layout details with the owner, Shen Xinyi. Finally, on November 7, he prepared sticky notes, artwork description cards, and display tools at home, completing all the preparations.

subevent.name: Selected exhibition photos
subevent.description: Feng Haoran carefully browsed street photography works on his phone and camera in his home study. From the recent Baozi series photos taken in Changsha, he selected 4 candid life photos showing baozi in natural states on windowsills and bookshelves. These photos match the theme requirements of the 'Temperature of the Street Corner' photography exhibition. He recorded the shooting parameters and intended artistic conception of each photo in a notebook, preparing for the subsequent production of description cards.

subevent.name: Printed and framed photos
subevent.description: Feng Haoran brought the selected electronic files of 4 photos to a professional print shop in Furong District, Changsha, chose high-quality photo paper for printing, and purchased simple wooden frames of uniform size on site for framing. He made sure each photo was the same size, carefully checked the corners and cleanliness during the framing process, and finally packed them up and brought them home, preparing the exhibits for the photo exhibition.
subevent.location: Furong District, Changsha – Professional Print Shop

subevent.name: Confirm the booth with the film festival organizer.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran contacted the organizers of the [The Temperature of the Street Corner] photography exhibition by phone and WeChat to confirm the specific location, booth size, and installation time requirements for his personal exhibition area. He recorded the organizer's setup specifications, and asked about the location of power outlets and lighting conditions, so as to later coordinate the display arrangement inside the coffee shop and ensure a smooth flow for the exhibition.

subevent.name: Discussing exhibition area layout with the coffee shop owner.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran went to Xinyi Hand-Drip Coffee Shop and met with the owner Shen Xinyi in person to discuss the specifics of setting aside a corner of the café as his personal exhibition area. The two measured the wall space on site, discussed the hanging method of photos, auxiliary lighting, and a layout that would not affect customer flow, and agreed on the coordination details between the café's business hours and the exhibition area's opening hours during the exhibition. They eventually reached a consensus and confirmed November 10 as the date for moving in and setting up the exhibition.

subevent.name: Prepare photo exhibition materials and description cards
subevent.description: At home, Feng Haoran sorted out the supplies needed for the photo exhibition: he prepared a stack of colored sticky notes and several marker pens for visitors to leave messages; wrote brief description cards for each exhibited photo, including the shooting time, location, story behind the image, and creative inspiration, then printed and trimmed them to a uniform size; meanwhile, he checked the installation tools such as frame hooks and a level, packed all the materials into storage boxes, and made sure everything would be brought along on the day of the exhibition.

name: Diet plan adjustment for competition preparation
description: In mid-December, Feng Haoran adjusted his daily diet based on the suggestions of his running coach and Gao Yunfei's dietary experience: he increased his intake of chicken breast, broccoli, and whole-wheat bread, and reduced high-fat, high-sugar takeout. He began making his own healthy lunch boxes and recording his daily protein and carbohydrate intake to ensure his physical energy could support high-intensity training.

subevent.name: Consulting on meal plan and shopping preparation
subevent.description: After his morning run, Feng Haoran talked with the running group coach and adjusted his diet structure based on the coach's suggestions. Then he exchanged diet experiences via WeChat with fellow runner Gao Yunfei, and combined both opinions to formulate a personal diet plan. Following that, he went to a nearby supermarket to buy healthy ingredients such as chicken breast, broccoli, and whole wheat bread, and also bought a lunch box and a food scale in preparation for making his own lunch bento.
subevent.location: Home in Yuelu District, Changsha, and nearby supermarket

subevent.name: After the morning run, consulted the running club coach for dietary advice.
subevent.description: After waking at 5:30 am, Feng Haoran went for his morning run at the foot of Yuelu Mountain as usual. After the run, he met Coach Wang, the running team coach, at the end point of the run on Lushan South Road, and proactively asked how to adjust his diet to optimize running performance and physical condition. Based on Feng Haoran's current weight of 75 kg and training volume (5 km daily, strength training three times a week), Coach Wang advised increasing protein intake and reducing refined carbohydrates, and recommended specific food types and meal pairing principles. The conversation lasted about 15 minutes.
subevent.location: End point of morning run, Lushan South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha

subevent.name: Exchanged diet tips with running buddy Gao Yunfei on WeChat.
subevent.description: At 9:00 a.m., Feng Haoran contacted his running buddy Gao Yunfei via WeChat at his home in Changsha, and the two discussed the topic of dietary adjustments. Gao Yunfei shared his experience over the past six months of successfully reducing his body fat percentage from 18% to 15% by changing his diet (increasing chicken breast, broccoli, and avocado, while reducing rice and fried foods), and recommended practical bento recipes and high-protein snack brands. Feng Haoran carefully took notes and asked how to stick to making his own lunch bento without affecting work. Gao Yunfei suggested preparing meals over the weekend and using a food scale to control portions. Their WeChat voice call lasted about 20 minutes.

subevent.name: Synthesize opinions to formulate a personal diet plan
subevent.description: At 20:00 in the evening, in the study of his home in Changsha, Feng Haoran combined the professional advice of Coach Wang from the running club and the practical insights of his running partner Gao Yunfei to develop a personal two-week diet adjustment plan. He opened his laptop and used Excel to list optional foods for breakfast, lunch, and dinner each day (breakfast: 2 slices of whole wheat bread + 2 boiled eggs + unsweetened soy milk; lunch: 150 g chicken breast + 200 g broccoli + 100 g brown rice; dinner: 100 g salmon + mixed vegetable salad + a small amount of quinoa), and planned three snacks per week (small packs of nuts, Greek yogurt). He also listed a shopping plan: chicken breast, broccoli, whole wheat bread, salmon, avocado, quinoa, and other ingredients, as well as tools such as lunch boxes and a food scale. The entire plan took about 40 minutes to complete.

subevent.name: Go to the supermarket to buy healthy ingredients and tools.
subevent.description: After work at 17:30, Feng Haoran walked to the Jiarunduo Supermarket near the company (Furong Middle Road store, Kaifu District, Changsha). Following the diet plan list, he first selected chicken breast (800g), salmon (300g), avocado (4), broccoli (2), mixed vegetable salad packs (3 bags), and one bag each of brown rice and quinoa in the fresh food area; then bought two bags of whole wheat bread and a box of unsweetened soy milk powder in the dried goods area. Next, he picked out a three-layer partitioned stainless steel lunch box (capacity 1.2L) and a digital kitchen scale (precision 0.1g) on the kitchenware shelf, and also bought two sets of plastic portion containers. At checkout, he paid by credit card, with a total purchase amount of about 380 yuan. The whole shopping trip took about 45 minutes; after returning home, he stored the ingredients by category in the refrigerator.
subevent.location: Changsha - Jiarunduo Supermarket, Kaifu District (Furong Middle Road Branch)

subevent.name: Execute the first-phase diet plan
subevent.description: Feng Haoran followed his formulated diet plan, getting up early every morning to prepare a healthy lunch box, mainly containing chicken breast, broccoli, and whole wheat bread. He used a food scale to record the protein and carbohydrate intake of each meal and wrote it in a memo. At the same time, he reduced his intake of takeout and greasy food and kept regular meals.
subevent.location: Changsha - Home Kitchen and Huatai Securities Office

subevent.name: Made a healthy lunch and recorded nutritional intake every day.
subevent.description: From December 15 to 22, 2025, Feng Haoran woke up early every morning to prepare healthy lunch boxes in his home kitchen using chicken breast, broccoli, and whole-wheat bread. He used a food scale to precisely record his protein and carbohydrate intake, noting it in his phone's memo. He then brought the lunch box to the Huatai Securities office and ate it at noon. Meanwhile, he persisted in reducing takeout and greasy foods and kept a regular three-meal routine.
subevent.location: Changsha - Home kitchen; Changsha - Huatai Securities office

subevent.name: Execute the second phase of the diet plan and make adjustments.
subevent.description: Building on his ongoing daily intake records, Feng Haoran fine-tuned his diet based on his body's responses, appropriately increasing the carbohydrate ratio from whole wheat bread, and optimizing fat and protein intake by adding legume protein and avocado. He insisted on making his own bento boxes and recording daily to ensure balanced nutrition to support high-intensity running training.
subevent.location: Changsha - home and Huatai Securities office

subevent.name: Start the second phase of the diet plan.
subevent.description: Feng Haoran started the second phase of his diet plan at home in Changsha. In the morning, he made a high-protein lunch bento box by hand (chicken breast + broccoli + quinoa), and for the first time used a mobile app to record his daily intake data, ensuring the calories and nutrient ratios matched the plan set by his coach.

subevent.name: Continue with the diet plan and data tracking
subevent.description: After getting up in the morning, Feng Haoran made his own bento (with an increased proportion of vegetables). In the morning, while working at the Huatai Securities office, he ate on time. In the afternoon, he recorded all food intake for the day, checked the protein, carbohydrate, and fat ratios, and observed no adverse reactions in his body.
subevent.location: Changsha - home and Huatai Securities office

subevent.name: Adjust the carbohydrate ratio and increase whole wheat bread.
subevent.description: Based on the weight and training recovery feedback from the past two days, Feng Haoran proactively changed his lunch staple from white rice to two slices of whole wheat bread while eating in the office at noon, increasing the proportion of complex carbohydrates, updated the recipe template in the app, and recorded the impact of this adjustment on his afternoon energy.

subevent.name: Fine-tune the diet plan to ensure balanced nutrition
subevent.description: On a weekend morning, Feng Haoran carefully prepared a lunch bento at home (adding legume protein and leafy green vegetables). In the afternoon, while reviewing the week's diet records, he found the fat ratio was slightly low, so he added a small serving of avocado at dinner and updated the next day's meal plan.

subevent.name: Summarized the implementation of the second phase of the diet plan.
subevent.description: At home in Changsha, Feng Haoran reviewed the execution results of the entire second-phase diet plan, organized the diet record data from December 23 to 31, calculated average intake of calories, protein, carbs, and fat, wrote down adjustment insights, and formulated a preliminary plan for the next phase.

name: Fine-tuned fund positions in response to market changes
description: Based on the annual audit, Feng Haoran fine-tuned his fund positions in December and paused new high-risk investments. By December 31st, as the market recovered, his personal portfolio exceeded 1 million yuan, achieving the annual core goal.

subevent.name: Conduct annual investment portfolio audit
subevent.description: On December 2, 2025, Feng Haoran conducted a comprehensive audit of his personal investment portfolio, reviewing the performance of each fund, risk assessment, and asset allocation ratios, in preparation for subsequent rebalancing.

subevent.name: Fine-tune fund positions and suspend high-risk investments
subevent.description: Based on the annual audit results, Feng Haoran made minor adjustments to his fund positions on December 3 through the Huatai Securities trading system, reducing holdings of high-risk thematic funds and increasing holdings of low-risk bond funds and money market funds, while deciding to suspend any new high-risk investments.

subevent.name: Monitor market trends and adjust fund holdings
subevent.description: After rebalancing, Feng Haoran tracked securities market dynamics and fund NAV changes daily starting December 4, 2025, focusing on the performance of funds already held. On December 10, based on nearly a week of observation, he fine-tuned positions using a risk assessment model (reducing low-volatility bond funds and increasing mixed funds); then continued high-frequency tracking, recording market sentiment and sector rotation data. On December 18, he further optimized the portfolio structure by transferring some profits from mixed funds into money market funds to lock in gains. Throughout the process, he strictly followed the strategy of suspending new high-risk investments.

subevent.name: Analyze the market and adjust the proportion of holdings.
subevent.description: In the office, Feng Haoran carefully analyzed the dynamics of the securities market over the past week and the changes in the net value of his held funds. Noticing a clear market recovery trend, he decided to adjust his holding ratios accordingly. Based on a risk assessment model, he fine-tuned the positions of some funds (reducing low-volatility bond funds and increasing mixed funds), while strictly adhering to the strategy of pausing new high-risk investments. All operations were executed through the company's trading system.

subevent.name: Daily market tracking (Week 2)
subevent.description: Feng Haoran continues to keep a high-frequency watch on securities market developments and fund NAVs every trading day, focusing on the performance of funds whose positions have been adjusted, while recording market sentiment indicators and sector rotation data to accumulate decision-making basis for subsequent operations.

subevent.name: Second adjustment of position ratios
subevent.description: After reviewing recent market trends and fund NAV changes, Feng Haoran further optimized his portfolio structure based on the recovery trend: transferred part of the gains from mixed funds into money market funds to lock in profits, while maintaining the principle of zero new additions to high-risk assets, and completed the rebalancing through the trading system.

subevent.name: Personal investment portfolio exceeds 1 million yuan
subevent.description: As the market continued to recover at the end of December, Feng Haoran's personal investment portfolio total market value surpassed the 1 million yuan mark on December 31, achieving his core annual goal. He confirmed the account balance through the trading app that day and recorded this milestone.

name: Maintained perfect attendance in the MBA FinTech course and reshaped my academic attitude.
description: To fulfill his perfect attendance commitment, Feng Haoran has attended the MBA "Fintech" course on time every Tuesday and Thursday evening since October 9. He actively participates in case discussions, organizes notes after class, and communicates with classmates online, striving to make up for the academic gap caused by last semester's absences. The course content also inspired him to incorporate fintech tools into his daily work analysis.

subevent.name: Attend the first 'Financial Technology' course and do after-class review and preview
subevent.description: On the evening of October 9, Feng Haoran attended the first session of the 'Financial Technology' course, actively participated in case discussions, and organized his notes. On the evening of October 10, he systematically reviewed the course content to make up for knowledge points missed last semester. On the morning of October 11, he exchanged insights with classmates online, previewed next week's content in the afternoon, and organized his study files in the evening.
subevent.location: Classroom, Business School, Hunan University, Changsha

subevent.name: Attend the first FinTech course and organize notes
subevent.description: On the evening of Thursday, October 9, 2025, Feng Haoran arrived on time at the multimedia classroom of the School of Business Administration at Hunan University to attend the first lecture of the Financial Technology course. In class, he listened carefully to the instructor's introduction to the syllabus and assessment methods, actively participated in case discussions, and shared his insights on the application of fintech in mobile payments and blockchain.
